Nevertheless, KRAS mutations were more frequently observed in patients with left-sided colon tumors, contrasting with the findings described in the literature. KRAS mutations were associated with poorer prognosis, higher rates of metastases (particularly to the liver), and higher rates of resistance to conventional treatments, such as chemotherapy. This study highlights the importance of KRAS mutation testing to support personalized, more effective treatment strategies to improve the prognosis of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer.
cn_title: 转移性结直肠癌KRAS基因突变与临床病理因素的关联研究
insight: 该研究再次证实KRAS突变与mCRC肝转移及化疗耐药相关，支持KRAS检测指导个体化治疗，但单中心回顾性设计证据等级有限。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性研究，样本量仅96例，无外部验证，结论与既往文献一致，难以改变现有临床实践。

title: Quality indicators in colonoscopies performed in digestive endoscopy services in northeast Brazil.
authors: Alves AIR, Teixeira FG
journal: Arquivos Brasileiros de Cirurgia Digestiva : ABCD = Brazilian Archives of Digestive Surgery
abstract: Colorectal cancer is the third most frequently diagnosed cancer worldwide. Colonoscopy is fundamental in reducing its incidence and mortality, provided it follows certain quality parameters. Examples of these quality parameters are the cecal intubation rate, adenoma detection rate (ADT), and the adequate percentage of patients with satisfactory bowel preparation. To measure the quality parameters of a colonoscopy service in Northeast Brazil. Methods: A cross-sectional, retrospective study, with data collected from electronic medical records, including screening colonoscopies between 2022 and 2024. 565 colonoscopies were included in the study. The overall ADR was 24.78, 21.27% in women and 32.03% in men. The cecal intubation rate was approximately 95%, and most patients (91.3%) had excellent bowel preparation. The polyp detection rate was 39.47%. The cecal intubation rate and the proportion of patients with adequate bowel preparation were satisfactory. However, the polyp detection rate was lower than recommended in the literature. Thus, evaluating these parameters is a way to monitor the quality of colorectal cancer prevention, improving the strategies employed, even in the face of the limitations encountered.
cn_title: 巴西东北部消化内镜中心结肠镜检查质量指标评估
insight: 该研究评估了巴西东北部结肠镜质量指标，腺瘤检出率达标但息肉检出率偏低，提示需加强内镜质量控制以优化结直肠癌筛查效果。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性研究，样本量中等，虽涉及质控但未提出新干预，对临床实践改变有限。

title: Implementation of perioperative nutritional care from the ACERTO Project in patients with colorectal cancer: feasibility and benefits.
authors: Frizon E, Nascimento DBD, Costa FAMD, Berto RT, Vendrametto SM, Tonello PL, et al.
journal: Revista Do Colegio Brasileiro de Cirurgioes
abstract: Cancer patients are more susceptible to compromised nutritional status, especially when undergoing surgery. Minimizing the metabolic response and muscle catabolism associated with surgical trauma and accelerating postoperative recovery are objectives of advanced recovery protocols such as the Accelerated Postoperative Total Recovery Project (ACERTO). In this context, the study aimed to implement and evaluate the feasibility and benefits of perioperative nutritional care recommended by ACERTO in an oncology hospital. Retrospective cohort study developed with adult and elderly patients with colorectal cancer undergoing laparotomy performed between 2018 and 2024. The study followed three phases: phase 1: ACERTO's pre-implementation data; phase 2: implementation of the ACERTO Project; and phase 3: ACERTO's post-implementation data. Demographic, clinical, surgical, and nutritional data, as well as outcomes, were collected in phases 1 and 3 and subjected to statistical analyses for comparison between the pre- and post-ACERTO phases. 275 pre-implantation and 101 post-implantation patient records were analyzed. Post-ACERTO patients were older (p=0.014), had higher body weight (p=0.002), higher BMI (p=0.012), and higher nutritional risk according to the NRS-2002 (p=0.015). Nutritional care improved after ACERTO implementation (p<0.05) and resulted in reduced postoperative IV fluids (p<0.001). Those who received less IV fluids had fewer complications (p=0.003). Also, after ACERTO implementation, those who were re-fed early (≤ 36 hours) had shorter hospital stays (p=0.006). The results showed that the implementation of the ACERTO nutritional guidelines at HCCU proved feasible and with important benefits for patients..
cn_title: ACERTO围手术期营养方案在结直肠癌患者中的实施可行性与获益
insight: ACERTO围手术期营养方案在肿瘤医院可行，减少术后静脉输液并促进早期再喂养，缩短住院时间，为肠癌围手术期营养管理提供实践依据。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性前后对照研究，样本量中等，虽显示营养管理改善与获益，但证据等级有限，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Index-window C-reactive protein and carcinoembryonic antigen and five-year all-cause mortality in Hispanic/Latino and non-Hispanic White patients with colorectal cancer: a retrospective biomarker cohort study.
authors: Martinez F, Cuomo RE
abstract: To examine index-window carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA), C-reactive protein (CRP), and five-year recorded mortality by ethnicity in colorectal cancer. This retrospective University of California Health Data Warehouse cohort included Hispanic/Latino and non-Hispanic White adults indexed during 2012-2020 with both biomarkers measured within ±30 days and complete covariates. Linear regression modeled log(CEA + 0.1); Cox regression modeled recorded all-cause mortality. Among 345 patients, 143 deaths were recorded. Hispanic/Latino ethnicity was associated with higher log(CEA + 0.1) (β = 0.743; robust 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.202-1.285; P = 0.007). The mortality association was nonsignificant (hazard ratio [HR], 0.723; 95% CI, 0.483-1.084; P = 0.117). Higher log(CEA + 0.1) (HR, 1.266; 95% CI, 1.174-1.366; P < 0.001) and log(CRP + 0.1) (HR, 1.134; 95% CI, 1.037-1.239; P = 0.006) were associated with mortality. In this biomarker-selected cohort, Hispanic/Latino patients had higher recorded CEA without a statistically significant ethnic-group mortality difference. Confirmation requires clinically characterized cohorts with stage, treatment, biomarker timing, verified assay comparability, and complete mortality ascertainment.
cn_title: 西班牙裔/拉丁裔与非西班牙裔白人结直肠癌患者基线CEA、CRP与五年全因死亡率的回顾性生物标志物队列研究
insight: 在生物标志物可及人群中，CEA与CRP升高均独立预测结直肠癌五年全因死亡，但西班牙裔/拉丁裔死亡率差异不显著；提示炎症-肿瘤标志物联合分层值得在肝转移人群中进一步验证。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性生物标志物队列，样本量有限（345例）且缺乏分期与治疗信息，仅具假设生成价值，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Engineered mesenchymal stem cell-derived small extracellular vesicles delivering miR-124 suppress colorectal cancer progression through EZH2 downregulation and attenuation of STAT3 signaling.
authors: Behzadi Andouhjerdi R, Hosseini F, Hosseinzadeh N, Zivari S, Salkhordeh S, Mohammadi M, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) progression is driven by dysregulated molecular pathways and epigenetic alterations, including enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2)-mediated histone methylation and STAT3 hyperactivation. While microRNA-124 (miR-124) acts as a tumor suppressor by targeting EZH2, its clinical translation is hindered by delivery challenges. Here, we engineered mesenchymal stem cell-derived small extracellular vesicles (MSC-sEVs) to deliver miR-124, exploiting their tumor-homing capacity and biocompatibility to suppress CRC progression. Bioinformatic analysis of clinical datasets revealed miR-124 downregulation in CRC tissues, correlating with advanced stages and poor prognosis. Lentiviral transduction enabled efficient miR-124 packaging into MSC-sEVs, which were internalized by CRC cells, restoring functional miR-124 levels. Mechanistically, miR-124 directly silenced EZH2, thereby suppressing its oncogenic activity. This led to attenuated STAT3 phosphorylation-a dual effect that inhibited proliferation, migration, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in CRC cells. In vitro, MSC-sEV-miR-124 induced apoptosis, sensitized cells to 5-fluorouracil, and reversed chemoresistance via EZH2 downregulation. In vivo, MSC-sEV-miR-124 significantly reduced tumor growth in BALB/c mice, downregulated EZH2/STAT3 signaling, and suppressed Ki-67 and EMT markers in xenografts. This study provides proof-of-concept that engineered MSC-sEVs can serve as a delivery platform for miR-124 in murine CRC models, offering a dual-targeting strategy against EZH2 and STAT3 to disrupt CRC progression. Our findings suggest that EV-based miRNA delivery warrants further investigation as a strategy to modulate the tumor microenvironment, providing a foundation for development aimed at overcoming epigenetic and oncogenic signaling barriers in CRC therapy.
cn_title: 工程化间充质干细胞小细胞外囊泡递送miR-124通过下调EZH2及抑制STAT3信号抑制结直肠癌进展
insight: 该研究证实工程化MSC-sEVs可高效递送miR-124，通过EZH2/STAT3双靶点抑制CRC增殖、EMT并逆转5-FU耐药，为肠癌（含肝转移）EV-miRNA治疗提供概念验证。
grade_rationale: 研究为临床前小鼠模型的概念验证，机制清晰但缺乏人体数据与外部验证，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: A propionate metabolism-related gene signature predicts prognosis and immunological features in colorectal cancer.
authors: Yuan S, Li S, Chen C
abstract: Propionate metabolism has emerged as a key metabolic axis shaping colorectal cancer (CRC) biology and the tumor microenvironment; however, propionate metabolism-related molecular stratification and its prognostic and therapeutic implications remain insufficiently characterized. Transcriptomic profiles of The Cancer Genome Atlas colon adenocarcinoma (TCGA-COAD) and rectum adenocarcinoma (TCGA-READ) were integrated to construct a CRC training cohort, and GSE38832 served as an external validation set. Propionate metabolism-related genes (PMRGs) were curated from GeneCards and intersected with differentially expressed genes to define differentially expressed PMRGs (DEPMRGs). Prognostic DEPMRGs were screened by univariate Cox regression and used for consensus clustering to identify propionate metabolism-related subtypes, followed by functional enrichment and immune landscape profiling (ESTIMATE, single-sample Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, and CIBERSORT). After adjustment for clinicopathological characteristics, Cox proportional hazards modeling was performed to verify whether the signature retained independent prognostic relevance. To facilitate individualized risk estimation, a nomogram was constructed from the significant variables, and its reliability and potential value in clinical decision-making were further evaluated through calibration analysis and decision curve analysis. Immunotherapy relevance was explored using Immunophenoscore and Tumor Immune Dysfunction and Exclusion, and anti-PD-L1 response was assessed in the IMvigor210 cohort. To characterize molecular differences across risk subgroups, the mutational landscape and tumor mutational burden were profiled with the maftools package, whereas potential therapeutic susceptibility was inferred from pRRophetic prediction and CellMiner-based drug response analyses. Application of consensus clustering to prognostic PMRG-related genes revealed two molecular classes in CRC, which were distinguished by different prognostic patterns and immune microenvironmental characteristics. A four-gene prognostic signature was then established, enabling classification of patients into low- and high-risk subsets with clearly separated survival curves in the training cohort; this predictive pattern was further reproduced in GSE38832. Comprehensive immune characterization demonstrated that the two risk groups differed substantially in immune-cell infiltration, checkpoint-gene expression, and immunotherapy-associated signatures, with the low-risk group showing a more favorable predicted response in the IMvigor210 cohort. Propionate metabolism-associated subtyping and a four-gene prognostic signature enable robust risk stratification in CRC and link metabolic programs to immune contexture and therapeutic vulnerability, providing a potential framework for prognosis assessment and individualized treatment.
cn_title: 丙酸代谢相关基因特征预测结直肠癌预后及免疫特征
insight: 该研究构建丙酸代谢相关四基因预后模型并揭示其与免疫微环境及治疗敏感性的关联，为肠癌风险分层和个体化治疗提供代谢-免疫新视角，但肝转移相关性未直接涉及。
grade_rationale: 基于公共数据库的生信分析，有外部验证但非前瞻性，证据等级中等，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: The circMTCL1/miR-145-5p/BMP3 axis suppresses colorectal cancer cell growth by mediating the MAPK signaling pathway.
authors: Liu L, Jiang D, Jia Y, Dong Y, Zhao W
abstract: Circular RNAs play key roles in colorectal cancer (CRC). Here, we examine the function and underlying mechanism of circMTCL1 in CRC. The expression of circMTCL1 in CRC tissues and cell lines were detected by quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR). The function of circMTCL1 was elucidated through overexpression and knockdown studies. Furthermore, a combination of Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH), nuclear-cytoplasmic fractionation, RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP), qRT-PCR, Western blotting, and dual-luciferase reporter assays was employed to elucidate the tumor-suppressive mechanism of circMTCL1 in CRC. circMTCL1 was significantly downregulated in CRC tissues compared to adjacent normal tissues, showing a 17.08-fold decrease (P < 0.001). It functioned as a competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) by specifically binding to miR-145-5p, thereby modulating the expression of Bone Morphogenetic Protein 3 (BMP3). Overexpression of circMTCL1 markedly inhibited the proliferation, migration, and invasion of CRC cells, resulting in a 3.76-fold decrease in proliferation (P < 0.001), and 1.58-fold and 2.00-fold decreases in migration and invasion, respectively (P < 0.001). Furthermore, circMTCL1 overexpression upregulated BMP3 expression by 1.60-fold (P < 0.001). Further investigation revealed that circMTCL1 regulates tumor progression by suppressing the activation of the MAPK signaling pathway. circMTCL1 acts as a tumor suppressor in CRC. Its mechanism likely involves sponging miR-145-5p to regulate BMP3 expression and modulating the MAPK signaling pathway. These findings provide a new perspective on the pathogenesis of CRC and identify a potential therapeutic target for clinical intervention.
cn_title: circMTCL1通过miR-145-5p/BMP3轴抑制结直肠癌细胞生长并调控MAPK信号通路
insight: 该研究揭示circMTCL1作为ceRNA吸附miR-145-5p上调BMP3、抑制MAPK通路，为结直肠癌提供新的抑癌靶点与预后标志物线索。
grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，仅细胞与组织层面验证，缺乏动物模型及临床转化验证，暂不具备改变临床实践的证据等级。

title: Individual and Occupational Factors Associated with Receipt of Guideline-Concordant Cancer Screening in California Firefighters.
authors: Gabriel J, Urwin D, Nguyen TT, Rohlf E, Glenn BA, Fejerman L, et al.
journal: Cancer Epidemiology, Biomarkers & Prevention : a Publication of the American Association for Cancer Research, Cosponsored By the American Society of Preventive Oncology
abstract: Firefighters face elevated cancer risk due to occupational exposures, yet cancer screening adherence and associated factors remain poorly characterized. We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of survey data from 3,076 active-duty career firefighters in California without a prior cancer diagnosis. Screening adherence was evaluated against U.S. Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) guidelines for colorectal (CRC), breast, cervical, prostate, skin, and lung cancer. Multivariable logistic regression was used to assess the associations between screening receipt and demographic, occupational, behavioral, clinical, and health belief factors. Overall, screen-eligible participants were racially/ethnically diverse (25% Hispanic; 37% non-White), had a mean age of 41 years, and a mean tenure in the fire service of 17 years. Receipt of guideline-concordant screening varied by cancer type and guideline: CRC (54% NFPA, 68% USPSTF), breast (76%), cervical (75%), prostate (59% NFPA, 78% USPSTF), skin (29%), and lung (ever low-dose computed tomography, 10%). Older age (odds ratio [OR]=1.19-2.65 per 5 years), 1+ years since a routine doctor's visit (OR=0.36-0.58), and family history of cancer (OR=1.33-1.77) were consistently associated with receipt of cancer screening. Firefighters who were younger (yet within eligibility age range), had not recently engaged in routine healthcare, and did not have a family history of cancer were less likely to be screened. This is the first broad characterization of cancer screening among career firefighters, identifying potentially actionable targets for interventions to close screening gaps in this high-risk population.
cn_title: 加州职业消防员癌症筛查依从性及其个体与职业相关因素分析
insight: 首次系统刻画职业消防员多癌种筛查依从性，结直肠癌筛查率仅54%-68%；提示高危职业人群需针对性干预以缩小筛查缺口。
grade_rationale: 横断面调查、单一人群、无随访结局，仅提示筛查缺口与可干预靶点，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Why Do Prehabilitation Studies Differ? Patient Selection and Program Design in Colorectal Cancer Surgery.
authors: Dong Y, Si G, Zhuang S, Jiang J, Wang W, Wu D
abstract: BackgroundPrehabilitation (PH) aims to optimize postoperative outcomes in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), yet randomized trials have shown variable benefits. This meta-analysis investigated factors contributing to heterogeneous effects, including patient age, intervention duration, and program composition. The objectives were to evaluate the efficacy of PH on postoperative recovery and outcomes and identify factors influencing its effects.MethodsRandomized controlled trials (RCTs) were searched in PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library from database inception to Sep. 2024. Postoperative recovery included functional outcomes (eg, 6-minute walk test [6MWT] and grip strength), while postoperative outcomes included complications, readmission, and mortality. Data were pooled using random-effects models, with sensitivity and subgroup analyses performed.ResultsSixteen RCTs were included. PH improved 6MWT performance (SMD 0.23, 95% CI 0.11-0.35) and reduced 30-day complications (RR 0.77, 95% CI 0.62-0.95). No significant effects were observed on other recovery indicators or outcomes, including length of stay, readmission, reoperation, and mortality. Subgroup analysis suggested greater benefits from multimodal PH in patients aged <70 years.ConclusionPH may improve functional recovery and reduce 30-day complications after CRC surgery, but its effects vary according to patient characteristics and intervention strategies. Although multimodal programs and younger patients may derive greater benefits, these findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation. Further high-quality RCTs are needed to establish optimal PH strategies for specific patient populations.
cn_title: 结直肠癌手术预康复研究异质性：患者选择与方案设计
insight: 预康复可改善结直肠癌术后功能恢复并降低30天并发症，但疗效受年龄与方案组成影响，提示需个体化设计预康复策略。
grade_rationale: 基于16项RCT的Meta分析，证据等级较高，但异质性大且结论为假设生成性，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: HESTIA: scalable multimodal integration of histology and high-resolution spatial Transcriptomics for robust spatial domain identification.
authors: Zhong Z, Zhu X, Guo J, Liao S, Chen A
abstract: Spatial omics has revolutionized molecular biology by providing invaluable insights into how native tissue microenvironments regulate cellular functions and disease mechanisms. Accurately capturing this structural complexity and decoding the underlying biological processes requires effectively integrating data from multiple modalities. However, transitioning to subcellular resolutions introduces massive data scales and severe transcriptomic sparsity, which challenge current analytical frameworks. To address this, we present HESTIA (Histology-Enhanced Scalable cross-Resolution inTegration for spatial trAnscriptomics), a highly efficient multimodal algorithm designed for identifying spatial domains in large-scale, high-resolution spatial omics data. By circumventing memory-intensive computations, HESTIA efficiently processes massive datasets on which existing algorithms fail due to memory constraints. HESTIA outperforms current multimodal methods in clustering accuracy and spatial continuity, accurately delineating fine structural boundaries. Furthermore, applying HESTIA to large-scale pathological samples successfully dissects clinically relevant intratumoral heterogeneity and maps distinct immune microenvironments in lung and colorectal cancers.
cn_title: HESTIA：组织学与高分辨率空间转录组的多模态整合用于空间域识别
insight: HESTIA突破高分辨率空间转录组数据规模与稀疏性瓶颈，可精细解析结直肠癌瘤内异质性与免疫微环境，为肝转移微环境研究提供可扩展的多模态分析工具。
grade_rationale: 方法学创新性强且可扩展，但尚属算法验证阶段，未直接改变临床决策。

title: Causal decomposition framework for quantifying intervenable cancer health disparities.
authors: Xia F, Lee SK, Kim S, Blum K, Hong HG, Canchola AJ, et al.
abstract: This study proposes a nonparametric decomposition framework to quantify and prioritize the impact of multiple intervenable mediators contributing to disparities in health outcomes. Identifying modifiable components of health disparities is essential for informing policy and guiding resource allocation, but several methodological challenges remain. These include formulating hypothetical interventions for immutable characteristics such as race or ethnicity, mitigating bias from potentially incompatible statistical models used to represent causal pathways, and evaluating multiple mediators for their joint and individual effects. To address these challenges, we integrate recent advances in health disparities research with modern machine learning techniques. A key assumption, common to causal disparity frameworks, is the absence of unmeasured confounding in the mediator-outcome relationship. We extend existing methods in mediation analysis and introduce a nonparametric sensitivity analysis that provides sharp bounds on modifiable disparity estimates in the presence of unmeasured confounding. Together, these methods offer a robust and flexible approach to causal disparity analysis, enabling the identification of high-impact, actionable interventions. We demonstrate the utility of the methods in the context of colorectal cancer survival disparities, a setting where persistent differences across racial, ethnic, and underserved populations in the United States underscore the urgent need for analytic strategies that uncover effective intervention points.
cn_title: 量化可干预癌症健康差异的因果分解框架
insight: 该研究提出非参数因果分解框架，可量化并排序结直肠癌生存差异中的可干预中介因素，为精准干预和政策制定提供方法学工具。
grade_rationale: 方法学创新性强，但尚属框架构建与示例分析，未直接改变临床实践，需后续实证验证。

title: Sleep disturbance trajectories in cancer survivors during the transition to survivorship: a prospective examination of modifiable predictors and physical health outcomes.
authors: Emrich M, Gnall KE, Magin ZE, Bellizzi KM, Park CL, Sanft T
journal: Annals of Behavioral Medicine : a Publication of the Society of Behavioral Medicine
abstract: Sleep disturbance is common among cancer survivors, but more research is needed to understand individual differences and predictors during the transition from primary treatment to early survivorship. This study aimed to: (1) model sleep disturbance trajectories among cancer survivors from post-primary treatment into early survivorship, (2) examine the relationships of general (i.e., anxiety, depression, emotion dysregulation) and cancer-specific (i.e., illness beliefs, fear of cancer recurrence) factors with sleep disturbance trajectories, and (3) examine the association between sleep disturbance trajectories and changes in physical health. A total of 501 breast, colorectal, and prostate cancer survivors (24-80 years old, 69.9% female, 84.6% White) completed self-report measures at baseline (approximately 3 months post-primary cancer treatment) and 3-, 6-, 9-, and 12-month follow-ups. Latent class linear mixed modeling identified distinct trajectories of sleep disturbance. Psychosocial correlates of trajectory membership were examined using multinomial logistic regression. A linear regression tested whether sleep trajectory class was associated with changes in physical health over one year. Three sleep disturbance trajectories were identified: low and slightly improving (44.3%), average and slightly improving (32.9%), and high and slightly improving (22.8%). Individually, higher emotion dysregulation, anxiety, depression, fear of cancer recurrence, and illness beliefs significantly differentiated the high sleep disturbance group from the low and average groups. In the combined model, only anxiety and depression symptoms remained significant. The high sleep disturbance group had significantly less improvement in physical health over one year compared to the low group. Both general and cancer-specific psychosocial factors appear to play a key role in identifying individuals at risk for persistent sleep disturbance following cancer treatment. Sleep disturbance trajectories were also associated with changes in physical health over one year, underscoring the importance of early intervention.
cn_title: 癌症幸存者治疗过渡期睡眠障碍轨迹的前瞻性研究
insight: 揭示癌症幸存者从治疗结束到早期生存期存在三类睡眠障碍轨迹，焦虑抑郁是关键可干预预测因子，且高睡眠障碍组躯体健康改善更差，提示肠癌幸存者需早期心理-睡眠联合干预。
grade_rationale: 发表于心理肿瘤学领域主流期刊，501例多癌种前瞻队列设计较扎实，但非肠癌专属且为观察性研究，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Association of food insecurity with gastrointestinal and hepatic conditions in U.S. adults: A population-based study.
authors: Lin JC, Lin JC, Zhao J, Gardner G, Mehta SJ, Moleski SM, et al.
abstract: BackgroundFood insecurity affects 2.33 billion people worldwide and disproportionately impacts those with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). However, population-level evidence linking food insecurity and gastrointestinal (GI) conditions remains limited.AimTo examine the association between food insecurity and GI conditions, including IBD, hepatitis, and GI cancers, among U.S. adults using national survey data.MethodsWe analyzed 2023-2024 National Health Interview Survey data from U.S. adults reporting food insecurity and GI conditions, including IBD, hepatitis, and GI cancers. Multivariable logistic regression assessed associations, adjusting for demographic and socioeconomic factors.SummaryAmong 57,860 adults, 14.1% of those with GI conditions reported food insecurity versus 8.8% without. Food insecurity was significantly associated with GI conditions (adjusted odds ratio (OR): 1.68; 95% CI: 1.44-1.97), particularly IBD (OR: 1.78; 95% CI: 1.42-2.23) and hepatitis (OR: 1.67; 95% CI: 1.33-2.09). Over half of food-insecure individuals with GI conditions (55.4%) lacked Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program benefits; only 14.0% were up-to-date on colorectal cancer screening. Food insecurity is strongly linked to GI conditions, yet many lack assistance, indicating the importance of screening and interventions in GI care.
cn_title: 美国成人粮食不安全与胃肠及肝脏疾病的关联：一项基于人群的研究
insight: 粮食不安全与IBD、肝炎及消化道肿瘤显著相关，且该人群肠癌筛查率极低，提示肠癌防控需关注社会经济弱势群体的筛查干预。
grade_rationale: 基于全国大型调查的多变量回归分析，样本量大但为横断面关联，仅提示筛查干预方向，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Punctate Nuclear MLH1 Staining With the VENTANA M1 Clone in Colorectal Carcinoma: Identification of 3 Patterns in Matched Biopsy-Resection Specimens.
authors: Akhter JZ, Dhaliwal D, Khoshab N, Marginean EC
abstract: In colorectal carcinoma (CRC), deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) is an established predictive and prognostic biomarker and an essential screening marker for Lynch syndrome. Immunohistochemistry (IHC) for MLH1, PMS2, MSH2, and MSH6 is routinely used to assess expression of mismatch repair (MMR) proteins. Strong, homogeneous nuclear staining in tumor cells supports MMR proficiency (pMMR), whereas the absence of tumor nuclear staining in the presence of intact internal controls supports dMMR. Loss of protein expression typically occurs in heterodimeric pairs, most commonly MLH1/PMS2 or MSH2/MSH6, although isolated loss of PMS2 or MSH6 may also occur. A clinically important interpretive pitfall is the punctate or dot-like nuclear staining pattern observed with the VENTANA anti-MLH1 M1 clone. This aberrant pattern represents MLH1 loss but may be misinterpreted as retained MLH1 expression, particularly by pathologists unfamiliar with its significance. We evaluated 24 paired biopsy-resection CRC cases, including 11 MLH1/PMS2-deficient cases in which biopsy specimens showed punctate MLH1 staining with the M1 clone. In the corresponding resection specimens, 3 distinct MLH1 staining patterns were identified: pattern 1, complete loss of nuclear staining throughout the tumor; pattern 2, punctate staining in superficial tumor cells with complete loss in deeper tumor regions; and pattern 3, punctate staining throughout the tumor. Repeat MLH1 IHC using the BioCare Medical G168-15 clone confirmed that punctate nuclear staining with the VENTANA M1 clone corresponds to true MLH1 protein loss. Four cases were initially misinterpreted by the original pathologists, underscoring the clinical impact of this artifact. Our findings indicate that dMMR staining patterns, particularly aberrant MLH1 staining, are more susceptible to interpretive error than conventional retained staining patterns. Recognition of punctate MLH1 staining as a manifestation of MLH1 loss is essential to prevent false MMR-proficient interpretation and to ensure appropriate molecular workup, Lynch syndrome triage, and therapeutic decision-making.
cn_title: 结直肠癌中VENTANA M1克隆MLH1点状核染色的三种模式及其误判风险
insight: 揭示VENTANA M1克隆MLH1点状核染色实为MLH1缺失，易被误判为pMMR，直接影响Lynch筛查与免疫治疗决策，需在病理判读中警惕。
grade_rationale: 基于24对配对样本的回顾性研究，虽样本量小，但直接揭示常规IHC判读陷阱并具明确实践纠偏价值。

title: Cancer incidence and mortality in the Metropolitan Area of Bucaramanga, Colombia, 2013-2017.
authors: Caballero Rojas H, Hormiga CM, Uribe Pérez CJ, Meza EE
abstract: Cancer is a global public health problem. Population-Based Cancer Registries (PBCRs) are essential tools for characterizing the epidemiology of the disease and evaluating the impact of public health interventions aimed at controlling it. To estimate cancer incidence and mortality in the Metropolitan Area of Bucaramanga (AMB) during 2013-2017. Descriptive retrospective population-based study of incidence and mortality. Invasive cancer cases were obtained from the Population-Based Cancer Registry of the AMB database, and population and mortality data from the National Administrative Department of Statistics (DANE). Crude and age-standardized incidence and mortality rates were calculated, both overall and sex-specific. During the study period, 11,815 incident cancer cases were recorded, excluding non-melanoma skin cancer. Age-standardized incidence rates per 100,000 person-years were 173.6 in men and 179.6 in women. The leading sites were prostate, stomach, and colorectal in men, and breast, thyroid, and colorectal in women. The age-standardized mortality rates were 117.56 per 100,000 man-years and 89.91 per 100,000 woman-years. Incidence and mortality rates for most sites are higher than those observed in the previous five-year periods. PBCRs are the main cancer surveillance tool and are essential for formulating and evaluating public cancer-control policies.
cn_title: 哥伦比亚布卡拉曼加都会区2013-2017年癌症发病与死亡分析
insight: 基于人群癌症登记的描述性流行病学研究，提示该地区结直肠癌为高发瘤种，为区域防控策略提供基线数据，但对肝转移机制与治疗无直接启示。
grade_rationale: 描述性人群登记研究，样本量较大但无干预与验证，仅具区域公共卫生参考价值，难以改变临床实践。

title: Incidental Appendiceal Adenocarcinoma Discovered After Ileocecectomy for Recurrent Small Bowel Obstruction: A Case Report.
authors: Bhachawat A, Marfatia H, Chintalapati S, Winter K
abstract: We report a case of moderately differentiated appendiceal adenocarcinoma discovered on histopathologic examination following ileocecectomy for recurrent SBO in a woman in her early 50s with a history of stage III rectal adenocarcinoma in remission. Notably, serial surveillance imaging over two years had demonstrated a radiographically normal appendix prior to the obstructive presentation. Immunohistochemical and histopathologic features confirmed a metachronous primary malignancy rather than metastatic recurrence. This case exemplifies the diagnostic challenge posed by occult appendiceal neoplasms, the importance of meticulous histopathologic evaluation of all resected specimens, and the need to consider rare malignant etiologies in patients with recurrent bowel obstruction and a prior colorectal cancer history.
cn_title: 复发性小肠梗阻行回盲部切除术后偶然发现阑尾腺癌一例
insight: 提示既往结直肠癌患者出现复发性肠梗阻时需警惕异时性阑尾原发肿瘤，强调对切除标本的细致病理评估以避免误判为转移复发。
grade_rationale: 单例个案报道，无外部验证或机制探索，仅提供临床警示，不足以改变临床实践。

title: Synergistic effects of sacituzumab govitecan and radiotherapy in preclinical models of colorectal cancer.
authors: Wang R, Situ Y, Wang W, Liao Y, He J, Deng Y, et al.
abstract: Although radiotherapy (RT) remains the standard of care for locally advanced colorectal cancer (CRC), intrinsic and acquired resistance frequently compromise long-term outcomes. Sacituzumab govitecan (SG)-a TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate-offers a targeted platform for intracellular SN-38 delivery. The aim of the present preclinical study was to investigate whether SG enhances radiosensitivity in CRC, thereby providing a preclinical rationale for the clinical evaluation of SG-based combination strategies. We evaluated SG-RT synergy across CRC cell lines with differential TROP2 expression (SW480, DLD-1 vs SW620, HCT116). In mechanistic studies, clonogenic assays, flow cytometry, cell counting kit-8, Western blot, and comet assays were utilized to assess cell survival, apoptosis, and DNA damage. TROP2 was knocked down or overexpressed to validate its role in radiosensitization. In TROP2-high CRC cell lines (SW480, DLD-1), combined SG and RT markedly inhibited proliferation, increased apoptosis, and amplified DNA double-strand breaks, as evidenced by elevated γ-H2AX expression and comet assay tail moments. Knockdown of TROP2 abrogated this synergy, whereas TROP2 overexpression restored it. In CDX and PDX models, SG combined with RT significantly suppressed tumor growth, increased cleaved CASP3 and γ-H2AX expression, and reduced Ki-67 without exacerbating systemic weight loss. Our findings identify SG as a potent radiosensitizer, providing a strong rationale for integrating SG into neoadjuvant RT regimens for locally advanced CRC.

title: Mapping risk: Spatial analysis of 2,4-D herbicide emissions and colorectal cancer.
authors: Baxter D, Dixon DA, Morris AJ, Zheng T, Zhu Y
abstract: Colorectal cancer remains a major public health concern in Arkansas and across the United States, disproportionately affecting rural and vulnerable populations. Beyond established lifestyle and genetic factors, environmental exposures, particularly agricultural chemicals, are increasingly recognized as potential contributors. In this ecological study, we screened 133 county-level estimated air pollutants to identify candidates associated with colorectal cancer incidence rates, focusing on Arkansas due to its agricultural economy and widespread herbicide use. Using publicly available environmental and cancer registry data, we applied spatial mapping, correlation tests, linear regression, and spatial regression models. Among screened pollutants, 2,4-Dichlorophenoxyacetic acid (2,4-D), a widely used herbicide, emerged as the top candidate. In Arkansas, 2,4-D emissions showed a strong positive association with colorectal cancer incidence rates (Spearman ρ = 0.338, p = 0.003; linear regression β1 = 6.28, p = 0.001), with high-emission counties aligning spatially with elevated incidence. This relationship was further confirmed in analyses of more than 2,500 U.S. counties, where 2,4-D emissions remained significantly associated with colorectal cancer (linear regression β1 = 5.94, p < 0.001; spatial regression β1 = 2.55, p = 0.001). Spatial regression improved model fit and accounted for geographic autocorrelation in both datasets. These findings suggest a potential association between 2,4-D emissions and colorectal cancer incidence rates, particularly in agricultural regions such as Arkansas. While causal inference is limited by the ecological design, the consistency of results warrants follow-up with individual-level, longitudinal, and mechanistic studies.

title: Clinical Implementation and Perioperative Outcomes of Robot-Assisted Pelvic Exenteration for Primary Rectal Cancer: A Multicenter Japanese Experience.
authors: Yamamoto S, Kagawa H, Yatabe Y, Kinugasa Y
abstract: Robot-assisted pelvic exenteration (RPE) has been introduced as a minimally invasive option for selected patients; however, its clinical implementation, patient selection, and perioperative outcomes for primary rectal cancer remain unclear. This study describes the use and outcomes of RPE in a multicenter Japanese cohort. This retrospective observational secondary analysis included patients who underwent pelvic exenteration (PE) for primary rectal cancer at 26 Japanese institutions between January 2012 and October 2022. Patient characteristics, surgical indications, temporal trends in operative approach, and perioperative outcomes were summarized descriptively. Propensity score-matched analyses were performed as supplementary exploratory analyses. Among 135 patients, 43 (32%) underwent RPE, 57 (42%) underwent laparoscopic PE, and 35 (26%) underwent open PE. In the RPE cohort, median operative time was 690 min, median blood loss was 360 mL, and 13 patients (30%) received intraoperative transfusion. One patient (2%) required conversion to open surgery, and RM0 resection was achieved in 42 (98%). Clavien-Dindo Grade II or higher and Grade III or higher complications within 30 days occurred in 16 (37%) and seven (16%) patients, respectively. No patient underwent reoperation during hospitalization or died within 30 days. Grade III or higher morbidity between 31 and 90 days occurred in five patients (12%). Median hospital stay was 23 days. RPE was performed with acceptable perioperative outcomes in selected patients with primary rectal cancer. It may serve as a complementary approach at institutions with sufficient experience in PE, whereas open surgery remains essential for extensive or technically demanding disease.

Colonoscopy revealed a large deep rectal ulcer with mucopurulent exudate, and pelvic magnetic resonance imaging showed rectal wall thickening with regional lymphadenopathy, raising concern for rectal cancer. Histopathology showed inflammatory changes without malignancy. Rectal secretion testing was positive for

title: Development and internal validation of a prediction model for suboptimal bowel preparation in individuals aged ≤50 years undergoing colonoscopy.
authors: Jiang F, Chen X, Wei Z, Lin S, Liu L, Ma P, et al.
abstract: The incidence of early-onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) has increased in recent decades, leading to more frequent colonoscopy use in younger adults. Adequate bowel preparation is essential for colonoscopy quality, but predictors of suboptimal bowel preparation and individualized risk assessment tools remain insufficiently defined in this population. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 2,283 consecutive individuals aged ≤50 years who underwent complete colonoscopy between June 2017 and December 2025. Bowel preparation quality was assessed using the Boston Bowel Preparation Scale (BBPS). Suboptimal bowel preparation was defined as a total BBPS score <6 or any segmental score <2. Colonoscopy indication was evaluated separately. Two multivariable logistic regression models were defined according to predictor availability relative to selection of the bowel-preparation regimen: a baseline model containing patient characteristics available before selection of the bowel-preparation regimen and an extended model that additionally included preparation and treatment variables. Performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic analysis, 1,000-resample bootstrap internal validation, calibration, Brier score, and decision curve analysis (DCA). Exploratory analyses examined age-group-by-predictor interactions in a same-centre older comparison cohort, calendar-period adjustment, and internal temporal validation. Suboptimal bowel preparation occurred in 426 participants (18.7%). Colonoscopy indication was not associated with suboptimal preparation after adjustment (global likelihood-ratio Patient characteristics available before regimen selection provided moderate discrimination for suboptimal bowel preparation. Adding preparation and treatment variables modestly improved performance and estimated residual risk after the selected regimen. Because these variables were not randomly assigned, their associations should not be interpreted as causal treatment effects. The model was developed for individuals aged ≤50 years who completed standard preparation without rescue cleansing and underwent complete colonoscopy. Its absolute risk estimates reflect the pooled 2017-2025 case mix; recalibration or model updating and external validation are required before clinical use.

title: Yield and Predictors of Histologically Confirmed Colorectal Polyps in Adults Younger Than 45 Years Undergoing Non-screening Colonoscopy: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
authors: Senyondo G, Shehadah A, Lee AK, Megere WH, Apon IH, Baskaran P, et al.
abstract: Background Early-onset colorectal cancer is increasing, but diagnostic colonoscopy yield below the routine screening age remains incompletely characterized. We evaluated histologically confirmed colorectal polyps in adults younger than 45 years undergoing non-screening colonoscopy. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 727 patients aged 18-44 years who underwent non-screening colonoscopy within a community health system during 2023-2024. Screening, surveillance, prior colorectal polyps or cancer, high-risk family history, inflammatory bowel disease, and hereditary colorectal cancer/polyposis syndromes were excluded. Outcomes required endoscopic identification and final histopathology. Logistic regression examined age, recorded sex, and body mass index (BMI), with aggregated indication and continuous-variable sensitivity analyses and a parsimonious neoplastic lesion model. Results Histologically confirmed polyps were present in 217/727 patients (29.8%; 95% confidence interval (CI), 26.6%-33.3%); yields were 17.4%, 33.0%, and 46.2% at ages 18-29, 30-39, and 40-43 years. Neoplastic lesions occurred in 139/727 (19.1%) and advanced colorectal neoplasia in 33/727 (4.5%), including four invasive cancers and one intramucosal carcinoma. In the primary model (n=724), adjusted odds ratios were 2.03 (95% CI, 1.35-3.06) for ages 30-39, 3.84 (95% CI, 2.31-6.38) for ages 40-43, and 1.85 (95% CI, 1.31- 2.62) for male sex. Obesity-class estimates were non-monotonic; class II was imprecise (1.84; 1.01-3.32), including after indication adjustment (1.79; 0.98-3.25). Primary model discrimination was modest (area under the curve, 0.692). The continuous age and the secondary neoplastic lesion model supported the age association; spline analysis suggested a non-linear association between BMI and polyp presence. Conclusion Histologically confirmed polyps and neoplastic lesions were not uncommon in this selected non-screening cohort. Findings support timely diagnostic evaluation when clinically indicated but do not establish population prevalence, justify screening before age 45, or validate a clinical prediction tool.

title: Multiomic and Spatial Profiling of Colorectal Tissue Reveals Viral Persistence and Immune Dysregulation in Long COVID.
authors: LaFranchi B, Maison DP, Vinden J, Rodriguez AE, Tout A, Grimbert L, et al.
journal: Biorxiv : the Preprint Server for Biology
abstract: Long COVID (LC) - a chronic condition characterized by persistent, debilitating symptoms following SARS-CoV-2 infection - has emerged as a major public health challenge. Although many interrelated mechanisms have been proposed as drivers of LC, the root causes have yet to be identified, posing significant challenges for therapeutic development. While many blood-based studies have been conducted, they have not yielded conclusive mechanistic insights into LC pathogenesis. Attention has therefore turned toward direct tissue investigation, with the gastrointestinal (GI) tract becoming a major focus due to evidence that virus or viral components can persist at this site for months to years following an episode of COVID-19. Here, we performed a high-dimensional characterization of colorectal tissue and peripheral blood in a highly characterized cohort of 44 people with LC and 13 recovered controls. We profiled SARS-CoV-2 persistence, host immune responses, and tissue inflammation using bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, nCounter RNA probe hybridization, quantitative PCR, metagenomic next-generation sequencing, plasma proteomics, high-dimensional spectral flow cytometry, in situ-hybridization/immunohistochemistry, and single-cell digital spatial omics. Our results support a model in which LC is driven by long-term immune dysregulation and perturbations of the regulatory gut immune environment which imply ongoing viral persistence, although direct viral detection was only observed in a subset of participants. Specifically, we identify a tissue-based transcriptional environment in which SARS-CoV-2 activates innate myeloid immune signaling, driving chronic inflammation while simultaneously downregulating pathways responsible for immune-mediated clearance of infected cells, including antigen presentation, phagocytosis, cytotoxic immune cell trafficking, and granzyme production. Importantly, signatures in peripheral blood are considerably weaker than those observed in tissue. Together, these findings provide a direct biological rationale for therapeutic strategies in LC aimed at enhancing or redirecting cytotoxic immune function to overcome immune dysregulation and clear persistent viral reservoirs.

title: scDIVA: semi-supervised integration and fine-grained annotation of tumor-immune single-cell atlases.
authors: Rapolu V, Karbalayghareh A, Lee B, Wong W, Leslie CS
journal: Biorxiv : the Preprint Server for Biology
abstract: Single-cell atlases of the tumor-immune microenvironment have defined numerous fine-grained immune cell states, but each study uses its own nomenclature and procedure for annotating cell types. Transferring annotations from a reference atlas to a query dataset is complicated by both batch effects and by the presence of query populations that the reference does not contain. Here we present scDIVA, a semi-supervised deep generative model that adapts the Domain Invariant Variational Autoencoder to scRNA-seq for fine-grained tumor-immune label transfer. Three encoders disentangle each cell's expression profile into separate latent subspaces for cell type, batch, and residual variation; a single decoder reconstructs the cell's expression profile from all three latent embeddings, and auxiliary classifiers on the cell type and batch embeddings encourage each encoder to capture the respective source of variation; scDIVA's cell type embeddings are batch-invariant by construction rather than through explicit or adversarial correction. Benchmarked against four established reference-mapping approaches-Harmony/Symphony, scANVI with scArches, scPoli with scArches, and Seurat with label transfer-across six tumor-immune atlases spanning five cancer types, scDIVA achieved the highest mean macro-F1 in five of six atlases and the highest biological conservation scores. To detect query-enriched populations, we adapted the Milo differential abundance (DA) framework, added a directional test, corrected spatialFDR weighting, and parallelized neighborhood distances for atlas-scale data, and applied it to scDIVA's cell type embeddings with reference- versus-query membership as the condition. This design correctly identified cell types held out from the reference as OOR and flagged exhausted CD8 T cells from a tumor-immune atlas as OOR relative to a healthy pan-tissue immune reference; conversely, this procedure confirmed a conserved immune landscape between two independent colorectal cancer cohorts. scDIVA thus couples fine-grained annotation and integration with an FDR-controlled test for states the reference lacks, solving both tasks required for accurate label transfer in tumor-immune scRNA-seq atlases.

title: A Candidate Inflammation-Microenvironment Progression Signature for Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastasis: Bulk Transcriptomic Discovery, TCGA-COAD Prognosis, and Spatial Localization.
authors: Han P, Tan Y, Chen A, Hu L
journal: Omics : a Journal of Integrative Biology
abstract: Colorectal cancer liver metastasis (CRLM) is biologically heterogeneous, and transcriptomic signals from metastatic tissue can be confounded by host liver background. We integrated GSE50760 bulk transcriptomes, The Cancer Genome Atlas colon adenocarcinoma (TCGA-COAD) survival data, GSE17536 external survival data, and GSE225857 spatial transcriptomes to derive and assess a candidate inflammation-microenvironment progression signature. Differential expression between liver metastases and primary colorectal tumors was analyzed with limma using Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction. Genes with CRLM differential expression, concordant primary-tumor progression direction, and no typical hepatic-background annotation were retained. The resulting 39-gene score was calculated as the mean up-module expression minus the mean down-module expression. Liver metastases showed 418 upregulated and 88 downregulated genes. title: Age Is Not a Limit: Postoperative Outcomes in Elderly Patients With Colorectal Liver Metastases.
authors: Li J, Waller G, Qin Y, Correa-Gallego C, Hiotis S, Gunasekaran G, et al.
abstract: Most colorectal cancers are diagnosed in patients aged 65 years and older, with nearly 50% developing liver metastases (CRLM). This study explores postoperative and oncologic outcomes in elderly and very elderly patients with CRLM who receive curative-intent treatment. A retrospective analysis of patients with CRLM who underwent surgical resection assessed associations with clinical outcomes. Groups were stratified by age at hepatic metastasectomy, defined as adults < 65 years, elderly 65-75 years, and very elderly > 75 years. We identified 346 patients, including 95 (27%) elderly and 38 (11%) very elderly patients. These patients had more medical comorbidities but comparable functional status. Elderly and very elderly patients had more right-sided tumors (p < 0.001), more pN1 disease (p = 0.009), and more often found to have metachronous liver metastases (p < 0.001). Significantly fewer elderly and very elderly patients received systemic treatment (p < 0.001). All groups underwent similar operative management with no differences in 30-day readmission, reoperation, and complication rates. Recurrence-free (p = 0.232) and overall survival (p = 0.418) were similar across groups. Age was not significantly associated with survival on univariate analysis. Well-selected elderly and very elderly patients can undergo hepatic metastasectomy without increased postoperative morbidity. Despite receiving less systemic treatment, these patients can achieve similar oncologic outcomes to adults.

insight: 经严格筛选的老年及高龄结直肠癌肝转移患者行肝转移灶切除术后并发症与生存结局与年轻患者相当，提示年龄本身不应成为手术排除标准。

title: Impact of Systematic Discontinuation of Mitomycin C HIPEC for Colorectal Peritoneal Metastases on Oncologic Outcomes: A Propensity Score-Matched Analysis.
authors: Tanweer MD, Waheed MT, Paz IB, Lwin T, Mohammed H, Melstrom L, et al.
abstract: The PRODIGE7 trial demonstrated a lack of effectiveness of oxaliplatin-based hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) after cytoreductive surgery (CRS) for colorectal cancer peritoneal metastases (CRC-PM), prompting many centers to transition to mitomycin C (MMC)-based HIPEC. However, the oncologic benefit of MMC-HIPEC remains unclear. In 2021, our center systematically discontinued HIPEC for CRC-PM. We retrospectively compared consecutive patients who underwent MMC-HIPEC after complete CRS (2009-2021) with those undergoing CRS alone (2021-2024). Outcomes included recurrence-free survival (RFS), peritoneal RFS, and 90-day postoperative outcomes. Propensity score-matching was performed using age, sex, primary tumor location, extraperitoneal disease, completeness of cytoreduction score, peritoneal carcinomatosis index, and preoperative chemotherapy. The study included 107 consecutive patients (median age, 56 years; median peritoneal carcinomatosis index [PCI], 8; 48% male; 45% left-sided primary tumor), 68 (64%) of whom underwent CRS-HIPEC with MMC. Most of the patients (75%) experienced recurrence. After matching, 96 patients remained (32 treated with CRS alone; 64 treated with CRS-HIPEC). Between CRS alone and CRS-HIPEC, RFS was comparable (median, 8.4 months [95% confidence interval {CI}, 5.6-12.7 months] vs. 8.7 months [95% CI, 6.2-11.0 months]; p = 0.527), as was peritoneal RFS (median 12.7 months [95% CI, 8.4-not reached {NR}] vs. 14.2 [95% CI, 8.7-19.8 months]; p = 0.806). The CRS-HIPEC patients had more respiratory complications (0% vs. 13%; p = 0.037) and longer hospital stays (median, 10 vs. 7 days; p < 0.001). Exploratory analyses suggested benefit in node-negative disease. Omission of MMC-HIPEC did not compromise oncologic outcomes.
cn_title: 系统性停用丝裂霉素C HIPEC对结直肠癌腹膜转移肿瘤学结局的影响：倾向评分匹配分析
insight: 该研究显示停用丝裂霉素C HIPEC未损害肿瘤学结局且减少并发症，提示CRC腹膜转移CRS后HIPEC价值有限，应重新审视其常规应用。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，但基于PRODIGE7背景，采用倾向评分匹配，结果可能挑战当前临床实践。

title: Outcomes of Elderly Patients with Colorectal Liver Metastases Treated with Liver-Directed Therapies.
authors: Fatimah N, Pettigrew MF, Peters VF, Johansen CF, Porembka MR, Kim AC, et al.
abstract: Liver-directed therapy (LDT) is an essential component of multimodal management of colorectal liver metastases (CRLM), yet older adults are less likely to receive liver-directed or curative-intent treatment. We evaluated presentation, treatment patterns, and outcomes among elderly patients with CRLM. We retrospectively reviewed patients with CRLM treated at the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center and Parkland Memorial Hospital from 2016 to 2023. Liver-directed therapy was defined as liver resection, hepatic artery infusion pump therapy, ablation, liver-directed radiation including external beam radiation and stereotactic body radiation, transarterial chemoembolization, and/or Y-90 radioembolization. The primary outcome was overall survival (OS); the secondary outcome was receipt of LDT. Cox proportional hazards regression identified factors associated with OS among patients aged ≥70 years. Among 852 patients, 710 were aged <70 years and 142 were aged ≥70 years. Liver metastasis number, bilobar involvement, CEA level, and extrahepatic disease were similar between age groups. Older adults were less likely to receive LDT than younger patients (20% vs. 40%, p < 0.001). Among patients who underwent hepatic resection, perioperative outcomes were similar by age. Among older adults, LDT was associated with longer median OS than no LDT (44 vs. 9 months, p < 0.001). Among patients receiving LDT, median OS was comparable between age groups (44 vs. 52 months, p = 0.19). Performance status, CEA ≥200 ng/mL, chemotherapy, and LDT were independently associated with OS. Older adults with CRLM were less likely to receive LDT. Among selected older adults, receipt of LDT was associated with longer OS than no LDT. Chronological age alone should not preclude consideration of LDT.
cn_title: 老年结直肠癌肝转移患者接受肝脏定向治疗的治疗模式与生存结局
insight: 老年CRLM患者接受肝脏定向治疗的比例显著低于年轻患者，但经选择的老年患者接受LDT后生存与年轻患者相当，提示不应仅凭年龄剥夺其治疗机会。
grade_rationale: 单中心大样本回顾性队列，虽非RCT但直接挑战年龄歧视性治疗决策，具较强实践改变潜力。

title: Prognostic significance of pre-intervention circulating cytokines in digestive system cancers: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
authors: Tajik F, Rezagholizadeh F, Razmi M, Safaei S, Alaeddini M, Etemad-Moghadam S, et al.
journal: Clinical & Translational Oncology : Official Publication of the Federation of Spanish Oncology Societies and of the National Cancer Institute of Mexico
abstract: Circulating cytokines can influence tumor progression and immune evasion, serving as non-invasive biomarkers in digestive system (DS) cancers. This study evaluates the prognostic significance of biofluid cytokines in DS cancers. Comprehensive literature search in various databases identified studies reporting the prognostic importance of serum or plasma cytokines based on multivariate data, focusing on overall survival (OS) and disease/relapse/progression-free/cancer-specific-survivals (DFS/RFS/PFS/CSS). Quality assessment was done using the Newcastle-Ottawa scale. Heterogeneity was evaluated through Chi-square-based Q and I2 analyses. Publication bias was assessed via funnel plots, Egger's, Begg's, and trim-and-fill methods, alongside subgroup and sensitivity analyses. A total of 42 articles evaluating 7 blood cytokines in DS cancers were included, with IL-6 and the CXCL family being the most studied. Elevated IL-6 levels were significantly associated with poor survival outcomes in esophageal, hepatocellular, biliary tract, pancreatic, and colorectal cancers for both OS and DFS/RFS/PFS/CSS. High CXCL levels correlated with worse prognosis in colorectal (OS: HR = 2.019) and hepatocellular (OS: HR = 5.569, DFS/RFS/PFS/CSS: HR = 1.610) cancer patients. Higher CCL levels predicted poor OS (HR = 1.912) in colorectal cancer. Circulating IL-10, IL-1β, and TNF-α showed no significant correlation with survival outcomes in DS. Subgroup analyses revealed varying prognostic significances of each cytokine in different DS malignancies. Publication bias was minimal except for IL-6 in pancreatic carcinoma, affirming the robustness of most outcomes. Elevated circulating IL-6, CXCL, and CCL families may predict poor prognosis in certain DS, highlighting their potential as prognostic markers. Further studies are needed to translate these findings into clinical practice. CRD42022316733.
cn_title: 干预前循环细胞因子在消化系统肿瘤中的预后价值：系统综述与Meta分析
insight: 循环IL-6、CXCL及CCL家族升高可预测结直肠癌等消化系统肿瘤不良预后，支持其作为非侵入性预后标志物，但尚需前瞻验证以指导临床分层。
grade_rationale: 基于42项研究的系统综述/Meta分析，证据等级较高，但为预后标志物观察性汇总，尚未达到改变临床实践的程度。

title: Soluble polymeric system reducing non-specific interactions in plasmonic biosensor-based detection of carcinoembryonic antigen.
authors: Špringer T, Kostka L, Šubr V, Jurgová L, Etrych T, Homola J
abstract: Non-specific interactions in detection systems are among the main factors limiting the performance of surface-sensitive biosensor technologies. Here, we report on a new macromolecular blocker based on low-fouling poly[N-2-(hydroxypropyl)methacrylamide] (HPMA) copolymer containing hydrophobic comonomer units, which can reduce non-specific interactions improving the limit of detection when used in conjunction with a sandwich assay employing functional gold nanoparticles (AuNPs). The poly(HPMA) blocker adopts a relatively compact or collapsed conformation in PBS buffer, potentially indicating significant intramolecular interactions in an extended random coil. In a model experiment, we use this approach with a surface plasmon resonance biosensor for the detection of carcinoembryonic antigen, a biomarker of colorectal cancer. We demonstrate that the poly(HPMA) blocker reduced the AuNP non-specific binding and provided a high reduction of the non-specific binding when compared to conventional additives such as bovine serum albumin (BSA) and Tween. A combination of poly(HPMA) blocker and BSA was found to be the most effective additive, providing a 2.9-fold decrease of AuNP non-specific sensor response and a 2.8-fold improvement of the limit of detection compared to BSA alone.
cn_title: 可溶性聚合物降低等离子体生物传感器检测癌胚抗原的非特异性相互作用
insight: 新型聚HPMA阻断剂显著降低SPR生物传感器检测CEA时的非特异性结合，将检测限提升2.8倍，为肠癌标志物超灵敏检测提供新工具。
grade_rationale: 方法学创新，体外概念验证，尚未临床验证，但可提升CEA检测灵敏度，具转化潜力。

cn_title: 术前[68Ga]FAPI PET/CT无创识别结直肠癌肿瘤出芽
insight: 首次证实FAPI PET/CT可无创评估结直肠癌肿瘤出芽这一侵袭前沿生物学标志，为术前风险分层及肝转移高危患者筛选提供新影像手段。

title: Role of extended venous thromboembolism prophylaxis in patients with colorectal neoplasia who underwent minimally invasive colorectal surgery within an enhanced recovery after surgery protocol.
authors: AlMarzooqi N, Robert L, Feldman LS, Liberman S, Lee L
abstract: Patients with colorectal cancer are at increased risk of venous thromboembolism (VTE) due to malignancy-associated hypercoagulability and the physiologic stress of surgery. Current guidelines recommend extended-duration thromboprophylaxis for up to 28 days following major abdominal or pelvic cancer surgery. However, its effectiveness in patients managed by Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) pathways is uncertain. This study evaluated the effectiveness of extended thromboprophylaxis after minimally invasive colorectal resection managed within a mature ERAS program in reducing clinically significant VTE. A retrospective cohort study was conducted including all adult patients undergoing elective minimally invasive colorectal resection for neoplasia at a high-volume Canadian academic centre between 01/2016 and 12/2024. Patients undergoing open surgery, emergency procedures, or receiving therapeutic anticoagulation were excluded. All patients received standard in-hospital thromboprophylaxis. Extended thromboprophylaxis with dalteparin 5000 U for 28 days post-discharge was provided at the physician's discretion before 03/2018 and was subsequently included in the ERAS protocol. The primary outcome was symptomatic post-discharge VTE within 30 days of surgery. Secondary outcomes included bleeding complications, length of stay, emergency department visits, and readmissions. A total of 1043 included in the primary analysis after excluding inpatient VTE events (n=351 patients did not receive extended prophylaxis, n=692 received extended prophylaxis). The incidence of post-discharge VTE was 0.5% (6/1043). There was a higher incidence of VTEs in the -eDVTp group compared to the +eDVTp group [5/351(1.4%) vs. 1/692 (0.1%), p=0.010]. Post-discharge VTE was significantly higher in patients who did not receive extended prophylaxis compared with those who did (1.4% vs. 0.1%, p = 0.010). There were no significant differences in overall or clinically significant bleeding between groups. In patients undergoing minimally invasive colorectal resection within a mature ERAS pathway, the incidence of symptomatic post-discharge VTE is very low. Although extended thromboprophylaxis was associated with a statistically significant reduction in VTE events, the absolute risk reduction was small.
cn_title: 加速康复外科路径下微创结直肠肿瘤手术延长静脉血栓预防的作用
insight: 在成熟ERAS路径下微创结直肠肿瘤切除术后症状性VTE发生率极低，延长血栓预防虽显著降低VTE但绝对获益小，提示需个体化筛选高危患者而非普遍延长预防。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，样本量较大但事件数极少（仅6例VTE），证据等级有限，尚不足以改变现行指南推荐。

title: A core transcriptional regulatory circuitry controls super-enhancer-driven activation of LGR5 in colorectal cancer.
authors: Ye M, Wang S, Chen Y, Ma H, Ying Y, Ma W, et al.
abstract: The core transcriptional regulatory program governed by a small set of master transcription factors is pivotal for establishing context-specific cellular features. Here, we report the roles of master factor MYC in actively regulating cancer-type specific super-enhancer activity and orchestrating a super-enhancer-dependent core transcriptional regulatory circuitry consisting of MYC, ETS2, and FOXP1 in colorectal cancer. The core regulatory module selectively promotes the transcription of super-enhancer-controlled genes in cooperation with co-activator BRD4, and perturbing the core circuitry factors sensitizes colon cancer cells to BET inhibition. LGR5, a key stemness gene, is activated in colorectal cancer at least in part by a circuitry-controlled distal super-enhancer, which is a frequently gained super-enhancer in colorectal cancer and required for metastasis propagation. These findings reveal a hierarchical transcription regulatory network in colorectal cancer, pinpoint distal enhancer as an important fuel for LGR5 overexpression in cancer, and provide insights for precisely targeting detrimental transcription events in therapy.
cn_title: 核心转录调控环路驱动结直肠癌LGR5超级增强子激活
insight: 揭示MYC-ETS2-FOXP1核心转录环路通过远端超级增强子激活LGR5，促进结直肠癌转移，为靶向超级增强子/BET治疗提供新策略。
grade_rationale: 研究设计为分子机制探索，未涉及临床干预或验证，但揭示LGR5超级增强子调控机制，对靶向治疗有潜在启示。

title: Glucose-induced histone lactylation confers metformin resistance in colorectal cancer stem cells.
authors: Li XR, Deng L, Zhang TG, Chen XD, Hu YH, Zhang HY, et al.
abstract: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) can adapt their metabolism, which limits the effectiveness of therapies targeting metabolic pathways. Here we show that high glucose conditions promote metformin resistance in CD133⁺ colorectal CSCs by driving a switch from glucose dependence to lipid use. Mechanistically, metformin increases LDHA-dependent lactate production in these cells under high glucose conditions. Lactate accumulation enhances histone H3 lysine 18 lactylation (H3K18la), which activates c-JUN and induces CD36 expression. CD36 promotes free fatty acid (FFA) uptake and lipid droplet (LD) formation, providing fuel for fatty acid β-oxidation. This process generates ATP and NADPH, reduces energy stress and reactive oxygen species, and thereby supports CSC survival during metformin treatment. In vitro and in vivo, inhibition of either LDHA or CD36 restores metformin sensitivity in CD133⁺ colorectal CSCs. These findings identify a lactate-driven epigenetic and metabolic pathway underlying metformin resistance and suggest LDHA and CD36 as potential therapeutic targets.
cn_title: 葡萄糖诱导组蛋白乳酸化介导结直肠癌干细胞二甲双胍耐药
insight: 揭示高糖通过LDHA-乳酸-H3K18la-CD36轴驱动结直肠癌干细胞代谢重编程致二甲双胍耐药，提示靶向LDHA/CD36可逆转耐药，为肝转移代谢治疗提供新靶点。
grade_rationale: 机制研究设计扎实，体内外验证充分，但尚属临床前阶段，暂不具备直接改变临床实践的证据等级。

title: Histone H4K5 lactylation-driven feedback loop modulates glycerol-linked immunosuppressive activity of tumor-associated T regulatory cells.
authors: Wang W, Kong B, Huang C, Xiong KX, Su C, Lu Y, et al.
abstract: Tumor metastasis is the leading cause of death for more than 90% of cancer patients, with colorectal cancer (CRC) mainly spreading to the liver. The colon and liver possess distinct nutritional microenvironments, yet how these differences shape the tumor immune landscape remains unclear. Using single-cell analysis of autologous samples from CRC patients with liver metastases, we identified a distinct CD177
cn_title: 组蛋白H4K5乳酰化反馈环路调控肿瘤相关Treg的甘油免疫抑制活性
insight: 揭示H4K5乳酰化反馈环路驱动Treg甘油代谢免疫抑制，为肠癌肝转移营养微环境差异提供新靶点。
grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，单细胞分析结合分子机制，尚未进入临床验证，但为免疫治疗提供潜在靶点。

title: A Cerebral Tumor Embolism from Colorectal Cancer via a Patent Foramen Ovale: A Diagnosis Made by Mechanical Thrombectomy.
authors: Kobayashi Y, Ohashi N, Kondo Y, Yamamoto K, Suzuki H, Kusama Y, et al.
abstract: A 56-year-old woman presented with an acute cerebral embolism. Mechanical thrombectomy retrieved a white embolus, and a pathological examination revealed a tumor fragment consistent with colorectal carcinoma. Imaging revealed no liver or lung metastases, but it identified a patent foramen ovale and pulmonary embolism, suggesting a paradoxical embolic pathway. Given the size of the tumor fragment, passage through the hepatic or pulmonary microcirculation would be difficult to explain given the size of the tumor fragment. These findings suggest venous invasion with direct entry of tumor material into the circulation, followed by right-to-left shunting, which resulted in a cerebral embolism.
cn_title: 结直肠癌经卵圆孔未闭致脑肿瘤栓塞：机械取栓确诊一例
insight: 揭示结直肠癌可经卵圆孔未闭形成脑肿瘤栓塞这一罕见转移途径，提示对无肝肺转移的脑栓塞患者应警惕肠癌来源及右向左分流。
grade_rationale: 单例个案报道，无对照与验证，仅提供罕见机制线索，不足以改变临床实践。

title: Deep Learning-Based Detection of Sessile Serrated Lesions in Colonoscopy Images: Optimization of a YOLOv3 Framework With Mucus Cap Feature Enhancement for Sessile Serrated Lesion Detection.
authors: Lu H, Jiang P, Chen T, Hu Q, Wu J, Deng X, et al.
abstract: Sessile serrated lesions (SSLs) are difficult to detect during colonoscopy via standard white-light imaging (WLI) because they are flat, have indistinct borders, and are often hidden by mucus caps. Although narrowband imaging (NBI) can help, its effectiveness is inconsistent. This study evaluated the feasibility of an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted approach incorporating mucus cap features and both WLI and NBI for SSL detection and diagnosis. This study developed an AI model for SSL detection by training it on 1980 colonoscopic images (2023-2025). The model enhances standard detection frameworks by specifically integrating mucus cap features and optimizing WLI performance. Model performance was evaluated using detection rate, accuracy, and AUC. At the image level, the SSL detection model achieved an accuracy of 98.7% (sensitivity 100.0%, specificity 97.4%). Lesion-level detection improved from 77.4% with the conventional model to 95.0% after incorporation of mucus cap screening, representing an improvement of 17.6%, with detection rates of 95.9% for mucus cap-free lesions and 98.4% for mucus cap-containing lesions. For morphology-based typing, the WLI-based model achieved an accuracy of 85.8% (AUC 0.89), whereas the NBI-based model showed superior performance with an accuracy of 91.6% (AUC 0.94). This study provides real-world clinical evidence validating AI-based models for SSL detection and diagnosis. Although representing an incremental step rather than a novel framework, such evidence is essential for improving model generalizability and enabling stable extrapolation across clinical settings. Further prospective and multicenter studies are required before reliable clinical deployment.
cn_title: 基于YOLOv3框架与黏液帽特征增强的结肠镜无蒂锯齿状病变深度学习检测
insight: 该研究通过整合黏液帽特征优化YOLOv3框架，显著提升结肠镜下无蒂锯齿状病变的检出率，为结直肠癌前病变的AI辅助筛查提供了可推广的技术路径。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性AI模型开发研究，样本量有限且缺乏外部验证，虽技术性能优异但尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Precision before incision: neoadjuvant tumor-agnostic therapies.
authors: Beal J, Coleman N, Liu J, Sicklick JK, Bryan J, Subbiah V
abstract: The emergence of tumor-agnostic therapies has fundamentally transformed precision oncology. Traditionally developed and approved for metastatic disease, nine therapies spanning immunotherapy, targeted agents, and antibody-drug conjugates now demonstrate a compelling rationale for earlier deployment in the neoadjuvant setting. This review examines the paradigm shift from last-resort to first-consideration approaches. Key advantages of neoadjuvant, biomarker-guided therapy include intervention prior to the development of therapeutic resistance, optimal immune system engagement, and opportunities for organ preservation. Single-agent programmed cell death protein-1 blockade has achieved a 100% complete response rate in mismatch repair-deficient rectal cancer with preserved organ function. Neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK), rearranged during transfection (RET), and B-Raf proto-oncogene serine/threonine kinase (BRAF) inhibitors have demonstrated substantial responses that enable curative-intent surgery across malignancies. As precision oncology matures, the neoadjuvant tumor-agnostic approach exemplifies optimized therapeutic sequencing, potentially improving patient outcomes and quality of life.
cn_title: 精准先行：新辅助肿瘤不可知疗法的范式转变
insight: 肿瘤不可知疗法前移至新辅助阶段，dMMR直肠癌PD-1单药达100%完全缓解并保全器官，为肠癌尤其肝转移的精准降期与器官保留提供新范式。
grade_rationale: 综述整合九类肿瘤不可知疗法的前沿证据，提出新辅助精准治疗范式，具改变临床实践潜力。

title: Short- and Long-Term Outcomes of Underwater Versus Conventional Colorectal Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection: A Large Retrospective Real-World Cohort Study.
authors: Murata S, Masunaga T, Sasaki M, Owada M, Katsumi A, Ishizawa M, et al.
abstract: Underwater techniques are increasingly used in colorectal endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD), but real-world data remain limited. We compared underwater and conventional colorectal ESD. This retrospective observational study included consecutive colorectal ESD lesions at a tertiary referral center between May 2010 and September 2024. The analysis used propensity score overlap weighting. Procedural outcomes included dissection speed, procedure time, resection outcomes, and adverse events. Intraoperative perforation and long-term outcomes were assessed descriptively. Among 1,649 lesions, 1,635 were included in the main analysis (conventional, 914; underwater, 721). Dissection speed was higher in the underwater group (speed ratio, 1.23; 95% CI, 1.14-1.32; p<0.001), whereas procedure time was similar. Failure to complete ESD was less frequent in the underwater group, with no clear differences in en bloc resection, R0 resection, or adverse events. Among 56 intraoperative perforation cases, all perforation sites were closed endoscopically, no emergent surgery was required, and short-term clinical outcomes showed no clear differences. Median survival follow-up was 3.09 [IQR, 0.48-7.39] and 2.10 [IQR, 0.56-3.72] years in the conventional and underwater groups, respectively; overall death occurred in 27/824 (3.3%) and 3/622 (0.5%) patients, with no colorectal cancer-related deaths. The underwater technique was associated with higher dissection speed, although this did not translate into a shorter procedure time or clear improvements in other procedural outcomes. These findings suggest a potential technical advantage during dissection, while its clinical relevance remains to be established.
cn_title: 水下与传统结直肠内镜黏膜下剥离术的短期与长期疗效：一项大型回顾性真实世界队列研究
insight: 水下ESD可提高结直肠病变剥离速度，但未缩短手术时间或改善其他结局，其临床价值尚待前瞻性验证，对肝转移预防意义有限。
grade_rationale: 单中心大样本回顾性研究，虽采用倾向性评分加权，但非随机设计且临床获益不明确，不足以改变实践。

title: Colonoscopy quality indicators among nurse endoscopists and physicians in population-based colorectal cancer screening in Sweden.
authors: Forsberg AM, Hreinsson JP, Schmidt PT, Blom J, Colonoscopy Research Sweden (CRS)
abstract: BACKGROUND : In Sweden, a nationwide colorectal cancer (CRC) screening program for individuals aged 60-74 started in 2021; to meet the increasing demand for colonoscopy, nurse endoscopists may play a key role - provided they maintain high technical quality. This observational study aimed to evaluate the nurse endoscopists' performance in the screening program, focusing on core quality indicators. METHODS : Data were extracted from the Swedish Quality Register for Colonoscopies and Colorectal Cancer Screening (SveReKKS), including all screening colonoscopies performed between 1 April 2019 and 31 August 2025. Key quality indicators - adenoma detection rate (ADR), cecal and ileal intubation rates, bowel preparation, sedation use, and complications - were compared between nurse and physician endoscopists using generalized linear mixed-effects models with a logit link. RESULTS : Of 27 978 colonoscopies, 42 % were performed by nurses. Nurses had a higher ADR (57 % vs. 46 %; odds ratio [OR] 1.55, 95 %CI 1.47-1.62), and 3.6 % of the nurses had an ADR < 25 %, compared with 11.2 % of the physicians. Nurses also had higher odds of ileal intubation (OR 1.2, 95 %CI 1.1-1.2) and longer withdrawal times. CONCLUSIONS : Nurse endoscopists demonstrated high quality colonoscopy performance in CRC screening and represent a valuable resource to meet increasing service demands without compromising clinical standards.
cn_title: 瑞典人群结直肠癌筛查中护士内镜医师与医师的结肠镜质量指标比较
insight: 基于全国筛查登记数据，护士内镜医师的腺瘤检出率等核心质量指标不劣于甚至优于医师，提示扩大护士内镜队伍可在保证质量前提下缓解筛查产能瓶颈。
grade_rationale: 基于全国性质量登记的大样本观察性研究，直接支持筛查服务人力配置政策，具较强实践改变潜力，但非随机设计限制因果推断。

title: The impacts of polystyrene nanoplastics on colorectal cancer: Evidence from integrated network toxicity and in vitro approaches.
authors: Le TK, Lee SH, Hsieh S, Hsieh SL, Chen YT
abstract: Environmental ingestion of polystyrene nanoplastics (PNPLs) raises critical public health concerns, yet their impacts on colorectal cancer (CRC) remain obscure. In this study, network toxicology, and in vitro validation were integrated to evaluate the molecular mechanisms linking PNPLs to CRC. We identified 154 overlapping targets by integrating GEO-derived differentially expressed genes with PNPLs-predicted targets and CRC-associated genes, which are enriched in pathways associated with cancer signaling, apoptosis, oxidative stress, and inflammation. Using protein-protein interaction network, along with two machine learning algorithms (LASSO and Random Forest), we identified seven hub genes in which the expression of these genes was corroborated by the CRC database of TCGA, the CRC dataset of GEO, and the RT-qPCR analysis on HCT-116 cells. Molecular docking demonstrated the significant binding affinities between PNPLs and six hub targets. In vitro experiments with HCT-116 cells revealed PNPLs dose- and time-dependent cytotoxicity. Additionally, PNPLs induced oxidative stress by significant reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation, collapse of mitochondrial membrane potential, and decrease of SOD, GPx and CAT activity. Furthermore, PNPLs caused apoptosis while concurrently pronounced pro-inflammatory responses by exciting the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines and mediators, including IL-6, IL-1β, TNF-α, NO, and PGE2. This study suggests the complex toxicity effects of PNPLs on CRC and supports the need for further research into nanoplastics as a potential environmental risk factor for CRC.
cn_title: 聚苯乙烯纳米塑料对结直肠癌的影响：网络毒理学与体外验证整合研究
insight: 该研究整合网络毒理学与体外实验，揭示聚苯乙烯纳米塑料通过氧化应激、凋亡及炎症途径影响结直肠癌，提示环境纳米塑料可能是CRC潜在风险因素，为肠癌环境病因学研究提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 研究为纯临床前基础机制探索，无临床转化或实践改变证据，但方法学整合有一定创新性。

title: Glycosylation in colorectal cancer: From tumor-intrinsic signaling to the host-microbiome glyco-interface.
authors: Wen Y, Sun H, Xiong N, Xu X, Ye Y, Shen Z, et al.
journal: Biochimica et Biophysica Acta. Reviews on Cancer
abstract: Aberrant glycosylation is increasingly recognized as a key regulatory layer in colorectal cancer (CRC), extending beyond tumor-cell-intrinsic signaling to shape the tumor microenvironment and host-microbiome interactions. In the immune compartment, glycosylation modulates the stability and activity of classical checkpoints, including PD-L1, while tumor-associated glycans engage MGL, DC-SIGN, Siglecs, and galectins to form glyco-immune checkpoints that influence T-cell dysfunction, macrophage polarization, dendritic-cell tolerance, and NK-cell activity. These mechanisms support emerging glyco-immunotherapeutic strategies such as targeted desialylation, glycoform-specific targeting, and combination with immune checkpoint blockade. Glycosylation also functions as a molecular language at the host-microbiome interface. Site-specific epithelial glycoproteins, mucin O-glycoforms, bidirectional host-bacterial fucosylation, IgA-associated glycan recognition, and microbial glycan utilization may collectively shape CRC-associated dysbiosis and mucosal inflammation. Integrating stool glycoproteomics with microbiome profiling may further enable noninvasive screening and patient stratification. This review highlights glycosylation as a multidimensional interface linking tumor biology, antitumor immunity, and microbiome ecology, with implications for biomarker development and precision therapy in CRC.
