grade_rationale: 发表于高影响力综述期刊，系统整合KRAS靶向治疗与耐药机制，但为叙述性综述，不直接改变当前临床实践。

title: Global variability in colorectal cancer screening guidelines: panel composition and recommendations.
authors: Nakajima K, Saito H, Nishikawa Y
journal: Journal of the Canadian Association of Gastroenterology
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Although many countries have developed CRC screening guidelines, how CRC screening guidelines are developed across countries remains unclear. This study examined guideline-development funding, stakeholders, and their conflicts of interest (COI), and compared CRC screening recommendations across Group of Seven (G7) countries. We reviewed the most recent CRC screening guidelines issued by official research organizations or governmental bodies in G7 countries. We extracted information on responsible organizations, panel composition, recommendations, target ages, screening tests and intervals, supporting evidence, funding, and COI. While CRC screening recommendations showed some similarities across G7 countries, some differences were observed in starting age, screening modality, and implementation structure. Differences were also identified in funding, COI reporting and management, and stakeholder composition, including limited involvement of patient and public representatives. Colorectal cancer screening guidelines among G7 countries varied despite shared international evidence. These differences likely reflect country-specific factors, including population characteristics, screening participation, health system capacity, and cultural context. Given that guideline development involves diverse stakeholders, ensuring transparency in the guideline-development process is essential.
cn_title: 七国集团结直肠癌筛查指南的全球差异：专家组构成与推荐意见比较
insight: 揭示G7国家结直肠癌筛查指南在起始年龄、筛查方式及制定透明度上的显著差异，提示国际证据需结合本国人群与卫生系统特征进行本土化转化。
grade_rationale: 基于G7官方指南的系统性比较分析，虽非原始研究，但为指南制定透明度与利益冲突管理提供重要政策参考，暂不直接改变临床实践。

title: Elective colorectal surgery in those with cirrhosis: a population-based study assessing practice patterns and patient outcomes.
authors: Brennan K, Zhang L, Chui H, Flemming JA, Nanji S, Djerboua M, et al.
journal: Journal of the Canadian Association of Gastroenterology
abstract: Patients with cirrhosis have significant postoperative risks following major abdominal surgery. Historic literature and prediction tools do not reflect current practices and outcomes. An assumed 30-day mortality by the model for end-stage liver disease (MELD) score of <12 and 12+ in patients undergoing abdominal surgery is 8% and 33%, respectively. The study objectives were to describe relevant practice patterns and postoperative outcomes in cirrhosis after elective colorectal surgery. This retrospective cohort study included 1439 individuals in Ontario with a diagnosis of cirrhosis who underwent colorectal surgery from 2009 to 2017. Demographics, cirrhosis-specific characteristics, and outcomes were identified using linked administrative databases. Univariable and multivariable analyses were performed. The median MELD-Sodium score was 8 (IQR 7-11). The most common cirrhosis etiologies were metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (58%) and alcohol-associated (24%). Indications for surgery included colorectal cancer (70%), diverticulitis (11%), and inflammatory bowel disease (10%). The 3 most common procedures performed were colon resection with primary anastomosis (66%), rectal resection with primary anastomosis (17%), and abdominal perineal resection (6%). In-hospital and 90-day mortality were 5% and 7%, respectively. Ninety-day complications included readmission (24%), emergency department visit (39%), intensive care admission (27%), and hepatic decompensation (6%). Ninety-day mortality based on MELD-Sodium score included 6% versus 21% in those with a score <12 compared to 12+. Alcohol-related cirrhosis, age, and comorbidities were associated with mortality ( This work confirms that the increased surgical risks are lower than once believed in patients with cirrhosis undergoing colorectal surgery in the elective setting. This evidence will guide management of patients in this high-risk group.
cn_title: 肝硬化患者择期结直肠手术的实践模式与结局：一项基于人群的队列研究
insight: 基于人群数据证实肝硬化患者择期结直肠手术风险低于既往认知，MELD-Na评分可分层90天死亡率，为高危人群围手术期管理提供当代证据。
grade_rationale: 基于大规模行政数据库的当代队列研究，样本量较大且结果挑战传统预测模型，可能影响肝硬化患者结直肠手术的术前评估与决策。

title: Assessing the impact of phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitors on survival in men after treatment for rectal cancer.
authors: Lutsyk M, Green J, Albitskiy I, Bar-Sela G
abstract: Phosphodiesterase type 5 inhibitors (PDE5Is) facilitate the attainment and maintenance of erections during sexual stimulation. Because erectile dysfunction is common after rectal cancer treatment, PDE5Is are frequently used in this population. We assessed whether PDE5I use was associated with overall survival after rectal cancer treatment. Methods: Utilizing data from Clalit Health Services in Israel, the analysis included 1,552 patients, with 256 users of PDE5Is. Survival differences were evaluated using categorical and non-parametric tests, Cox proportional hazards models, and propensity score matching to control for confounding variables. PDE5I use was found to be significantly associated with improved survival, with a hazard ratio of 0.455 (p<0.001). The survival benefit persisted after adjusting for covariates and implementing matching procedures. These findings suggest a potential association consistent with a protective effect of PDE5I use as well as duration of use on survival in rectal cancer patients, warranting further investigation into underlying mechanisms and clinical implications.
cn_title: 磷酸二酯酶5抑制剂使用与直肠癌治疗后生存改善相关
insight: 本研究提示PDE5抑制剂使用与直肠癌治疗后总生存改善显著相关，为直肠癌生存干预提供新线索，但机制未明，需前瞻验证。
grade_rationale: 基于大型医疗数据库的回顾性队列，采用倾向性评分匹配，但为观察性研究且机制未明，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Bibliometric analysis of clinical treatment in Hirschsprung disease: trends and emerging hotspots.
authors: Liu Y, Li R, Sun D
abstract: Hirschsprung disease (HSCR) is a congenital gastrointestinal malformation defined by the absence of enteric ganglion cells in the distal bowel. Although surgical resection remains the primary treatment, the field has witnessed rapid evolution toward precision minimally invasive strategies, including laparoscopic/robotic-assisted procedures and standardized perioperative protocols. The expanding literature volume necessitates a systematic synthesis of the research landscape. We retrieved HSCR clinical treatment publications from Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus (2005-2025). After deduplication, 3,816 publications (3,201 articles, 615 reviews) were analyzed using CiteSpace 6.4.R1 and VOSviewer 1.6.20, covering annual trends, collaboration networks, journal distribution, reference bursts, and keyword bursts. Annual output rose from 103 (2005) to 313 (2025), exceeding 200 since 2019. The United States (27.2%), China (13.0%), and the United Kingdom (8.2%) led contributions. Nationwide Children's Hospital and Huazhong University of Science and Technology were top institutional producers, while Journal of Pediatric Surgery was the most productive journal. Reference burst analysis identified ERNICA rectosigmoid HSCR guidelines (strength = 25.65) and HAEC management guidelines (strength = 23.55) as landmark works. Keyword bursts revealed three evolutionary phases: surgical technique optimization (2005-2012, dominated by "surgical technique," strength = 18.96); pathophysiological and experimental therapies (2011-2018, with "stem cell" and "transplantation"); and guideline-driven standardized management (2019-present, with active bursts in "guidelines," strength = 8.53; "colorectal surgery," strength = 10.68; and "prematurity," strength = 7.89). Persistent bursts in colorectal surgery and guideline-related terms indicate sustained attention, while stem cell-based regenerative therapies remain at an early experimental stage and represent an emerging frontier, although clinical translation has not yet been demonstrated. HSCR clinical treatment research has grown substantially over two decades, transitioning from surgical technique optimization through experimental therapies to standardized multidisciplinary management. Current hotspots include HAEC prevention, long-term functional follow-up, and clinical guideline implementation-all core components of precision minimally invasive frameworks. Stem cell-based regenerative therapies (still at a preclinical stage) and precision surgery for long-segment HSCR are future directions warranting further investigation. These findings provide an evidence-based reference for navigating the evolving landscape and prioritizing investigations.
cn_title: 先天性巨结肠临床治疗文献计量学分析：趋势与新兴热点
insight: 该文献计量分析揭示先天性巨结肠治疗从手术优化、实验性治疗到指南驱动标准化管理的演进，对肠癌研究提示：指南实施、功能随访与再生医学是热点方向。
grade_rationale: 文献计量学描述性研究，非临床干预，不直接改变实践，但提供领域趋势参考。

title: The added value of [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT imaging in oncology: a real-world clinical setting.
authors: VAN DEN Bos M, VAN Duijvenvoorde M, Poot AJ, Bol GM, DE Keizer B, Braat AJ, et al.
journal: The Quarterly Journal of Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging : Official Publication of the Italian Association of Nuclear Medicine (AIMN) [and] the International Association of Radiopharmacology (IAR), [and] Section of the Society Of...
abstract: The aim of the study is to evaluate the diagnostic performance of fibroblast activation protein inhibition (FAPI)-PET/CT imaging for cancer patients in a real-world setting. All patients who underwent FAPI-PET/CT imaging between June 2021 and June 2024 due to a diagnostic dilemma unresolved by routine imaging were included in this single center retrospective analysis. The diagnostic yield, potential impact, diagnostic accuracy, and change in management were evaluated. Reference standard included histology, imaging and/or clinical follow-up for at least six months. Out of 42 patients presenting with 11 different cancer types (including mainly metastatic colorectal cancer, prostate cancer and cancer of unknown primary), 34 had a positive FAPI-PET/CT scan. All patients with previously on-routine-imaging-identified disease (N.=31) also had a positive FAPI-PET/CT scan. In 64% (95% CI: 50-79%) of the 42 patients, the FAPI-PET/CT revealed additional findings compared to routine imaging, with the potential to directly impact clinical decision-making. Sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value and negative predictive value of the additional findings were 88% (95% CI: 81-94%), 83% (95% CI: 75-92%), 88% (95% CI: 81-94%), and 83% (95% CI: 75-92%), respectively. FAPI-PET/CT led to a change in management in 45% (95% CI: 30-60%) of all patients. A substantial added value of FAPI-PET/CT for cancer patients in a real-world setting was demonstrated.
cn_title: [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-46 PET/CT在肿瘤真实世界临床中的增益价值
insight: 真实世界数据显示FAPI-PET/CT在常规影像难以定夺时额外发现率达64%、改变治疗决策达45%，提示其在肠癌及肝转移病灶探查与分期中具有潜在增益价值。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性、样本量小（42例）且癌种混杂，虽显示较高诊断增益与管理改变率，但尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Indole Hybrids: Emerging EGFR-Targeted Agents With Multifaceted Anticancer Properties (2021-Present).
authors: Zhang B, Wang Y, Wen S, Liu Z, Zhao B, Dai L
abstract: The epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) is a validated therapeutic target for EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and colorectal cancer, yet secondary T790M/C797S mutations and mesenchymal-epithelial transition factor (MET) amplification confer profound resistance to first-, second-, and third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). Indole hybrids integrate indole cores (including azaindoles and fused indoles) with diverse pharmacophores to achieve multi-site binding within the EGFR ATP pocket, conferring higher selectivity toward mutant EGFR than mono-indole scaffolds. This review systematically summarizes indole-based EGFR hybrids reported from 2021 to date into three categories: Phase I/II clinical candidates (1, 10), C797S-resistant preclinical leads (11a, 14a, 34, 48a, and 50a), and structurally diversified analogs with favorable blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability and low systemic toxicity. Optimized indole hybrids exhibit prominent advantages over commercial TKIs, including enhanced binding affinity toward mutant EGFR, optimized pharmacokinetic profiles, minimized off-target effects, and the capacity to suppress compensatory oncogenic signals. We comprehensively dissect their binding modes, structure-activity relationships (SARs), in vitro/in vivo anticancer activities, and pharmacological features, and summarize critical substituent optimization rules for overcoming resistance. This work establishes a systematic structural basis for rational development of next-generation indole EGFR inhibitors against refractory EGFR-driven malignancies.
cn_title: 吲哚杂合体：靶向EGFR的多面抗癌新药（2021年至今）
insight: 系统梳理吲哚类EGFR杂合体的结构优化与耐药克服策略，为肠癌EGFR靶向耐药（T790M/C797S、MET扩增）提供新一代抑制剂设计蓝图。
grade_rationale: 发表于药物化学领域综述期刊，系统整合2021年至今吲哚-EGFR杂合体数据，属临床前药物发现层面，尚未进入临床实践改变阶段。

title: Intermittent Fasting Reduces Taurine Availability and Promotes Antitumor Immunity Through PERK Attenuation-Associated Paraptosis-Like Cell Death in Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Song B, Kam S, Liu J, Lv R, Huo X, Chen Z, et al.

insight: 揭示间歇性禁食经牛磺酸-PERK-类副凋亡轴增强抗肿瘤免疫的新机制，为肠癌代谢干预联合免疫治疗提供潜在靶点。

title: Dihydropyrimidine Dehydrogenase Genotype-Phenotype Correlations in Plasma and Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells.
authors: Bembenek BM, Hamzic S, Bouchonville KJ, Largiadèr CR, Offer SM
abstract: The chemotherapeutic 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) is commonly used to treat solid tumors, especially colorectal cancer. Deleterious variants in DPYD, which encodes dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD), are strongly associated with severe and potentially lethal 5-FU toxicity. Phenotypic assays for DPD function have been proposed as alternative or complementary approaches to identify DPD deficiencies with the rationale that they may capture unrecognized causes. cn_title: 血浆与外周血单核细胞中DPYD基因型-表型相关性研究
insight: 系统评估血浆尿嘧啶及PBMC中DPD活性与DPYD基因型的相关性，为5-FU毒性风险分层提供基因型之外的补充表型检测依据，对肠癌个体化化疗有直接启示。
grade_rationale: 属基因型-表型相关性验证性研究，样本与设计尚不足以直接改变DPYD基因型指导用药的现行实践。

title: Synthesis, cytotoxic evaluation, molecular docking, and DFT analysis of 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2,5-dithiol derivatives.
authors: Alsehli M
abstract: A new series of 1,3,4-thiadiazole-2,5-dithiol-based acetohydrazide derivatives 6a-f has been designed and synthesized via a multi-step procedure that includes esterification and condensation reactions. Target compounds 6a-f were synthesized using various substituted aryl aldehydes and hydrazide intermediate 3. FT-IR, 1H NMR and 13C NMR spectroscopy, and elemental analysis were used to characterize the synthesized compounds. The cytotoxic activity of the target compounds 6a-f against Caco-2 colorectal cells was evaluated at different concentrations using the MTT assay. The results showed that derivative 6a, which has a p-NO2 group on the phenyl ring, displayed good activity with an IC50 of 262.5 µg/mL. Molecular docking studies of compound 6a revealed a remarkable binding affinity towards HDAC1 and FGFR, with docking scores of -7.7 and -9.3 kcal/mol, respectively, facilitated by several hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions. The DFT analysis revealed a high energy gap (9.882 eV), indicating good electronic stability, moderate electrophilicity, and significant molecular polarity, suggesting a favorable interaction potential in biological settings. Additionally, the drug-likeness and ADMET properties of the lead compound were predicted to be favorable based on in silico drug-likeness and ADMET evaluations.
cn_title: 1,3,4-噻二唑-2,5-二硫醇衍生物的合成及其对Caco-2结直肠癌细胞的细胞毒活性、分子对接与DFT分析
insight: 该研究合成新型噻二唑类化合物并初步证实其对结直肠癌细胞的细胞毒活性及与HDAC1/FGFR的潜在结合，为肠癌新药先导化合物发现提供早期化学依据。
grade_rationale: 仅体外细胞毒与计算模拟，无动物或临床验证，证据等级低，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Photoinactivation of MRSA ATCC 33591 by antimicrobial photodynamic therapy using coumarin-functionalized zinc(II) phthalocyanine.
authors: Bilgin M, Elgün T, Aktaş Ç, Karagülle OO, Çınar K, Yurttaş A
abstract: This study evaluates the photodynamic inactivation potential of a coumarin-functionalized zinc(II) phthalocyanine derivative against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) ATCC 33591. The antimicrobial and cytotoxic effects of the derivative were assessed under dark and laser-irradiated (658 nm) conditions. Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) values were determined, and the photodynamic response was further explored in MRSA-infected HT-29 (human colorectal adenocarcinoma) and HUVEC (human umbilical vein endothelial) cell models. While the derivative exhibited dose-dependent antibacterial activity, the light-induced reduction in colony-forming units (CFU) was moderate, remaining below a tenfold (1-log10) under the tested conditions. In cell-based assays, the compound showed detectable dark cytotoxicity, which was further enhanced upon laser irradiation. The photodynamic cytotoxic response was more pronounced in infected HT-29 cells than in infected HUVEC cells, with flow-cytometric profiles consistent with predominantly necrotic/late apoptotic cell-death patterns. These findings indicate that the compound exhibits light-enhanced effects in complex infection models; however, further optimization of formulation, photophysical properties, and light dosimetry is required to improve antimicrobial efficacy and selectivity.
cn_title: 香豆素功能化锌酞菁光动力疗法对MRSA的光灭活及其在结直肠腺癌感染模型中的评价
insight: 该研究在MRSA感染HT-29结直肠腺癌细胞模型中验证光动力灭活效果，提示光动力疗法可能为肠癌合并感染提供局部治疗思路，但抗菌效能有限、需优化。
grade_rationale: 体外基础研究，抗菌效果未达1-log10且存在暗毒性，距临床转化远，无实践改变潜力。

title: Next-Generation Sequencing-Based Molecular Profiling and Management of Advanced Solid Tumors: A Real-World Experience in a Community-Based Academic Cancer Center.
authors: Moorthy G, Sereika A, Kaul K, Parilla M, Alikhan MB, Bouma M, et al.
abstract: Advances in molecular and cell biology have led to a paradigm shift in cancer management. We implemented next-generation sequencing (NGS) at our community-based academic cancer center over a decade ago. We sought to optimize the use of genomics and understand its impact in identifying actionable genomic alterations to determine therapy options in patients with advanced solid tumors for whom standard therapies had been exhausted. Through a prospective non-randomized trial, patients with advanced solid tumors who had exhausted standard therapies and who did not qualify for routine guideline-concordant NGS at the time of the study (the study excluded at least Stage 1B lung and Stage IV colorectal cancers) underwent in-house NGS on tumor specimens to identify actionable alterations, and pharmacogenomic testing. Our in-house-developed/integrated bioinformatics pipeline (Flype) was used for structured reporting and served as a molecular knowledgebase. Patients were presented at a multidisciplinary molecular tumor board. 251 patients underwent somatic tissue NGS. 173 patients (68.9%) had alterations targetable with FDA-approved or currently investigational drugs. 75 patients (29.9%) had alteration(s) qualifying them for FDA-approved drug(s) for their tumor type. An additional 61 patients (24.3%) had alterations qualifying them for "off-label" use of FDA-approved drugs. 40 patients (15.9%) qualified for tumor-agnostic therapies. Of the 224 patients (89.2%) who had RNA analysis, eight (3.6%) had targetable fusions. Of the 33 patients (19.1%) who received NGS-guided targeted therapies, 19 (57.6%) were on treatment for longer than three months. 255 patients underwent pharmacogenomics testing, with over 40% having an alteration in typical response to opioids or antidepressants. In this real-world study, 54.2% of patients with advanced solid tumors were identified as candidates for FDA-approved therapies (on- or off-label), supporting the utility of in-house NGS in providing genomics-guided care for patients.
cn_title: 基于二代测序的晚期实体瘤分子分型与治疗：社区学术癌症中心的真实世界经验
insight: 在社区学术中心开展院内NGS和分子肿瘤委员会，可使过半晚期实体瘤患者获得FDA批准（标签内或超适应症）治疗机会，为肠癌肝转移等难治患者的精准治疗提供可行路径。
grade_rationale: 前瞻性非随机真实世界研究，样本量中等（251例），无对照，但展示了院内NGS在社区环境中的可行性和临床可操作性，对实践有参考价值但非改变性证据。

title: A Rare Case of Acquired Haemophilia A Following Sigmoid Adenocarcinoma: Case Report and Literature Review.
authors: Reardon B, Haran H, Curnow J
abstract: Acquired haemophilia A (AHA) is a rare autoimmune bleeding disorder resulting from the development of inhibitory autoantibodies against factor VIII (FVIII). Malignancy is a recognised association, although colorectal cancer remains an uncommon underlying cause. We report a 68-year-old woman with sigmoid adenocarcinoma who developed severe postoperative haemoperitoneum associated with progressive activated partial thromboplastin time prolongation, an initial FVIII activity of 52 IU/dL that subsequently declined to 2 IU/dL, and development of an FVIII inhibitor measuring 9.7 BU. The case highlights diagnostic challenges associated with AHA, particularly the risk of delayed diagnosis and the complexities of balancing immunosuppressive intensity alongside haemostatic therapy. We then present a review of current literature to guide management for this rare condition and emerging therapies.
cn_title: 乙状结肠腺癌术后获得性血友病A：个案报告与文献综述
insight: 肠癌可诱发获得性血友病A，术后不明原因出血需警惕FVIII抑制物，提示肿瘤相关自身免疫并发症的识别与免疫抑制治疗平衡。
grade_rationale: 罕见个案报道并附文献综述，无原始临床研究数据，证据等级低，不足以改变临床实践。

title: Minimally invasive versus open emergency right-sided colectomy for malignant obstruction: a nationwide propensity score-matched cohort study.
authors: Agger E, Matthiessen P, Vedin T
journal: World Journal of Emergency Surgery : WJES
abstract: Minimally invasive surgery (MIS) improves short-term outcomes in elective colectomy, however, the choice of surgical approach in hemodynamically stable patients with obstructing right-sided colon cancer remains unclear in emergency settings. MIS could be considered and the present study aims to evaluate short-term outcomes of MIS in bowel obstructed patients compared with open surgery (OPEN). A retrospective nationwide study including patients from the nationwide Swedish Colorectal Cancer Registry (SCRCR) undergoing emergency right-sided colectomy in Sweden (2017-2023) was conducted. Propensity score matching (1:1) was performed based on sex, age, ASA class, hospital size, and operative timing (on-call vs. daytime). Outcomes included length of stay (LOS), postoperative complications, and surgical quality indicators. Analysis was performed according to intention-to-treat. A total of 1147 patients were identified. Of the 1,147 included patients, 99 (8.6%) underwent an initially minimally invasive approach. After matching, 99 patients remained in each group. The conversion rate was 34%. Median LOS was 9 days (IQR 6;14) after OPEN and 6 days (IQR 5;10) after MIS. In quantile regression with bootstrap standard errors, MIS was associated with a 3-day shorter median LOS (median difference - 3.0 days, 95% CI - 4 to - 2, p = 0.002). Postoperative complications (Clavien-Dindo ≥ 2) occurred in 38.8% after OPEN and in 23.2% after MIS. Logistic regression analysis with robust standard errors showed significantly lower odds of postoperative complications after MIS (OR 0.48, 95% CI 0.27-0.83, p = 0.009). No significant differences were observed in re-admission, 90-day mortality, R0 resection, lymph node yield, blood loss or operative time. In this nationwide observational cohort, an initially minimally invasive approach was associated with shorter length of stay and fewer postoperative complications. No statistically significant differences were observed in the available short-term surgical and pathological quality indicators. Given the limited number of MIS procedures and potential for residual confounding, these findings support further evaluation of MIS in carefully selected patients.
cn_title: 微创与开放急诊右半结肠切除术治疗恶性梗阻：全国倾向性评分匹配队列研究
insight: 全国性队列显示急诊梗阻性右半结肠癌微创入路可缩短住院并减少并发症，为选择性患者尝试MIS提供依据，但转化率34%提示需谨慎筛选。
grade_rationale: 基于全国登记数据库的大样本倾向性评分匹配队列，证据等级较高但为回顾性观察设计且MIS例数少，尚不足以直接改变实践。

title: Intestinal epithelial GSK3β governs fumarate-dependent neutrophil reprogramming to promote colorectal cancer.
authors: He XS, Yang XQ, Wan S, Yang Y, Gan WJ, Liu YX, et al.
abstract: Tumor-infiltrating neutrophils (TINs) promote colorectal cancer progression and therapeutic resistance, but their reprogramming mechanisms remain unclear. Using mouse models and multiomics profiling, we reveal that intestinal epithelial glycogen synthase kinase-3-β (GSK3β) orchestrates fumarate-dependent TIN polarization. GSK3β-primed T3 neutrophils express FTH1 and PD-L1, conferring ferroptosis resistance and immune evasion. Mechanistically, nuclear GSK3β phosphorylates linker histone H1FX, triggering its proteasomal degradation via USP43 dissociation and elevating chromatin accessibility for glycolytic gene transcription. Lactate inactivates fumarate hydratase through lactylation, driving intratumoral fumarate accumulation. Fumarate inhibits KDM2B activity in TINs, elevating histone H3 lysine 36 dimethylation to trigger epigenetic reprogramming toward immunosuppressive T3 neutrophils. Pharmacological GSK3β inhibition with tideglusib attenuates T3 polarization and potentiates checkpoint blockade in preclinical colorectal cancer models. Our work establishes a metabolic-epigenetic axis controlling TIN reprogramming and suggests combinatorial immunotherapies for CRC.
cn_title: 肠上皮GSK3β调控富马酸依赖的中性粒细胞重编程促进结直肠癌
insight: 揭示肠上皮GSK3β-富马酸-KDM2B轴驱动中性粒细胞免疫抑制重编程，为结直肠癌（含肝转移）免疫联合治疗提供代谢-表观新靶点。
grade_rationale: 临床前多组学机制研究，提出GSK3β抑制剂联合免疫治疗策略，尚需临床验证。

title: Metal-organic framework nanovaccines for systemic tumour regression.
authors: Jiang X, Wang C, Yang K, Tillman L, Lin EJ, Piffkó A, et al.
abstract: Cancer vaccines can elicit antigen-specific antitumour immunity, but their clinical efficacy is often limited by their inability to sustain T-cell activation in tumours. Here we report MOF-Vac, a nanoscale metal-organic framework (MOF)-based therapeutic vaccine platform that co-delivers peptide antigens and STING agonists with high loading capacity and phosphate-triggered intracellular release. This design enables coordinated antigen presentation and innate immune activation, resulting in sustained T-cell priming and intratumoural effector function. In murine models of melanoma, colorectal cancer, triple-negative breast cancer, lung cancer and oropharyngeal cancer, MOF-Vac induced tumour regression, immune memory and protection against metastasis. MOF-Vac also synergized with radiotherapy and immune checkpoint blockade to eradicate both primary and distant tumours. Single-cell RNA sequencing and immune depletion studies revealed that therapeutic efficacy predominantly depends on macrophage-mediated antigen presentation and remodelling of the tumour microenvironment towards a proinflammatory, immune-active state. MOF-Vac provides a modular platform for off-the-shelf and personalized cancer vaccination.
cn_title: 金属有机框架纳米疫苗诱导系统性肿瘤消退
insight: MOF纳米疫苗共递送抗原与STING激动剂，经巨噬细胞抗原呈递重塑微环境，为肠癌及肝转移免疫治疗提供模块化平台。
grade_rationale: 发表于Nature系列、机制深入且多瘤种验证，但尚属临床前研究，暂不改变实践。

title: Trends in incidence and prevalence of patients living long-term with de novo metastatic incurable cancer: a retrospective cohort study.
authors: Bouma R, Geerse OP, Raijmakers NJH, Fransen HP, van Zuylen L, Reyners AKL, et al.
abstract: Therapeutic advances have improved the survival of incurable cancer patients, creating a growing population living long-term with incurable cancer. However, little is known about their epidemiological characteristics. We aimed to examine trends in annual incidence and prevalence among patients living long-term with de novo metastatic incurable cancer in the Netherlands and to describe additional relevant sociodemographic and clinical characteristics among patients diagnosed in recent years. A population-based, retrospective cohort study using data from the Netherlands Cancer Registry was performed. Adults (≥18 years) diagnosed with de novo metastatic solid tumors in 2000-2021 who survived ≥2 years after their diagnosis were included. Annual incidence, prevalence, key demographic, and tumor characteristics were calculated. Annual incident cases of patients living long-term with de novo metastatic incurable cancer increased from 1298 (2000) to 5398 (2021), representing 12.0-22.6% of incurable cancer diagnoses. In February 2024, at least 18,466 patients in the Netherlands were living long-term with de novo metastatic incurable cancer (1 per 1000 inhabitants). Mean age was 64 years (SD 12), 59.4% were male, and 55.8% (n = 10,310) were alive 2- < 5 years after diagnosis, 31.0% (n = 5721) 5- < 10 years, and 13.2% (n = 2435) ≥ 10 years. The most common tumor types were prostate (35.6%), lung (20.2%), breast (14.4%), and colorectal cancer (6.3%). Substantial increases in the incidence and prevalence were identified, reflecting a shift toward prolonged survival within the incurable cancer population. Greater awareness and research are needed to inform care for this emerging group.
cn_title: 不可治愈性转移性实体瘤长期生存者的发病率与患病率趋势：荷兰全国回顾性队列研究
insight: 该研究揭示转移性不可治愈肿瘤长期生存者规模迅速扩大，结直肠癌占比6.3%，提示肠癌肝转移长期生存管理需求上升，需关注这一新兴人群的照护与研究。
grade_rationale: 基于全国癌症登记的大样本回顾性队列，描述性流行病学，不直接改变临床实践，但为卫生政策和服务规划提供依据。

title: Integrated spatial and single-cell transcriptomics uncover IFI6⁺ regulatory T-cells and SPP1⁺ macrophages immunosuppressive niches in colorectal cancer.
authors: Miroszewska D, Song S, Urbiola-Salvador V, Cázares Olivera M, Jabłońska A, Bolcewicz M, et al.
abstract: In colorectal cancer (CRC), tumor-immune interactions are critical drivers of tumorigenesis, immune evasion, and therapeutic response. Therefore, a deeper spatially resolved understanding of these interactions is urgently needed. Spatial transcriptomics (ST) of CRC and matched normal samples was used to characterize cell populations and gene expression patterns associated with tumorigenesis and immune infiltration. An additional 41 publicly available ST slides, single-cell transcriptomics and bulk transcriptomics datasets from 472 and 617 CRC patients, respectively, were analyzed to validate the findings. Cancer regions exhibited profound molecular alterations with increased oncogenic pathways, immunosuppressors, and tryptophan deprivation via KYNU-AHR axis, inducing the macrophage attractant CXCL5, contributing to immune evasion. In tumor boundaries, SPP1⁺ macrophages fostered an immunosuppressive microenvironment with regulatory T-cells (Tregs) recruited via CCL18-CCR8 and CCL22-CCR4. SIT1 emerged as a potential anti-tumor T-cells suppressor within tertiary lymphoid structures, suggesting a novel immune regulator. We also uncovered a previously uncharacterized population of tumor-infiltrating IFI6⁺ Tregs associated with unfavorable prognosis and therapy response, defined by elevated interferon-related genes and LGALS9, a potential immune checkpoint target. This study uncovered previously unrecognized immunosuppressive cell populations and key immune regulators that advance understanding of CRC immune evasion and highlight potential targets for personalized immunotherapy.
cn_title: 空间与单细胞转录组揭示结直肠癌IFI6⁺ Treg与SPP1⁺巨噬细胞免疫抑制生态位
insight: 该研究通过空间与单细胞转录组解析了结直肠癌免疫抑制微环境，发现IFI6⁺ Treg和SPP1⁺巨噬细胞等新亚群，为肠癌免疫治疗及肝转移微环境研究提供了潜在靶点。
grade_rationale: 研究整合空间与单细胞转录组并利用公共数据验证，机制深度较高，但尚属探索性生物标志物发现，未直接改变临床实践。

title: Not all early recurrences define futility: relapse patterns shape outcomes after colorectal liver metastases resection.
authors: Marino R, Silvia B, Marco C, Alessandris R, Mini E, Cipriani F, et al.
journal: HPB : the Official Journal of the International Hepato Pancreato Biliary Association
abstract: Recurrence after curative resection of colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) is heterogeneous. Early recurrence not always implies futile surgery. This study distinguishes predictors of early recurrence versus futile surgery and examines recurrence patterns. This study analyzed the prospective LiMeT cohort of patients undergoing curative-intent resection for CRLM at IRCCS San Raffaele. Early recurrence was defined as <12 months and futile surgery as Time-to-Surgical-Failure (TSF) < 12 months (unresectable recurrence, progression, or death). Logistic regression identified predictors, and Sankey analysis mapped recurrence characteristics. Two hundred twenty-eight patients were included: 74 without recurrence, 115 early recurrences, and 39 late recurrences. Early recurrence was independently associated with synchronous CRLM (OR1.56, p = 0.02), primary tumor N1-N2 stage (OR2.23, p < 0.01), KRAS mutation (OR2.40, p = 0.024), ≥5 CRLM (OR2.15, p < 0.01), and metastatic diameter ≥3 cm (OR2.19, p < 0.01). Futility was associated with age>65, T4 stage, KRAS mutation, and no adjuvant chemotherapy. Sankey analysis showed that early recurrence not always leads to futility, often remaining liver-limited or oligometastatic. Early recurrence and futile surgery represent distinct forms of postoperative failure. Early recurrence reflects tumor burden and biology, whereas futility identifies relapse that becomes unresectable or fatal, negating benefit. TSF provides complementary information on the durability of surgical benefit.
cn_title: 早期复发不等于手术无效：结直肠癌肝转移术后复发模式重塑预后评估
insight: 该研究区分早期复发与手术无效，揭示复发模式异质性，提示KRAS突变等生物学特征影响手术获益，为CRLM术后个体化随访与治疗决策提供新视角。
grade_rationale: 基于前瞻性队列的回顾性分析，样本量中等（228例），单中心，但提出TSF新概念，可能影响预后评估，尚需外部验证。

title: Patient selection in those undergoing cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy for colorectal peritoneal metastases - systematic review and meta-analysis of prognostic factors in large cohorts.
authors: Liesegang A, Powell H, Jain A, Mohan H, Tie J, Clemons N, et al.
journal: European Journal of Surgical Oncology : the Journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology
abstract: Cytoreductive surgery (CRS) with concurrent hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is a treatment for colorectal peritoneal metastases (CPM) which can offer a median overall survival of 41 months and improve quality of life. Judicious patient selection is critical for deriving the greatest benefit and avoiding overtreatment. This meta-analysis identifies prognostic factors associated with survival in large cohorts derived from prospectively maintained databases of CRS-HIPEC patient cohorts. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to evaluate prognostic variables influencing overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS) in patients with CPM who underwent CRS-HIPEC. Forty-five studies satisfied inclusion criteria for systematic review, with thirty-three studies included for qualitative synthesis. Incomplete cytoreduction, PCI, and grade III-IV complications were the strongest predictors of both OS and DFS. Tumour-specific factors associated with worse OS on pooled analysis included: poor differentiation, signet-ring cell pathology, nodal involvement, T4 stage, and rectal primary. Adjuvant/neoadjuvant systemic treatments had no significant impact on survival in this analysis. RAS mutations may be associated with poorer survival on exploratory analysis. Survival after CRS-HIPEC was best determined by quantity of peritoneal disease (PCI) and the ability to achieve complete cytoreduction (CC-0). Major post-operative complications impact survival beyond short term morbidity. Baseline primary tumour-specific features also impacted survival.
cn_title: 结直肠腹膜转移CRS-HIPEC患者选择：大样本预后因素系统综述与Meta分析
insight: 该研究明确PCI、完全减瘤及严重并发症是CRS-HIPEC生存的最强预测因素，为结直肠腹膜转移患者筛选提供循证依据，提示应严格把握手术指征以避免过度治疗。
grade_rationale: 基于45项研究的大样本系统综述与Meta分析，证据等级高，可直接影响CRS-HIPEC患者选择标准。

title: Efficacy of artificial intelligence in detecting precancerous lesions among a colorectal cancer screening population undergoing surveillance colonoscopies in Italy: a randomized control trial (GENIAL-CO Follow-Up study).
authors: Spada C, Cesaro P, Fuccio L, Salvi D, Ferrari C, Barbaro F, et al.
journal: Digestive and Liver Disease : Official Journal of the Italian Society of Gastroenterology and the Italian Association for the Study of the Liver
abstract: Computer-aided detection (CADe) has demonstrated improved adenoma detection rate (ADR) in screening populations; however, its value in post-polypectomy surveillance colonoscopy remains unclear. This study evaluated CADe efficacy in enhancing detection metrics during surveillance colonoscopy within an organized colorectal cancer (CRC) screening program. In this multicenter randomized controlled trial, patients aged 50-74 scheduled for surveillance colonoscopy were randomized 1:1 to CADe-assisted or standard colonoscopy (SC). The primary endpoint was ADR. Secondary endpoints included advanced ADR, adenomas per colonoscopy (APC), sessile serrated lesion detection rate (SSLDR), and withdrawal time (WT). Of 973 enrolled patients, 914 were included after excluding 59 with inadequate bowel preparation (CADe: 455 vs SC: 459). ADR and AADR did not differ significantly between groups (66.6%vs 61.0%, p = 0.160; 7.3% vs 6.3%, p = 0.263). APC was significantly higher in the CADe group (1.80±2.19 vs 1.32±1.75, p < 0.001), while SSLDR was comparable (17.1%vs 14.2%, p = 0.154). Mean WT was significantly longer with CADe (16.35±8.32 vs 14.52±7.24 min, p < 0.001). CADe-assisted colonoscopy did not improve ADR or AADR in a CRC organized screening population undergoing surveillance colonoscopy, while significantly increasing WT.
cn_title: 人工智能辅助结肠镜在结直肠癌筛查人群监测性结肠镜中的随机对照试验
insight: 在筛查项目监测性结肠镜中，CADe未提高腺瘤检出率却延长退镜时间，提示AI辅助价值可能因人群基线ADR高而受限，需重新界定其适用场景。
grade_rationale: 多中心RCT设计证据等级高，但结果为阴性且未改变现有实践，故实践改变潜力有限。

title: Does omission of a loose seton before sphincter-preserving surgery achieve non-inferior fistula closure compared with routine loose seton placement in adults with single-tract cryptoglandular anal fistula in the Netherlands?
authors: Elwakel AA, Van Hagen P, Veldkamp R, van Dieren S, Bemelman WA, Han-Geurts IJM, et al.
abstract: Cryptoglandular anal fistulas are burdensome, often recurrent and frequently treated in two stages using a loose seton before definitive sphincter-preserving surgery. Although this practice is common, high-quality evidence supporting improved healing or functional outcomes is lacking. A trial is needed to determine whether omitting routine seton placement can reduce procedures, patient burden and costs without compromising fistula closure. The SETON trial is a multicentre, randomised, unblinded non-inferiority trial with an integrated cost-utility analysis. Adults with a single-tract non-purulent mid-high or high cryptoglandular anal fistula will be randomised to loose seton placement for 8 weeks followed by definitive sphincter-preserving surgery, or to direct sphincter-preserving surgery without prior seton placement. The primary endpoint is fistula closure 26 weeks after final surgery, defined clinically and if needed confirmed by MRI or endoanal ultrasound. Secondary outcomes include recurrence, postoperative complications, pain, re-interventions, continence, fistula-related quality of life, generic health-related quality of life, return to work and cost-effectiveness. A sample size has been calculated for a non-inferiority design with fistula closure at 26 weeks as the primary endpoint. Assuming a conservative closure rate of 60% in the standard-care seton group, a one-sided alpha of 0.05, 80% power and a non-inferiority margin of 15 percentage points, 126 patients are required per group for analysis. Allowing for approximately 10% loss to follow-up, the total sample size will be 277 patients. Data will be analysed according to the intention-to-treat and per-protocol principle. The protocol has been approved by the Medical Ethics Review Committee of the Amsterdam University Medical Center, location AMC (reference number: 2025.0826-NL-010338 R031541). Findings will be disseminated in peer-reviewed journals and presented at conferences, whether they are positive, negative or inconclusive. NL-010338.
cn_title: 单管肛瘘括约肌保留术前是否省略松弛挂线：SETON非劣效随机试验方案
insight: 该试验将验证省略常规松弛挂线不劣于传统两阶段手术，有望减少手术次数、患者负担与费用，为肛瘘治疗策略提供高质量证据。
grade_rationale: 多中心随机非劣效试验方案，样本量充足，若结果阳性可能改变临床实践，但尚待结果发表。

title: Diethyl phthalate exposure promotes colon cancer progression through ALDOC mediated proliferation, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and ferroptosis resistance.
authors: Gu Y, Yalikun A, Shen Y, Chen P, Gong H, Liu Q, et al.
journal: Food and Chemical Toxicology : an International Journal Published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
abstract: Colon cancer is a global health threat characterized by marked heterogeneity and therapeutic resistance. Although environmental pollutants may contribute to tumor progression, the role of diethyl phthalate (DEP), a widely used plasticizer and endocrine disruptor, remains unclear. By integrating clinical cohort data, bioinformatics, and in vitro and in vivo models, we investigated the oncogenic effects and mechanisms of DEP in colon cancer. Elevated serum DEP was independently associated with shorter overall survival, and DEP exposure accelerated subcutaneous tumor growth in vivo. In vitro, DEP enhanced cell migration and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), while suppressing ferroptosis by reducing intracellular iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation. LASSO regression and tumor immune microenvironment profiling further established a DEP-related prognostic signature associated with an immune-cold phenotype, characterized by reduced CD4+ and CD8+ memory T cells and increased M2 macrophage infiltration. ALDOC was identified as a key downstream mediator of DEP-induced malignancy. DEP markedly upregulated ALDOC, whereas ALDOC knockdown reversed EMT activation, restored ferroptosis sensitivity, and inhibited cell migration. These findings demonstrate that DEP promotes colon cancer progression through the ALDOC/EMT axis and ferroptosis evasion, highlighting ALDOC as a potential therapeutic target.
cn_title: 邻苯二甲酸二乙酯通过ALDOC促进结肠癌增殖、EMT及铁死亡抵抗
insight: 揭示环境污染物DEP经ALDOC轴驱动结肠癌EMT与铁死亡抵抗并关联免疫冷表型，为肠癌环境暴露相关预后分层及ALDOC靶向治疗提供新依据。
grade_rationale: 多组学与体内外机制整合较完整，但属临床前环境毒理研究，尚无干预性证据，暂难改变临床实践。

title: Lipid droplet-associated proteins integrate lipid metabolism, cell cycle, and cytoskeletal remodeling in colon cancer.
authors: Snarski P, Drago A, Daniels M, Naeem MA, King AN, Ruiz E, et al.
abstract: Lipid remodeling is a hallmark of colonic tumorigenesis, with lipid droplets emerging as key driver of cellular metabolism and tumor growth. This study investigates how dysregulation of lipid droplet-associated proteins facilitates human colon cancer growth. cn_title: 脂滴相关蛋白整合脂质代谢、细胞周期与细胞骨架重塑促进结肠癌生长
insight: 该研究基于脂滴蛋白质组构建151个脂滴相关蛋白的转录组特征，揭示脂滴相关蛋白通过整合脂质代谢、细胞周期和细胞骨架重塑驱动结肠癌生长，为肠癌代谢靶向治疗提供新候选标志物。

title: Clostridium septicum Aortitis and Mediastinitis Complicating Perforated Appendicitis in a Patient with Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia: A Case Report.
authors: Muqtadir J, Bhatti S, Rasheed A, Lesho EP
journal: Journal of Infection and Chemotherapy : Official Journal of the Japan Society of Chemotherapy
abstract: Clostridium septicum is an aerotolerant anaerobe classically linked to occult colorectal malignancy and hematologic disease, and a rare but frequently fatal cause of nontraumatic infective aortitis; it also causes gas gangrene, osteomyelitis and spondylodiscitis. Survival depends on radical surgical debridement, as antibiotics alone are almost uniformly fatal. We describe a 71-year-old man with untreated chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML) who presented with back pain, vomiting and rigors. Computed tomography showed perforated appendicitis with extraluminal air together with mediastinitis and aortitis of the aortic arch and the aorta at the diaphragmatic hiatus. Inflammatory markers were markedly elevated and vasculitis serologies negative. The appendix was managed nonoperatively as he remained hemodynamically stable. Despite broad-spectrum antibiotics, repeat angiography on day 5 showed new aneurysmal dilatation of the arch to 5.1 cm, prompting emergent left carotid-subclavian bypass and thoracic endovascular aortic repair. On day 8, thoracotomy revealed necrotic aortic wall with an exposed endograft, which was debrided and covered with a pedicled latissimus dorsi flap; tissue cultures grew C. septicum. Colonoscopy twelve months earlier had shown only polyps and diverticulosis. He completed six weeks of intravenous ampicillin-sulbactam, was transitioned to lifelong oral suppression for retained prosthetic material, and was discharged on day 57 to long-term acute care, ventilator-dependent. This case shows that C. septicum aortitis may arise from a perforated appendix rather than a colorectal neoplasm, that nonoperative appendicitis management may give inadequate source control in an immunocompromised host, and that survival is attainable with a staged hybrid endovascular-and-open strategy.
cn_title: 产气荚膜梭菌主动脉炎及纵隔炎并发穿孔性阑尾炎：一例慢性粒单核细胞白血病患者的病例报告
insight: 产气荚膜梭菌主动脉炎可源于穿孔性阑尾炎而非结直肠肿瘤，提示免疫抑制患者阑尾炎非手术管理可能源控制不足，分期杂交手术可挽救生命。
grade_rationale: 单例病例报告，证据等级低，但提示了免疫抑制患者阑尾炎管理及产气荚膜梭菌感染源筛查的潜在实践要点。

title: Rational design and molecular docking-guided screening of high-affinity β-glucosidase affibodies for application in a lateral flow immunoassay platform.
authors: Wang L, Liu Z, Zhu Y, Dai S, Yang Z, Liu J, et al.
abstract: Intestinal microbial β-glucosidase serves as a key functional biomarker associated with gut dysbiosis and colorectal cancer (CRC) progression. However, the development of rapid and sensitive point-of-care testing (POCT) methods for β-glucosidase has been limited by the lack of stable and high-affinity recognition elements. In this study, we combined AlphaFold3-based structural prediction with molecular docking to rationally engineer affibodies targeting β-glucosidase. Key binding residues, including Arg-35 and Phe-17, were precisely identified and subjected to saturation mutagenesis for directed optimization. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated that the optimized mutants exhibited enhanced conformational stability, with RMSD values ranging from 1.211 to 1.233 Å, outperforming the wild-type affibody. Among the engineered variants, Mut2 showed excellent thermal stability (Tm = 67.4 °C) and strong binding affinity at the micromolar level. Based on the optimized affibody, a sandwich-format lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA) platform was successfully developed for rapid β-glucosidase detection. The assay achieved a detection limit of 5 μg/mL (59 nM) within 15 min, together with good specificity and repeatability (CV = 3.57%). This work provides a promising strategy for the development of stable non-antibody recognition elements and establishes a rapid LFIA platform for potential early screening of intestinal malignancies.
cn_title: 基于理性设计与分子对接筛选高亲和力β-葡萄糖苷酶亲和体用于侧流免疫分析
insight: 通过AlphaFold3与分子对接理性设计高稳定β-葡萄糖苷酶亲和体，并构建15分钟快速检测的侧流免疫层析平台，为肠道菌群相关结直肠癌早期筛查提供新型POCT工具。
grade_rationale: 研究为临床前方法学开发，虽结合AI结构预测与分子对接，但仅完成分析性能验证，尚无临床样本验证，暂不具备实践改变力。

authors: Dabrowska A, Ruggero D
abstract: How nutrients shape gene expression has remained a fundamental question. Wu et al.
