cn_title: 细菌释放型黏膜黏附贴片用于胃肠道肿瘤局部递送与穿透治疗
insight: 该研究开发多层黏膜黏附贴片实现工程菌在胃肠道肿瘤的局部定植与穿透递送，为肠癌靶向细菌治疗提供新递送策略，但尚处早期。
grade_rationale: 属临床前材料学与工程菌递送研究，无临床数据，距实践改变尚远。

title: AIM2 in tregs restrains anti-PD-1 efficacy by reinforcing immune suppression in MC38 colorectal cancer.
authors: Wang N, Jiang H, Fang Z, Ma J, Ma H, Xu B, et al.
abstract: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) maintain immune homeostasis but also constrain antitumor immunity. Here, we show that the DNA sensor AIM2 sustains immunosuppressive programs in Tregs and limits responses to immune checkpoint blockade. Using an MC38 colorectal cancer model, Treg specific deletion of AIM2 enhanced the efficacy of PD1 blockade. This effect was associated with reduced effector Tregs and immunosuppressive myeloid populations, alongside increased cytotoxic activity of CD8 T cells. AIM2 deficient Tregs exhibited diminished suppressive programs and enhanced interferon responsive signatures, accompanied by broad remodeling of tumor immune interactions. These findings identify AIM2 as a key regulator of Treg mediated immune suppression and suggest that targeting AIM2 may improve the efficacy of cancer immunotherapy.
cn_title: AIM2调控调节性T细胞免疫抑制并限制MC38结直肠癌抗PD-1疗效
insight: 揭示AIM2是Treg免疫抑制程序的关键维持因子，靶向AIM2可增敏PD-1阻断，为肠癌免疫治疗耐药提供新靶点。
grade_rationale: 研究基于MC38小鼠模型，机制新颖但尚处临床前阶段，暂无临床实践改变证据。

title: The shifting balance: innate lymphoid cell plasticity in chronic gut diseases.
authors: Ling P, Fang J, Wang J, Xu Y, Huang N, Mu R, et al.
abstract: Innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), as core components of innate immunity, coordinate mucosal immune defense and homeostasis through their functional plasticity. They exhibit functional diversity in the intestine and display a complex dual role in intestinal diseases, which is closely associated with their phenotypic transformation and functional reprogramming. Current studies have demonstrated that ILCs play critical roles in various chronic intestinal diseases, including autoimmune intestinal disorders, chronic infectious intestinal inflammation, and colorectal cancer. However, the specific functions and reprogramming mechanisms of ILC subsets remain controversial across different types of intestinal diseases. This review provides a comprehensive overview of current research on the mechanisms of ILCs in chronic intestinal diseases, aiming to advance the development of immunotherapeutic strategies targeting ILC reprogramming and offer novel insights into the prevention and treatment of intestinal diseases.
cn_title: 固有淋巴样细胞可塑性在慢性肠道疾病中的平衡转变
insight: 系统梳理ILC亚群在慢性肠炎与结直肠癌中的功能可塑性及重编程机制，为靶向ILC的肠癌免疫治疗提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 综述性文章，无原始数据或临床试验，但聚焦ILC可塑性这一前沿免疫机制，对肠癌免疫治疗方向有启发意义。

title: Explainable AI-based prognostication of patients with resectable colorectal liver metastases using preoperative clinical parameters: is it comparable to traditional clinical scoring systems?
authors: Kumar NP, Drejian S, Akhavi MS, Qadir HA, Fretland ÅA, Kazaryan AM, et al.
abstract: Prognostication for patients undergoing liver resection for colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) remains challenging. Artificial intelligence-based survival models may improve individualized risk estimation. We developed and compared classical machine learning and deep learning survival models using exclusively preoperative clinical variables from 350 patients undergoing first-time liver resection for CRLM. Models included Cox proportional hazards (CoxPH), random survival forest (RSF), support vector machine for survival (SVM), XGBoost survival, DeepSurv, and DeepHit. Model performance was evaluated using the concordance index (C-index) and the Integrated Brier Score (IBS) on a training set of 245 patients, testing set of 105 patients, and an independent internal validation set of 88 patients from the OSLO-COMET trial. Model interpretability was assessed using SHapley Additive explanation (SHAP) analysis. The results of the developed models were compared to well established Basingstoke Predictive Index (BPI). On internal validation cohort, CoxPH demonstrated the most consistent performance on the internal validation set (C-index 0.59), and on the test set patients (C-index 0.65), comparable to more complex machine learning and deep learning models. Although RSF achieved the highest training performance, this did not translate into superior performance both on the test and the internal validation datasets. CoxPH and DeepSurv models showed comparable 1-, 3-, and 5-year individual prediction to BPI. SHAP analysis consistently identified ASA score, lobar distribution, primary tumor location and number of metastases as the most influential predictors across models. Using structured preoperative clinical data, we developed machine-and deep-learning models to predict overall survival in patients with CRLM. Given that the models were based exclusively on preoperative clinical variables, their performance is encouraging. Predictive accuracy may be further improved by incorporating additional data modalities, particularly radiological features as well as by training on larger datasets.
cn_title: 可切除结直肠癌肝转移术前临床参数的可解释AI预后模型：与传统评分系统的比较
insight: 基于术前临床变量的机器学习/深度学习模型在CRLM预后预测中与BPI相当，但未超越传统Cox模型，提示需整合影像等多模态数据以提升预测精度。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性研究，样本量有限，模型性能未超越传统评分，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: The ATM inhibitor KU55933 inhibits TGF-β1-mediated epithelial to mesenchymal transition in colorectal cancer cells.
authors: Ding Y, Zhang Y, Zhang Z, Kong X, Hu X, Lu Y, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a major cause of cancer death worldwide, largely due to metastasis and drug resistance. The epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) is known to drive CRC metastasis. ATM kinase has been reported to influence the Akt signaling pathway, which itself plays a central role in EMT. We examined whether the ATM inhibitor KU55933 could interfere with TGF-β1-induced EMT in two human CRC cell lines, SW620 and HT29. Cells were exposed to TGF-β1 with or without KU55933 (or KU60019). EMT was assessed by cell morphology and Western blotting for epithelial and mesenchymal markers. Migration was measured by wound healing assay, and invasion by Matrigel assay. Apoptosis and proliferation were evaluated by flow cytometry and MTT assay. To explore the underlying mechanism, we analyzed Akt pathway signaling by Western blot and performed KEGG pathway enrichment on gene expression changes. A xenograft model was also used to test the KU55933 effectively reversed the morphological changes triggered by TGF-β1. It reduced mesenchymal markers Vimentin and N-cadherin while upregulating the epithelial marker E-cadherin. At the mechanistic level, KU55933 was associated with reduced phospho-AKT Ser473 and phospho-GSK-3β Ser9 signals, together with lower expression of the transcription factors ZEB1, Snail, and Twist-1. KEGG pathway analysis showed that differentially expressed genes between the TGF-β1 and TGF-β1 plus KU55933 groups were significantly enriched in the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway. Functionally, the inhibitor significantly suppressed TGF-β1-driven migration and invasion and promoted apoptosis. Our data indicate that KU55933 and KU60019 attenuate TGF-β1-induced EMT-associated phenotypes, migration, and invasion in CRC cells, accompanied by reduced AKT-related signaling, while also promoting apoptosis and suppressing xenograft growth. These findings support further investigation of pharmacological ATM inhibition as a potential strategy for limiting CRC progression.
cn_title: ATM抑制剂KU55933抑制结直肠癌细胞TGF-β1介导的上皮间质转化
insight: ATM抑制剂通过AKT/GSK-3β轴阻断TGF-β1诱导的EMT、迁移侵袭并抑制移植瘤生长，为靶向ATM遏制肠癌进展提供临床前依据。
grade_rationale: 仅两株细胞系加小鼠移植瘤的临床前机制研究，尚无临床或外部验证，暂不具备改变实践的证据强度。

title: Malnutrition as an independent risk factor for fluoropyrimidine- and oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy-induced cardiovascular toxicity in colorectal cancer: a single-center retrospective cohort study.
authors: Zhou X, Tang B, Sheng X, Chang H
abstract: Fluoropyrimidine- and oxaliplatin-based regimens (FOLFOX/XELOX) are the standard of care for colorectal cancer (CRC) but carry significant cardiovascular toxicity. Malnutrition, present in up to 60% of post-surgical CRC patients, may amplify this toxicity through systemic inflammation and pharmacokinetic alterations; however, this relationship has not been specifically investigated. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 320 CRC patients receiving FOLFOX or XELOX at the Shanghai songjiang sijing hospital (January 2020-December 2023). Nutritional status was assessed by the Nutritional Risk Screening 2002 (NRS-2002) and serum albumin. The primary endpoint was chemotherapy-induced cardiovascular toxicity events (CICVT), defined per 2022 ESC Cardio-Oncology Guidelines. Multivariable logistic regression, 1:1 propensity score matching (PSM), and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis were performed. An intestinal fistula subgroup compared outcomes between total parenteral nutrition (TPN) and early enteral nutrition (EEN). Nutritional risk (NRS-2002 ≥ 3) was identified in 112 patients (35.0%). CICVT occurred in 31.3% of patients at nutritional risk vs. 11.5% of well-nourished patients ( Malnutrition is an independent and modifiable risk factor for chemotherapy-induced cardiovascular toxicity in CRC. Integrating nutritional assessment into pre-chemotherapy cardiovascular risk stratification and prioritizing early enteral nutrition in fistula patients may mitigate cardiovascular morbidity.
cn_title: 营养不良是结直肠癌氟尿嘧啶及奥沙利铂化疗相关心血管毒性的独立危险因素
insight: 该研究首次将营养风险确立为肠癌化疗心血管毒性的独立可干预因素，提示化疗前应整合营养评估进行心血管风险分层，并为肠癌围化疗期营养干预研究提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，样本量320例，虽提示可干预风险因素但缺乏外部验证，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Tectochrysin, a propolis-associated flavone, suppresses colorectal cancer progression and modulates ERBB4-associated signalling.
authors: Du Y, Wang Y, Wang Z, Li Q, Wang L, Li D, et al.
abstract: Tectochrysin is a propolis-associated methoxylated flavone with reported anticancer activity, but its actions in colorectal cancer (CRC) remain incompletely defined. In CRC mouse models, tectochrysin reduced orthotopic tumor-associated bioluminescence and the numbers of histologically identified lung and liver metastatic nodules.
cn_title: Tectochrysin抑制结直肠癌进展并调控ERBB4相关信号通路
insight: 该研究揭示蜂胶黄酮Tectochrysin通过调控ERBB4信号抑制肠癌生长及肺肝转移，为肠癌肝转移的天然产物干预提供了新靶点与临床前证据。
grade_rationale: 临床前动物模型研究，尚无临床数据，但涉及肝转移直接相关表型，机制新颖，暂不具备实践改变力。

title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Clinical Outcomes of the Intraoperative Intelligent Knife (REIMS) in Adult Oncologic Surgery: A Systematic Review.
authors: Alatoom M, Abdelhadi L, Al-Majmuei A, Alqawasmi LMF, Fredericks S
abstract: Rapid intraoperative distinction between malignant and non-malignant tissue may improve resection completeness and reduce reoperation in cancer surgery. The intelligent knife (iKnife) integrates rapid evaporative ionisation mass spectrometry with electrosurgery to provide real-time tissue classification during surgery. This systematic review assessed the diagnostic accuracy and reported clinical outcomes of intraoperative iKnife use in adults undergoing oncological surgery. The review was prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251049162) and written according to PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-DTA, given the primary focus on diagnostic test accuracy. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, ClinicalTrials.gov, and the WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform were searched to 10 March 2026. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias and certainty of evidence. Nineteen studies across nine tumour types were included, most of which were small prospective observational or feasibility cohorts. Reported sensitivity ranged from 60% to 100% and specificity from 80.7% to 100%, with high point estimates in ovarian, breast, colorectal and soft-tissue sarcoma settings. Downstream clinical outcome data were limited to margin status in 10 studies, reoperation in 3, complications in 4 and recurrence in 1, with no report of survival. The iKnife shows promise as a real-time intraoperative diagnostic adjunct, but evidence that it improves patient outcomes remains limited. Larger prospective multicentre studies with standardised outcomes and follow-up are required.
cn_title: 术中智能刀（REIMS）在成人肿瘤外科中的诊断准确性与临床结局：系统综述
insight: iKnife实时质谱组织鉴别在结直肠癌等肿瘤中灵敏度60-100%、特异度80.7-100%，但缺乏生存与复发硬终点证据，提示肠癌肝转移切缘判定需前瞻多中心验证。
grade_rationale: PROSPERO注册、PRISMA-DTA规范的系统综述证据等级较高，但纳入研究多为小样本前瞻观察/可行性队列，结局数据有限且无生存报告，尚不足以改变实践。

title: Development and Validation of a Stability-Indicating UPLC-PDA Method for Fruquintinib: LC-QTOF-MS/MS-Based Structural Characterization of Degradation Products and In Silico ADMET Prediction.
authors: Nayak S, Labhade VD, Hirlekar BU, Tewari S, Pawar SD
journal: Rapid Communications in Mass Spectrometry : RCM
abstract: Fruquintinib (FRQ) is a recently approved drug for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer. To date, only a limited number of studies have investigated the stability-indicating analysis of FRQ. Understanding its degradation pathways is essential for ensuring drug quality and safety, for regulatory compliance and for providing valuable insights into pharmaceutical development and quality control. FRQ was subjected to acid, base, oxidative, neutral, thermal, and photolytic stress as per ICH Q1A(R2). A stability-indicating UPLC-PDA method was developed on a Waters BEH C18 column (2.1 × 50 mm, 1.7 μm) with gradient elution using a mobile phase of 10 mM ammonium acetate (pH 3.5) and acetonitrile. Degradants were characterized by LTQ-XL ion-trap MS and LC-QTOF-MS/MS, followed by silico ADMET prediction. The method is developed and validated in accordance with the ICH Q2(R2) guidelines. Forced degradation of FRQ under acidic, basic and oxidative stress conditions generated two common degradation products, DP-1 (m/z 207.0756) and DP-2 (m/z 221.0900), common to all three stress conditions, in addition to one degradation product specific to the oxidative pathway; FRQ was stable under neutral, thermal and photolytic conditions. The two major degradation products are identified and characterized by LC-QTOF-MS/MS. Out of two DPs, the DP-2 product has not been reported previously. ADMET prediction indicated acceptable pharmacokinetic properties but flagged potential drug-drug interaction risk. The developed UPLC-PDA method provides a robust stability-indicating method for FRQ and enables comprehensive characterization of its degradation products. The discovery of the novel degradation product DP-2 expands current knowledge of FRQ degradation chemistry, whereas the combined analytical and in silico findings support pharmaceutical quality assessment, regulatory evaluation, and future safety investigations.
cn_title: 呋喹替尼稳定性指示UPLC-PDA方法的建立与验证及降解产物LC-QTOF-MS/MS表征与ADMET预测
insight: 该研究建立呋喹替尼稳定性指示分析方法并鉴定新降解产物DP-2，为这一mCRC治疗药物的质量控制与用药安全提供分析学支撑，但未涉及疗效或肝转移结局。
grade_rationale: 属药物分析化学方法学论文，遵循ICH Q2(R2)验证但无临床终点，对临床实践影响有限。

title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of preoperative MRI-based pelvimetry in predicting surgical difficulty in rectal cancer: Implications for personalised surgical planning.
authors: Kitaguchi D, Kolbinger FR, Dipanjyoti P, Jadhav K, Oda T, Forgione A, et al.
journal: Colorectal Disease : the Official Journal of the Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based pelvimetry has been investigated for predicting surgical difficulty in total mesorectal excision (TME) for rectal cancer. However, heterogeneity in pelvimetric parameters, surrogate outcomes, and study design has resulted in inconsistent evidence. This systematic review aimed to synthesise the evidence on commonly used MRI parameters and difficulty surrogates and assess their methodological robustness and clinical relevance. PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were systematically searched through December 2025 for studies evaluating preoperative MRI pelvimetry in patients undergoing TME for rectal cancer. Outcome parameters were surrogate measures of surgical difficulty, including operating time, intraoperative blood loss, conversion to open surgery, pathological quality metrics, and postoperative complications. Risk of bias was assessed using the Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Exposures (ROBINS-E) tool. This systematic review and meta-analysis was reported in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 statement and prospectively registered (PROSPERO: CRD420261287153). Thirty-six studies comprising 8,364 patients were included. Common parameters included sagittal measurements and axial interspinous distance (ISD) and intertuberous distance (ITD). Definitions of surgical difficulty varied substantially. ROBINS-E identified some concerns in 30 studies, a high risk of bias in five, and insufficient information in one. Meta-analysis of six studies (n = 769) showed that shorter ISD (mean difference [MD] -5.13 mm, 95% CI -6.61 to -3.65; p < 0.001; I MRI-based pelvimetry, particularly ISD and ITD, may help predict surgical difficulty in TME. However, methodological heterogeneity limits broader quantitative synthesis and highlights the need for standardised pelvimetric protocols.
cn_title: 术前MRI骨盆测量预测直肠癌手术难度的系统综述与Meta分析
insight: 术前MRI骨盆测量（尤其ISD、ITD）可辅助预测直肠癌TME手术难度，但方法学异质性大，亟需标准化方案以推动个体化手术规划。
grade_rationale: 基于36项非随机研究、8364例患者的系统综述与Meta分析，证据等级中等，但异质性高且无干预性验证，暂不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Tissue carcinoembryonic antigen as a superior independent prognostic factor for colorectal cancer over serum CEA: a retrospective cohort study.
authors: Lu X, Zhang G, Xiao Y, Wang L, Huang X, Xiao Y
abstract: We explored the relationships between tissue carcinoembryonic antigen (t-CEA) and serum CEA (s-CEA) and further pursued their association with long-term survival among postoperative colorectal cancer (CRC) patients. All patients underwent determination of s-CEA levels and t-CEA expression. Pearson correlation analysis was performed to quantify the interactions between two variables. Kaplan-Meier survival analysis and time-dependent receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses were performed. Prognostic factors were subjected to analysis using multivariable Cox regression to form prognostic nomograms. The results showed the positive rate of t-CEA overexpression recorded at 90.96%. No significant correlation was shown between the two variables. CRC patients with high t-CEA expression revealed a significantly poorer overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS). In unadjusted Kaplan-Meier survival analyses, elevated s-CEA levels were associated with significantly poorer PFS (p = 0.033) but not OS (p = 0.077). Crucially, multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression confirmed that high t-CEA expression, rather than s-CEA, served as a robust independent prognostic factor for both OS (HR = 2.887, p = 0.017) and PFS (HR = 2.500, p = 0.002). Nomograms comprising t-CEA were constructed with superior utility in predicting the survival probability of CRC patients. To conclude, our study demonstrates the superior prognostic value of t-CEA as an independent prognostic factor for CRC compared to s-CEA.
cn_title: 组织CEA较血清CEA是结直肠癌更优的独立预后因素：回顾性队列研究
insight: 组织CEA表达与血清CEA无显著相关，且为独立于血清CEA的更强预后因子，提示术后病理CEA免疫组化有望纳入肠癌风险分层，并可能影响肝转移随访策略。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，样本与外部验证有限，虽提出t-CEA优于s-CEA的预后价值，但尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Fluoroscopy-guided colorectal stent placement for distal malignant colorectal obstruction: a retrospective single-center study.
authors: Uysal A, Göl M, Akıncı D, Çiftçi TT, Ünal E
abstract: Malignant distal colorectal obstruction is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality when managed with emergency surgery. This study aimed to evaluate the technical and early clinical outcomes, safety, procedural radiation exposure, and stent-related reintervention of fluoroscopy-guided self-expandable metal stent (SEMS) placement. This retrospective single-center study included patients treated between January 2018 and December 2025. Bridge-to-surgery or palliative intent was established before stent placement and retrospectively abstracted from contemporaneous records. Primary end points were technical success and early clinical success within 48 hours. Secondary end points included adverse events within 30 days, stent-related reintervention, time to oral intake, total procedure time, fluoroscopy time, and dose-area product. The cohort comprised 19 patients. Technical success was achieved in all patients [100%; 95% confidence interval (CI), 82.4%-100%], and early clinical success in 18 (94.7%; 95% CI, 74.0%-99.9%). Median time to oral intake was 3 days (interquartile range, 2-5 days). Median total procedure time was 38 minutes (range, 25-55 minutes). Median fluoroscopy time was 4.5 minutes (range, 3.8-8.0 minutes), and median dose-area product was 6.4 Gy·cm Fluoroscopy-guided SEMS placement achieved high technical and early clinical success in selected patients with distal malignant colorectal obstruction and may provide an effective interventional radiology-led decompressive option in experienced centers. Fluoroscopy-guided SEMS placement can provide timely decompression in selected patients with distal malignant colorectal obstruction within an interventional radiology-led multidisciplinary pathway, with endoscopic support available when needed.
cn_title: 透视引导下结直肠支架置入治疗远端恶性梗阻的单中心回顾性研究
insight: 透视引导SEMS置入在远端恶性结直肠梗阻中技术成功率高、早期临床有效，为介入放射科主导的多学科减压路径提供可行选择，对肠癌梗阻及后续肝转移治疗衔接有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 单中心小样本（19例）回顾性研究，无对照组，证据等级低，仅提示介入路径可行性，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Proopiomelanocortin (POMC)-β-Endorphin System in the Rat Colon: Expression, Up Regulation by Stress, and Correlation With Stress-Induced Visceral Analgesia.
authors: Yuan PQ, Larauche M, Wu V, Taché Y
abstract: The pituitary proopiomelanocortin (POMC)-β-endorphin (β-END) system is activated by hypothalamic corticotropin-releasing factor (CRF) signaling and stress. We investigated whether this pathway is also expressed in the rat colon, regulated by peripheral CRF and stress, and correlated with stress-induced visceral analgesia. POMC and the prohormone convertases PC1/3 and PC2 transcripts were assessed by RT-PCR, and POMC and β-END localization was examined by immunohistochemistry in the proximal and distal colon of naïve adult male Sprague-Dawley rats. Proximal colonic POMC mRNA was quantified by real-time quantitative PCR 1 h after intraperitoneal injection of CRF (10 μg/kg) or saline and on day 11 after assessing visceromotor responses (VMRs) to colorectal distension (CRD) using a non-invasive method in rats subjected to repeated water avoidance stress (rWAS) (1 h/day for 10 days) or control handling. The correlation between POMC gene expression and VMRs was evaluated. POMC, PC1/3, and PC2 transcripts were detected in the proximal and distal colon. POMC- and β-END-immunoreactive cells are localized in the lamina propria and enteric plexuses. CRF increased POMC mRNA expression by 2.5-fold. rWAS decreased VMRs to CRD in a pressure-dependent manner, with a reduction of up to 52% at 60 mmHg, and increased POMC expression 10-fold compared with controls; POMC expression was inversely correlated with cumulative VMRs (r = -0.655, p = 0.034). POMC-β-END system expression in the rat colonic enteric plexus, together with CRF/stress-induced upregulation of POMC and its correlation with analgesic responses to CRD, suggests a possible relevance in modulating visceral pain.
cn_title: 大鼠结肠POMC-β-内啡肽系统：应激上调及其与应激诱导内脏镇痛的关联
insight: 该研究揭示结肠局部POMC-β-内啡肽系统受CRF/应激调控并与内脏镇痛相关，为肠癌患者应激相关内脏痛及肝转移疼痛管理提供潜在靶点。
grade_rationale: 基础动物机制研究，样本量小，无临床验证，但揭示新通路，暂不具备改变临床实践的证据等级。

title: Survival Outcomes in Older Adults with Axial Spondyloarthritis and Concomitant Cancer.
authors: Bowman S, Li M, Lei X, Zhao H, Ruiz JI, Giordano SH, et al.
abstract: The objective of this study was to determine survival outcomes in older adults with axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) and concomitant cancer. We conducted a population-based study using Medicare claims data linked to Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results data to determine overall survival (OS) and cancer-specific survival (CSS) in patients aged ≥66 years with in situ, localized, regional, or distant breast cancer (BC), prostate cancer (PCa), lung cancer (LC), or colorectal cancer (CRC), with and without axSpA, diagnosed January 2006 to December 2019 using ICD-O-3 site and histology codes. Patients with axSpA were matched to 2-5 controls without axSpA using cancer type, age at cancer diagnosis, sex, stage, and year of cancer diagnosis. We censored OS and CSS at 5 years and estimated rates using Kaplan-Meier analyses with log-rank tests. Stratified Cox proportional hazard regression models were performed for each cancer type, with CSS analyzed under the competing risks framework. We included 6,095 patients (2,061 BC, 1,988 PCa, 1,229 LC, 817 CRC) with axSpA and 30,386 controls. Mean ages ranged from 74 (BC, PCa, LC) to 77 (CRC). No statistically significant differences in OS or CSS rates were observed between BC, PCa, or LC patients with axSpA compared to controls. CRC patients with axSpA had higher 5-year OS (adjusted hazard ratio (aHR): 0.78 (95% CI: 0.67-0.91, P=0.002)) and CSS (aHR: 0.76 (95% CI: 0.59-0.99, P= 0.04)) compared to controls. Older patients with axSpA and BC, PCa, and LC had similar OS and CSS compared to controls. Among patients with CRC, axSpA was associated with higher OS and CSS.
cn_title: 老年中轴型脊柱关节炎合并结直肠癌患者的生存结局：基于SEER-Medicare的人群研究
insight: 合并中轴型脊柱关节炎的老年结直肠癌患者总生存与癌因生存反而更优，提示免疫炎症背景或治疗暴露可能影响肠癌预后，值得在肝转移人群中进一步验证。
grade_rationale: 基于SEER-Medicare大样本回顾性匹配队列，样本量可观但为观察性设计且仅限老年人群，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Clinical and pathological characteristics of mucinous adenocarcinoma in colon cancer: comparison with classic adenocarcinoma.
authors: Acar B, Muhtaroğlu A, Kesi̇ci̇oğlu T, Acar S, Yilmaz E, Çeki̇ç Y
abstract: Mucinous adenocarcinoma of the colon is defined by extracellular mucin occupying at least 50% of the tumour. Although it is often regarded as a distinct histological subtype, its clinicopathological profile remains variable across published series. We compared mucinous and classic adenocarcinoma in a colon-only surgical cohort. We retrospectively reviewed patients who underwent oncological resection for colon adenocarcinoma between October 2021 and March 2026. Rectal tumours, neoadjuvant-treated cases and signet ring cell carcinoma were excluded. Clinicopathological variables were compared using Mann-Whitney U, Pearson chi-square or Fisher exact tests. Multivariable analyses were revised as parsimonious logistic regression models, with model size and event counts reported. The final cohort included 155 colon cancers: 29 mucinous and 126 classic adenocarcinomas. Mucinous tumours were more often right-sided (75.9% vs. 44.4%; p = 0.002) and more frequently poorly differentiated (24.1% vs. 4.8%; p = 0.003). Advanced pT stage was common in both groups (86.2% vs. 82.5%; p = 0.786). Nodal metastasis was numerically less frequent in mucinous adenocarcinoma (31.0% vs. 50.8%; p = 0.055), while lymphovascular invasion was significantly less common (10.3% vs. 32.5%; p = 0.017). Deficient mismatch repair was recorded in 13.8% of mucinous tumours and 8.7% of classic adenocarcinomas (p = 0.484). In parsimonious adjusted models, mucinous histology was not independently associated with advanced pT stage (adjusted OR 1.51, 95% CI 0.46-4.92; p = 0.496) or nodal metastasis (adjusted OR 0.48, 95% CI 0.19-1.19; p = 0.113). In this colon-only cohort, mucinous adenocarcinoma was associated with right-sided location and poor differentiation, but not with independently higher local invasion or nodal spread. These findings support a cautious, clinicopathology-based interpretation of mucinous histology and should not be extrapolated to prognosis without molecular and survival data.
cn_title: 结肠黏液腺癌与经典腺癌的临床病理特征比较
insight: 单中心回顾性队列显示结肠黏液腺癌多位于右半结肠、分化差，但并非独立与局部浸润或淋巴结转移相关，提示不宜仅凭黏液组织学推断预后。
grade_rationale: 单中心小样本回顾性研究，无生存与分子数据，仅提供描述性病理关联，不足以改变临床实践。

title: Metabolic Bariatric Surgery for Cancer Prevention and Risk Reduction in Patients with Obesity: A GRADE-Based International Federation for the Surgery and Other Therapies for Obesity (IFSO) Position Statement.
authors: Belluzzi A, De Luca M, Vitiello A, Cohen R, Aminian A, Salminen P, et al.
abstract: Obesity is a major increasing driver of cancer burden worldwide, and intentional weight loss has emerged as a potential strategy for cancer risk reduction. Metabolic bariatric surgery (MBS) achieves sustained weight loss, but its role in cancer prevention remains uncertain. This GRADE-based International Federation for the Surgery and Other Therapies for Obesity (IFSO) position statement aimed to synthesize contemporary evidence on MBS and cancer outcomes and translate it into clinically actionable recommendations. A systematic review according to PRISMA guidelines was performed searching MEDLINE and EMBASE up to 8th March 2026. Two questions were formulated addressing MBS versus non-surgical weight-loss interventions and comparative effectiveness of MBS procedures for reducing cancer incidence. Evidence was appraised using GRADE principles. There were no RCTs enrolling adults with obesity reporting cancer incidence after MBS. The search identified 191 records, of which 26 were included in the qualitative synthesis and a maximum of seven contributed to any single quantitative pooled estimate. Across retrospective matched cohorts, MBS was generally associated with lower incidence of several obesity-related malignancies, with point estimates favoring MBS for most cancer sites. Pooled random-effects estimates included breast cancer (IRR 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.91), endometrial cancer (IRR 0.38, 95% CI 0.23-0.61) and colorectal cancer (IRR 0.72, 95% CI 0.59-0.88); certainty of evidence was low to very low for all outcomes. Reported reductions were most consistent for hormone-sensitive cancers but also observed across multiple gastrointestinal and other sites with variable heterogeneity. Sensitivity analyses incorporating modern obesity management medications (OMMs) also suggested cancer incidence reductions across several sites, supporting sustained weight loss as a mediator of cancer risk reduction. Current evidence suggests that MBS is associated with reduced incidence of several obesity related cancers. However, the certainty of the evidence is limited by residual selection bias, and heterogeneity.
cn_title: 代谢减重手术预防肥胖患者肿瘤：IFSO基于GRADE的立场声明
insight: 代谢减重手术与结直肠癌等肥胖相关肿瘤发病率下降相关，提示持续减重可降低肠癌风险，为肠癌一级预防提供新思路。
grade_rationale: IFSO国际立场声明基于系统综述与GRADE分级，但证据确定性低至极低，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Resolving cell-cell interaction networks and their molecular logic in complex tissues.
authors: Tang L, Tian K, Fu X, Xu Y, Wu J, Zhang J, et al.
abstract: Cells in complex organisms function through extensive interactions, yet mapping these interaction networks at scale remains challenging. Here we present CCI-seq, a high-throughput method to unbiasedly capture cell-cell interactions across a proximity continuum by combining cell clump combinatorial indexing with single-cell sequencing. CCI-seq identified known interactions and fine-grained cellular organization in mouse kidney and intestine, and uncovered aberrant interactions and disrupted spatial organization in adenomatous polyposis coli knockout (Apc-KO) intestines. Applied to human colorectal cancer, it revealed subtype-specific interactions linked to clinical classifications. By leveraging a single-cell RNA sequencing backbone, CCI-seq achieves deep transcriptome coverage, enabling analysis of molecular states arising from interactions. This functional resolution revealed that interacting cells associate with distinct transcriptional programs-driving ion transport in kidney, antigen presentation in Apc-KO villi and NF-κB inflammatory activation in colorectal cancer. Thus, CCI-seq provides a scalable platform to unveil large-scale cell-cell interaction networks and dissect their molecular and functional impacts, enhancing our understanding of complex multicellular systems.
cn_title: CCI-seq解析复杂组织中细胞间互作网络及其分子逻辑
insight: CCI-seq实现高通量、无偏倚的细胞互作捕获，在肠癌中揭示亚型特异性互作及NF-κB炎症激活，为肝转移微环境研究提供新工具。
grade_rationale: 方法学创新性强，但尚属工具开发阶段，未直接改变临床实践。

title: Comparative efficacy and safety of hybrid versus conventional endoscopic submucosal dissection for non-ampullary duodenal submucosal tumors.
authors: Luo SB, Wang L, Zhang JY, Qu YF, Li QL, Zhou PH, et al.
abstract: Hybrid endoscopic submucosal dissection (H-ESD) is established to be curable and safe for colorectal submucosal tumors (SMTs). We aimed to evaluate the feasibility and safety of H-ESD and conventional ESD (C-ESD) for non-ampullary duodenal SMTs (NAD-SMTs). From September 2017 to December 2024, patients with NAD-SMTs treated with H-ESD or C-ESD at the Endoscopy Center of Zhongshan Hospital were retrospectively analyzed. After propensity score matching (PSM), baseline characteristics, clinical outcomes, and follow-up were retrospectively analyzed. With similar baseline characteristics between the two groups after PSM, the H-ESD group had a shorter procedural duration (41 vs. 67 min, P < 0.001) compared to the C-ESD group. The en bloc resection rates were 93.8 and 92.2%, and the R0 resection rates were 90.6 and 89.1%, respectively. Although there was no statistically significant difference, the H-ESD group had a lower overall adverse event (AE) rate. The H-ESD group had 1 case of abdominal effusion and 1 case of febrile episode, whereas the C-ESD group had 2 cases of intraprocedural bleeding, 1 case of intraoperative muscle layer injury, 1 case of pneumoperitoneum, 1 case of delayed bleeding, and 1 case of abdominal effusion. During the median follow-up period, no recurrence occurred in the H-ESD group, while one local recurrence was detected in the C-ESD group. Both H-ESD and C-ESD were safe and effective for NAD-SMTs; however, H-ESD resulted in a reduced procedure time without increasing the occurrence of AEs compared with C-ESD. Therefore, H-ESD may be recommended as a treatment for NAD-SMTs.
cn_title: 混合与常规内镜黏膜下剥离术治疗非壶腹部十二指肠黏膜下肿瘤的疗效与安全性比较
insight: 该研究提示混合ESD可缩短非壶腹部十二指肠黏膜下肿瘤手术时间且不增加不良事件，为肠癌相关内镜治疗策略提供参考，但与肝转移直接关联有限。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列结合倾向性评分匹配，样本量有限且非随机，虽提示H-ESD优势但证据等级不足以改变临床实践。

title: Talc Use and Risk of Cancer: An Umbrella Review and Overlapped Analysis.
authors: Mayta-Tovalino F, Cabanillas-Lazo M, Quispe-Vicuña C, Espinoza-Carhuancho F, Hernandez AV
abstract: This umbrella review aimed to systematically synthesize and critically appraise the available evidence from systematic reviews and meta-analyses evaluating the association between talc exposure and cancer risk in humans. This umbrella review was conducted in accordance with the PRIOR guidelines and registered in PROSPERO. A comprehensive search of PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, and Epistemonikos was performed up to October 2024 without language or date restrictions. Eligible studies were systematic reviews evaluating any type of talc exposure in humans. Study selection and data extraction were performed independently, and risk of bias was assessed using the AMSTAR-2 tool. Nine systematic reviews were included, eight combining cohort and case-control studies and one restricted to cohort studies. Cosmetic talc exposure was the most frequently investigated, with most reviews focused on ovarian cancer. Moderate overlap of study populations (9.2%) was identified, primarily related to Boon et al. Based on AMSTAR-2, confidence in the evidence was moderate in one review and critically low in seven, with frequent methodological shortcomings such as lack of protocol registration and unclear study exclusions. For occupational exposure, elevated risks were observed for overall cancer (RR 1.21; 95% CI 1.03-1.42) and colorectal cancer (SIR 1.59; 95% CI 1.07-2.26), while no increased risk was found for other cancer types. Four of five systematic reviews evaluating cosmetic talc exposure and ovarian cancer reported a statistically significant association with increased ovarian cancer risk, whereas one review found no statistically significant association. However, confidence in the results of the reviews included was predominantly low or critically low, reflecting important methodological limitations, including concerns regarding risk-of-bias assessment and reporting. Overall, the evidence supporting an association between cosmetic talc exposure and ovarian cancer was of limited confidence. There is limited evidence from systematic reviews regarding the association of exposure to cosmetic talc with an increased risk of developing ovarian cancer. Therefore, the results of the systematic reviews should be regarded as suggestive, rather than definitive, and further studies are required to demonstrate a causal relationship.
cn_title: 滑石粉暴露与癌症风险：伞状综述及重叠分析
insight: 职业滑石粉暴露与结直肠癌风险升高相关（SIR 1.59），但证据质量普遍偏低，提示需在肠癌病因学研究中关注职业暴露因素并提升证据等级。
grade_rationale: 伞状综述整合9项系统综述，方法学规范（PRIOR、PROSPERO、AMSTAR-2），但原始证据置信度多为极低，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Age-specific patterns in colorectal cancer incidence and survival over time: a 17-year population-based cancer registry study from northeastern Italy.
authors: Taborelli M, Toffolutti F, Angelin T, Lazzaretto E, Losciale M, Puglisi F, et al.
journal: Digestive and Liver Disease : Official Journal of the Italian Society of Gastroenterology and the Italian Association for the Study of the Liver
abstract: Age-specific differences in colorectal cancer remain insufficiently characterized in studies integrating incidence and survival dynamics. We analyzed age-specific patterns of colorectal cancer incidence and survival over time using population-based registry data from northeastern Italy, including 16,752 colorectal adenocarcinomas (2005-2021). Analyses examined early-onset (<50 years), screening-eligible (50-69 years), and late-onset (≥70 years) disease. Incidence trends were assessed using Joinpoint regression. Five-year net survival and conditional net survival were estimated using the Pohar-Perme method. Early-onset cancers (4.2%) more often presented with advanced stage and high-grade histology, with stable incidence over time. Among screening-eligible individuals, incidence initially increased and then declined after the 2008 implementation of organized screening, particularly for stage I disease (annual percent change: +13.8% then -7.8%), left-sided (+7.3% then -19.9%), and rectal cancers. Five-year net survival improved over time, mainly in stage II-III. Stage IV survival remained poor, with modest gains in younger patients (16-29%) and persistently poor outcomes in older ones (6-8%). Conditional 5-year net survival increased across all age groups and stages, especially in stage IV (7-16% at diagnosis; 64-74% at 5 years). These findings support timely diagnosis and appropriate care across age groups, continued screening among eligible individuals, and dynamic prognostic assessment.
cn_title: 意大利东北部17年人群登记研究：结直肠癌发病与生存的年龄特异性模式
insight: 基于人群登记数据揭示早发、筛查适龄及晚发肠癌的发病与生存差异，提示应坚持筛查并重视动态预后评估，对肝转移高危人群的早期识别与分层管理具有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 大样本、17年人群登记数据，但为观察性回顾设计，主要提供流行病学与预后证据，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Association of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease with colorectal cancer incidence and surgical outcomes.
authors: Elemosho A, Woldesenbet S, Mirzaeifard A, Yuza K, Angez M, Chatzipanagiotou OP, et al.
journal: HPB : the Official Journal of the International Hepato Pancreato Biliary Association
abstract: The incidence as well as how metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) impacts colorectal cancer (CRC) remains unclear. We sought to define CRC incidence among patients with MASLD and assess the association of MASLD with postoperative outcomes. Adults with incident MASLD/MASH were identified using Epic Cosmos to estimate CRC incidence. CRC patients with versus without pre-existing MASLD were evaluated using propensity score matching and multivariable regression. Among 2,995,488 patients with MASLD (MASH n = 400,935), 10,588 developed incident CRC (incidence: 109.13 per 100,000 persons per year). CRC incidence was similar in MASH and MASLD without MASH. Patients with MASLD were younger (median age, 67 vs 73 years) and more often had severe obesity (37.7% vs 15.7%), type-2 diabetes (39.9% vs 31.0%), and cirrhosis (10.3% vs 1.6%). After matching, MASLD was independently associated with longer length-of-stay (IRR 1.12, 95% CI 1.09-1.16), 30-day readmission (OR 1.29, 95% CI 1.16-1.44), ICU stay (OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.07-1.34), any 30-day complication (OR 1.24, 95% CI 1.15-1.33), hepatobiliary (OR 1.19, 95% CI 1.06-1.33) and renal complications (OR 1.25, 95% CI 1.05-1.47), yet no difference in mortality. CRC arising in the setting of MASLD was associated with greater metabolic and liver-related comorbidity and greater postoperative morbidity, yet long-term survival was similar.
cn_title: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病与结直肠癌发病率及手术结局的关联
insight: MASLD显著增加结直肠癌术后并发症与再入院风险但不影响远期生存，提示肠癌围手术期需重视代谢性肝病共病管理。
grade_rationale: 基于Epic Cosmos近300万人大样本回顾性队列，倾向性评分匹配后结果稳健，但为观察性设计，尚不足以直接改变指南。

title: Reduced venesection requirement as a clue to occult colorectal cancer in hereditary haemochromatosis.
authors: Burrows-O'Donoghue R, Lit YT, Gorard L, Cheent K
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. We report a case of CRC in a man in his late 70s with hereditary haemochromatosis (HH) who historically required venesection two to three times per year to maintain target ferritin levels. Despite the absence of gastrointestinal symptoms or anaemia, his requirement for maintenance venesection unexpectedly ceased and ferritin levels remained low without treatment. Two faecal immunochemical tests were negative. Colonoscopy subsequently revealed an adenocarcinoma in the caecum. Chronic occult blood loss from the tumour likely counterbalanced the increased intestinal iron absorption characteristic of HH. This case highlights that an unexplained reduction in venesection requirements in HH may represent an early marker of occult gastrointestinal blood loss and should prompt consideration of further investigation.
cn_title: 遗传性血色病静脉放血需求减少提示隐匿性结直肠癌
insight: 该个案提示遗传性血色病静脉放血需求意外减少可能是隐匿性结直肠癌的早期线索，为肠癌筛查提供了新的临床警示信号。
grade_rationale: 单一个案报道，无对照或验证，证据等级低，但可能启发临床警觉，尚不足以改变实践。

title: Follow-up colonoscopy after abnormal stool-based colorectal cancer screening: a systematic review of completion, timeliness and implementation strategies.
authors: Naserrudin NA, Chong Woei Quan D, Adnan SB, Krebanathan H, Edi Razman ES, Abdullah MYR, et al.
abstract: To synthesise evidence on diagnostic colonoscopy completion and time-to-colonoscopy after abnormal stool-based colorectal cancer screening tests and to examine the implementation strategies and health-system configurations used to support follow-up. Systematic review with narrative synthesis, reported in accordance with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 statement and the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis reporting guideline. We searched MEDLINE via PubMed, Embase via Ovid and Scopus for articles published from 1 January 2010 to 28 October 2025. Reference lists of included studies were also screened. Randomised and non-randomised trials, observational studies, mixed-methods studies and eligible programme evaluations involving adults with an abnormal faecal immunochemical test, guaiac faecal occult blood test or multitarget stool DNA-faecal immunochemical test were included. Eligible studies reported diagnostic colonoscopy completion, time to colonoscopy or implementation-related outcomes. Study characteristics, implementation strategies, colonoscopy completion, time-to-colonoscopy and sociodemographic differences were extracted using a piloted form. Risk of bias was assessed using the Revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomised trials, the Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Interventions or the Joanna Briggs Institute tools, according to study design. Certainty of evidence was assessed using Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE). Because of differences in settings, study designs and outcome definitions, findings were synthesised narratively. Reported follow-up intervals were grouped into approximately ≤3, ≤6 and ≤12 months. Twenty-five studies were included, predominantly from high-income settings. Colonoscopy completion within 6-12 months commonly ranged from approximately 30% to 55% in federally qualified health centres and safety-net settings to 70%-80% or higher in organised and integrated programmes. Time to colonoscopy ranged from approximately 42 to 184 days. Higher completion and shorter delays were more commonly reported in programmes combining real-time tracking, clearly assigned responsibility, proactive outreach or navigation and coordinated colonoscopy scheduling. Of the 25 studies, 1 was judged to have low overall risk of bias, 19 moderate risk and 5 serious risk. Certainty of evidence was low for colonoscopy completion at approximately 6 and 12 months and very low for approximately 3-month completion and time to colonoscopy. Higher-performing post-abnormal-test pathways commonly incorporated registry-based tracking, clear ownership of abnormal results, proactive outreach or navigation and coordinated access to colonoscopy. However, confidence in the comparative performance of specific implementation bundles is limited by heterogeneous and predominantly observational evidence. Health systems serving under-resourced populations may require targeted investment in tracking, navigation and integrated scheduling to improve timely and equitable follow-up. PROSPERO CRD42024579672.
cn_title: 粪便筛查异常后结肠镜随访：完成率、及时性与实施策略的系统综述
insight: 粪便筛查异常后结肠镜完成率仅30%-80%，差距取决于追踪、责任归属与导航等实施策略；提示肠癌筛查链条的薄弱环节在随访落实而非初筛。
grade_rationale: 系统综述纳入25项研究、GRADE评级，虽证据确定性低，但明确指向可操作的卫生系统实施策略，具实践改进潜力。

title: Accelerated Biological Aging and Risk of Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer: Findings from a Large Prospective East Asian Cohort.
authors: Chang Y, Kim K, Wild SH, Byrne CD, Ryu S
journal: Clinical Gastroenterology and Hepatology : the Official Clinical Practice Journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
abstract: The global increase in young-onset colorectal cancer (CRC, diagnosed before age 50) necessitates improved risk stratification. Biological age, which better reflects physiological deterioration than chronological age, may serve as a crucial indicator of disease susceptibility. We examined the association between accelerated biological aging and early-onset colorectal adenocarcinoma (EOCRC-AC) risk. In a prospective cohort of 198,491 Korean adults under 50 years of chronological age, we estimated biological age using Phenotypic Age (PhenoAge), derived from nine routine blood biomarkers, with acceleration calculated as the residual from regressing biological age on chronological age. Cox proportional hazards models, adjusted for demographic, behavioral, and clinical factors, examined the association between biological age acceleration and incident EOCRC-AC, with colorectal neuroendocrine tumors (EOCRC-NET) analyzed as a comparator outcome. Over a median follow-up of 7.7 years, 127 incident EOCRC-AC and 142 EOCRC-NET were identified through linkage with the National Cancer Registry. Individuals with biological age greater than chronological age (accelerated biological aging) had a 93% higher risk of EOCRC-AC (hazard ratio [HR] 1.93, 95% CI 1.28-2.91), with particularly strong associations for colon adenocarcinoma (HR 2.32, 95% CI 1.38-3.89). Associations remained consistent across subgroups including adults younger than 45 years and lag-time sensitivity analyses. In contrast, no consistent association was observed for EOCRC-NET. Accelerated biological aging is independently associated with increased EOCRC-AC risk. Biological aging measures could complement chronological age-based criteria, improving risk stratification and identifying younger individuals who may benefit from earlier or tailored screening strategies.
cn_title: 加速生物学衰老与早发性结直肠癌风险：东亚大型前瞻性队列研究
insight: 在近20万东亚人群中证实加速生物学衰老独立增加早发性结直肠腺癌风险，提示PhenoAge可用于优化早筛分层，为肝转移高危年轻人群识别提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 大型前瞻性队列（近20万人、7.7年随访）证据等级较高，但为观察性研究且缺乏外部验证，暂不足以直接改变筛查指南。

title: High-throughput, amplification-free detection of endogenous gene expression perturbations via fluorescence anisotropy.
authors: Wei N, Bhat ZI, Tang Q, Huang Y, Wong YH, Tan JL
abstract: High-throughput detection of gene expression changes enables novel biological discovery. However, current methods coupled with RNA sequencing involve higher costs and technological barriers, while gene reporter assays account for only promoter activity. We developed a high-throughput, amplification-free, and accessible method-cellular fluorescence anisotropy of RNA (CFAR)-for assessing the effect of multiple perturbations on the endogenous expression of one or a few genes. CFAR measures cellular RNA levels through changes in fluorescence anisotropy of fluorescent dye-labeled DNA probes. Heating and centrifugation steps remove unwanted cellular components. CFAR robustly detects relative expression changes of endogenously expressed genes with duplex measurements. In a high-throughput chemical screen for oncogene MYC expression modulators, CFAR identified hits more robustly than the traditional gene reporter assay. We validated FDA-approved drugs that can potentially be repurposed for downregulating MYC expression in colorectal cancer cells. CFAR is an accessible alternative tool for assessing perturbations on endogenous gene expression.
cn_title: 基于荧光各向异性的高通量无扩增内源基因表达检测方法
insight: CFAR为低成本、无扩增的高通量内源基因表达检测提供新工具，并在结直肠癌细胞中筛选出可下调MYC的FDA药物，提示药物重定位潜力。
grade_rationale: 方法学创新且具转化潜力，但尚属临床前细胞水平验证，未改变当前临床实践。

title: Recent trends in childhood, teenage and young adult cancer incidence in England (2001-2020).
authors: Thompson S, Venables ZC, Levell NJ, Stiller C, McCabe MG
abstract: Cancer remains a leading cause of death among children, teenagers and young adults (CTYAs) in England with a distinct incidence profile compared to older adults. We examined trends in cancer incidence among individuals aged < 25 years in England from 2001 to 2020 using openly available National Disease Registration Service (NDRS) data. All malignancies (ICD-10 C00-C97) diagnosed between 2001 and 2020 were extracted from published NDRS official registration statistics. Analyses were stratified into children (0-14 years) and TYAs (15-24 years), with subanalyses by gender. Joinpoint regression analysis (SEER v5.4.0) was used to calculate annual percentage change (APC) in age-specific incidence and identify trend changes. 2020 data were excluded from trend analyses due to COVID-19 related disruption. Instant rate ratios (IRRs) directly compared rates in 2020-2019. Between 2001 and 2020, cancer incidence was 147 and 273 per million person-years in children and TYAs, respectively. In children, lymphoid leukaemia and brain/CNS tumours accounted for 46% of diagnoses. Among TYAs, Hodgkin lymphoma (15%) and malignant melanoma (9%) were most common, and 24% of male cancers were testicular. TYA colorectal cancer incidence increased until 2015, then declined from 2015 to 19 (APC -37.59%, p < 0.001). Thyroid cancer incidence rose throughout the study period (APC +5.49%, p < 0.001), while cervical cancer incidence declined from 2015 to 19 (APC -21.9%, p = 0.03). Cervical cancer incidence fell the most from 2019 to 2020 (IRR 0.38, p = 0.09). Overall cancer incidence in CTYAs remains low. Trends in colorectal and cervical cancer may reflect appendiceal carcinoid reclassification, HPV vaccination, and COVID-19 related disruption to diagnostic and screening services.
cn_title: 2001-2020年英格兰儿童青少年及年轻成人癌症发病趋势
insight: 该研究揭示年轻成人结直肠癌发病率在2015年后显著下降，提示阑尾类癌重新分类等诊断因素可能影响趋势解读，对肠癌流行病学及肝转移研究具参考价值。
grade_rationale: 基于全国登记数据的回顾性分析，样本量大但非干预性，对临床实践直接影响有限。

title: PLA1A Inhibition Enhances Chemoimmunotherapy Efficacy by Blocking Immunosuppressive Macrophage Polarization in Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Wang TT, Kong WS, Li JJ, Qiu YY, Huang RZ, Chen HJ, et al.
abstract: Clinical outcomes are often suboptimal in colorectal cancer (CRC) patients treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC). A key determinant of the response to NAC is the functional state of tumor-infiltrating immune cells. Understanding how NAC reshapes the immunological landscape will be essential for refining patient stratification and identifying effective combination treatment strategies. Here, we analyzed paired samples before and after NAC treatment by single-cell RNA sequencing, revealing that NAC treatment significantly reshaped the immune microenvironment. Tumors from NAC non-responders featured increased immunosuppressive M2-like macrophage infiltration, which correlated with elevated phosphatidylserine-specific phospholipase A1 (PLA1A). Mechanistically, PLA1A hydrolyzed phosphatidylserine (PS) exposed by chemotherapy to elevate lysophosphatidylserine (LysoPS), which activated the P2ry10 receptor and downstream signaling to promote M2-like macrophage polarization. Importantly, pharmacological inhibition of PLA1A by cilengitide synergized with chemoimmunotherapy to suppress tumor progression in murine models. Clinically, high plasma PLA1A levels negatively correlated with responses to chemoimmunotherapy. Collectively, these findings reveal a chemotherapy-driven metabolic axis that induces an immunosuppressive milieu by increasing lysoPS release. This axis highlights PLA1A as a therapeutic target to mitigate immunosuppression and improve chemoimmunotherapy efficacy.
cn_title: PLA1A抑制通过阻断免疫抑制性巨噬细胞极化增强结直肠癌化疗免疫治疗疗效
insight: 揭示化疗诱导的PLA1A-LysoPS-P2ry10代谢轴驱动M2巨噬细胞极化导致免疫抑制，靶向PLA1A可增敏化疗免疫治疗，为肠癌联合治疗提供新靶点。
grade_rationale: 研究基于单细胞测序和动物模型，机制新颖且具转化潜力，但尚处临床前阶段，暂未改变临床实践。

title: Role of circulating tumour DNA in predicting complete clinical response and local regrowth after total neoadjuvant therapy for rectal cancer: meta-analysis.
authors: Lal N, Shukla S, Hodges N, Brown G, Jenkins JT
abstract: Non-operative management after total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) has emerged as a potential strategy for patients with locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) achieving clinical complete response (cCR). Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) has been proposed as a systemic biomarker to augment response assessment, but its role in predicting cCR and local regrowth remains uncertain. A systematic review and meta-analysis were performed of studies evaluating ctDNA dynamics in patients with LARC undergoing TNT. PubMed, EMBASE, and Web of Science databases were searched from database inception to 31 March 2026. Primary outcomes were the association between post-TNT ctDNA status and cCR and sustained cCR. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) were calculated using a random-effects model. Six studies comprising 597 patients were included. ctDNA negativity following TNT was associated with higher likelihood of cCR (OR 8.01; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.43 to 44.90; I2 = 27.0%). The association with sustained cCR was not statistically significant (OR 3.46; 95% c.i. 0.03 to 394.64; I2 = 59.9%). Across studies, post-TNT ctDNA positivity was associated with inferior disease-free, distant recurrence-free, and progression-free survival. ctDNA demonstrated high specificity and positive predictive value for residual disease, but low sensitivity for the detection of residual local disease and local regrowth, with a substantial proportion of patients with residual tumour remaining ctDNA negative at restaging. Post-TNT ctDNA positivity may identify patients at increased risk of adverse oncological outcomes. However, ctDNA negativity was not consistently associated with the absence of residual local disease, limiting its utility as an independent determinant of organ preservation eligibility. ctDNA should be interpreted as a complementary tool for systemic risk stratification alongside established anatomical assessment.
cn_title: 循环肿瘤DNA预测直肠癌全程新辅助治疗后临床完全缓解及局部再生的Meta分析
insight: ctDNA阳性提示不良预后，但阴性不足以排除局部残留，不能单独作为豁免手术的依据，需与影像/内镜联合评估。
grade_rationale: Meta分析纳入6项研究597例，样本量有限且异质性高，尚不足以改变现行器官保留决策流程。

title: Exploring the key genes of colorectal "adenoma-cancer" based on graph transformer.
authors: Yuan Y, Liu Y, Fan J, Ren Z
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most lethal malignancies worldwide, and the precise identification of biomarkers from colonic adenoma to cancer is of great significance for preventing the development of adenocarcinoma. Given that existing methods inadequately capture the topological network relationships among genes, this study proposes a graph neural network model based on multifeature learning, named ChebTs, to investigate the correlation between key genes involved in the colorectal "adenoma-cancer" transition. The GSE41657 and GSE31905 datasets from the GEO database were stratified into normal, adenoma, and colorectal cancer groups. Feature encoding was introduced to enhance node features, followed by Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses of differentially expressed genes (DEGs). A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed using Cytoscape software, and the aggregated information was embedded into the model for training to generate a list of key genes with corresponding importance scores. An attention pooling mechanism aggregated node-level representations into graph level representations for sample classification, and a two layer fully connected network, following activation and regularization, produced predicted probabilities. Furthermore, we provided interpretable analyses at the gene level using GNNExplainer. The results were validated through virtual knockout techniques. The eight screened genes, Fibronectin 1 (FN1), Claudin 2 (CLDN2), Interleukin-33 (IL-33), Matrix Metallopeptidase 1 (MMP1), Stanniocalcin 2 (STC2), Insulin-Like Growth Factor-Binding Protein 7 (IGFBP7), NADPH Oxidase 4 (NOX4), and Secreted Frizzled Related Protein 1 (SFRP1), were all found to be associated with overall survival (OS) in CRC. In this study, eight molecules closely related to the development of colorectal adenocarcinoma were screened out, and they may be diagnostic biomarkers of colorectal cancer. These genes affect the prognosis of patients by participating in biological processes such as remodeling of extracellular mechanisms, and are of great significance for preventing the carcinogenesis of adenoma.
cn_title: 基于图Transformer探索结直肠腺瘤-癌转变关键基因
insight: 该研究用图神经网络从腺瘤-癌序列中筛选出8个关键基因，为肠癌早期预警和肝转移风险评估提供了潜在生物标志物，值得在转移队列中验证。
grade_rationale: 纯生信分析、无外部临床队列验证，虽方法新颖但证据等级低，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Embedding Undergraduate Nursing Students as Patient Navigators in Federally Qualified Health Centers.
authors: Wareg NK, Zink CM, Niizawa J, Liu Y, Vaca FA, Shahan M, et al.
abstract: Enhancing nursing care coordination systems supports improvement of colorectal cancer (CRC) screening rates. This project implemented a nursing student-led patient navigation model to address open colonoscopy referrals while providing experiential, systems-based learning aligned with Kolb's experiential learning theory. Undergraduate nursing students in a community-focused clinical course were trained as patient navigators and partnered with nine federally qualified health centers (FQHC) to review and act on open colonoscopy referrals. Students assessed 303 open referrals, resulting in 26% completed colonoscopies, 43% nonadherent cases, and 21% scheduled but wait listed. Through hands-on navigation activities, students strengthened competencies in communication, care coordination, workflow problem solving, and health equity advocacy. A student-led navigation model is feasible and educationally valuable while improving CRC screening processes. This scalable approach enhances workforce readiness by providing real-world systems practice and supports FQHCs in reducing persistent screening barriers.
cn_title: 本科护生作为患者导航员嵌入联邦合格健康中心提升结直肠癌筛查
insight: 护生主导的患者导航模式可行且具教育价值，能改善肠癌筛查流程，为资源匮乏地区提升筛查依从性提供可推广路径。
grade_rationale: 单臂前瞻性实施研究，样本量有限且无对照，但为FQHC筛查障碍提供可扩展的护理教育整合模式。

title: Topoisomerase-Based CDH17 Antibody Drug Conjugates Overcome P-gp Resistance but Undergo Target Mediated Clearance in Colorectal Cancer.
authors: O'Brien NA, Zhang J, Gong KW, McDermott MSJ, Hoffstrom B, Lu M, et al.
journal: Clinical Cancer Research : an Official Journal of the American Association for Cancer Research
abstract: Cadherin 17 (CDH17) is an emerging therapeutic target in colorectal cancer (CRC), but the effects of drug efflux and physiological CDH17 expression on the activity and pharmacokinetics of CDH17-directed antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) remain poorly understood. We evaluated the impact of payload selection and target-mediated clearance on CDH17-directed ADCs. CDH17-directed ADCs carrying either monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE) or the topoisomerase 1 inhibitor exatecan were evaluated in CRC models with variable P-glycoprotein (P-gp) expression. The effects of P-gp modulation on ADC sensitivity were assessed. CDH17 expression in human tissues was characterized by immunohistochemistry, and pharmacokinetic studies were performed in cynomolgus monkeys and mice engineered to express human CDH17. CDH17-exatecan ADCs demonstrated greater antitumor activity than CDH17-MMAE ADCs in P-gp-expressing CRC models. Forced P-gp expression induced resistance to CDH17-MMAE ADCs without affecting sensitivity to CDH17-exatecan ADCs, whereas genetic or pharmacological inhibition of P-gp restored CDH17-MMAE activity. CDH17 was highly expressed in CRC and localized to the lateral membranes of gastrointestinal epithelial cells in normal tissues. In mice expressing human CDH17, CDH17-directed antibodies and ADCs exhibited approximately four-fold faster clearance than in wild-type mice or cynomolgus monkeys, consistent with substantial target mediated systemic drug clearance. Together, these findings identify topoisomerase I inhibitor payloads, such as exatecan, as advantageous for targeting P-gp-expressing CRCs while highlighting target-mediated clearance and potential on-target, off-tumor toxicity as important translational challenges for CDH17-directed therapeutics and other ADCs targeting antigens with substantial normal tissue expression.
cn_title: 基于拓扑异构酶载荷的CDH17抗体偶联药物克服P-gp耐药但存在靶点介导清除
insight: 该研究提示拓扑异构酶I抑制剂载荷（如exatecan）可克服P-gp介导的CDH17-ADC耐药，但CDH17正常组织表达导致靶点介导清除和潜在on-target off-tumor毒性，为肠癌ADC设计提供关键转化依据。
grade_rationale: 临床前机制研究，虽具转化潜力但尚无临床数据，暂不改变实践。

title: World's first case report of live birth following autologous ovarian tissue cryopreservation and transplantation in a patient with colon carcinoma.
authors: Ruan X, Du J, Gu M, Jin F, Jin J, Li Y, et al.
journal: Gynecological Endocrinology : the Official Journal of the International Society of Gynecological Endocrinology
abstract: This article reports on the world's first live birth after ovarian tissue cryopreservation and transplantation (OTCT) in a patient with colon cancer. A 29-year-old unmarried nulliparous patient underwent ovarian tissue cryopreservation before chemotherapy. After chemotherapy-induced premature ovarian insufficiency, she received the first transplantation of six thawed ovarian cortex strips. Despite normal ovarian function being maintained for over 2 years, she requested and underwent a second transplantation with another six strips to maximize her chances of pregnancy. After the first transplantation, she resumed spontaneous menstruation with restored ovarian function, which was remained functional for 28 months until the second transplantation. Following the second transplantation, she conceived spontaneously without assisted reproductive technology two months after grafting. Routine prenatal examinations showed normal fetal development without abnormalities. She delivered a healthy baby girl weighing 2785 g with Apgar scores of 8/9 at 1 and 5 min. This case demonstrates the feasibility and safety of OTCT for fertility and ovarian function preservation in patients with colon cancer.
cn_title: 结肠癌患者自体卵巢组织冻存移植后首例活产报道
insight: 全球首例结肠癌患者通过卵巢组织冻存移植实现自然妊娠活产，为年轻肠癌患者化疗前生育力保存提供了可行且安全的循证依据。
grade_rationale: 单例个案报道，证据等级低，但作为世界首例具有提示意义，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Evaluation of Intervention Strategies to Improve Follow-Up Colonoscopy After Abnormal FIT/FOBT Result: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
authors: Chua WY, Chew LX, Chan CKM, Tong Z, Ng LP, Chee CE, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer is the second leading cause of cancer mortality worldwide. Early detection through screenings has been shown to improve morbidity and mortality. While fecal immunochemical test (FIT) or fecal occult blood test (FOBT) are established cost-effective screening modalities for colorectal cancer, follow-up colonoscopy screening rates remain suboptimal. To evaluate interventions targeting colonoscopy completion and the prevalence of colonoscopy completion after an abnormal FIT/FOBT result. MEDLINE, Embase, and Cochrane databases were searched from inception to May 9, 2026, and the bibliographies of relevant studies were screened. Original studies, published in English, examining nonrandomized interventional studies or randomized clinical trials comparing interventions to improve follow-up colonoscopy after an abnormal FIT/FOBT result were included. Prevalence and risk ratios (RRs) with accompanying 95% CIs for each study were computed, and the results were pooled using a random-effects meta-analysis. This study was conducted in line with the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) reporting guideline. Two authors reviewed each study and extracted the data independently, with discrepancies referred to a third independent author. Outcomes included prevalence and RR of various interventions. A total of 21 studies involving 19 613 patients (8101 female individuals [41.3%] and 11 512 male individuals [58.7%]; age range, 50-75 years) evaluating interventions to improve colonoscopy completion after an abnormal FIT/FOBT result were included. Patient navigation (RR, 1.24; 95% CI, 1.15-1.33; I2 = 57.1), patient reminders (RR, 1.32; 95% CI, 1.04-1.67; I2 = 89.9), clinician reminders (RR, 1.36; 95% CI, 1.12-1.65; I2 = 94.4), and automated referrals to gastrointestinal consult (RR, 1.68; 95% CI, 1.09-2.60; I2 = 91.9) were effective in increasing follow-up colonoscopy completion with moderate to high heterogeneity detected within and across intervention types. Sensitivity analyses excluding outliers resulted in low heterogeneity for patient navigation, patient reminders (messaging), and clinician reminders, while moderate heterogeneity remained for automated referrals. Follow-up colonoscopy increased from 4755 of 10 263 in control to 6272 of 9350 after interventions; pooled prevalence estimates were 47.8% and 69.1%, respectively. In this systematic review and meta-analysis, patient-level and system-level interventions, including patient navigation, patient reminders, and clinician reminders, are associated with increased completion of follow-up colonoscopy after an abnormal FIT/FOBT result. More studies are required to evaluate the efficacy of automated referrals to gastrointestinal consult due to large heterogeneity between studies and to study the incremental effect of each intervention in multicomponent interventions.
cn_title: 干预策略提升异常FIT/FOBT后结肠镜随访完成率的系统综述与Meta分析
insight: 患者导航、患者及医生提醒等干预可显著提高异常FIT/FOBT后结肠镜随访完成率，为肠癌筛查闭环管理提供循证依据，对肝转移早期防控具潜在价值。
grade_rationale: 基于21项研究、近2万例患者的系统综述与Meta分析，证据等级较高，提示可改变筛查随访实践。

title: Muir-Torre syndrome in a patient with advanced duodenal carcinoma.
authors: Taketo R, Shibata K, Ishijima R, Noguchi T, Inomata M
abstract: Muir-Torre syndrome (MTS) is a rare autosomal dominant disorder characterized by sebaceous neoplasms and visceral malignancies and is regarded as a phenotypic variant of Lynch syndrome. Although colorectal and genitourinary cancers are the most common visceral malignancies in MTS, duodenal cancer is extremely rare. We report a case of advanced duodenal cancer associated with MTS treated with multidisciplinary therapy. A 62-year-old man with a history of multiple colorectal cancers and sebaceous carcinomas presented with vomiting and epigastric pain. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy revealed a circumferential tumor with stenosis in the fourth portion of the duodenum, and a biopsy showed moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma. Computed tomography suggested peritoneal dissemination, and the tumor was considered unresectable. Systemic chemotherapy with 5-fluorouracil and oxaliplatin resulted in tumor regression and disappearance of the suspected dissemination. Conversion surgery with partial duodenectomy and lymph node dissection was subsequently performed, achieving R0 resection. Genetic testing revealed microsatellite instability-high status and a pathogenic MSH2 mutation, confirming MTS. Although postoperative lymph node recurrence occurred, the disease has been controlled with immunotherapy and radiotherapy, and the patient remains alive two years after surgery. This case highlights the potential role of multidisciplinary treatment and the importance of recognizing MTS and implementing appropriate surveillance.
cn_title: Muir-Torre综合征相关晚期十二指肠癌的多学科治疗个案
insight: MTS作为Lynch综合征表型变异，可累及十二指肠；化疗转化后R0切除联合免疫治疗有效，提示肠癌谱系需扩展MMR筛查与监测。
grade_rationale: 单例个案报告，无对照与外部验证，仅提供临床启示，不足以改变实践。

title: H19 and the PD-1/PD-L1 Axis in hepatocellular carcinoma and colorectal cancer: emerging evidence, mechanistic links, and therapeutic perspectives.
authors: Nami MT, EmamiPari F, Farrokhi N, Fattahyan I, Yekkalam M
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and colorectal cancer (CRC) are major causes of cancer-related mortality, yet responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) remain heterogeneous. Although programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) is a key component of immune checkpoint biology, antitumor immunity is shaped by multiple tumor-intrinsic and microenvironmental factors, and the contribution of the long non-coding RNA H19 to these processes remains incompletely defined. This narrative review synthesizes experimental and clinical evidence linking H19 to immune regulation in HCC and CRC, with particular emphasis on its potential intersection with PD-L1-mediated immune checkpoint signaling. Evidence was classified as experimentally demonstrated, indirectly supported, contextual, or hypothetical according to the strength, mechanistic resolution, and disease specificity of the available data. Current evidence indicates that H19 perturbation can influence PD-L1-associated phenotypes in selected experimental HCC models; however, a complete, mechanistically resolved H19-dependent PD-L1 regulatory axis, including validated intermediate mechanisms and causal rescue, has not been established in HCC or CRC. Proposed ceRNA and signaling mechanisms remain incompletely validated, while several mechanistic links are supported primarily by indirect or cross-cancer evidence. Beyond direct checkpoint regulation, H19-associated extracellular vesicles and H19-dependent signaling have been implicated in macrophage remodeling, intercellular communication, and T-cell dysfunction, although direct convergence of these processes on H19-mediated PD-L1 regulation remains unproven. Circulating H19 has also shown preliminary associations with tumor presence or burden, but its clinical utility as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker remains insufficiently validated, particularly for ICI response. Overall, H19 represents a biologically plausible interface between non-coding RNA regulation, tumor-intrinsic signaling, and the tumor immune microenvironment rather than an established central regulator of PD-L1. Disease-specific mechanistic studies incorporating H19 perturbation, PD-L1 measurement, pathway-specific rescue, and immune-functional assays are required to determine whether H19 can serve as a clinically actionable component of immune checkpoint regulation.
cn_title: H19与PD-1/PD-L1轴在肝细胞癌和结直肠癌中的研究进展
insight: 该综述系统梳理H19与PD-L1免疫检查点交叉调控的证据，指出机制尚未完全阐明，提示肠癌免疫治疗耐药或存新靶点，但需疾病特异性验证。
grade_rationale: 叙述性综述，未提供新临床数据，仅提出假设，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Feasibility of robotic-assisted right colectomy using the "squeezing approach".
authors: Shibata K, Ichikawa N, Yoshida T, Ohno Y, Imaizumi K, Sano S, et al.
abstract: To evaluate the initial outcomes regarding the safety and feasibility of robotic-assisted right colectomy (RRC) using the squeezing approach compared to conventional laparoscopic right colectomy (LRC). We retrospectively compared the short-term surgical outcomes of 118 consecutive patients who underwent right colectomy using the squeezing approach for colon cancer (70 LRC and 48 RRC) at our institution between April 2022 and December 2025. The median operative time was significantly longer in the RRC group than in the LRC group (219.0 min vs. 189.0 min, p < 0.0001). However, the median estimated blood loss was equivalent and minimal in both groups (0.0 mL vs. 0.0 mL, p = 0.9035). There was no significant difference in the median number of harvested lymph nodes (21.5 vs. 23.0, p = 0.7506). RRC demonstrated safety, with outcomes comparable to LRC in terms of the rate of conversion to open surgery (2.1% vs. 5.7%, p = 0.6194), Clavien-Dindo Grade II complications (8.3% vs. 11.4%, p = 0.741), and Grade III complications (2.1% vs. 2.9%, p = 1.000). The squeezing approach enables safe and feasible RRC, thereby achieving perioperative outcomes comparable to LRC, even during the initial implementation phase.
