title: VINTER: a generative vision-language model for annotating and interrogating spatial tissues
authors: Wu, J.; Xu, W.; Zhuang, Y.; Zhang, Y.; Loza Lopez, M. d. J.; yang, y.; Nakai, K.
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics links gene expression to tissue structure, yet current models learn embeddings whose meaning is assigned afterwards or read histology without measured expression. Tissue decisions are therefore rarely made from morphology, genes and neighbourhood together, or examined through them. Here we introduce VINTER, a generative vision-language model aligned on 1.45 million histology-caption pairs that reads histology, measured gene expression and spatial neighbourhood as one sequence. It returns the probability of every tissue class, and because genes enter as text, its molecular evidence can be edited with the image held fixed. Reading all three sources together, VINTER annotated tissue more accurately than spatial-domain methods and a spatial foundation model, and transferred across cohorts without target labels. Editing only the neighbourhood resolved the follicular B-cell and plasma-cell programmes behind its reading of tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) maturation in lung and kidney cancer. Its class probabilities exposed what single labels conceal in triple-negative breast cancer: immune heterogeneity within stroma and cancer hidden beneath benign labels. Without retraining, the same model transferred to Visium HD and single-cell Xenium data and resolved follicular architecture within colorectal cancer TLS. VINTER thus turns spatial annotation into an interrogable reading of tissue across platforms and resolutions.
cn_title: VINTER：用于空间组织注释与解析的生成式视觉-语言模型
insight: VINTER将组织学、基因表达与空间邻域统一为可编辑序列，实现跨平台空间注释与机制解析；其无需重训即可解析结直肠癌TLS滤泡结构，为肠癌肝转移微环境研究提供可 interrogation 的新工具。
grade_rationale: 预印本未经同行评审，不参与分级

title: Suppression of epithelial proliferation and tumorigenesis by immunoglobulin A
authors: Donaldson, G. P.; Reis, G. L.; Saad, M.; Wichmann, C.; Mamede, I.; Chen, G.; Harrer, C. E.; DelGaudio, N. L.; Zhang, D.; Aydin, B.; Castro, T. B. R.; Grivennikov, S.; Reis, B. S.; Liu, E.; Eisenbarth, S. C.; Birsoy, K.; Tavazoie, S. F.; Stadtmueller, B. M.; Victora, G. D.; Mucida, D.
abstract: Immunoglobulin A (IgA) is the most abundant antibody isotype produced by mammals, playing a specialised role in mucosal homeostasis. IgA is constantly secreted into the intestinal lumen and binds commensal microbiota to regulate their colonisation and function, with unclear implications for health. IgA deficiency is common in humans but is difficult to study due to its complex aetiology and comorbidities. Using genetically and environmentally controlled mice, here we show that multiple animal models of IgA deficiency result in increased susceptibility to multiple models of endogenous colorectal tumours. Cellular and molecular analyses revealed that, in the absence of IgA, colonic epithelial cells induce antibacterial factors and accelerate cell cycling in response to the microbiota. Oral treatment with IgA was sufficient to reduce steady-state proliferation and protect mice from tumours; however, this function was due to the antibody structure rather than binding specificity. In a reductionist culture system, IgA directly suppresses epithelial growth. Co-immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry and targeted CRISPR screening identified DMBT1 as an IgA-binding epithelial surface protein required for IgA-mediated suppression of proliferation. Together, IgA and DMBT1 tune the normal cycling of absorptive colonocyte progenitors. In mice, deletion of the transmembrane and cytoplasmic signalling portions of DMBT1 was sufficient to reverse both the increased proliferation and tumour susceptibility of IgA knockouts. These experiments establish a homeostatic function for IgA in tempering physiological epithelial responses to microbiota to maintain mucosal health.
cn_title: 免疫球蛋白A通过DMBT1抑制结肠上皮增殖与肿瘤发生
insight: 该研究揭示IgA通过结合DMBT1直接抑制结肠上皮增殖，为肠道菌群-免疫-上皮稳态失衡驱动肠癌提供了新机制，提示IgA可作为肠癌预防干预靶点。
grade_rationale: 预印本未经同行评审，不参与分级

title: Distinct iron metabolism regulation during cachexia progression in murine models of intestinal and pancreatic cancer
authors: Auffret, M.; Gasrel, P.; Orfila, L.; Martin, B.; Martin, A.; Freyssenet, D.; Island, M.-L.; Ropert, M.; Rebillard, A.; Derbre, F.
abstract: Background. Cancer cachexia is a multifactorial syndrome characterized by substantial metabolic disturbances including systemic inflammation, and muscle atrophy, which may affect the regulation of iron metabolism in patients. This study aimed to characterize this regulation in two murine models of colorectal and pancreatic cancer, both associated with a high prevalence of cachexia. Methods. Histological, biochemical and molecular analyses were performed in serum, skeletal muscle, liver, spleen and tumor from UN-KC-6141 pancreatic tumor bearing mice and from ApcMin/+ mice (colorectal cancer model), both models exhibiting variable cachexia severity. Results. Both models induce cachexia, but diverge markedly in their regulation of iron metabolism. UNKC mice display reduced plasma iron availability (-9.6% transferrin saturation, p<0.001) without concomitant anemia, while hepatic hepcidin synthesis is upregulated (+100.6%, p<0.001) by inflammation, promoting ferroportin (FPN) downregulation (-42.4%, p<0.001) and iron sequestration in the spleen (+134% total iron content, p<0.001). In the atrophied gastrocnemius, iron concentration is preserved through increased ferritin (+86.6%, p=0.010) and hemoproteins (i.e., myoglobin, CYSC, COXIV) expression. Conversely, ApcMin/+ mice exhibit anemia together with hepatic and splenic iron depletion (-48.4%, p<0.001 and -84.9%, p<0.001, respectively). Hepcidin synthesis is downregulated (-99.9%, p<0.001) despite persistent inflammation, indicating that hypoxia and/or iron-deficiency signals probably predominate over the inflammatory pathway. FPN is markedly decreased (-94.2%, p<0.001) in the iron-depleted spleen despite low hepcidin. In the atrophied quadriceps of ApcMin/+ mice, iron deficiency is associated with decreased FPN and ferritin (-87.9%, p<0.001, and -38.4%, p=0.016, respectively), and increased TfR1 expression (+305%, p=0.107). Finally, tumor iron import may play a significant role in cachexia progression, as suggested by the association between tumor weight, tumor TfR1 protein levels and body weight loss in UNKC mice. Conclusion. These findings reveal cancer type-specific signatures of iron regulation in cachexia, which appear to be more driven by cancer type specific features than by cachexia severity itself, with skeletal muscle iron metabolism impaired mainly when cachexia is associated with anemia. This suggests that the clinical management of iron metabolism in cachectic patients should be guided by the underlying cancer type.
cn_title: 肠癌与胰腺癌恶病质模型铁代谢调控差异
insight: 揭示恶病质铁代谢紊乱具癌种特异性，肠癌以缺铁性贫血为主，提示肠癌恶病质患者补铁策略需按癌种个体化。
grade_rationale: 预印本未经同行评审，不参与分级

title: Estimating conditional cell population associations across tumor density trajectory in three dimensional tissue images
authors: Bhadury, S.; Rao, A.
abstract: Registered serial-section imaging preserves a depth coordinate that a single planar image cannot represent. We introduce ISPat-3D (Informed Spatially Aware Patterns in Three Dimensions), a framework that combines anisotropic Gaussian-process adjustment with multi-study factor analysis to separate smooth spatial variation from covariance shared across tumor-density zones and covariance specific to individual zones. Precision matrices summarize the adjusted structure as signed partial correlations, interpreted as conditional co-location or exclusion rather than physical contact, signaling, or causation. We analyze conditional associations among cell-type neighborhood-density variables across five relative tumor-burden strata in one colorectal-cancer CyCIF specimen and one HER2-positive breast-carcinoma IMC specimen. The workflow adjusts modeled smooth spatial variation with an anisotropic three-coordinate Gaussian process, fits shared and zone-specific factor covariance to the residuals, and converts each full zone covariance to signed partial correlations. To make the reported cell budgets feasible, the analysis uses a 15-neighbor Vecchia GP likelihood on spatially balanced anchors and a Gaussian-likelihood fit of the same factor covariance form from full residual covariance summaries. Controlled simulations, a matched section-wise planar comparison, and direct graphical-lasso sensitivity check the estimator. In CRC, positive T-cell and macrophage -- stroma density associations show relatively high agreement across three sampling budgets. Breast pair signs are much less stable across budgets and remain exploratory, even though graphical lasso agrees on the same GP-adjusted residuals. A GP separates patterns by assumed spatial scale; a smooth field may contain meaningful biology and residual associations may contain noise or unmeasured effects. The two single-specimen analyses identify biologically plausible, zone-resolved conditional associations for replication, without establishing cellular contact, mechanism, or cohort-level reproducibility. Code release: https://github.com/sagnikbhadury/ISPAT-3D.
cn_title: 三维组织图像中肿瘤密度轨迹的条件细胞群关联估计
insight: ISPat-3D框架通过各向异性高斯过程与多研究因子分析，在三维结直肠癌CyCIF图像中解析肿瘤密度分层的条件细胞共定位模式，为肝转移微环境空间生态研究提供方法学工具。
grade_rationale: 预印本未经同行评审，不参与分级

title: Pdk1-dependent metabolic heterogeneity promotes aggressive colorectal cancer through cell-intrinsic interferon signaling
authors: Calviello, J.; Poeltl, L.; Mira, A.; Spini, F.; Larranaga, A.; Fortuny, L.; Vianello, F.; Bonilla-Diaz, A.; Alvarez-Munoz, A.; Pazzagli, G.; Serra, M.; Ducano, N.; Gut, M.; Casals, E.; Esteve-Codina, A.; Liesa, M.; Trusolino, L.; Sapino, A.; Sebastian, D.; Sebastian, C.
abstract: Tumor heterogeneity is a major determinant of tumor progression and therapeutic resistance, yet the contribution of metabolism to intratumoral heterogeneity still remains poorly explored. Here, we find that pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase-1 (Pdk1) expression defines metabolically distinct cancer cell populations in colorectal tumors. Image-based spatial single-cell phenotyping shows that Pdk1-high cells are associated with tumor progression in orthotopic models of colorectal cancer (CRC). Genetic ablation experiments demonstrate the role of Pdk1-high cells in tumor growth, 5-fluorouracil chemoresistance and tumor relapse. Mechanistically, we identify a link between Pdk1-driven metabolic states and specific cell phenotypes, where Pdk1-high cancer cells exhibit an EMT, stem cell-like phenotype characterized by increased interferon (IFN) signaling. Mitochondrial remodeling in Pdk1-high cells leads to the release of mitochondrial DNA to the cytosol and activation of IFN pathways, promoting Pdk1-driven phenotypes. Inhibition of IFN signaling impairs the tumorigenic and aggressive features of Pdk1-high cancer cells, thus establishing a functional connection between metabolic heterogeneity, cell-intrinsic IFN signaling and aggressive CRC.
cn_title: Pdk1依赖性代谢异质性通过细胞内在干扰素信号促进结直肠癌侵袭
insight: 揭示Pdk1高表达细胞通过线粒体DNA释放激活干扰素信号驱动结直肠癌侵袭与化疗耐药，为靶向代谢异质性提供新策略。
grade_rationale: 预印本未经同行评审，不参与分级

title: Loss of the Y chromosome is transcriptionally silent in clear cell renal cell carcinoma and across cancer entities
authors: Waterhoelter, A.; Scholz, R.; Tsouris, A.; Cuomo, F.; Adlesic, M.; Nguekeu Zebaze, L.; Witt, C.; Rodriguez Hernandez, Z.; Koettgen, A.; Boerries, M.; Schlosser, P.; Frew, I. J.
abstract: Tumors in men often lose the Y chromosome. In some tumor types, this is predictive of poor outcome. Given the male predominance and high LOY frequency in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), we asked whether LOY might impact the transcriptome of ccRCC. We determined somatic Y chromosome status and performed differential expression analysis on tumor RNA-sequencing samples of two human ccRCC cohorts (TCGA-KIRC, CPTAC-ccRCC) and in an autochthonous murine ccRCC model with renal epithelium-specific deletion of Vhl, Trp53 and Rb1. We additionally derived five isogenic Y-deficient and five Y chromosome-retaining clones of the human ccRCC cell line 786-O. Across all three settings, transcriptional changes were largely restricted to the expected gene dosage effects of male-specific Y (MSY) and pseudoautosomal region (PAR) genes, without large effects on autosomal genes. At the pathway level, we identified a modest but reproducible response in the human cohorts, converging on cell cycle, ribosomal biogenesis and DNA repair genes. A pan-cancer meta-analysis across TCGA entities recovered the same pattern, with no autosomal gene showing a large consistent effect. In some entities, but not in ccRCC, cancer/testis antigen expression was higher in LOY tumors. We conclude that, apart from direct gene dosage, modest pathway-level shifts and altered silencing of cancer/testis antigens, LOY is transcriptionally silent in adult humans and mice. Y-chromosomal genes are therefore unlikely to act as transcriptional drivers of ccRCC and other cancer entities.
cn_title: Y染色体丢失在透明细胞肾细胞癌及泛癌中转录沉默
insight: 该研究证实LOY在ccRCC及泛癌中除剂量效应外转录沉默，提示Y染色体基因不太可能作为肠癌等肿瘤的转录驱动因子，对肠癌性别差异研究有警示意义。
grade_rationale: 预印本未经同行评审，不参与分级

title: Cold Snare Polypectomy Versus Cold Snare Polypectomy With Submucosal Injection for 3-9 mm Colorectal Polyps: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
authors: Pattarajierapan S, Surapat P, Kongsupapsiri S, Methakittrakoon P, Wisedopas N, Wanpiyarat N, et al.
abstract: Incomplete resection after cold snare polypectomy (CSP) remains a concern. CSP may sometimes require a forcible pull ("forced CSP"), which increases the incomplete resection rate (IRR). Submucosal injection before CSP (SI-CSP) may facilitate resection and reduce IRR. We compared SI-CSP with CSP for 3-9 mm polyps using an approach avoiding forced CSP. This randomized controlled trial enrolled patients aged 40-79 years undergoing screening or surveillance colonoscopy with at least one 3-9 mm adenomatous or sessile serrated lesion. They were randomized in a 1:1 ratio into the SI-CSP and CSP groups. If resection without forced CSP was not feasible, the procedure was converted to endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR). The primary outcome was the IRR, assessed by additional biopsies of the margins. Overall, 340 polyps from 340 patients were analyzed. Baseline characteristics were comparable between the groups. In the intention-to-treat analysis, the IRRs were low and similar between the SI-CSP and CSP groups (0% vs. 1%, p = 1). SI-CSP was associated with a lower EMR conversion rate (1% vs. 12%, p < 0.001), but median procedural time was longer (77 s vs. 54 s, p < 0.001). EMR conversion occurred exclusively for 6-9 mm polyps. Avoiding forced CSP, with conversion to EMR when necessary, results in very low IRRs for SI-CSP and CSP in 3-9 mm colorectal polyps. Compared with CSP, SI-CSP does not reduce the IRR but reduces conversion to EMR. However, SI-CSP requires a longer procedural time and additional resources for submucosal injection. Thai Clinical Trials Registry TCTR20240805001.
cn_title: 冷圈套息肉切除术联合黏膜下注射对比单纯冷圈套切除术治疗3-9mm结直肠息肉：随机对照试验
insight: 在避免强行牵拉并必要时转EMR的策略下，3-9mm息肉冷切的不完全切除率极低，黏膜下注射未进一步降低IRR但减少EMR转换，提示临床可按息肉大小与操作难度个体化选择。
grade_rationale: 单中心RCT，样本量适中（340例），主要终点为阴性结果，虽可能优化操作策略但尚不足以改变指南推荐。

title: Efficacy of improvised EndoVAC versus covered stent in colorectal anastomotic leaks: A multicenter study with a propensity analysis.
authors: Castaño-Llano R, Puerta JD, Palacios LJ, Rodríguez M, Cortés N, Castro JM, et al.
abstract: Colorectal anastomotic leak (AL) occurs in up to 25% of cases and is the leading cause of postoperative morbidity and mortality. Self-expanding metallic stents (SEMSs) and endoscopic vacuum therapy (EVT) have recently emerged as therapeutic options. Our aim was to compare EVT and SEMS success rates in the treatment of AL, in patients with and without protective diverting ostomy. A retrospective study was conducted at three oncology centers in Medellín, Colombia, within the time frame of January 2006 and December 2022. Fifty-four patients with AL, treated with either EVT or SEMS were included. Groups were matched 1:1 by age (±3 years), body mass index (BMI ± 3 kg/m²), and leak size. There were no significant differences between the two groups in baseline characteristics, leak size and location, time from surgery to treatment (P = .11), tumor stage, or surgical approach. The EVT group required more procedures (4.6 ± 3.1 vs 2.1 ± 1.6; P = .047), but was associated with fewer additional interventions (P = .035), shorter hospital stay (41 ± 16 vs 52 ± 23 days; P = .017), higher leak resolution rate (89% vs 67%; P = .049), higher ostomy reversal rate (83% vs 55%; P = .053), and a trend toward improved survival (log-rank P = .050). EVT was associated with better clinical outcomes, compared with SEMS. Larger studies are needed to confirm our findings.
cn_title: 改良内镜负压治疗与覆膜支架治疗结直肠吻合口漏的多中心倾向性分析
insight: 多中心倾向匹配显示内镜负压治疗吻合口漏的闭合率、住院时长及造口还纳率优于覆膜支架，为肠癌术后严重并发症的微创处理提供了更优选择。
grade_rationale: 多中心回顾性队列结合倾向性匹配，样本量有限但结果一致指向EVT优势，可能影响吻合口漏处理决策。

title: PET/MR Imaging of the Gastrointestinal Tract.
authors: Bhinder KK, Ammirabile A, Zarrintan A, Jadoon AK, Goenka AH
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Clinics of North America
abstract: PET/MR imaging combines molecular PET data with multiparametric MR imaging in a single reduced-radiation examination of the gastrointestinal tract. For oncologic indications, the hybrid modality adds value in hepatic metastasis detection, locoregional staging, and posttreatment response assessment. Radiotracers beyond fluorodeoxyglucose, including fibroblast activation protein inhibitor ligands and somatostatin receptor analogs, expand diagnostic reach in tumors with low glycolytic activity and in neuroendocrine disease. For inflammatory bowel disease, PET/MR enterography assists with selected questions such as differentiation of inflammatory from fibrotic strictures. This review evaluates current evidence supporting PET/MR imaging across oncologic and nononcologic gastrointestinal applications.
cn_title: PET/MR在胃肠道肿瘤及肝转移中的应用价值综述
insight: PET/MR整合分子与多参数MR信息，在肝转移检出、局部分期及疗效评估中具增量价值，新型示踪剂拓展了低糖代谢肿瘤的诊断能力。
grade_rationale: 综述性文章，非原始研究，虽涉及肝转移检出等临床问题，但未提供新证据，暂不改变实践。

title: MR Imaging of Anal Cancer.
authors: Young PM, Golia Pernicka JS, Jing AB, Ernst RD, Rauch GM
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Clinics of North America
abstract: High-resolution pelvic MR imaging is central to the diagnosis, staging, treatment planning, and posttreatment assessment of anal squamous cell carcinoma (SCCA), the most common malignancy of the anal canal. Accurate imaging interpretation requires detailed knowledge of anal canal anatomy, lymphatic drainage, and optimized MR imaging technique. MR imaging provides excellent evaluation of primary tumor extent, while nodal and distant staging are enhanced by computed tomography (CT) and FDG-PET/CT. Imaging directly informs contemporary chemoradiation strategies and surveillance. Human papillomavirus (HPV) is implicated in nearly 90% of SCCA, is vaccine-preventable, and HPV ctDNA shows promise for response assessment and relapse prediction.
cn_title: 肛管鳞癌的MRI影像学评估
insight: 系统阐述肛管鳞癌MRI诊断、分期及疗效评估要点，并提示HPV ctDNA在疗效监测与复发预测中的潜力，对肛管癌精准诊疗具有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 综述性影像学文章，无原始数据或外部验证，但系统整合MRI与HPV ctDNA证据，对临床实践有参考意义而非直接改变。

title: MR imaging of Rectal Cancer.
authors: Kassam Z, Lee S, Maheshwari E, Wasnik AP
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Clinics of North America
abstract: MR imaging strengthens contemporary management of rectal cancer by depicting tumor extent, mesorectal fascia proximity, and nodal disease with exquisite anatomic detail. Both standardized technique and synoptic reporting improve reproducibility and multidisciplinary planning. Accurate T-category assignment, measurement of the circumferential resection margin, and recognition of extramural vascular invasion/tumor deposits stratify risk and help to triage patients into surgical, neoadjuvant or "watch-and-wait" pathways. Station-based evaluation of lateral pelvic nodes is critical to develop local control strategies. On restaging, a descriptive T2 + diffusion-weighted imaging framework differentiates treatment-related fibrosis from residual tumor to support organ-preserving options when appropriate.
cn_title: 直肠癌的磁共振成像：标准化技术、结构化报告与再分期框架
insight: 系统阐述直肠癌MRI标准化技术、结构化报告及再分期框架，强调其在风险分层、治疗路径选择及器官保留中的核心作用，为直肠癌精准诊疗提供影像学规范。
grade_rationale: 基于领域权威综述，系统整合MRI在直肠癌全程管理中的规范应用，对临床实践具有直接指导意义。

title: Imaging of Colonic Malignancies.
authors: Darwish A, Lalwani N, Kanmaniraja D, Yee J
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Clinics of North America
abstract: This comprehensive review outlines current imaging strategies for the evaluation and management of colonic malignancies. It explores anatomic considerations, histologic subtypes with distinct imaging features, and the evolving role of advanced modalities such as computed tomography colonography, radiomics, and MR spectroscopy. Emphasis is placed on tumor detection, accurate staging, response assessment, and surgical planning. Radiologists play a pivotal role in optimizing care across all phases of disease.
cn_title: 结肠恶性肿瘤的影像学评估：现状与进展
insight: 系统梳理结肠癌影像学评估策略，强调CT结肠成像、影像组学等新技术在分期、疗效评估及手术规划中的价值，为肠癌精准诊疗提供影像学框架。
grade_rationale: 综述性文章，无原始数据或前瞻验证，但发表于影像学领域期刊，对临床影像实践有参考价值，尚不足以直接改变实践。

title: Imaging Review of Benign Colonic and Anorectal Pathologies.
authors: Dawkins A, Heba E, Nair RT
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Clinics of North America
abstract: This review highlights the MR imaging appearance of benign colonic and anorectal conditions, emphasizing anatomic landmarks and characteristic imaging patterns. MR imaging enables confident differentiation of benign neoplasms, cystic lesions, and inflammatory processes through excellent soft-tissue contrast, multiplanar capability, and advanced sequences such as diffusion-weighted imaging. As a radiation-free modality with high diagnostic performance, MR imaging plays an increasingly important role in evaluating colorectal pathology, particularly in pregnancy and in patients requiring avoidance of ionizing radiation.
cn_title: 结肠与肛直肠良性病变的MRI影像学综述
insight: 系统梳理良性结直肠病变的MRI特征，有助于减少与肠癌及肝转移的误诊，但属影像描述性综述，对肝转移研究直接启示有限。
grade_rationale: 叙述性影像综述，非系统综述，无原始数据或外部验证，仅具教学参考价值，难以改变临床实践。

title: Imaging Review of Small Bowel Pathologies (Benign and Malignant).
authors: Paspulati RM, Ronen N
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Clinics of North America
abstract: Small bowel tumors are less common compared to large bowel tumors despite small bowel, being the largest segment of gastrointestinal tract. There is increase in incidence of small bowel cancers compared to large bowel cancer due to improved diagnostic imaging and endoscopic methods and increase in cross sectional imaging with contrast enhanced computed tomography. Diagnosis of small bowel tumors is delayed due to nonspecific clinical presentation and initial diagnosis is at advanced stage with local spread and distant metastases. There are several genetic and acquired predisposing risk factors for adenocarcinoma and lymphoma of small bowel.
cn_title: 小肠良恶性病变的影像学综述
insight: 系统梳理小肠肿瘤影像特征，虽非结直肠癌直接主题，但小肠与结直肠同属肠道肿瘤谱系，其影像诊断思路对肠癌肝转移的鉴别诊断与随访有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 综述性影像学文章，无原始数据或外部验证，对小肠肿瘤诊断有教学价值但难以直接改变结直肠癌临床实践。

title: Geriatric Assessment-Based Stratification to Evaluate Treatment Intensity, Quality of Life, and Survival in Older Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: Protocol for a Prospective Observational Study.
authors: Hiramatsu T, Okazaki I, Hosokawa K, Yoshimatsu K, Nagasaka T
abstract: Older patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) are a heterogeneous population with wide variability in functional status, frailty, cognition, nutritional reserve, and comorbidity burden. Treatment decisions are often guided primarily by chronological age and performance status, which may not adequately capture vulnerability or patient-centered outcomes in this population. The primary aim of this study is to prospectively evaluate the association of baseline geriatric assessment (GA)-derived frailty with overall survival in older patients with mCRC receiving first-line systemic therapy in routine clinical practice; secondary aims are to evaluate the associations of frailty with initial treatment intensity and early changes in quality of life (QOL). Baseline GA includes activities of daily living, instrumental activities of daily living, the Clinical Frailty Scale, the Mini-Cog, nutritional assessment, the Charlson Comorbidity Index (excluding cancer-related items), and the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status. Blood-based prognostic biomarkers, including the prognostic nutritional index and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, are also collected. Initial treatment intensity is defined according to the first-line systemic regimen selected at baseline, whereas subsequent local therapies are recorded separately. QOL is assessed using the European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer Quality of Life Questionnaire Core 30 (EORTC QLQ-C30) at baseline and 8 to 12 weeks after treatment initiation. This study was registered in the UMIN Clinical Trials Registry (UMIN000060489) on April 1, 2026. This study received no external funding. Participant recruitment began on April 1, 2026 (the first participant enrolled in June 2026) and is planned to continue for approximately 2.5 years (projected completion: October 2028), with an anticipated sample size of approximately 100 participants; an early QOL follow-up is scheduled for 8 to 12 weeks after treatment initiation for each participant. As of the submission of this revised manuscript (August 2026), 4 participants had been enrolled, baseline QOL assessments had been completed for all 4 participants, and the 8- to 12-week follow-up QOL assessments had been completed for 3 participants; no outcome data were available. Analysis of the primary outcome will be conducted after final survival follow-up, with the main results anticipated for publication in 2030. This protocol describes a pragmatic GA-based observational framework to examine associations between pretreatment vulnerability, initial treatment intensity, survival outcomes, and patient-reported QOL in older patients with mCRC. Given the exploratory, hypothesis-generating design, the study is expected to generate clinically relevant hypotheses for individualized, patient-centered treatment strategies and future geriatric oncology research. UMIN Clinical Trials Registry UMIN000060489; https://tinyurl.com/3mn563er. DERR1-10.2196/94561.
cn_title: 基于老年评估分层评估老年转移性结直肠癌患者治疗强度、生活质量与生存的前瞻性观察研究方案
insight: 该方案以老年评估（GA）驱动的衰弱分层替代单纯年龄/PS，前瞻性关联一线治疗强度、QOL与生存，为老年mCRC个体化决策提供假设生成框架。
grade_rationale: 仅为单中心小样本（约100例）前瞻性观察性研究方案，尚无结局数据，不足以改变实践，但可为老年肿瘤个体化决策提供依据。

title: Reproducible and Interpretable H&E-based Histopathological Subtypes of Non-metastatic Lymph Nodes Refine Risk Stratification in Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Zhang Z, Zhang Y, Liu X, Li Y, Cui W, Su H, et al.
journal: Modern Pathology : an Official Journal of the United States and Canadian Academy of Pathology, Inc
abstract: Lymph node status is fundamental for staging, prognostic assessment, and treatment decision-making in colorectal cancer (CRC); however, current pathological evaluation largely focuses on metastatic involvement and overlooks the biological heterogeneity of non-metastatic lymph nodes (LNs). Here, we developed a reproducible histopathological classification system for non-metastatic LNs and established an interpretable machine-learning model for patient-level risk stratification in CRC. In this multicentre cohort study, we analyzed H&E-stained whole-slide images of non-metastatic LNs from patients with CRC undergoing curative-intent surgery across three independent cohorts. Non-metastatic LNs were classified into stimulated, unstimulated, and depleted subtypes based on semiquantitative assessment of proliferative and depletion-related morphological features. The biological characteristics of these subtypes were investigated using immunohistochemistry, transcriptomic profiling, and clinicopathological correlation analyses. Patient-level distributions of lymph node histopathological subtypes were integrated into multiple machine-learning algorithms, with model performance evaluated in internal and external validation cohorts. A total of 754 patients and 11,678 LN whole-slide images were included, comprising 10,410 non-metastatic and 1,268 metastatic LNs. Histopathological subtype assignment showed high interobserver reproducibility (Fleiss' κ=0.879, 95% CI 0.810-0.938). Stimulated LNs demonstrated enhanced immune activation features, whereas depleted LNs exhibited stromal remodeling, innate inflammatory activation, and impaired adaptive immune signaling. These histopathological subtypes were strongly associated with previously defined molecular LN subtypes. Among 12 machine-learning approaches, the random survival forest model achieved the best prognostic performance, with C-indices of 0.877 in the training cohort, 0.777 in cross-validation, 0.744 in temporal validation, and 0.748 in geographic validation. The resulting risk stratification system consistently discriminated overall survival across independent cohorts and clinically relevant subgroups. We established a reproducible H&E-based histopathological classification of non-metastatic LNs in CRC and developed an interpretable machine-learning model that captures lymph node immune-stromal heterogeneity and provides additional prognostic information beyond conventional staging parameters.
cn_title: 基于H&E的非转移性淋巴结组织病理亚型可重复分类并优化结直肠癌风险分层
insight: 该研究建立了可重复的非转移性淋巴结H&E组织病理分型（刺激型/未刺激型/耗竭型），并构建可解释机器学习模型，在常规分期之外提供额外预后信息，提示淋巴结免疫-间质异质性应纳入肠癌（含肝转移）风险分层与治疗决策。
grade_rationale: 多中心大样本（754例、11678张WSI）结合多组学与多模型外部验证，但为回顾性设计、尚未前瞻验证，暂不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Advances in KRAS
authors: Hao S, Niu T, Wu X, Mu C, Wang M, Liu H, et al.
abstract: KRAS gene mutations represent one of the most common drivers of human cancers, with particularly high prevalence in pancreatic, lung, and colorectal cancers. Among these, the KRAS
cn_title: KRAS突变靶向治疗研究进展综述
insight: 系统梳理KRAS突变致癌机制及靶向药物研发进展，为结直肠癌KRAS突变患者精准治疗提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 综述类文章，非原始研究，但KRAS靶向治疗为当前热点，对临床实践有潜在指导意义。

title: Modulating pMMR colorectal tumors toward a dMMR-like phenotype by Xian-Lian-Jie-Du decoction enhances anti-PD-1 efficacy.
authors: Li Y, Xu L, Zhang C, Zheng H, Zhang Q, Jiang W, et al.
journal: Phytomedicine : International Journal of Phytotherapy and Phytopharmacology
abstract: In advanced colorectal cancer (CRC), only approximately 5% of patients harbor deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) tumors, which are responsive to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), whereas the remaining 95% with proficient mismatch repair (pMMR) derive limited benefit. To investigate whether the Chinese medicinal formulation Xian-Lian-Jie-Du decoction (XLJDD) can modulate pMMR colorectal tumors toward a dMMR-like phenotype, thereby enhancing their responsiveness to anti-PD-1 therapy. We employed an integrative approach using isogenic pMMR/dMMR mouse models, combining in vivo efficacy assessment, mechanistic dissection, and bioactive compound screening to elucidate how XLJDD overcomes immunotherapy resistance. We developed a pMMR/dMMR mouse model to assess the efficacy of XLJDD in conjunction with anti-PD-1 therapy. The therapeutic outcomes were examined using histopathological evaluation, immunofluorescence, and flow cytometry analyses. The mechanisms underlying XLJDD's effects were elucidated through transcriptomic, proteomic, and single-cell transcriptomic approaches. Additionally, ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) was employed to analyze the constituents of XLJDD. We demonstrate that XLJDD sensitizes pMMR tumors to anti-PD-1 treatment, achieving efficacy comparable to that observed in dMMR tumors. Mechanistically, we reveal that pMMR tumor cells evade immune killing by downregulating and concealing interferon-gamma receptor 1 (IFNGR1) from the cell surface, thereby weakening interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) signaling. XLJDD overcomes this immune evasion by restoring IFNGR1 abundance and membrane localization, which amplifies IFN-γ-JAK2-STAT1 signaling and augments cytotoxic immune responses. We further identify Bilobalide A, an active component of XLJDD, as a critical factor in stabilizing IFNGR1 at the membrane and enhancing immunotherapeutic sensitivity in pMMR tumors. These findings establish IFNGR1 expression and membrane localization as critical determinants of IFN-γ mediated tumor cell killing and identify XLJDD and its active component Bilobalide A as pharmacological strategies to target this pathway, providing a rationale for expanding the clinical benefit of anti-PD-1 therapy in pMMR CRC patients.
cn_title: 仙连解毒汤调控pMMR结直肠肿瘤向dMMR样表型转化增强抗PD-1疗效
insight: 揭示IFNGR1下调与膜定位缺失是pMMR肠癌免疫逃逸关键机制，中药仙连解毒汤及其活性成分白果内酯A可恢复IFNGR1增强抗PD-1疗效，为占95%的pMMR肠癌免疫治疗增敏提供新策略。
grade_rationale: 研究设计扎实、多组学机制深入，但仅为临床前动物与细胞模型，尚需临床试验验证，暂不改变临床实践。

title: Imperatorin exerts anti-colorectal cancer effects by targeting NOX2 to inhibit mast cell degranulation.
authors: Shi X, Zhang P, Cui X, Hou Y, Zhang D, Zhao Y, et al.
journal: Phytomedicine : International Journal of Phytotherapy and Phytopharmacology
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a major global malignancy with a poor prognosis in advanced stages. Aberrant mast cell activation within the tumor microenvironment (TME) drives CRC progression; however, the molecular mechanisms underlying the tumor-promoting role of mast cells in the hypoxic TME remain unclear, and effective therapies targeting these cells are lacking. To investigate the role of the NADPH oxidase 2 (NOX2)-reactive oxygen species (ROS)-calcium signaling axis in mast cell activation and evaluate the anti-CRC activity of imperatorin (IMP), a natural furanocoumarin. Human mast cell and CRC cell lines were used to establish hypoxic activation and conditioned medium co-culture systems. Tissue microarrays, single‑cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets and CT26 allograft mouse models were employed, combined with gain/loss-of-function, Western Blot, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), immunofluorescence and cell functional assays. NOX2 expression was significantly upregulated in activated mast cells from human CRC tissues. IMP inhibited NOX2, thereby blocking hypoxia-induced oxidative stress and mast cell degranulation. This intervention suppressed the secretion of tumor-promoting mediators and effectively inhibited CRC cell proliferation and invasion. Furthermore, in vivo experiments demonstrated that IMP dose-dependently suppressed CRC allograft growth in murine models without causing overt systemic toxicity. This study reveals a mechanism by which mast cells promote CRC progression in the hypoxic TME and demonstrates that IMP exerts potent anti-CRC effects by targeting NOX2 to inhibit mast cell activation. These findings identify both a therapeutic target and a promising lead compound for TME-targeted CRC therapy.
cn_title: 欧前胡素靶向NOX2抑制肥大细胞脱颗粒发挥抗结直肠癌作用
insight: 揭示缺氧微环境中NOX2-ROS-钙轴驱动肥大细胞活化促癌的新机制，为肠癌微环境靶向治疗提供天然化合物先导，但尚需临床转化验证。
grade_rationale: 研究设计为细胞系与小鼠同种移植模型的临床前机制研究，机制新颖但缺乏人体临床数据，暂不具备改变临床实践的证据等级。

title: Pathophysiological contributions of P-selectin glycoprotein ligand-1 to early- and late-onset colorectal cancer.
authors: Zaongo SD, Bado I
abstract: The incidence of early-onset colorectal cancer (CRC) is rising steadily alongside traditional late-onset disease, yet the pathophysiological mechanisms distinguishing these two entities remain largely elusive. Herein, we address this knowledge gap by examining the distinctive properties of P-selectin glycoprotein ligand (PSGL)-1 within the CRC landscape. Given that both early- and late-onset CRC are underpinned by chronic gut inflammation, the potential role of PSGL-1 in this context warrants close investigation. First, we synthesize current evidence on the contributions of PSGL-1 to CRC pathogenesis and propose its function as a molecular bridge between early- and late-onset disease forms. Second, we explore the mechanistic links connecting PSGL-1 to established protumorigenic pathways and to the gut microbiome, reinforcing its emerging significance in CRC development. Finally, by offering deeper insights into the putative roles of PSGL-1 in promoting CRC, we inform new directions for clinical and therapeutic strategies centered on PSGL-1-directed investigation.
cn_title: P-选择素糖蛋白配体-1在早发与晚发结直肠癌中的病理生理作用
insight: 综述提出PSGL-1作为连接早发与晚发结直肠癌的分子桥梁，关联慢性肠道炎症、促瘤通路与肠道菌群，为肠癌机制研究和靶向治疗提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 叙述性综述，整合现有证据提出假说，无原始数据或外部验证，暂不具备改变临床实践的直接证据。

title: Prognostic value of the Global Leadership Initiative on Malnutrition for clinical outcomes in outpatients with colorectal and/or lung cancer: an observational prospective study.
authors: Estanislau AMDC, Maia FCP, Lima AI, Silva LC, Generoso SV, Maurício SF, et al.
abstract: The Global Leadership Initiative on Malnutrition (GLIM) was established to standardize malnutrition diagnosis. Despite growing research, few studies have investigated its application in outpatients. This study assessed the prognostic value of GLIM combinations in colorectal and/or lung cancer outpatients. Ninety-two outpatients with colorectal and/or lung cancer at different treatment stages were assessed between December 2022 and July 2024. Nutritional status was classified using eight GLIM combinations. Phenotypic criteria (weight loss, reduced muscle mass, reduced muscle strength) remained constant across all models, while etiologic criteria (reduced intake, inflammation, cancer-related burden) varied. Classifications were compared with the Subjective Global Assessment. The prognostic value was evaluated for 12-mo mortality. Logistic regression, Kaplan-Meier analysis, and Cox regression were adjusted for age, sex, cancer stage, tumor site, and Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group status. The mean patient age was 64 y (interquartile range: 57-74 y). Malnutrition prevalence ranged from 30.4% to 89.1% depending on the GLIM combinations. When reduced intake was combined with any phenotypic criteria, 12-mo mortality risk increased 5.6-19.8-fold. The combination including all phenotypic and etiologic variables independently predicted shorter survival. Malnutrition prevalence and prognostic performance varied according to the GLIM combination, influencing predictive accuracy for mortality. As evidence grows regarding which models achieve the greatest diagnostic accuracy in oncology, combinations including phenotypic criteria and reduced intake should be prioritized to optimize prognostic evaluation and clinical decision-making.
cn_title: GLIM营养不良标准对结直肠癌和/或肺癌门诊患者预后的预测价值：一项前瞻性观察研究
insight: GLIM不同组合对门诊肿瘤患者营养不良诊断率及预后预测差异显著，含表型标准与摄入减少的组合预测12个月死亡风险最佳，提示应标准化GLIM组合以优化肠癌患者营养评估与临床决策。
grade_rationale: 前瞻性观察研究，样本量小（92例），单中心，未外部验证，但提示GLIM组合标准化需求，暂不足以改变实践。

title: Has the use of enhanced recovery protocols in IBD surgery increased postoperative bleeding complications?
authors: Aviran E, Assaf D, Zaghiyan K, Fleshner P
abstract: Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols improve recovery after colorectal surgery but include NSAIDs and COX-2 inhibitors that may increase gastrointestinal bleeding risk. We evaluated the association between ERAS and postoperative bleeding in IBD patients undergoing colorectal resection. A prospectively maintained registry was reviewed for elective IBD-related colorectal resection with anastomosis before and after ERAS protocol implementation. Outcomes included postoperative bleeding, transfusion, intervention, length of stay, and 30-day readmission. The cohort included 964 patients (466 ERAS, 498 non-ERAS). Bleeding without sequelae (14% vs 5%, p < 0.001) and bleeding with sequelae (5% vs 2%, p = 0.01) were more common in the ERAS group. Transfusion and intervention rates did not differ. On multivariable analysis, ERAS was independently associated with bleeding with sequelae (OR 2.6, 95% CI 1.2-5.7; p = 0.02). ERAS use in IBD colorectal surgery was associated with increased postoperative bleeding. Most events were self-limited and did not require transfusion or intervention.
cn_title: 加速康复方案在IBD结直肠手术中是否增加术后出血并发症
insight: ERAS在IBD结直肠手术中与术后出血增加相关，但多为自限性；提示需权衡NSAIDs/COX-2抑制剂使用，优化ERAS镇痛方案。
grade_rationale: 基于前瞻性登记数据库的大样本回顾性队列，发现ERAS与出血相关但多为自限性，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Association Between Multidisciplinary Team Meetings and Short-Term Postoperative Outcomes in Gastrointestinal Malignancies: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
authors: Zhao H, Liu B, Wu M, Ding G, Yan Y, Fu W
journal: Cancer Control : Journal of the Moffitt Cancer Center
abstract: IntroductionMultidisciplinary team meetings (MTMs) integrate expertise from different specialties to support individualized treatment planning. However, their association with short-term postoperative outcomes in high-risk patients with gastrointestinal malignancies remains unclear. This study evaluated the implementation of preoperative MTM discussion and its association with postoperative outcomes in patients with gastric cancer (GC) or colorectal cancer (CRC) complicated by diabetes mellitus and/or coronary heart disease.MethodsThis single-center retrospective cohort study included consecutive patients with histologically confirmed gastric or colorectal adenocarcinoma and concomitant diabetes mellitus and/or coronary heart disease who underwent radical resection between January 2020 and January 2024. Patients were divided into MTM and no-MTM groups according to whether they received preoperative MTM discussion. The primary outcome was the severity of postoperative complications during the hospitalization, categorized as no complication, Clavien-Dindo grade I-II, or grade III or higher. Multivariable ordinal logistic regression was used to estimate the association between the absence of preoperative MTM discussion and increasing complication severity. The secondary outcome was the occurrence of any postoperative complication and was analyzed using binary logistic regression. Firth penalized logistic regression for major postoperative complications was performed as a sensitivity analysis.ResultsA total of 477 patients were included, with 191 in the MTM group and 286 in the no-MTM group. The no-MTM group had a higher overall postoperative complication rate than the MTM group (19.2% vs. 12.0%, p=0.039), whereas ICU admission and hospitalization costs were higher in the MTM group. Multivariable ordinal logistic regression showed that absence of preoperative MTM discussion, longer operative time per 30-minute increase, and preoperative hypoalbuminemia were independently associated with increasing postoperative complication severity. Secondary analyses yielded generally consistent findings.ConclusionsPreoperative MTM discussion was associated with a lower occurrence and lower severity of postoperative complications during the hospitalization among high-risk patients with GC or CRC.
cn_title: 多学科团队会议与胃肠道恶性肿瘤术后短期结局的关联：回顾性队列研究
insight: 术前MDT讨论与高危胃癌/结直肠癌患者术后并发症发生率和严重程度降低相关，提示MDT模式在肠癌围手术期管理中的潜在价值，但需前瞻性验证。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列研究，样本量中等（477例），虽提示MDT与术后并发症减少相关，但存在选择偏倚，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Hyper-mutational processes provide a head-start for weak cancer drivers: Explaining atypical KRAS variants.
authors: Nicholson MD, Tomlinson I
abstract: Hypermutant cancers frequently contain atypical driver gene variants, which may provide sub-optimal oncogenic advantages. The reason why weak cancer drivers prevail and are not outcompeted by stronger alternatives is unclear. Here, using mathematical modelling, we show that aberrant mutational processes alone can account for the detection of weak, rather than canonical, driver mutations. We find that simply increasing the mutation rate per cell division, without altering selection or mutational biases, can lead to the dominance of weak drivers due to rapidly occurring further driver events. This effect can be further enhanced by mutational biases towards specific nucleotide sequence contexts. Focusing on POLE-mutant (DNA polymerase epsilon proofreading-deficient) colorectal cancers, we quantify the mutation bias for varied KRAS drivers under both POLE-mutant and non-hypermutant mutational processes. In POLE-mutant cancers, the combination of the bias coupled with an elevated mutation rate is sufficient to explain the enrichment of atypical KRAS drivers. Furthermore, model predictions are consistent with the observed prevalence of atypical KRAS drivers observed in mismatch repair deficient colorectal cancer. Thus, differential selection across these cancer types need not be invoked to explain the variation in driver mutations. Our study clarifies the interplay of mutation and selection during the evolutionary dynamics of tumourigenesis.
cn_title: 超突变过程为弱驱动突变提供先发优势：解释非典型KRAS变异
insight: 该研究通过数学模型揭示超突变（POLE突变、MSI）通过提高突变率而非选择压力，使弱驱动KRAS变异富集，提示肠癌驱动基因检测需结合突变背景解读。
grade_rationale: 研究基于数学建模和公共数据验证，虽未直接改变临床实践，但为理解超突变肠癌驱动基因变异提供了新视角，可能影响未来分子诊断解读。

title: Efficient and real-time polyp segmentation: An empirical evaluation of lightweight Mamba integration strategies.
authors: Chen S, Mohd Rahim MS, Sim HM, Pang YY, Teo PK, Ong EL, et al.
abstract: Accurate and efficient polyp segmentation is essential for computer-aided colorectal cancer screening, yet achieving a favorable balance among segmentation accuracy, computational efficiency, and cross-dataset generalization remains challenging. Recent studies suggest that Mamba-based state-space modeling can enhance long-range dependency modeling with relatively low complexity, but how lightweight Mamba integration strategies affect dense prediction frameworks for polyp segmentation remains insufficiently understood. In this study, we present LiteMamba-Seg, a lightweight polyp segmentation framework built on a U-Net-like encoder-decoder architecture with a ResNet34 backbone, and conduct an empirical evaluation of different lightweight Mamba integration strategies. Specifically, we investigate bottleneck-only integration as well as alternative second-stage placements at an encoder-side intermediate stage and a decoder-side reconstruction stage. Experimental results on four public benchmark datasets show that LiteMamba-Seg achieves competitive segmentation performance while maintaining a lightweight design and real-time model-level inference, with 26.81 M parameters, 13.89 GFLOPs, and 167.73 FPS. Further ablation, controlled placement, multi-seed, robustness, boundary, calibration, and false-positive analyses indicate that the effect of Mamba integration depends on its placement within the network. In particular, decoder-side reconstruction-stage integration yields more favorable quantitative and qualitative results than encoder-side intermediate placement across the evaluated benchmarks. These findings suggest that, for lightweight polyp segmentation frameworks, Mamba integration should be considered jointly with placement strategy rather than simply increasing the number of sequence modeling blocks.
cn_title: 轻量Mamba集成策略在结直肠息肉实时分割中的实证评估
insight: 系统评估轻量Mamba在息肉分割网络中的集成位置，发现解码器重建阶段集成优于编码器中间阶段，为肠癌筛查AI的实时高效部署提供架构设计依据。
grade_rationale: 属AI方法学工程优化研究，非临床终点研究，虽在四个公开基准上验证但尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Cancer-type-specific gaps between treatment recommendation and implementation following comprehensive genomic profiling: a nationwide real-world study.
authors: Nakano Y, Igarashi A, Esaki M
abstract: Comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) has been reimbursed in Japan since 2019; however, the extent to which treatments recommended by expert panels are subsequently implemented and how this varies across cancer types remain unclear. Among 50,974 patients with solid tumors registered in the C-CAT database between June 2019 and April 2023, 44,669 adult patients met the eligibility criteria and were included in the analysis. Patients were grouped into three cohorts: non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), colorectal cancer (CRC), and other solid tumors. We evaluated the proportion of patients with at least one drug-based treatment recommended by an expert panel (PoTR) and the proportion who subsequently received an expert-panel-recommended treatment (PoTI). We also conducted exploratory multivariable analyses of factors associated with PoTR and, among patients who received a treatment recommendation, PoTI. The PoTR was 54.57% for NSCLC, 53.80% for CRC, and 39.92% for other solid tumors. The PoTI was 16.74%, 7.96%, and 7.74%, respectively. A substantial gap between treatment recommendation and implementation was observed across cancer types. Among the Cohort C organ groups, PoTI was higher in the prostate and breast groups and lower in the pancreatic and soft-tissue groups. Exploratory adjusted analyses showed that the associations of age, ECOG performance status, CGP panel, and cohort differed between the PoTR and conditional PoTI models. This nationwide analysis found substantial variation in treatment recommendation, recorded implementation, and the gap between them across the prespecified cancer cohorts. These descriptive findings may help frame patient counseling and expectations regarding treatment recommendation and subsequent implementation after CGP.
cn_title: 全面基因组分析后治疗推荐与实施在癌种间的差异：一项全国性真实世界研究
insight: 全国性真实世界数据显示，CGP后结直肠癌治疗推荐率约54%，但实际实施率仅8%，远低于肺癌的17%，提示肠癌CGP结果向临床治疗转化存在显著障碍，需优化可及性与试验入组策略。
grade_rationale: 基于日本C-CAT全国数据库近4.5万例的大样本真实世界研究，描述性强但非干预性，揭示CGP实施差距，对临床实践有参考价值但暂不直接改变实践。

title: Incidence Trends and Projections of Major Gastrointestinal Cancers in the United States: A SEER-Based Analysis from 2000 to 2022.
authors: Yaseen S, Khoursheed H, Osman ASA, Abdelaziz Abdelmoneim S, Atef Ahmed B, Hamad M, et al.
abstract: Gastrointestinal (GI) cancers account for a substantial cancer burden, yet contemporary incidence trends and future projections across cancer sites and demographic subgroups remain incompletely characterized. We aimed to analyze incidence trends from 2000-2022 and forecast rates through 2032 for eight major GI cancers in the United States. Using SEER Research Data (17 registries, 2000-2022), we identified patients with esophageal, gastric, liver, gallbladder, pancreatic, small intestine, and colorectal cancer. Age-adjusted incidence rates were calculated and stratified by sex, age group (<60 vs. ≥60 years), and race (White, Black, Asian/Pacific Islander, American Indian/Alaska Native). Time-series forecasting models (linear regression, ARIMA, ETS, NNAR) were applied to project incidence through 2032. Incidence trends varied markedly by cancer site. Pancreatic cancer showed sustained increases across most subgroups, with projected rates rising from 4.41 to 5.11 per 100,000 by 2032. Colorectal cancer demonstrated divergent age-specific patterns: incidence among individuals ≥60 years is projected to decline (25.48 to 14.89 per 100,000), while early-onset disease (<60 years) is expected to increase (5.35 to 5.84 per 100,000). Liver cancer incidence is forecast to decline (2.18 to 1.42 per 100,000). Esophageal and gastric cancers showed modest increases, while gallbladder cancer remained stable. Substantial disparities persisted by sex (male predominance for most sites, female predominance for gallbladder) and race (highest burden among Asian/Pacific Islander populations). GI cancer incidence trajectories are highly heterogeneous. The projected rise in pancreatic and early-onset colorectal cancers signals urgent needs for targeted prevention, risk-factor modification, and improved early detection strategies in at-risk populations.
cn_title: 美国主要消化道肿瘤发病趋势与2032年预测：基于SEER的2000-2022年分析
insight: 该研究预测早发性结直肠癌发病将持续上升而老年组下降，提示需针对年轻人群优化筛查起始年龄与早期检测策略。
grade_rationale: 基于SEER大样本回顾性分析并构建时间序列预测模型，趋势预测可提供政策参考，但非干预性研究，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Persistent Health Disparities Among Adult Cancer Survivors.
authors: Kjaer TK, Levinsen AKG, Grand MK, Jakobsen E, Borre M, Zachariae R, et al.
abstract: Cancer survivors face elevated risks of age- and treatment-related health conditions, possibly due to accelerated biological aging from cancer therapy. The role of social determinants of health (SDOH) in these aging trajectories remains understudied. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 109,224 curatively treated Danish cancer survivors (lung, breast, prostate, or colon cancer, diagnosed between 1997 and 2018) and 574,022 age- and sex-matched cancer-free individuals. SDOH was assessed using educational level and cohabitation status. Using national registries, we investigated associations between SDOH and 16 post-cancer new morbidities with Cox proportional hazard models and flexible parametric models. During a median 6.9-year follow-up, cancer survivors had significantly higher rates of new morbidities than cancer-free individuals. Lung cancer survivors had elevated hazard rates for 14 morbidities, breast cancer survivors had increased rates for 12 morbidities, prostate cancer survivors exhibited elevated rates for 8 morbidities, and colon cancer survivors had rates for 14 morbidities. Educational disparities were evident: survivors with short education had higher rates for chronic respiratory disease (HRs: 1.30-1.55 across cancer types), heart failure (HRs: 1.50-1.54 in breast and colon), diabetes (HRs: 1.67-1.95 in breast, prostate, and colon), and depression (HRs: 1.32-1.37 in breast and colon). Living alone was also associated with increased but less pronounced rates. Cancer survivors experience elevated rates for age- and treatment-related post-cancer new morbidities compared to cancer-free individuals. Sociodemographic disadvantages, particularly short education, further increase these rates. These findings suggest that SDOH play an important role in post-cancer aging, highlighting the need for targeted interventions addressing social determinants in survivorship care.
cn_title: 丹麦癌症幸存者治疗后新发合并症的社会决定因素差异研究
insight: 该研究揭示社会健康决定因素（尤其低教育水平）显著加剧癌症幸存者治疗后新发合并症风险，提示肠癌幸存者随访应纳入社会因素分层管理。
grade_rationale: 基于全国登记的大样本回顾性队列，证据等级中等，提示社会因素应纳入 survivorship 管理，但尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Safety and efficacy of robotic repeat hepatectomy compared to laparoscopic and open repeat hepatectomy: a retrospective comparative study.
authors: Garosi E, Bernardi L, Roesel R, Pozza G, Mongelli F, Majno-Hurst P, et al.
abstract: Repeat hepatectomies are challenging due to adhesions and altered anatomy. Robotic surgery, with enhanced dexterity and visualization, may expand the role of minimally invasive liver surgery (MILS) in this setting. The aim of this study was to explore the safety and efficacy of robotic repeat hepatectomy. We conducted a retrospective cohort study comparing repeat robotic (R-RLR), laparoscopic (L-RLR), and open liver resections (O-RLR) performed between January 2019 and December 2024. The primary outcome was postoperative morbidity. Secondary outcomes included conversion to laparotomy, use of Pringle maneuver, blood loss, hospital stay and postoperative mortality. For oncologic efficacy, rates of negative surgical margins (R0) or equivalent (R1 vascular), recurrences and survival were assessed. Forty-two patients underwent repeat hepatectomy (O-RLR = 15, L-RLR = 13, R-RLR = 14). Over time, O-RLR and L-RLR declined in favor of R-RLR. Main indications were colorectal liver metastases and hepatocellular carcinoma. Groups had similar age and comorbidities; however, cirrhosis and portal hypertension were more frequent in R-RLR. Mean Iwate scores were 6 (O-RLR), 4 (L-RLR), and 5 (R-RLR) (p = 0.240). Postoperative morbidity was significantly lower in L-RLR (7.6%) and R-RLR (7.7%) compared to O-RLR (40%) (p = 0.030). Mean Comprehensive Complication Index was 11.7 (O-RLR), 0.7 (L-RLR), and 0.6 (R-RLR) (p = 0.025). Two L-RLR cases required conversion. Pringle maneuver, blood loss, and hospital stay decreased progressively from O-RLR to L-RLR to R-RLR. There was no postoperative mortality.R0 resection was achieved in 73% (O-RLR), 100% (L-RLR), and 78.5% (R-RLR); R1 vascular rates were 13.3%, 0%, and 21.5%, respectively (p = 0.14). The three groups had similar overall and hepatic recurrence rates; survival (recurrence-free and overall) was also similar. Repeat robotic hepatectomy is safe and provides good oncologic outcomes. The robotic approach may allow MILS in more complex cases, including patients with cirrhosis and portal hypertension.
cn_title: 机器人对比腹腔镜与开腹再次肝切除的安全性与疗效：回顾性比较研究
insight: 机器人再次肝切除安全可行，可拓展微创肝切除至肝硬化等复杂病例，为肠癌肝转移复发再切除提供微创选择。
grade_rationale: 单中心小样本回顾性队列，虽提示机器人可拓展微创适应证，但证据等级有限，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Association between left colic artery preservation and surgical outcomes after laparoscopic radical resection for rectal cancer: a propensity score-matched analysis.
authors: Zhang H, Li W, Wang S, Fu Z
abstract: To evaluate the association between left colic artery (LCA) preservation during laparoscopic rectal cancer resection and the incidence of anastomotic leakage (AL) and perioperative outcomes. Clinical data were retrospectively collected from patients who underwent laparoscopic rectal cancer resection at the First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University between July 2020 and February 2023. Patients were divided into an LCA-preservation group and a non-preservation group according to whether the left colic artery (LCA) was preserved intraoperatively. A 1:1 propensity score matching analysis was performed to balance baseline covariates, including sex, age, body mass index, comorbidities, American Society of Anesthesiologists classification, TNM stage, tumor differentiation, distance from the anal verge, and tumor size. Postoperative outcomes were subsequently compared between the two groups. A total of 500 patients were included, comprising 341 patients in the LCA-preservation group and 159 in the non-preservation group. Before matching, patients in the non-preservation group had more advanced TNM stages and a higher incidence of AL than those in the LCA-preservation group. After propensity score matching, baseline characteristics were well balanced between the two groups. The incidence of AL remained significantly higher in the non-preservation group than in the LCA-preservation group (P = 0.038). Operative time was significantly longer in the LCA-preservation group (P = 0.026), whereas no significant differences were observed in intraoperative blood loss, drainage volume on postoperative day 1, or postoperative length of hospital stay. In laparoscopic rectal cancer resection, LCA preservation was associated with a lower incidence of anastomotic leakage, potentially through the maintenance of proximal bowel perfusion. Although this technique may prolong operative time, it does not appear to increase other major perioperative adverse outcomes, supporting its potential clinical value.
cn_title: 保留左结肠动脉与腹腔镜直肠癌根治术后吻合口漏风险的倾向性评分匹配分析
insight: 保留左结肠动脉可降低腹腔镜直肠癌术后吻合口漏发生率，虽延长手术时间但不增加其他并发症，支持其在直肠癌手术中的临床应用价值。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，经倾向性评分匹配后显示LCA保留与吻合口漏降低显著相关，可能改变手术实践，但证据等级受限于回顾性设计。

title: The sphingolipid code of cancer: divergent roles across tumor types and therapeutic horizons.
authors: Thombre DG, Katre VA, Singh S, Vaish V
abstract: Sphingolipids have emerged as critical bioactive molecules that orchestrate diverse cellular processes underlying cancer initiation, progression, and therapeutic resistance. Once considered structural membrane lipids, they are now recognized as dynamic regulators of proliferation, apoptosis, angiogenesis, metastasis, and immune evasion. Central to this biology is the ceramide and sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P) balance, a metabolic switch that dictates cell fate between death and survival. However, accumulating evidence reveals that the "sphingolipid code" is cancer-type specific, shaped by the expression of distinct enzyme isoforms, metabolite profiles, and microenvironmental contexts. This review consolidates current knowledge on sphingolipid alterations across major malignancies, including hematological cancers, colorectal, gastric, pancreatic, breast, ovarian, endometrial, lung, glioblastoma, and melanoma. We have highlighted emerging common mechanistic themes, such as the roles of gangliosides in metastasis and chemoresistance driven by glucosylceramide synthase. Furthermore, we have discussed the therapeutic horizons of targeting sphingolipid metabolism, ranging from sphingosine kinase (SphK1/2) inhibitors and ceramide delivery systems to ganglioside-directed immunotherapy, with emphasis on preclinical and clinical advancements. By integrating sphingolipid biology with precision oncology frameworks, sphingolipids hold a promise as both therapeutic targets and biomarkers. Yet, challenges such as tumor heterogeneity, drug delivery barriers, and toxicity must be overcome to achieve positive clinical translations. Deciphering the sphingolipid code across cancers offers a transformative opportunity to unlock novel strategies for diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment, ultimately bridging basic lipid biology with personalized cancer therapy.
cn_title: 鞘脂密码在肿瘤中的异质性作用及治疗前景
insight: 系统梳理鞘脂代谢在包括结直肠癌在内的多种肿瘤中的类型特异性作用，提示靶向鞘脂通路（如SphK1/2、神经节苷脂）可能为肠癌及肝转移提供新治疗策略与生物标志物。
grade_rationale: 为叙述性综述，整合临床前与临床进展，未提供新原始数据或高级别循证证据，暂不具备直接改变实践的能力。

title: Visualizing pelvic splanchnic nerve and hypogastric nerve with magnetic resonance neurography in rectal cancer patients.
authors: Ikeda Y, Ohira G, Hayano K, Tochigi T, Kurata Y, Hirata A, et al.
abstract: To evaluate the visualization rates of the hypogastric and pelvic splanchnic nerves using magnetic resonance neurography (MRN) and to identify associated factors. This study included patients with rectal carcinoma who underwent preoperative MRN at our institution between December 2019 and September 2020. Two gastrointestinal surgeons evaluated the visibility of the hypogastric and pelvic splanchnic nerves on a per-nerve basis, with scores of "excellent" or "good" defined as successful visualization. The visualization rates of the hypogastric and pelvic splanchnic nerves were 21.6% and 81.8%, respectively. A large visceral fat area at the umbilical level (p = 0.0150) was an independent factor affecting the visualization rate of the hypogastric nerves. Early clinical T stage (cT1-3) (p = 0.0255) and a large visceral fat area at the level of the upper edge of the femoral head (p = 0.0096) were independent factors affecting the visualization rate of the pelvic splanchnic nerves. MRN demonstrated a high visualization rate for the pelvic splanchnic nerves but a low rate for the hypogastric nerves. Visualization appeared to be influenced by the visceral fat area and inflammatory responses or edema in surrounding structures.
cn_title: 直肠癌患者盆腔内脏神经与腹下神经的磁共振神经成像可视化研究
insight: MRN对盆腔内脏神经显示率高、腹下神经显示率低，且受内脏脂肪面积影响，为直肠癌手术神经保护提供影像学依据。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性影像学研究，样本量有限，未改变临床实践，但为神经保护提供新视角。

title: External validation of the Pre-operative Predictive (PROP) score for feasibility of complete cytoreduction in colorectal peritoneal metastases: a single-centre experience.
authors: Steidle C, Yurttas C, Huth M, Radtke A, Keck J, Horvath P
abstract: Colorectal peritoneal metastases (PM) remain a major therapeutic challenge. Cytoreductive surgery (CRS) combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) offers prolonged survival in selected patients. Accurate preoperative assessment of resectability is crucial to avoid non-beneficial surgery. The Preoperative Predictive Score (PROP) integrates nine preoperative clinical and radiologic parameters to predict the completeness of cytoreduction (CC). This study aimed to externally validate the PROP Score in an independent European single-centre cohort. 63 Patients undergoing CRS ± HIPEC for colorectal PM between 2012 and 2022 were retrospectively analysed. PROP scores were calculated from preoperative data and compared with intraoperative CC scores (CC-0, CC-1, CC-2/3). Statistical analysis included χ², Spearman correlation, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve evaluation. Sixty-three patients were included (CC-0 = 41; CC-1 = 13; CC-2/3 = 9). Median PROP values increased with lower resectability (3.4 vs. 7.2 vs. 10.8; p < 0.001). A cutoff ≥ 6 predicted incomplete cytoreduction with 78% sensitivity and 90% specificity (AUC = 0.919). PROP correlated strongly with the Peritoneal Cancer Index (ρ = 0.673; p < 0.001). No 30- or 90-day mortality was observed. The PROP Score reliably predicts the likelihood of complete cytoreduction in colorectal PM using solely preoperative parameters. Moreover it is the first score which is able to preoperatively discriminate patients with a future CC-0 und CC-1 resection. Its external validation supports evidence-based patient selection for CRS ± HIPEC, optimizing surgical decision-making and resource utilization.
cn_title: PROP评分外部验证：预测结直肠腹膜转移完全减瘤可行性
insight: PROP评分在独立欧洲队列中验证可术前预测结直肠腹膜转移完全减瘤可能性，有助于优化CRS±HIPEC患者选择，避免无效手术。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性外部验证，样本量小（63例），但AUC高且为首个可区分CC-0与CC-1的评分，有潜在实践价值但需更大样本验证。

title: Building Engagement Using Financial Incentives for Colorectal Cancer Screening (BENEFIT-C) in a Rural Louisiana Federally Qualified Health Center.
authors: Perry LM, Peacock E, LeBlanc A, Williams L, Wiltz G, Krousel-Wood M
abstract: To evaluate the preliminary effectiveness and feasibility of a community-engaged financial incentive intervention for increasing colorectal cancer (CRC) screening in a rural, low-resource primary care setting. A feasibility pilot trial at a federally qualified health center in the Acadiana region, Louisiana. Participants were identified via electronic health records (EHR), recruited by telephone, and randomized to intervention (n = 25) or control (n = 25). Both groups received incentives for flu and COVID-19 vaccines. The intervention group also received incentives for CRC screening. Fisher's Exact tests evaluated between-group differences in completion of CRC screening (primary outcome), flu, and COVID-19 vaccines 2 months post-enrollment. Eligible patients were aged 45-75, due for CRC screening, and English-speaking. From November 11, 2023 to March 31, 2024, completion of each outcome was obtained from the EHR. 57% of interested individuals were eligible; 94% of eligible individuals enrolled. Participants were 70% female, 42% Black, 24% uninsured, with a mean age of 52.4 years. Completion of CRC screening was higher in the intervention versus control group (17 [68%] vs. 8 [32%], p = 0.02). Financial incentives significantly increased completion of CRC screening. Future research should confirm findings in larger samples and evaluate cost-effectiveness to inform health system policies.
cn_title: 基于经济激励的农村结直肠癌筛查可行性随机对照试验
insight: 经济激励可显著提高农村低资源人群结直肠癌筛查完成率，为通过卫生系统政策干预提升筛查依从性提供了初步证据，但样本量小需进一步验证。
grade_rationale: 小样本可行性RCT，虽显示阳性结果，但需更大样本和成本效果分析才能改变实践。

title: MyoD and Myogenin regulatory cascade is targeted by tumor signals to repress myogenesis in cancer cachexia.
authors: Huang KF, Liao YS, Lin HB, Lu IN, Lin XR, Wu YJ, et al.
abstract: It is estimated that about 20-30% cancer death is directly linked to the syndrome called cancer cachexia (CAC), which is characterized by debilitating skeletal muscle (SKM) and fat wasting. Recent studies have found that the myogenic ability of myogenic stem cells (MuSC) in the cachectic SKM is compromised, but the mechanisms remain to be clarified. Using the C26 colon cancer cells mediated cachexia model, the down-regulation of myogenic regulatory factors (MRF) MyoD and MyoG, but not Myf5 and Mrf4, was confirmed in vitro and in vivo. We further found the repression of myogenesis by C26 cells conditioned medium (C26M) in vitro could be rescued by inducible over-expression of either MyoD or MyoG, but not Myf5 or Mrf4. As MyoD is the major upstream activator of MyoG, these findings suggest the targeting of the MyoD-MyoG regulatory cascade by CAC signals. The transactivation of myogenic gene promoters by MyoD was also constantly repressed by C26M, suggesting MyoD dysfunction is critical to myogenesis repression in CAC. The repression of MyoD gene transcription by C26M was found to be mediated by the core enhancer (CE) located in the distal enhancer (DE) region. The activation of CE mediated promoter activity by MyoD, ß-Catenin*, and Pbx1 was significantly reduced by C26M, implying the repression of MyoD positive feedback loop. Taken together, these observations suggest that CAC signals repress both MyoD transactivational activity on target genes and its transcriptional activation by upstream activators, which subsequently leads to repression of myogenesis and failed regeneration in cachectic SKM.
cn_title: 肿瘤信号靶向MyoD-Myogenin调控级联抑制癌症恶病质中的肌生成
insight: 揭示C26结肠癌恶病质信号通过抑制MyoD-MyoG级联阻断肌生成，为肠癌恶病质肌肉消耗提供干预靶点，提示肝转移患者肌肉保护策略。
grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，虽揭示新靶点但尚无临床验证，暂不改变实践。

title: Structural and Functional Consequences of Arg512 Mutations in Methyl-CpG-Binding Domain Protein 4.
authors: Barnes R, Ouzon-Shubeita H, Mandimutsira C, Wang G, Lee S
abstract: Methyl-CpG-binding domain protein 4 (MBD4) is a base excision repair glycosylase that removes the thymine of a T:G mispair. If left unrepaired, these mismatches can cause C>T transitions. Human MBD4 uses an arginine finger, R468, to flip the mispaired thymine into its active site and to stabilize the orphaned guanine. MBD4 also possesses a second highly conserved arginine, R512, in close proximity to R468, whose role remains unknown despite an R512W mutation catalogued in colorectal cancers and an R512Q mutation reported in Myelodysplastic Syndromes. Here, we investigate the structural and functional significance of R512 using MBD4 variants R512A, R512K, R512Q, and R512W. We find that the native hydrogen-bonding network mediated by R512 is critical for active-site stability, and that R512K is the only variant to retain catalytic activity. This mutant preserves the wild-type rate of base excision despite a reduced affinity for the DNA substrate. Structural characterization of R512K MBD4 bound to T:G-mismatched DNA reveals an ordered water molecule in this pocket. This water molecule, along with the lysine amino group, retain 6 of the 7 native R512 hydrogen bonds, thereby preserving the local architecture of the enzyme. Comparative structural modeling of the catalytically inactive R512A, R512Q, and R512W variants suggests that loss of localized positive charge combined with disruption of the hydrogen-bonding network accounts for their inactivity. Together, these findings establish an essential role for R512 in catalytic activity and suggest how mutation of this residue can disrupt the BER pathway and contribute to tumorigenesis.
cn_title: MBD4 Arg512突变的结构与功能后果及其在结直肠癌中的意义
insight: 揭示MBD4 R512在碱基切除修复中的关键作用，R512W/Q突变破坏修复活性，为结直肠癌错配修复缺陷和突变负荷提供机制解释。
grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，无临床验证，但为结直肠癌中MBD4突变的功能影响提供结构生物学证据，暂不改变实践。

title: Taking Into Account the Susceptible Window for Exposures in Cox Proportional Hazards Model: A Way Using Splines to Model the Lag-Risk Relationship.
authors: Guo F, Qian Z, Wang W, Wang F, Rosner B, Wang M
abstract: External exposures take time to accumulate and affect human health, leading to a time lag between initial exposure and the manifestation of clinical signs. Susceptible time window analysis aims to describe the relationship between the time since exposure and its effects. To obtain unbiased estimates in susceptible time window analysis, researchers may need to adjust for exposures measured at different times simultaneously. Conventional Cox proportional hazards models often fail in this regard due to the strong multicollinearity between lagged exposure terms. In addition to estimation challenges, missing data in historical exposures present another obstacle for long-term analysis. To address these challenges, we first impose flexible parametric models on the effects across historical exposures by assuming that they follow restricted cubic splines. Based on our proposed restricted cubic spline model, we develop two model selection algorithms to help researchers determine the optimal knot locations in the splines. Additionally, we propose using multiple imputations to handle the missing exposure data. We conducted simulation studies to evaluate the performance of the restricted cubic spline models and the imputation algorithms in various realistic settings. The results show that our model demonstrates strong performance, offering great flexibility and robustness to misspecified maximum length of effect. Compared to the complete-person-time analysis, our multiple imputation algorithm exhibits significantly lower variance, with only a slight increase in bias. Finally, as an illustrative example, we apply our proposed models to analyze the effect of folate consumption on colorectal cancer incidence in the Nurses' Health Study from 1976 to 2016.
cn_title: Cox比例风险模型中暴露易感时间窗的样条建模方法
insight: 提出限制性立方样条结合多重插补处理滞后暴露与缺失数据，为肠癌病因学中饮食等暴露的易感窗口分析提供更稳健方法学工具。
grade_rationale: 方法学创新研究，含模拟验证并以护士健康研究叶酸与肠癌为例，但非临床干预试验，不直接改变临床实践。

title: Extranodal Extension in Colorectal Cancer: Association With Nodal Burden and Disease Recurrence.
authors: Hacihasanoglu E, Isal Arslan A, Kivanc AE
abstract: BackgroundExtranodal extension, defined as tumor invasion beyond the lymph node capsule into perinodal adipose tissue, has been associated with adverse outcomes in several malignancies but is not included in the AJCC-TNM staging system for colorectal cancer. This study evaluated the clinicopathological and prognostic significance of extranodal extension and its extent in lymph node-positive colorectal carcinoma.MethodsSixty-nine patients who underwent curative-intent resection for lymph node-positive colorectal carcinoma were retrospectively analyzed. Patients were classified according to the presence of extranodal extension, and extranodal extension-positive tumors were further categorized as limited (<1 mm) or extensive (≥1 mm).
