cn_title: 结直肠癌淋巴结外侵犯与淋巴结负荷及疾病复发的关联研究
insight: 淋巴结外侵犯与更高淋巴结转移负荷、N分期及远处转移相关，提示其或应纳入肠癌分期与复发风险分层，对肝转移高危人群筛选有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性小样本（69例），虽提示淋巴结外侵犯的预后价值，但证据级别不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Conferone: Sources, Anticancer Mechanisms, and Potential in Overcoming Chemoresistance - A Comprehensive Review.
authors: Dashtaki M, Shahini S, Moghadam FM, Mohamadi-Zarch SM, Bagheri SM
abstract: Cancer remains a leading cause of mortality worldwide, and limitations of conventional therapies such as toxicity and Multidrug Resistance (MDR) highlight the need for safer and more effective agents. Natural compounds derived from medicinal plants have gained attention as potential anticancer therapeutics. Conferone, a sesquiterpene coumarin isolated mainly from Ferula species, has shown promising biological activities. This review comprehensively summarizes available primarily in vitro studies, with very limited in vivo evidence investigating the anticancer properties of conferone. Data were collected from published experimental studies focusing on its chemical characteristics, pharmacological effects, molecular mechanisms, and efficacy across different cancer cell lines. Conferone exhibits significant anticancer activity against a wide range of malignancies, including leukemia/lymphoma, breast, colorectal, bladder, ovarian, and embryonal cancers. Its mechanisms involve induction of mitochondrial-dependent apoptosis, cell cycle arrest, increased oxidative stress, inhibition of angiogenesis, and modulation of oncogenic signaling pathways such as NF-κB, c-MYC, and CDK6. Notably, conferone exhibits MDR-modulating activity by inhibiting ATP-binding cassette transporters (e.g., P-gp and MRP2), thereby enhancing intracellular accumulation and efficacy of chemotherapeutic agents like doxorubicin, vincristine, and cisplatin. Incorporation into nanocarrier-based delivery systems further improves its bioavailability and anticancer potency. Conferone is a multifunctional natural compound with strong anticancer and chemosensitizing properties. Although current findings are encouraging, further in vivo and clinical investigations are required to clarify its pharmacokinetics, safety profile, and therapeutic potential in cancer treatment.
cn_title: Conferone的抗癌机制及其逆转化疗耐药的研究进展综述
insight: 该综述系统梳理了天然倍半萜香豆素Conferone通过诱导凋亡、抑制NF-κB等通路及抑制ABC转运蛋白逆转MDR的抗癌作用，为肠癌化疗耐药逆转提供了潜在天然先导化合物，但尚需体内及临床验证。
grade_rationale: 该文为基于体外研究的叙述性综述，缺乏体内和临床数据，证据等级低，暂不具备改变临床实践的潜力。

title: FZD10 and Diseases: From Molecular Mechanisms to the Potential of Targeted Therapy.
authors: Liu Q, Zheng Y, Yuan C
abstract: Frizzled class receptor 10 (FZD10) is a member of the Frizzled family of seven-transmembrane receptors. It mediates Wnt signaling through both canonical (β-catenin) and non-canonical (planar cell polarity and Ca²⁺) pathways, thereby regulating cell proliferation, differentiation, migration, apoptosis, and stem cell self-renewal. Dysregulation of FZD10-resulting from altered expression, aberrant promoter methylation, or functional impairment-has been linked to multiple human diseases, including cancers, metabolic and inflammatory disorders, and neurodegenerative conditions. In malignant tumors, FZD10 shows tissue-specific oncogenic activity. It is overexpressed in synovial sarcoma, colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, cervical cancer, ovarian cancer, nasopharyngeal carcinoma, non-small cell lung cancer, and renal cell carcinoma, but downregulated in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. This restricted expression pattern makes FZD10 a potential biomarker for diagnosis and prognosis, as well as a candidate for targeted therapy. This review summarizes current knowledge on FZD10, covering its gene and protein structure, signaling mechanisms, and roles in various diseases. We also discuss its diagnostic and prognostic value in different cancers, and review recent progress in FZD10-targeted strategies, including antibodies, radioimmunotherapy, small-molecule inhibitors, drug repurposing, exosome-based delivery, and gene editing. Current limitations, such as the context-dependent functions of FZD10 and the safety issues associated with targeted agents, are also discussed. Future studies are needed to clarify the mechanistic basis of FZD10 action and to develop biomarkers for patient stratification.
cn_title: FZD10在疾病中的作用：从分子机制到靶向治疗潜力
insight: 系统梳理FZD10在结直肠癌等肿瘤中的Wnt信号调控与靶向治疗进展，为肠癌肝转移的分子分型及新型靶点开发提供参考。
grade_rationale: 综述性文章，无原始临床数据，但全面整合FZD10机制与靶向策略，对后续研究有启发意义。

title: Magnetic and Non-Magnetic Halloysite Nanotubes Functionalized with Folic Acid for the Targeted Delivery of [Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O: Cytotoxicity and Apoptosis Induction in Colon Cancer Cells.
authors: Wang R, Heidari Majd M
abstract: Cisplatin and its analogs are commonly used in cancer therapy, but the lack of differentiation between healthy and cancer cells often leads to severe side effects. To address this problem, magnetic and non-magnetic Halloysite Nanotubes (HNTs) modified with folic acid (Fe-HNTs-FA and HNTs-FA) were developed, and the [Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O complex was encapsulated inside them. Cell viability was measured using the MTT assay. Real-time PCR was used to evaluate apoptosisrelated genes and the drug resistance marker. Oxidative stress in erythrocytes was assessed to confirm biocompatibility. The Encapsulation Efficiency (EE%) of [Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O in the pores of Fe-HNTs-FA was found to be 29%. Fe-HNTs-FA-[Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O reduced cell viability to below 50%. HNTs-FA-[Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O showed cytotoxic effects at higher concentrations. The [Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O complex and cisplatin did not effectively inhibit the growth of HCT116 colon cancer cells. Real-time PCR analysis showed that the presence of Fe3O4 Nanoparticles (NPs) on Fe-HNTs-FA-[Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O increased the Bak1/Bclx ratio by 14.4-fold compared to the control group. Other compounds only increased the expression of caspase-3. The expression level of AKT1 was 1.39 for the free complex, and 0.076 and 0.078 for Fe-HNTs-FA-[Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O and HNTs-FA- [Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O, respectively. Furthermore, the modified HNTs did not induce oxidative stress in erythrocytes. This targeted delivery induced apoptosis via extrinsic and intrinsic pathways, increased caspase-3 activation, and abolished drug resistance by downregulating AKT1 expression. The Fe-HNTs-FA- [Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O showed the potential to be a safer and more effective alternative to cisplatin without causing oxidative damage to erythrocytes. The positive properties of Fe-HNTs-FA-[Pd(dipic)Cl].H2O make it a promising candidate for targeted therapy of colon cancer.
cn_title: 叶酸修饰磁性埃洛石纳米管靶向递送钯配合物诱导结肠癌细胞凋亡
insight: 该研究利用叶酸修饰的磁性埃洛石纳米管靶向递送钯配合物，通过下调AKT1克服耐药并诱导凋亡，为结肠癌靶向纳米治疗提供新策略。
grade_rationale: 仅为体外细胞实验，无动物模型或临床验证，但机制探索较深入，具有一定转化潜力。

title: Translational Horizons in Targeted Oncology: Mechanistic Insights, Therapeutic Innovations, and Clinical Impact.
authors: Balachandran H, Byran G, Murugesan S, Karri VVKSNR, Purohit D, Rajagopal K
abstract: Because of the elevated prevalence and death rates of cancers such as breast, lung, colorectal, bladder, gastrointestinal, and liver malignancies, cancer remains an important global health issue. More productive, targeted, and personalized therapeutic treatments are crucial, as evidenced by the growing load on the healthcare system. A comprehensive literature search was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar to identify studies on molecular mechanisms and targeted therapies in oncology. Peer-reviewed articles published in English between 2015 and 2026 were screened, focusing on genomic, transcriptomic, and signalling pathway alterations across multiple cancer types. The reviewed literature highlights the identification of specific protein targets that have facilitated the development of precision therapies tailored to the molecular characteristics of individual tumors. Evidence from preclinical and clinical studies indicates that these targeted approaches are associated with improved therapeutic efficacy, enhanced treatment consistency, and reduced adverse effects compared with conventional treatment modalities. Since they allow for tailored regimens, targeted cancer treatments are a significant advancement in chemotherapy. However, issues such as drug resistance, tumour diversity, and difficulties in adopting patented breakthroughs into medical care continue to be primary barriers to their widespread utilization. The identification of new molecular targets and the growth of personalized therapies for cancer depend on current studies. It is believed that new advances in molecular science will contribute to the development of innovative and successful methods for therapy, and eventually decrease the prevalence of malignancies worldwide.
cn_title: 靶向肿瘤学的转化前沿：机制洞察、治疗创新与临床影响
insight: 系统梳理靶向治疗分子机制与临床转化现状，提示肠癌及肝转移精准治疗需突破耐药与瘤内异质性瓶颈。
grade_rationale: 叙述性综述，未提供新原始数据或定量合并，仅归纳现有证据，难以直接改变实践。

title: cGAS‑STING pathway in digestive tract cancer: From molecular mechanisms to therapeutic applications (Review).
authors: Chen T, Zhang J, Sun J, Zhang H, Huang D, Ye H
abstract: As a classic cytosolic DNA sensor, the cyclic GMP‑AMP synthase (cGAS)‑stimulator of interferon genes (STING) pathway contributes to the secretion of multiple inflammatory molecules and functions as a suppressor or promoter in tumor development. Currently, the effect of this pathway on digestive tract cancer types remains unclear, which may be due to its paradoxical roles in different cell types. Tumor cells in digestive cancer often employ multiple mechanisms to inhibit this pathway activation, which then restricts the infiltration of antitumor immune cells and facilitates the formation of an immunosuppressive microenvironment. However, cGAS‑STING pathway activation also influences the function of multiple immune cells. For example, while it mainly potentiates the function of dendritic cells and natural killer cells in the tumor microenvironment, it can also promote macrophage polarization into the immunosuppressive M2 subset. To improve the understanding of the cGAS‑STING pathway in digestive cancer types, the present article systematically reviews the regulatory mechanism and effects of this pathway across different malignancies of the digestive system, including oral cavity, esophageal, gastric, hepatobiliary, pancreatic and colorectal cancer. Furthermore, the present review examines potential stimulatory strategies and future directions to utilize this pathway against tumors, such as inducing DNA damage, removing cell‑intrinsic inhibitory signals and direct activation by agonists. Overall, the present review aims to provide new perspectives and ideas for leveraging the cGAS‑STING pathway to exert antitumor effects by highlighting the changes and roles of this pathway in digestive tract cancer types.
cn_title: cGAS-STING通路在消化道肿瘤中的分子机制与治疗应用
insight: 系统梳理cGAS-STING通路在消化道肿瘤中的双向免疫调控作用，为结直肠癌免疫微环境重塑及肝转移免疫治疗提供新靶点思路。

title: Prolonged Hospital Stay in Elderly Blunt Colorectal Trauma: A National Trauma Data Bank Analysis.
authors: Rayzah M
journal: Journal of Emergencies, Trauma, and Shock
abstract: Understanding predictors of prolonged hospitalization in elderly colorectal trauma patients is crucial for resource allocation and prognostic counseling, yet the relative contributions of injury severity, surgical complexity, and patient frailty remain unclear. This study aims to identify factors associated with length of hospital stay in elderly patients with blunt colorectal trauma. This is a retrospective cohort study using the National Trauma Data Bank. Patients aged ≥65 years with blunt colorectal trauma who survived were included. The primary outcome was hospital length of stay (LOS), analyzed as continuous and binary variables (prolonged vs. normal, defined as ≥75 Among 287 elderly survivors (median age 72.0 years; 60.3% male), the median LOS was 12.0 days. Frailty distribution: 34.8% nonfrail, 40.1% prefrail, 25.1% frail. Motor vehicle accidents predominated (58.9%); 67.9% underwent surgery. ISS was the strongest predictor of continuous LOS (β =0.46; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.29-0.63; In elderly blunt colorectal trauma survivors, injury severity and surgical complexity were primary determinants of hospital LOS, while frailty status did not independently predict prolonged hospitalization.
cn_title: 老年钝性结直肠创伤延长住院的全国创伤数据库分析
insight: 在老年钝性结直肠创伤中，损伤严重度与手术复杂度而非衰弱状态决定住院时长，提示肠癌/肝转移围手术期应优先优化创伤与手术因素。

title: Delayed Cervical and Multifocal Spinal Metastases From Rectal Adenocarcinoma: A Case Report of Severe Canal Stenosis, Neurological Decline, and Septic Shock.
authors: Porter-Edwards S, Edwards L
abstract: A 76-year-old male with a past medical history significant for rectal adenocarcinoma diagnosed in 2014 presented to the emergency department with worsening left arm pain, generalized weakness, and two syncopal episodes. The patient previously underwent sigmoid colectomy followed by low anterior resection and permanent colostomy. Imaging revealed diffuse spinal metastases with extensive epidural tumor causing multilevel severe canal stenosis and spinal cord compression. Additional findings included hepatic metastases, bilateral pleural effusions, supraclavicular nodal disease, and suspected leptomeningeal involvement. This case highlights the rare but devastating pattern of colorectal cancer metastasis to the spine and underscores the importance of early recognition of metastatic epidural disease, multidisciplinary management coordination, palliative care integration.
cn_title: 直肠腺癌迟发颈椎及多灶性脊柱转移：一例严重椎管狭窄、神经功能恶化及感染性休克的病例报告
insight: 报道直肠癌罕见迟发多灶性脊柱转移伴严重椎管狭窄及感染性休克，提示肠癌随访需警惕非肝转移部位，并强调多学科与姑息治疗整合。
grade_rationale: 单例病例报告，证据等级低，但可提示临床警惕罕见转移模式，不足以改变实践。

title: Trends, Disparities, and Outcomes in Time to Treatment Initiation in Patients With Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Qureshi I, Patel C, Kazi MAI, Edwards J, Khan H, Hajifathalian K, et al.
journal: JGH Open : an Open Access Journal of Gastroenterology and Hepatology
abstract: The incidence of early-onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) is on the rise globally. It is well documented in the literature that increased time to treatment initiation (TTI) results in higher mortality rates in malignancies. We conducted this study to explore trends, disparities, and outcomes in TTI in patients with EOCRC. We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the National Cancer Database. We identified 56 333 patients less than 45 years of age who were diagnosed with colorectal cancer between 2004 and 2021 who had data on TTI. We calculated the average annual percentage change (AAPC) in TTI and assessed predictors of treatment delay and the degree to which they are associated with delays using logistic and linear regression, respectively. A Cox proportional hazards model was fit for each stage to assess 5-year, 10-year, and overall mortality. The overall AAPC was 1.50% (95% CI: 1.40-1.60, Treatment delays are increasingly common and strongly associated with insurance status, socioeconomic disadvantage, and race, with clinically meaningful delays of several days, while patients with advanced disease are prioritized for faster treatment. These provide public health stakeholders with important insights into inequities in the treatment of EOCRC.
cn_title: 早发性结直肠癌治疗启动时间的趋势、差异与结局
insight: 基于国家癌症数据库的大样本分析显示，早发性结直肠癌治疗启动时间逐年延长，且与保险状态、社会经济劣势和种族显著相关，提示需关注治疗公平性。
grade_rationale: 基于国家癌症数据库的大样本回顾性队列研究，揭示了治疗延迟的社会决定因素，但未评估干预措施，实践改变潜力有限。

title: Preoperative CT deep learning of tumor and visceral adipose tissue combined with postoperative pathology predicts colorectal cancer recurrence: a multicenter study.
authors: Wei P, Zhong L, Tan Y, Zhao J, Zhou Y
abstract: To develop and externally validate a preoperative CT imaging model integrating primary tumour and visceral adipose tissue (VAT) features for predicting recurrence in colorectal cancer (CRC). This retrospective multicentre study included 1,369 patients with CRC undergoing upfront curative-intent resection, comprising a training cohort (n = 705) and two external test cohorts (n = 425 and 239). A 3D convolutional neural network extracted tumour-centred volumetric features, while an attention-based multiple instance learning branch aggregated whole-abdominal VAT slices into patient-level representations. The two CT-derived scores constituted the preoperative imaging model. A clinicopathological component was combined with the imaging scores to construct the postoperative multimodal model; robustness to variable selection was evaluated using an all-candidate ridge-penalised Cox sensitivity model. Both tumour and VAT DL scores remained independently associated with recurrence-free survival after multivariable adjustment. In external test cohorts 1 and 2, the preoperative Tumor + VAT imaging model achieved C-indices of 0.734 and 0.772, whereas the postoperative multimodal model achieved C-indices of 0.772 and 0.810 and 2-year time-dependent AUCs of 0.757 and 0.836, respectively. Training-derived tertile cut-offs from the postoperative model consistently stratified patients into low-, intermediate- and high-risk groups across all cohorts (all log-rank P < 0.001). In the two external cohorts, the clinicopathological-only model achieved C-indices of 0.709 and 0.715, compared with 0.772 and 0.810 for the postoperative multimodal model. The preoperative CT model non-invasively stratified recurrence risk using tumour and whole-abdominal VAT phenotypes, while postoperative clinicopathological features further improved prognostic performance.
cn_title: 术前CT深度学习联合术后病理预测结直肠癌复发：多中心研究
insight: 整合原发肿瘤与内脏脂肪CT深度学习特征可无创分层复发风险，术后病理进一步增效，为肠癌复发精准预测提供多中心验证工具。
grade_rationale: 多中心外部验证设计扎实，但为回顾性研究，尚需前瞻验证方可改变实践。

title: A Trojan horse nanoplatform overcoming delivery barriers for targeted gene immunotherapy of colorectal cancer.
authors: Wang Y, Yu Y, Deng Q, Liu D, Liang X, Wang H, et al.
abstract: Programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) antibody has been shown to hold tremendous promise in curing metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC). However, the delivery efficacy of the targeted biologics limits this immunotherapy in a subset of CRC. Here we report a novel biomimetic 'Trojan horse' nano-delivery system for targeted gene-immunotherapy of colorectal cancer. The system comprises a core of gold nanoparticles and cationic liposomes encapsulating CRISPR/Cas9-sgSOX9, camouflaged with homologous CRC cell membranes for immune evasion and tumor tropism, and functionalized with PD-L1 antibodies to enhance tumor recognition and relieve immune suppression.
cn_title: 仿生“特洛伊木马”纳米平台靶向基因免疫治疗结直肠癌
insight: 该研究构建膜伪装纳米递送系统，突破生物大分子递送屏障，实现CRISPR/Cas9与PD-L1抗体协同治疗，为肠癌免疫治疗提供新策略。

title: Engineered bacteria and engineered probiotics for intestinal disease therapy: a bibliometric and knowledge mapping analysis.
authors: Sun W, Liu H, Shao A, Li R, Ma W, Zheng M, et al.
abstract: Engineered bacteria and engineered probiotics are emerging living therapeutic platforms for intestinal diseases, supported by advances in synthetic biology, genetic engineering, and microbiome technologies. This study aimed to characterize the research landscape, knowledge structure, research hotspots, and emerging trends of engineered bacteria and engineered probiotics for intestinal disease therapy using bibliometric and knowledge mapping approaches. Publications were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus databases. After publication type restriction, thematic relevance screening, database merging, and duplicate removal, 499 publications published between 2015 and 2026 were included. The search was completed on July 3, 2026; therefore, records from 2026 represent a partial-year dataset. R, Python, VOSviewer, and CiteSpace were used to analyze annual publication trends, country/region, institution, author and journal distributions, keyword co-occurrence and bursts, co-cited references, and research frontiers. Publication output increased markedly over the study period, reaching 109 publications in 2025; 64 records were retrieved for 2026 by the cutoff date. China had the highest publication output, whereas the United States had the highest total link strength, and Asia contributed 361 publications. Keyword analysis identified inflammatory bowel disease, gut microbiota, probiotics, engineered bacteria, engineered probiotics, synthetic biology, intestinal barrier, drug delivery, colorectal cancer, and immunotherapy as major research hotspots. Co-cited reference and timeline analyses indicated a shift in research attention from conventional probiotic-mediated anti-inflammatory effects, mucosal immune regulation, and intestinal barrier protection toward bacterial chassis selection, enhanced colonization, self-regulated genetic circuits, probiotic-based biomaterials, sustained-release delivery systems, and engineered bacteria-mediated antitumor therapy. The bibliometric evidence indicates that recent research attention is increasingly focused on programmable living therapeutic strategies. Environmental sensing, local therapeutic delivery, sustained activity, and multifunctional design features are capabilities reported in the underlying literature and represented among the emerging themes identified in this analysis, rather than therapeutic performance directly established by the bibliometric data. Future research should further address biosafety, genetic stability, spatiotemporal controllability, intestinal colonization, delivery efficiency, and clinical translation.
cn_title: 工程菌与工程益生菌治疗肠道疾病：文献计量与知识图谱分析
insight: 该文献计量分析揭示工程菌/工程益生菌研究正从抗炎与屏障保护转向可编程活体治疗及抗肿瘤方向，提示肠癌及肝转移的细菌递送与免疫治疗是新兴前沿。

title: Multimodal Immune Profile Score (IPS) as a Pan-Cancer Biomarker for Stratifying Outcomes of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Benefit in Microsatellite Stable Colorectal Cancer and Rare Solid Tumors
authors: Ting-Lin, M. A.; Antonarakis, E. S.; Wang, X.; Erbe, R.; Zander, A. D.; Liu, Y.; Jin, A.; Vidal, G. A.; Haake, S. M.; Stein, M. M.; DeSantis, D. F.; Beauchamp, K. A.; Campbell, M. E.; Cohen, E. E. W.; Hyun, S. W.; Kelly, R. J.; Kalyan, A.; Bashir, B.; Rimel, B. J.; Herzog, T. J.; Chiou, V. L.; Sangli, C.; Nimeiri, H.; Carlson, J.; Simeone, D. M.; Strickler, J. H.
abstract: Background Immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapies have revolutionized oncology, but identifying patients who benefit remains a challenge, particularly in populations where ICIs are not the standard of care, including microsatellite stable colorectal cancer (MSS CRC) and rare solid cancers. We evaluated real-world performance of the Immune Profile Score (IPS), a validated DNA- and RNA-based molecular signature, in these cohorts. Methods In an exploratory analysis, we analyzed two real-world cohorts: 1) MSS CRC; and 2) MSS, tumor mutational burden-low rare solid cancers treated with off-label ICI. IPS-High and IPS-Low were calculated using a previously validated threshold. Cox proportional hazards models were fit to demonstrate prognostic utility for real-world overall survival (rwOS). In MSS CRC, time-to-next-treatment (TTNT) on prior non-ICI therapy was compared to rwOS on subsequent ICI therapy. Results In MSS CRC (n=46), IPS-High patients (13%) demonstrated clinically meaningful improvement in rwOS versus IPS-Low (Median OS: not reached vs 7.3 months; HR = 0.22, 90% CI 0.04-1.16). While IPS was not associated with TTNT on the preceding non-ICI line (HR = 1.07, 90% CI 0.60-1.91), it was associated with OS in patients receiving later line ICI (HR 0.21, 90% CI 0.04-1.22). In the rare cancers cohort (n=90; 26 unique malignancies), IPS-High (17.8%) was associated with longer OS to ICI therapy (HR = 0.26, 90% CI 0.11-0.61), even when restricted to histologies represented in both IPS groups (HR = 0.18, 90%, CI 0.05-0.62). Conclusions Preliminary evidence suggests that IPS may serve as a generalizable, pan-cancer biomarker capable of stratifying outcomes for ICI treatment in populations traditionally excluded from immunotherapy benefit.
cn_title: 多模态免疫特征评分作为泛癌生物标志物预测MSS结直肠癌及罕见实体瘤免疫治疗获益

grade_rationale: 预印本未经同行评审，不参与分级

title: Panel-level multilocus methylation quantification in native cell-free DNA by PCR-compatible sequential enzymatic processing
authors: Vaquer, C. C.; Wetten, P. A.; Garcia Samartino, C.; Rodriguez, J. D.; Manzino, N. R.; Perez Ravier, R.; Angeloni, A. R.; Militello, R. D.; Ledesma, A.; Sesma, J.; Agnella, Y.; Gudino, E.; Fracchia Diaz, C. E.; Ongay, R.; Sanguinetti, G.; Correa, A.; Carlen, M.; Minatti, W. R.; Vaschalde, G. A.; Valdemoros, P.; Sarrio, L.; Mayorga, L.; Bocanegra, V.; Campoy, E. M.
abstract: DNA methylation provides informative signals for liquid biopsy, but low template abundance, distributed signals across loci and conversion-dependent processing can complicate implementation in low-input samples. Here we present Delta-HLD, a PCR-compatible platform that quantifies methylation directly in native DNA through sequential hybridization, ligation and methylation-sensitive digestion. By encoding locus specificity at the hemi-probe hybridization and ligation stage, Delta-HLD allows methylation-dependent products from multiple loci to converge on a shared amplification and detection system and contribute to a single panel-level readout. We established the assay chemistry, optimized panel composition through model-guided experiments and implemented the platform in qPCR and ddPCR, including a triplex qPCR format with per-sample digestion and amplification controls. Proof-of-concept plasma analyses showed discriminatory signals in colorectal cancer and supported transfer of the same assay logic to hepatocellular carcinoma. The assay was further adapted for cfDNA analysis following platelet-retaining processing, preserving cfDNA-associated signal while reducing genomic DNA recognition. Delta-HLD provides a compact native-DNA platform for multilocus methylation analysis in low-input settings without base conversion.
