title: Potential Use of AI Chatbots by Patients With Bowel Tumors: Opportunities and Implications for Low- and Middle-Income Countries.
authors: AlSamhori JF, AlSamhori ARF, Amourah RM, Aldweik H, AlSamhori AF, Holy LM, et al.
abstract: Bowel tumors and colorectal cancer (CRC), in particular, have become a major concern to the global health community and have led to high morbidity and mortality levels, especially in lower- and middle-income countries (LMICs). This narrative review examines the potential roles of patient-facing AI chatbots and large language model (LLM)-based conversational tools across bowel tumor care, with particular attention to their potential applicability, limitations, and implementation requirements in LMICs. The available evidence spans small prospective and feasibility studies of patient-facing symptom monitoring or education as well as studies evaluating LLM performance in simulated clinical scenarios and clinician-facing decision support. Among the 16 studies, three were conducted in middle-income countries, and none in low-income countries; most evidence therefore arose from high-income settings. Patient-facing interventions generally support feasibility, acceptability, symptom reporting, and communication, whereas accuracy and concordance for screening, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations vary by task and are less reliable in complex cases. These findings support chatbots primarily as adjuncts to structured clinical care rather than autonomous clinical decision-making tools. AI chatbots may complement bowel tumor care through education, symptom monitoring, communication, and selected decision-support functions, but current evidence does not establish broad clinical effectiveness or safety, particularly in LMICs. Prospective validation, human oversight, privacy safeguards, local-language and cultural adaptation, digital-access considerations, and context-specific implementation studies are needed before wider clinical adoption.
cn_title: AI聊天机器人在肠道肿瘤患者中的应用潜力：中低收入国家的机遇与挑战
insight: 该综述指出AI聊天机器人可作为肠道肿瘤结构化诊疗的辅助工具，但证据多来自高收入国家，中低收入国家需前瞻性验证和本地化适配。
grade_rationale: 叙述性综述，纳入16项小型研究，无低质量国家数据，证据等级有限，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Conditional Recurrence-Free Survival After Hepatectomy for Colorectal Liver Metastases: Time-Dependent Prognostic Relevance of Liver Metastasis Number.
authors: Mori T, Sakai N, Takayashiki T, Takano S, Hosokawa I, Konishi T, et al.
abstract: Recurrence risk after hepatectomy for colorectal liver metastases (CRLMs) changes during follow-up, but whether baseline tumor burden remains prognostically relevant with increasing recurrence-free time is unclear. We evaluated the time-dependent prognostic relevance of liver metastasis number. We retrospectively analyzed 226 patients who underwent initial curative-intent hepatectomy for CRLMs between 2007 and 2022. Three-year conditional recurrence-free survival (RFS) was estimated at surgery and after 6, 12, and 24 months without recurrence. Landmark Cox models evaluated liver metastasis number (< 4 vs. ≥ 4), adjusting for RAS status, with supplementary expanded models. Three-year conditional RFS improved from 27.1% at surgery to 33.3%, 49.3%, and 76.6% after 6, 12, and 24 months without recurrence, respectively. However, subsequent RFS remained worse in patients with ≥ 4 liver metastases at the 6-month (adjusted hazard ratio [HR]: 1.83, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.14-2.94; p = 0.012) and 12-month (HR: 2.14, 95% CI: 1.08-4.27; p = 0.030) landmarks. In supplementary expanded models, the associations remained directionally similar but were attenuated. Recurrence risk improved with increasing recurrence-free time, but survivors remained heterogeneous according to baseline tumor burden. Liver metastasis number retained prognostic relevance at early postoperative landmarks.
cn_title: 结直肠癌肝转移切除术后条件无复发生存：肝转移数目的时间依赖性预后意义
insight: 揭示肝转移数目在术后早期（6-12个月）仍具预后价值，提示应按时间分层随访与辅助治疗决策，为肝转移术后动态风险分层提供依据。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列（n=226），采用landmark Cox模型方法学较严谨，但样本量有限且无外部验证，尚不足以直接改变实践。

title: Asymptomatic Portomesenteric Venous Thrombosis After Colorectal Cancer Surgery: Incidence, Natural History, and Implications for Management.
authors: Kim CH, Kim D, Park JH, Pyo DH, Park JK, Kim H
abstract: Portomesenteric venous thrombosis (PMVT) after colorectal cancer (CRC) surgery is most often reported in symptomatic patients, leaving its frequency and natural history across the asymptomatic spectrum poorly defined. When encountered incidentally, it frequently prompts anticoagulation, hypercoagulability evaluation, or delays in oncologic treatment, despite limited evidence that intervention alters its course. Using a cohort with routine postoperative imaging, we characterized the incidence, anatomic distribution, risk factors, and clinical course of asymptomatic PMVT. We retrospectively studied 799 consecutive patients who underwent CRC surgery between April 2019 and June 2025. All patients underwent standardized abdominal computed tomography (CT) on postoperative day (POD) 6 as part of our institutional clinical pathway for immediate postoperative follow-up. PMVT was defined radiologically, and thrombus location was classified as peripheral intrahepatic branches or main portal/superior mesenteric vein. Management followed a risk-stratified pathway of therapeutic anticoagulation or active surveillance, with radiologic resolution assessed on follow-up CT. Given the limited number of events, multivariable analysis was considered exploratory. Asymptomatic PMVT was identified in 33 patients (4.1%), none symptomatic at detection. Thrombi were predominantly confined to the distal intrahepatic branches. In exploratory multivariable analysis, age ≤ 60 years (OR 2.45, 95% CI 1.19-5.03, p = 0.015) and POD 5 WBC > 10 × 10 When postoperative imaging is routinely performed, asymptomatic PMVT after CRC surgery is detected in approximately 4% of patients. It is typically confined to peripheral intrahepatic branches, and follows a uniformly benign self-limiting course, even in patients managed without anticoagulation. These findings argue against reflexive anticoagulation and extensive workup for short-segment, non-occlusive PMVT confined to peripheral intrahepatic branches, and support an individualized, predominantly conservative approach. We do not advocate routine postoperative CT; rather, surgeons who encounter incidental PMVT can be reassured regarding its favorable prognosis.
cn_title: 结直肠癌术后无症状门肠系膜静脉血栓：发生率、自然史与管理启示
insight: 约4%的肠癌术后患者经标准化CT检出无症状门肠系膜静脉血栓，多局限于肝内分支且呈良性自限性，提示应避免反射性抗凝，支持个体化保守管理。
grade_rationale: 基于799例连续病例的回顾性队列，虽非RCT但样本量较大且挑战现有抗凝常规，具有改变临床实践的潜力。

title: Technical Complications and Salvage of Hepatic Artery Infusion Pumps: An Institutional Experience of 2935 Consecutive Cases.
authors: Zaki OA, Schleimer LE, Kalvin HL, Choubey A, Barekzai AB, Jung J, et al.
abstract: Describe the technical complications of hepatic artery infusion pump (HAIP) placement and characterize salvage rates. HAIP chemotherapy is an effective tool used in the treatment of hepatic malignancies and has become increasingly adopted at select centers. Much of the safety data is reported from small, newer programs or older, large series. Retrospective analysis of all patients who underwent HAIP placement at our institution between 2000 and 2022 was conducted. Pump salvage was defined as the ability to receive HAIP chemotherapy after a pump-associated complication. Pump failure was defined as an HAIP-related complication permanently stopping ongoing HAIP chemotherapy. Over the study period, 2935 patients had an HAIP placed for colorectal liver metastases (n=2582, 88%), intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (n=294, 10%) or another malignancy (n=59, 2%). Of all patients, 759 (26%) had an HAIP-related complication, with 404/759 (53%) having their pump salvaged. The most common complications were abnormal perfusion (n=360 [12%], 285/360 [79%] salvaged), arterial pseudoaneurysm and/or hemorrhage (n=117 [4%], 7/117 [6%] salvaged), and pump-pocket infection (n=115 [4%], 60/115 [52%] salvaged). The complications with the highest salvage rates were pump-pocket seroma (n=15/16, 94%), pump-flipping (n=41/44, 93%), and pump-pocket hematoma (n=45/49, 92%). Unsalvaged complications were catheter dislodgement from vessel (n=0/47, 0%), catheter erosion into bowel (n=0/25, 0%), and arterial thrombosis (n=0/19, 0%). The cumulative incidence of pump failure at 1 year in patients receiving adjuvant therapy was 6.6%, and 4.5% among those receiving palliative therapy. HAIP-related complications occur in about one quarter of patients, predominantly perfusion and pump-pocket complications. These are salvageable in the majority of cases with multidisciplinary interventions.
cn_title: 肝动脉灌注泵技术并发症与挽救：2935例连续病例的单中心经验
insight: 大样本证实HAIP相关并发症约1/4但多数可挽救，为肝转移综合治疗中HAIP的安全管理提供了关键循证依据。
grade_rationale: 单中心大样本回顾性研究，虽样本量大但非随机对照，对临床实践有参考价值但不足以直接改变指南。

title: CFI-400945 enhances radiosensitivity in colorectal cancer models by promoting mitotic dysregulation and DNA damage-associated apoptosis.
authors: Hwang JW, Gong EY, Cho JM, Kim S, Byun SJ, Hong H, et al.
abstract: Radioresistance remains a major barrier to improving radiotherapy (RT) efficacy in colorectal cancer (CRC). Since mitotic fidelity and centrosome homeostasis influence cell fate under genotoxic stress, we investigated whether CFI-400945 enhances the radiation response in CRC models and whether this effect is associated with polo-like kinase 4 (PLK4)-related mitotic dysregulation. HCT116 and HT29 CRC cells were treated with CFI-400945 and/or irradiation. Radiation response was evaluated using MTT viability and clonogenic survival assays, alongside analyses of cell-cycle distribution, centrosome-associated abnormalities, nuclear phenotypes, DNA damage-associated signaling, and apoptotic markers. PLK4 involvement was evaluated using siRNA-mediated PLK4 depletion, and Aurora kinase B (AURKB) phosphorylation was assessed to examine potential Aurora B-related effects. Combination treatment was also tested in non-malignant CCD 841 CoN colon-derived control cells and patient-derived CRC organoids. Combined CFI-400945 and RT treatment reduced short-term viability and long-term clonogenic survival in HCT116 and HT29 cells compared with either monotherapy. In CCD 841 CoN cells, CFI-400945 did not significantly enhance radiation-associated loss of clonogenic survival versus RT alone. Combination treatment increased G2/M accumulation, >4 N and sub-G1 fractions, γ-tubulin-positive foci, multinucleation, and micronucleation, consistent with centrosome-associated mitotic abnormalities and reduced survival. DNA damage-associated signaling was enhanced, with increased DNA-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit (DNA-PKcs) and phosphorylated histone H2AX (γH2AX) levels and increased phosphorylation of ataxia telangiectasia mutated (ATM) and CHK2. Apoptotic marker induction also increased, including robust cleavage of caspase-3 and PARP1. CFI-400945 did not markedly suppress AURKB phosphorylation under the experimental conditions. Importantly, siRNA-mediated PLK4 depletion reduced clonogenic survival after irradiation and increased cleaved PARP1 and cleaved caspase-3, supporting PLK4 involvement in the radiation response. In patient-derived CRC organoids, combination treatment reduced viability and increased DNA damage-associated and apoptotic markers compared with single treatments. CFI-400945 enhanced radiation response in CRC cell lines and patient-derived organoids, accompanied by centrosome-associated mitotic abnormalities, increased DNA damage-associated signaling, and apoptotic marker induction. siRNA-mediated PLK4 depletion partially recapitulated these effects, supporting a role for PLK4-associated mitotic regulation. However, because CFI-400945 may also target non-PLK4 mitotic kinases, these support an association --between radiosensitization and PLK4-related mitotic dysregulation rather than an exclusively PLK4-dependent mechanism.
cn_title: CFI-400945通过促进有丝分裂异常及DNA损伤相关凋亡增强结直肠癌放射敏感性
insight: PLK4抑制剂CFI-400945在细胞系与患者来源类器官中增强放疗反应，为结直肠癌放射增敏提供新策略，但需体内及临床验证。
grade_rationale: 临床前细胞与类器官研究，机制较系统但无体内数据，暂不具备改变实践的证据强度。

title: Extending prophylactic antimicrobial use beyond 48 h postoperatively fails to reduce surgical site infections and other healthcare-associated infections in patients undergoing colorectal resection: a Propensity Score Matching study.
authors: Yang Y, Bao Z, Zhang Z
abstract: It is controversial whether antibiotic should be used prophylactically 48 h after colorectal resection. Hence, the association of prophylactic antimicrobial (PA) use beyond 48 h postoperatively with the incidence of surgical site infections (SSI) and other healthcare-associated infections (HAI) in patients receiving colorectal resection surgery was evaluated. A retrospective analysis was performed on 2691 patients who underwent colorectal resection between March 1, 2023, and December 31, 2025. Patients were categorized into the non-PA beyond 48 h postoperatively group (n = 1934) and the PA beyond 48 h postoperatively group (n = 757) based on whether prophylactic antibiotic use exceeded 48 h postoperatively. Propensity Score Matching (PSM) was used to balance differences in covariates between the two groups, subsequently, the relationship between prophylactic antibiotic use and infection was analyzed. The incidence of surgical site infections (SSI) in patients undergoing colorectal resection was 8.51% (229/2691), while the incidence of other healthcare-associated infections (HAI) was 8.06% (217/2691). After PSM, both non-PA beyond 48 h postoperatively group and PA beyond 48 h postoperatively group were divided into 757 cases each. Multiple regression analysis showed that PA beyond 48 h postoperatively was not associated with SSI(OR = 0.85, 95% CI 0.59 -1.21, P = 0.356) and other HAI (OR = 0.81, 95% CI 0.54-1.23, P = 0.325) after adjustment for the confounding effect of age, sex, diabetes, hypertension, anemia, hypoproteinemia. Subsequent to adjustment for all confounding factors, PA beyond 48 h postoperatively was still not a influence factor for SSI (OR = 0.85, 95% CI 0.59-1.22, P = 0.372) and other HAI (OR = 0.77, 95% CI 0.50-1.18, P = 0.229). The total cost (¥57349.60 vs. ¥55039.10, P = 0.0006) were higher in the PA beyond 48 h postoperatively group than non-PA beyond 48 h postoperatively group, and no statistically significant differences were observed between the two groups in postoperative hospital stay (P > 0.05). Extending prophylactic antimicrobial use beyond 48 h postoperatively following colorectal resection surgery was not associated with lower morbidity rate of SSI and other HAI, nor did it shorten the postoperative hospital stay; however, it resulted in elevated costs. Nonetheless, this study may contribute to the development of strategies for standardizing prophylactic medication management during the perioperative period of colorectal resection. Not applicable.
cn_title: 结直肠切除术后预防性抗菌药物超过48小时不降低手术部位感染：倾向性评分匹配研究
insight: 延长预防性抗生素至48小时后不降低SSI和其他HAI，反而增加费用，支持围手术期规范用药管理，对肠癌手术患者感染防控有直接指导意义。
grade_rationale: 大样本回顾性PSM研究，证据等级中等，虽不支持延长用药但需RCT验证，暂不足以改变指南。

title: Patient-, endoscopist-, and procedure-related factors associated with adenoma detection in first screening colonoscopies at a Lebanese tertiary hospital: a retrospective cohort study.
authors: Ghantous MI, Zayour N, Al Sabagh N, Mchawrab N, Kattan O, Eljammal O, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide, and is largely preventable through colonoscopy, during which adenomatous polyps can be detected and removed. The adenoma detection rate (ADR) and polyp detection rate (PDR) are key quality indicators of colonoscopy quality and are inversely associated with post-colonoscopy CRC. These indicators may be influenced by patient-, physician-, and procedure-related factors. This study aimed to evaluate the ADR and PDR, identify factors influencing these indicators, and compare them among gastroenterologists at a Lebanese medical center. This observational, single-center, retrospective cohort study included 257 patients aged 50-75 years who underwent first-time screening colonoscopy over 3 years. Data on patient characteristics and colonoscopy findings were collected. ADR and PDR were calculated according to established guidelines, with ADR additionally estimated using the adenoma-to-polyp detection rate quotient (APDRQ). Descriptive statistics were applied, and chi-square or Fisher's exact tests were used to assess associations between patient-, physician-, and procedural related factors and adenoma detection. Out of 257 patients, 159 had polyps detected during colonoscopy. The overall ADR was 44.4%, and the PDR was 61.8% over the three-year study period. The ADR was 52.1% in men and 38.0% in women, whereas the PDR was 68.6% in men and 56.3% in women. Although the overall ADR and PDR met or exceeded the recommended benchmarks, disparities were noted in detection rates between males and females. Bowel preparation quality and guarantor type significantly influenced adenoma detection, whereas other factors related to patients and endoscopists had no significant effect. The estimated ADRs derived from the PDRs for five endoscopists were also high, surpassing the 25% benchmark; however, their annual estimated ADRs were relatively below this threshold. This study provides valuable regional data and underscores the need for standardized quality monitoring and further multicentric prospective research to optimize CRC prevention in Lebanon.
cn_title: 黎巴嫩三级医院首次筛查结肠镜腺瘤检出率相关因素回顾性队列研究
insight: 该研究提供黎巴嫩地区结肠镜腺瘤检出率数据，提示肠道准备质量与支付方式影响腺瘤检出，对肠癌筛查质量改进有参考价值，但与肝转移无直接关联。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，样本量257例，仅提供区域性质量数据，不足以改变临床实践。

title: An ensemble machine learning approach for predicting colorectal polyps using novel inflammatory markers.
authors: Zhang L, Wu Y, Jin Q, Wen Y, Wang Y, Qi H, et al.
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the associations of two novel inflammatory-nutritional markers, the C-reactive Protein-Albumin-Lymphocyte (CALLY) index and C-reactive protein-to-lymphocyte ratio (CLR), with colorectal polyps, and to develop machine learning models for improved risk prediction. The study conducted a retrospective analysis of 946 patients who underwent colonoscopy at the Second Qilu Hospital of Shandong University from 2023 to 2024. Clinical, laboratory, and endoscopic data were retrieved. Four machine learning models were developed: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM). Additionally, a Stacking ensemble model was constructed, integrating RF, XGBoost, and SVM with logistic regression as the meta-learner. Model performance was evaluated using metrics including the Area Under the Curve (AUC), accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and Kappa coefficient. Both the CALLY index and CLR were significantly associated with the presence of colorectal polyps. The Stacking ensemble model achieved the highest predictive performance (AUC: 0.96), outperforming all individual base models. The RF, SVM, and XGBoost models also attained robust predictive capability (AUC: 0.75-0.76). By comparison, LightGBM exhibited suboptimal performance (AUC = 0.72). Feature importance analysis revealed CA19-9 as the top predictive factor. Elevated CLR and reduced CALLY index, together with traditional risk factors, synergistically contribute to colorectal polyp formation. The Stacking ensemble model serves as a highly accurate tool for identifying individuals at high risk of colorectal polyps, thereby facilitating targeted screening and timely early intervention. These findings support the incorporation of multi-dimensional inflammatory-nutritional biomarkers and machine learning strategies into clinical practice to optimize Colorectal Cancer (CRC) prevention.
cn_title: 基于新型炎症标志物的集成机器学习模型预测结直肠息肉
insight: 该研究构建的Stacking集成模型（AUC 0.96）能高精度预测结直肠息肉，提示炎症-营养标志物联合机器学习可优化结直肠癌筛查与早期干预策略。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性研究，样本量中等（946例），虽AUC高但缺乏外部验证，实践改变潜力有限。

title: Pfannenstiel versus periumbilical specimen extraction in laparoscopic low anterior resection: a comparative analysis of incisional hernia risk, postoperative recovery, and oncologic outcomes.
authors: Kang SY, Shin DH, Bae HW, Han YD, Cho MS, Hur H, et al.
abstract: Incisional hernia is a common long-term complication following colorectal surgery. In laparoscopic low anterior resection (LAR) for rectal cancer, specimen extraction is most commonly performed via a periumbilical midline incision, although the Pfannenstiel incision has emerged as an alternative approach with the potential to reduce hernia rates. However, its adoption has been limited by technical demands, and comparative evidence in a homogeneous rectal cancer cohort remains scarce. This study compared incisional hernia risk, postoperative recovery, and oncologic outcomes according to extraction site in laparoscopic LAR. This retrospective cohort study included patients who underwent laparoscopic LAR for rectal cancer between 2014 and 2021. Specimen extraction was performed via either a Pfannenstiel incision or a periumbilical midline incision. The primary outcome was incisional hernia at the extraction site, assessed by computed tomography. Secondary outcomes included postoperative recovery, perioperative complications, and long-term oncologic outcomes. Risk factors for incisional hernia were evaluated using Cox proportional hazards regression. Among 242 patients, 115 underwent Pfannenstiel extraction and 127 periumbilical extraction. Incisional hernia occurred in one patient (0.9%) in the Pfannenstiel group and 12 patients (9.4%) in the periumbilical group (p = 0.003). Pfannenstiel extraction was associated with shorter hospital stay, earlier return of bowel function, and lower analgesic requirements. On multivariable analysis, periumbilical extraction was an independent risk factor for incisional hernia. Disease-free and overall survival were comparable between groups. Pfannenstiel specimen extraction was associated with a lower risk of incisional hernia and improved postoperative recovery after laparoscopic LAR without compromising oncologic outcomes, supporting its use as an effective specimen retrieval option in minimally invasive rectal cancer surgery.
cn_title: Pfannenstiel切口与脐周切口在腹腔镜低位前切除术中取标本的比较：切口疝风险、术后恢复及肿瘤学结局分析
insight: Pfannenstiel切口取标本可显著降低腹腔镜直肠癌低位前切除术后切口疝风险并加速康复，且不影响肿瘤学结局，支持其作为微创直肠癌手术的优选取标本方式。
grade_rationale: 回顾性队列但样本量适中、主要终点客观（CT诊断切口疝）、效应显著且具实践改变潜力。

title: SPEED-EMR Score: A Simple Predictive Model for Estimating Colorectal Endoscopic Mucosal Resection Duration.
authors: Souto M, Vieira R, Abreu Marques I, Macedo Silva V, Dias de Castro F, Magalhães J, et al.
abstract: EMR is widely used for large and complex nonpedunculated superficial colorectal lesions, but objective tools to predict procedure duration are lacking. We aimed to develop a simple clinical model to estimate EMR duration: the SPEED-EMR Score. Retrospective cohort study of consecutive conventional EMRs of nonpedunculated colorectal lesions ≥ 15 mm performed at a tertiary referral center between 2020 and 2025. EMR duration was defined from the first lesion image to final post-resection documentation. Predictors of duration were identified using multivariable linear regression and converted into an integer-based score. Model performance and discrimination for predefined time-based complexity categories were evaluated. A total of 1077 EMRs were analyzed. Median lesion size was 20 mm (IQR 15-25), and median EMR duration was 13 min (IQR 7-24). Independent predictors of longer duration were lesion size, flat/depressed morphology, NICE type 2 pattern, difficult anatomical location, and recurrent lesion at a previously treated site (all p ≤ 0.002). These variables composed the SPEED-EMR Score (0-15 points). Predicted duration was calculated as 3.23 + 3.94 × SPEED-EMR score. The final model showed R SPEED-EMR is a novel, bootstrap internally validated tool for objective prediction of colorectal EMR duration. It may support optimized scheduling, workflow efficiency, and resource allocation in therapeutic endoscopy services.
cn_title: SPEED-EMR评分：预测结直肠内镜黏膜切除术时长的简易模型
insight: 该模型可客观预测结直肠EMR手术时长，优化内镜中心调度与资源配置，对肠癌早期病变内镜治疗的工作流程管理有实用价值。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，样本量较大（1077例）且内部验证充分，但缺乏外部验证，实践改变潜力有限。

title: Aloe vera Enhanced Hydroxycamptothecin-Mediated Antitumor Activity in Colorectal Carcinoma Based on the Targeted Regulation of Nucleotide Metabolism.
authors: Wang CY, Li Y, Zhang W, Jiang ZH
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Combination therapies, which integrate traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) with conventional chemotherapeutic agents, offer a promising new strategy for the management of CRC. This study aimed to investigate the potential of Aloe vera (L.) Burm.f. (A. vera) as an adjuvant to hydroxycamptothecin (HCPT) for CRC treatment and to explore the underlying mechanisms, specifically focusing on nucleotide metabolism, as perturbations in intracellular nucleotide pools are closely linked to various human pathologies. The aqueous extract of A. vera adjuvantly ameliorated the progression of colon carcinogenesis was investigated in Apc Major constituents of A. vera, including aloin A, aloin B, aloesin, aloenin, and aloe-emodin, were quantified and found to meet Chinese Pharmacopoeia standards. A. vera synergistically enhanced the anticancer activity of HCPT. This effect was mediated by exacerbated DNA damage, imbalanced purine/pyrimidine metabolism, and inhibition of the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway. This study provided preliminary evidence that A. vera could be developed as an adjuvant therapy for CRC, contributing to its further clinical application in this field.
cn_title: 芦荟增强羟基喜树碱抗结直肠癌活性及靶向核苷酸代谢机制研究
insight: 芦荟通过加剧DNA损伤、失衡嘌呤/嘧啶代谢及抑制Wnt/β-catenin通路增强HCPT疗效，为中药辅助化疗提供临床前依据。
grade_rationale: 临床前机制研究，虽涉及中药辅助化疗新策略，但尚无临床数据，不足以改变实践。

title: Sex Differences in Postoperative Outcomes for Men and Women With Colon Cancer in the US Military Health System.
authors: Eaglehouse YL, Gage MM, Darmon S, Krell RW, Vicente DA, Shriver CD, et al.
abstract: Biological, behavioral, and health care access differences between men and women may contribute to differences in colon cancer diagnosis and treatment. We compared postoperative outcomes between men and women with colon cancer in the universal access Military Health System (MHS) to better understand sex-based differences in surgery. We identified patients with stage I to III colon adenocarcinoma receiving surgery in the Military Cancer Epidemiology (MilCanEpi) database between 2001 and 2014. Thirty-day postoperative outcomes included general cardiovascular and respiratory complications; infections (surgical site [SSI], urinary tract [UTI], and systemic); gastrointestinal (GI) complications (hemorrhage, bowel obstruction, ileus, intra-abdominal abscess, and anastomotic leakage); and hospital readmissions. Modified Poisson regression estimated adjusted rate ratios (ARRs) and 95% CIs in association with biological sex for the outcomes. The study included 1073 male (mean age=59.5±13.5 y) and 794 female (mean age=59.6±13.5 y) patients. In the 30-day postoperative period, general complication rates were not different by sex (ARR=1.03, 95% CI: 0.76-1.40 for women vs. men). Female sex was associated with higher rates of UTI (ARR=2.44, 95% CI: 1.63-3.65) and lower rates of GI complications (ARR=0.79, 95% CI: 0.69-0.90) relative to men. There were no sex differences in 30-day hospital readmissions (ARR=0.90, 95% CI: 0.76-1.08 for women vs. men). In the MHS, female sex was associated with higher rates of UTI and lower rates of GI complications relative to men undergoing colon cancer surgery. Factors other than health care access, such as biological differences in pelvic anatomy, physiology, or immune responses, may contribute to observed differences.
cn_title: 美国军事健康系统中男女性结肠癌术后结局的性别差异
insight: 在医疗可及性均等的体系中，女性结肠癌术后尿路感染风险更高、胃肠道并发症更少，提示解剖与生理性别差异影响术后管理。
grade_rationale: 基于大型数据库的回顾性队列研究，样本量中等且为单一医疗系统，仅提示性别相关术后风险分层，尚不足以改变实践。

title: Tubocapsenolide A Overcomes Oxaliplatin Resistance in Colorectal Cancer by Targeting PLK1 to Impair CEP55-ESCRT-Associated Vesicular Damage Clearance.
authors: Yang Y, Liang J, Wang L, Zhang H, Zhang Z, Liu Y, et al.
abstract: Oxaliplatin (L-OHP) is a first-line chemotherapeutic agent for advanced colorectal cancer (CRC) and postoperative adjuvant therapy. However, acquired L-OHP resistance remains a clinical obstacle. Here, we identify Tubocapsenolide A (TA), a natural withanolide isolated from Tubocapsicum anomalum, as a promising antitumor agent that suppresses CRC growth and sensitizes L-OHP-resistant CRC to L-OHP. Using a PROTAC-based target deconvolution strategy, we identify PLK1 as a direct molecular target of TA. PLK1 is elevated in L-OHP-resistant CRC and is associated with reduced patient sensitivity to L-OHP. Mechanistically, elevated PLK1 promotes CEP55 Ser436 phosphorylation and facilitates ESCRT recruitment to nuclear and mitochondrial budding sites. This process facilitates the clearance of L-OHP-induced damaged components through nuclear budding and TOM20
cn_title: Tubocapsenolide A靶向PLK1逆转结直肠癌奥沙利铂耐药
insight: 揭示PLK1-CEP55-ESCRT轴介导奥沙利铂耐药新机制，天然产物TA可增敏耐药肠癌，为耐药逆转提供候选药物与靶点。
grade_rationale: 临床前机制研究，靶点新颖且具转化潜力，但尚无临床验证，暂不改变实践。

title: Primetime for the Gasdermins Seesaw in Intestinal Homeostasis and Digestive Disorders.
authors: Liu Q, Liu H, Liu Y, Wang C
abstract: The five pore-forming gasdermins (GSDMs, namely GSDMA-E) are best known for executing pyroptosis, a lytic and highly inflammatory form of programmed cell death. Accumulating evidence over the past decade has unveiled diverse nonlytic functions of GSDMs in digestive homeostasis and disease. GSDMs preserve intestinal barrier integrity and mucosal immunity under physiological conditions, whereas their dysregulated activation fuels tissue injury across a spectrum of digestive diseases, including inflammatory bowel disease, acute intestinal injury, radiation enteritis, acute pancreatitis, and liver disorders. Notably, the functional outcome of GSDM activation is highly context-dependent: the same protein can be either protective or injurious. This duality extends to digestive oncology, where GSDM-mediated pyroptosis can stimulate or suppress antitumor immunity. GSDM-targeted drugs, including GSDMD agonists, GSDMD inhibitors, and GSDME inhibitors, have shown encouraging efficacy in preclinical models, although none have yet reached the clinic. Here, we review the dual roles of GSDMs across the digestive system, outline the mechanistic basis of their form-, cell-, and tissue-specific functions, and discuss the progress and remaining challenges in GSDM-targeted therapy.
cn_title: Gasdermins在肠道稳态与消化系统疾病中的双重作用
insight: 该综述系统阐述了GSDM家族在消化系统疾病中的双刃剑作用，为肠癌及肝转移中靶向GSDM介导的细胞焦亡与抗肿瘤免疫调控提供了理论框架。
grade_rationale: 发表于高影响力综述期刊，系统整合临床前证据，但尚无临床转化数据，暂不改变实践。

title: Screening colonoscopy utilization among adults living with spina bifida.
authors: Patel HV, Goldberg D, Allen IE, Copp HL, Hampson LA
abstract: PurposeSpina bifida (SB) is the most common neural tube defect, often accompanied by neurogenic bladder and bowel dysfunction, hydrocephalus, and orthopedic sequelae. As life expectancy increases for individuals with SB, understanding disparities in healthcare utilization becomes crucial. This study examined colorectal cancer (CRC) screening colonoscopy utilization rates among adults living with SB.MethodUsing the California Health Care Access and Information database (2005-2017), a matched control group was established to compare colonoscopy utilization. Multivariable logistic regression analysis was performed to identify predictors of screening colonoscopy utilization.ResultsAmong individuals aged ≥50 years, 9.5% of those living with SB underwent screening colonoscopy compared to 13.0% of matched controls. After adjustment, SB was independently associated with lower odds of screening colonoscopy (OR 0.84, 95% CI 0.76-0.93).ConclusionFindings underscore the need for targeted interventions to improve CRC screening accessibility for this vulnerable population. Addressing structural barriers and enhancing patient-centered approaches may improve preventative care delivery and long-term health outcomes in individuals with SB.
cn_title: 脊柱裂成人结直肠癌筛查结肠镜使用率及差异分析
insight: 脊柱裂患者筛查结肠镜使用率显著低于匹配对照，提示该脆弱人群存在CRC筛查障碍，需针对性干预以改善预防保健公平性。
grade_rationale: 基于大型州级数据库的回顾性匹配队列研究，样本量大但非干预性，对临床实践的直接改变潜力有限。

title: Prolonged fever with a distinct rectangular rash: What is going on?
authors: Ting IPL, Yahaya B, Tang MM
journal: Malaysian Family Physician : the Official Journal of the Academy of Family Physicians of Malaysia
abstract: We present the case of an older adult man with prolonged fever of unknown origin and a persistent rectangular erythematous plaque, highlighting the diagnostic value of careful skin examination in patients with systemic inflammatory symptoms. This 70-year-old man with adult-onset endogenous eczema, hypertension, stage II upper rectal carcinoma following resection and adjuvant radiotherapy and chemotherapy and left hip avascular necrosis presented with fever persisting for 1 month following an upper respiratory tract infection. He developed generalised arthralgia and bilateral lower limb oedema, accompanied by poor oral intake. Initial treatment with amoxicillin- clavulanate and intravenous piperacillin-tazobactam provided temporary relief. Physical examination revealed generalised xerosis, with an incidental finding of an erythematous, non-tender, mildly indurated, rectangular patch measuring 10x20 cm at the lower back, unnoticeable by the patient. Bilateral inguinal lymph nodes measuring 2x1 cm were palpable. Bilateral pedal oedema with joint bogginess was also present. Laboratory investigations showed leucocytosis with neutrophilia without blasts, normochromic normocytic anaemia, hypoalbuminaemia, transaminitis and elevated inflammatory markers. Imaging (computed tomography and positron emission tomography scans) revealed mild left pleural effusion with multiple subcentimetre lymphadenopathies above and below the diaphragm. Tuberculosis, malignancy and autoimmune markers were negative. Skin biopsy showed scattered single dyskeratotic cells at the upper epidermis, with mild-to-moderate mixed perivascular inflammation including lymphocytes, neutrophils and eosinophils at the upper dermis. Atypical cutaneous manifestations may serve as a valuable clue to adult-onset Still's disease; however, the diagnosis should be established only after careful exclusion of infectious, malignant and autoimmune mimics.
cn_title: 持续发热伴矩形皮疹：成人Still病在直肠癌术后患者中的诊断挑战
insight: 该个案提示直肠癌术后患者出现不明原因发热时，需警惕成人Still病等自身免疫性疾病，皮肤检查可提供关键线索，避免误诊为肿瘤复发或感染。
grade_rationale: 单一个案报道，无对照或验证，证据等级低，但提示临床鉴别诊断思路，对实践影响有限。

title: A prognostic model based on seven cell adhesion molecule-related genes to predict the prognosis of colorectal cancer.
authors: Zhou J, Shen Z
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a major contributor to cancer mortality. Cell adhesion molecules (CAMs) hold an essential role in CRC malignant progression. However, how to leverage CAMs-related genes to predict CRC prognosis and guide its treatment is still unclear. Gene expression data and clinical information of CRC patients were obtained from TCGA and GEO databases. Subsequently, a series of analyses were utilized to obtain 7 CAM-related feature genes and set up a prognostic risk model. The riskscore was obtained, and patients were stratified into high-risk (HR) and low-risk (LR) groups. Significant survival differences were observed ( The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s10616-026-01086-5.
cn_title: 基于七个细胞黏附分子相关基因的结直肠癌预后模型
insight: 该研究构建了基于CAM相关基因的预后模型，为CRC风险分层提供新工具，但需外部验证及肝转移特异性评估。
grade_rationale: 基于公共数据库的生信分析，缺乏前瞻性验证和肝转移特异性，实践改变潜力有限。

title: An Integrated Approach to MSI-High Colorectal Cancer Therapy in a Young Patient: A Clinical Case.
authors: Turkpenova I, Smagulova K, Jumanov A, Moldasheva A, Kadyrbayeva R, Imanaliyeva A
journal: The American Journal of Case Reports
abstract: BACKGROUND Colorectal cancer (CRC) is extremely rare in adolescents and often presents with advanced disease because of nonspecific symptoms. Deficient mismatch repair (dMMR) and microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) are important biomarkers that influence prognosis, treatment selection, and the need for genetic evaluation. We report the case of an adolescent with MSI-H-associated CRC presenting with acute intestinal obstruction. CASE REPORT A 16-year-old male initially underwent appendectomy for presumed acute appendicitis. Persistent postoperative bowel obstruction prompted computed tomography (CT), revealing a descending colon tumor requiring emergency Hartmann's procedure. Histopathology demonstrated mucinous adenocarcinoma, pT4N0M0, with vascular invasion. Immunohistochemistry showed loss of MSH2/MSH6 expression with retained MLH1/PMS2, indicating dMMR and findings highly suggestive of Lynch syndrome, although germline testing was unavailable. Molecular analysis identified a KRAS mutation without NRAS alterations. Given his multiple high-risk features, including T4 disease, bowel obstruction, vascular invasion, mucinous histology, and very young age, he received 12 cycles of adjuvant FOLFOX chemotherapy. Treatment was well tolerated, and he remains disease-free more than 5 years after completion of therapy. CONCLUSIONS This case highlights the diagnostic complexity of adolescent CRC and the need to consider colorectal malignancy in young patients with persistent or atypical abdominal symptoms. Routine MMR/MSI testing and comprehensive molecular profiling are essential in young-onset CRC to identify patients who may have hereditary cancer syndromes and require genetic counseling. Although limited to a single case, this report underscores the importance of multidisciplinary decision-making and individualized treatment based on clinicopathological and molecular characteristics, which may contribute to favorable long-term outcomes.
cn_title: 青少年MSI-H结直肠癌综合治疗一例：病例报告
insight: 报道青少年MSI-H结直肠癌伴梗阻的多学科个体化治疗长期无病生存，提示年轻患者应常规行MMR/MSI检测及遗传评估。
grade_rationale: 单例个案报告，证据等级低，但强调年轻肠癌常规MMR/MSI检测与遗传咨询具有临床提示意义。

title: Early implementation of exercise to facilitate recovery after elective colorectal surgery-a randomized clinical pilot trial.
authors: Hermann M, Kusma L, Taebi N, Kluge T, Mueller C, Orth V, et al.
abstract: Early mobilization is a key component of enhanced recovery after elective colorectal surgery. This pilot trial evaluated the safety and feasibility of an early supervised postoperative exercise intervention in addition to standard care. In this single-center randomized controlled pilot trial, 31 patients undergoing elective colorectal surgery were randomized to an intervention group (n = 16) or control group (n = 15). One patient withdrew after randomization, leaving 30 patients for modified intention-to-treat analysis. The intervention consisted of individualized, physiotherapist-supervised exercise sessions on postoperative days 1, 3, and 5. The control group received standard postoperative care according to the institutional ERAS protocol. The originally registered primary endpoint was time to first bowel movement; prior to final analysis, safety and feasibility were designated as the primary outcomes in accordance with the pilot nature of the study. The change was documented transparently. Secondary outcomes included physical performance (Short Physical Performance Battery [SPPB], handgrip strength), time to first bowel movement, patient-reported outcomes, and postoperative complications. Thirty patients completed the study (retention 96.8%). Adherence to the intervention was 100%, and no intervention-related adverse events occurred. The intervention group showed significantly better preservation of physical performance, reflected by a more favorable change in SPPB score from baseline to postoperative assessment. No significant between-group differences were observed for time to first bowel movement, handgrip strength, postoperative complications, or other secondary outcomes. Early supervised postoperative exercise after elective colorectal surgery was safe and feasible. Although no differences were found for most secondary outcomes, the intervention improved postoperative physical performance. These exploratory findings warrant confirmation in adequately powered randomized trials. German Clinical Trials Register, DRKS00036327 (retrospectively registered, 22.04.2025).
cn_title: 结直肠癌择期手术后早期监督性运动促进康复的随机对照预试验
insight: 术后早期监督运动安全可行且改善体能，为ERAS康复路径补充运动干预提供初步证据，但样本小需大样本验证。
grade_rationale: 单中心小样本预试验（n=31），仅改善体能次要终点，不足以改变实践。

title: 2-Hydroxyisobutyrylation of SRSF9 Regulates CD44 Alternative Splicing to Promote Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastasis.
authors: Zhang M, Song J, Yu S, Liu H, Li Z, Nie T, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer liver metastasis (CRLM) remains a major cause of cancer mortality, yet the metabolic mechanisms that remodel metastatic RNA-splicing programs are poorly defined. Here, integrated quantitative proteomics and lysine 2-hydroxyisobutyrylation (Khib) proteomics of patient-matched normal mucosa, primary CRCs, and liver metastases revealed a progressive increase in global Khib, with enrichment on RNA-splicing proteins. Serine/arginine-rich splicing factor 9 (SRSF9) emerged as a Khib-modified splicing factor whose expression and K155 Khib levels increased from normal tissue to primary tumors and liver metastases. Gain and loss of function studies in CRC cell lines, patient-derived organoids, subcutaneous xenografts, and splenic injection liver metastasis models showed that SRSF9 promotes proliferation, invasion, tumor growth, and liver colonization. Mechanistically, K155 Khib stabilized SRSF9 protein; the K155R mutation accelerated degradation and abolished SRSF9-driven malignant phenotypes. KAT7 and SIRT6 act as regulators of Khib modification, which positively and negatively modulate the K155 Khib modification of SRSF9, respectively. SRSF9 bound CD44 pre-mRNA through its RRM1 domain and promoted alternative splicing toward the oncogenic CD44V8-10 isoform, which was elevated in patient tumors and metastases and rescued the impaired proliferation and metastatic capacity caused by SRSF9 loss. Finally, a CD44V8-10-targeting antisense oligonucleotide suppressed CRC growth and liver metastasis in preclinical models. These findings define a KAT7/SIRT6-regulated Khib-SRSF9-CD44V8-10 axis that couples metabolic acylation to metastatic splicing and nominate CD44V8-10 as a therapeutic vulnerability in CRC liver metastasis.
cn_title: SRSF9的2-羟基异丁酰化调控CD44可变剪接促进结直肠癌肝转移
insight: 揭示KAT7/SIRT6-SRSF9-CD44V8-10轴耦合代谢酰化与RNA剪接驱动肝转移，为靶向CD44V8-10治疗提供新策略。
grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，多模型验证但尚未进入临床，暂不改变实践。

title: Transient but not sustained p53 activation by targeting METTL3 prevents radiation-induced intestinal injury through dual-regulation of revival stem cells.
authors: Zhu R, Li M, Liu C, Kong D, Qian J, Li M, et al.
abstract: Radiation-induced intestinal injury (RIII) remains a severe complication of radiotherapy. Although p53 activation is known to be protective, no clinically available p53 activators exist. Different p53 activation dynamics (transient or sustained) are linked with radio-sensitivity, yet their therapeutic relevance to RIII has not been explored. The emerging role of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) in radiation injury is recognized, but the mechanistic link between m6A and p53 signaling in RIII remains elusive. Here, we investigated how m6A regulates p53 signaling, as well as the functional consequences and mechanisms of transient or sustained p53 activation via pharmacologically targeting m6A in RIII. After radiation, m6A writer METTL3 increases m6A on MDM2 mRNA, which is recognized by m6A reader IGF2BP3, upregulating MDM2 and suppressing intestinal p53. Then, METTL3 inhibitor S-Adenosylhomocysteine (SAH) was used to induce transient or sustained p53 activation. Functionally, a single dose of SAH suppressed MDM2 and induced transient p53 activation, thereby protecting against RIII, whereas multiple dosing induced sustained p53 activation but failed to confer a protective benefit. Mechanistically, transient p53 activation prevented RIII by stimulating YAP signaling and revival stem cells (revSCs) regeneration, a newly defined stress-induced intestinal stem cell population, whereas sustained p53 activation failed to. Importantly, SAH did not protect colorectal cancer cells from radiation. Together, these findings reveal that radiation inhibits intestinal p53 expression through the METTL3/m6A/IGF2BP3/MDM2 axis, and that transient p53 activation via METTL3 inhibition offers a promising protective strategy for RIII through YAP-mediated revSCs regeneration.
cn_title: 靶向METTL3诱导瞬时而非持续p53激活通过双重调控复活干细胞预防放射性肠损伤
insight: 揭示METTL3/m6A/IGF2BP3/MDM2轴调控p53动态激活保护放射性肠损伤且不保护肠癌细胞，为放疗防护提供新策略。
grade_rationale: 临床前机制研究，虽具转化潜力但尚未临床验证，暂不改变实践。

title: MCT1 as a key determinant of cytotoxic response to 6-O-Carboxypropyl-α-tocotrienol in colorectal cancer cells.
authors: Ishii K, Yano T
abstract: 6-O-Carboxypropyl-α-tocotrienol (T3E), a derivative of α-tocotrienol, has been reported to exert anticancer activity. However, the molecular determinants underlying T3E-induced cytotoxicity in cancer cells remain unclear. Recent studies have reported that ion transporters play important roles in cancer cell survival. In this study, we investigated whether ion transporters are involved in the cytotoxic effects of T3E in colorectal cancer (CRC) cells. T3E exerted cytotoxic effects in multiple CRC cell lines, while showing minimal cytotoxicity in immortalized normal colonic epithelial cells. The cytotoxicity of T3E was markedly attenuated by syrosingopine, an inhibitor of monocarboxylate transporter 1 (MCT1) and 4 (MCT4). Knockdown of MCT1 significantly attenuated T3E-induced cytotoxicity, whereas knockdown of MCT4 significantly enhanced the cytotoxic effects of T3E. T3E induced cytotoxicity in CRC cells through inducing endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, and inhibition of MCT1 partially attenuated T3E-induced ER stress. Our findings demonstrate that MCT1 is involved in T3E-induced cytotoxicity in CRC cells and suggest a potential pharmacological strategy targeting MCT1-dependent cytotoxicity.
cn_title: MCT1是结直肠癌细胞对6-O-羧丙基-α-生育三烯酚细胞毒性反应的关键决定因素
insight: 揭示MCT1介导T3E在结直肠癌细胞中诱导内质网应激和细胞毒性的机制，为靶向MCT1的结直肠癌治疗策略提供依据。
grade_rationale: 研究为体外细胞实验，揭示MCT1在T3E细胞毒性中的作用，但缺乏体内和临床数据，暂不具备改变临床实践的潜力。

title: Exercise as anticancer medicine? Evidence, mechanisms and implementation in oncology.
authors: Schmidinger M, Huebner-Resch I, Shariat SF
abstract: Research over the past two decades has repositioned exercise from a general lifestyle recommendation to a potential anticancer intervention. Pooled analyses of more than 1.4 million participants link regular physical activity with lower incidence of at least 13 tumour types, and prospective cohort data report cancer-specific mortality 24-31% lower among the most active patients with breast, colorectal, prostate and lung cancer, although these estimates derive from observational designs using self-reported activity. In 2025, a phase III trial in stage III colon cancer provided the first randomised evidence that a structured exercise and behaviour-change programme improves disease-free and overall survival after adjuvant chemotherapy; a randomised trial in ovarian cancer subsequently did not show a progression-free survival benefit. Candidate mechanisms include insulin and growth-factor signalling, myokine secretion, immune mobilisation, reduced chronic inflammation and gut microbiome remodelling, although these rest on evidence ranging from cell culture to human trials and are rarely distinguished by level. Despite this evidence, structural, educational and economic barriers prevent integration of exercise into routine oncology care. This Review synthesises the available evidence and identifies the steps required for clinical adoption.
cn_title: 运动作为抗癌药物？肿瘤学中的证据、机制与实施
insight: 该综述系统总结运动抗癌证据，III期结肠癌试验首次提供随机证据支持运动改善生存，提示应将运动纳入肠癌辅助治疗及肝转移综合管理。
grade_rationale: 基于III期随机试验证据及大规模队列数据，系统综述具有改变临床实践潜力，但证据等级受限于观察性设计。

title: Deploying machine learning and metagenomics for predicting gut microbial drug biotransformation in colorectal cancer.
authors: Palanisamy H, Vidyalakshmi S
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the leading causes of death globally. Chemotherapy is considered as one of the standard treatment option for CRC. Although effective in many cases, drugs used in chemotherapy are often associated with adverse toxicity. Inter-individual variations in drug response are often attributed to pharmacogenomic associations, and current evidence suggests involvement of gut microbes as a contributor to drug response variations. While several studies have implemented machine learning to predict drug responses mediated by gut microbial enzymes, these predictions mainly rely on substrate information and bacterial genome data. In this study, we have developed CRCGMMeta Predictor, a tool that predicts gut microbial enzymes and species capable of biotransforming drugs. Unlike existing tools, CRCGMMeta Predictor integrates enzyme prediction with species-level abundance in CRC metagenomes using eight geographically diverse metagenomic studies. The tool was trained on 437,079 species-specific enzyme data, incorporating 3457 substrate and protein-encoding features. Multiple machine learning models were evaluated, with the random forest model achieving 99% accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score and ROC-AUC metrics. Validation of the generated model with a blind set achieved 97% accuracy, while 10-fold cross-validation achieved an accuracy of 0.831 ± 0.068. Based on the above results, the random forest model was selected to build the CRCGMMeta Predictor tool. This was further assessed against fluoropyrimidine drugs and its ability to predict enzymes supported by literature evidence and those predicted by existing computational tools. These findings highlight the potential of CRCGMMeta Predictor in identifying microbiome-mediated drug responses.
cn_title: 机器学习与宏基因组学预测结直肠癌肠道菌群药物生物转化
insight: 构建CRCGMMeta Predictor工具整合酶预测与菌群丰度，可预测结直肠癌化疗药物微生物代谢，为个体化用药和毒性管理提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 方法学工具开发，随机森林模型准确率高但仅基于公共宏基因组数据，尚无临床验证，暂不改变实践。

title: Synthesis of thiadiazole derivatives and investigation of the effects against colon cancer cells.
authors: Xu Z, Shang S, Yu W, Li Y, Zhang J, Zhao Z, et al.
abstract: Colon cancer is a life-threatening gastrointestinal malignancy in which Hedgehog (Hh) signaling plays a critical role, yet no Hh pathway inhibitor is clinically approved for its treatment. This study aimed to design and synthesize thiadiazole-based Hh pathway inhibitors and evaluate their anti-colon cancer activity and mechanism. A series of thiadiazole derivatives were synthesized from pyrazole boronic acid and 2,5-dibromothiadiazole via nucleophilic substitution, Suzuki-Miyaura coupling, and tert-butoxycarbonyl deprotection, with structures confirmed by The target compounds were structurally confirmed. SEZ13 exhibited the strongest Hedgehog inhibition, outperforming Vismodegib. BODIPY-cyclopamine assay, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations confirmed its binding to smoothened. SEZ13 dose-dependently inhibited HCT116 and HT-29 cell proliferation. At 30 μM, SEZ13 significantly suppressed migration and invasion, induced apoptosis, and caused G2/M arrest (P < 0.05). Mechanistically, SEZ13 significantly downregulated Gli1 and Patched-1 mRNA and Gli1 protein expression (P < 0.05). SEZ13, a novel thiadiazole derivative, binds smoothened and exerts anti-colon cancer activity by inhibiting the Hedgehog/Gli1 signaling pathway.
cn_title: 新型噻二唑衍生物SEZ13靶向Smo抑制Hedgehog通路抗结肠癌
insight: 合成新型Hh通路抑制剂SEZ13，体外证实其经Smo/Gli1抑制结肠癌细胞增殖侵袭，为肠癌靶向治疗提供先导化合物，但尚缺体内与肝转移验证。
grade_rationale: 仅为细胞层面的化合物合成与机制探索，无动物实验或临床数据，距实践改变甚远。

title: Recent advances in cancer-associated fibroblasts in colorectal cancer: functional subtypes, spatiotemporal dynamics and therapeutic targets.
authors: Ding Y, Zhang S, Guo Y, Xia W, Fu B, Di W, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a malignant tumour with an extremely high global incidence rate; its development and progression are closely linked to fibroblasts within the tumour microenvironment (TME). In recent years, single-cell and spatial multi-omics technologies have revealed the high heterogeneity of fibroblasts in colorectal cancer and identified multiple subtypes with either oncogenic or tumour-suppressive functions. Within the TME, these fibroblast states have been associated with key processes in tumour initiation, progression, metastasis, and treatment resistance, although direct functional evidence for many of them remains to be established. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the origins, differentiation and activation trajectories, stage-associated distribution patterns, and spatial characteristics of fibroblasts, with a focus on newly identified functional states and their distributions across primary and metastatic CRC. Furthermore, given that the efficacy of current clinical treatments for fibroblasts remains less than satisfactory, there is still a need to develop effective targeted therapies for these newly identified subtypes in the future.
cn_title: 结直肠癌相关成纤维细胞：功能亚型、时空动态与治疗靶点新进展
insight: 系统梳理CAF功能亚型与时空分布，提示原发灶与转移灶CAF异质性，为肠癌肝转移微环境靶向治疗提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 发表于高影响力综述期刊的叙述性综述，整合单细胞与空间多组学证据，但缺乏原始数据与临床验证，暂难改变实践。

title: Operability and survival in resectable colorectal cancer: A retrospective propensity score-matched study impact of operability in colorectal cancer.
authors: Ose I, Rosen AW, Ngo-Stuyt L, Gögenur I
journal: European Journal of Surgical Oncology : the Journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology
abstract: To investigate survival outcomes in frail, older patients with colorectal cancer who were deemed non-operable despite technically resectable tumors, compared to propensity score matched patients who underwent curative-intent surgery. This was a propensity score-matched retrospective cohort study. Overall survival was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. A univariate Cox proportional hazards model was applied to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) and their corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs). From a total of 1667 patients, assessed at the Department of Surgery, Zealand University Hospital, Denmark, between January 1, 2020, and April 30, 2024, 67 were deemed non-operable and 805 patients underwent elective, curative intent surgery. After applying PSM, each study cohort included 36 patients. Both, before and after propensity score matching, surgery was significantly associated with better survival, HR: 11.73, 95% CI: 8.48-16.21, p < 0.01 and HR: 5.06, 95% CI: 2.57-9.95, p < 0.001, respectively. The results of the sensitivity analysis were consistent. In the propensity score-matched cohort, curative intent surgery was significantly associated with longer overall survival compared with patients who were deemed non-operable.
cn_title: 可切除结直肠癌中不可手术患者的生存结局：倾向性评分匹配回顾性研究
insight: 即使肿瘤技术可切除，衰弱老年患者被判定不可手术则生存显著恶化，提示需优化术前评估与决策，避免可手术患者被过度保守处理。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列，样本量有限（匹配后各36例），但揭示可手术患者被判定不可手术的生存差距，对临床决策有提示意义，尚不足以改变实践。

title: Integrative transcriptomic analysis reveals tumor-adjacent mucosal remodeling in colorectal cancer.
authors: Wu S, Wu L, Li R, Luo X, Zhao X, Shi L, et al.
abstract: Tumor-adjacent mucosa is commonly used as a normal reference in colorectal cancer (CRC) transcriptomic studies, but its relationship with distant normal mucosa and tumor tissue remains unclear. Here, we performed bulk RNA sequencing of paired distant normal, adjacent, and tumor tissues from 25 patients with CRC and used these three tissue states to construct an ordered normal-adjacent-tumor (N-A-T) expression continuum. Although adjacent mucosa was globally closer to distant normal mucosa and showed no significant differential expression by pairwise analysis, a limma-based linear trend model identified widespread monotonic transcriptional changes along the N-A-T continuum. Tumor-directed genes were enriched in translation, RNA processing, cell-cycle activity, and proliferation-related pathways, whereas genes decreasing along this axis were associated with oxidative metabolism and epithelial homeostasis. A trend gene-based N-A-T score positioned adjacent mucosa between normal and tumor tissues in external bulk cohorts and was associated with proliferative and immune-low molecular states in CRC. Single-cell RNA-seq analysis localized this signal mainly to epithelial cells and associated higher scores with proliferative and stem-like epithelial states. In conclusion, CRC-adjacent mucosa is not fully equivalent to distant normal mucosa but carries coordinated tumor-directed transcriptional changes mainly associated with epithelial-cell programs.
cn_title: 整合转录组分析揭示结直肠癌癌旁黏膜重塑
insight: 癌旁黏膜并非真正正常对照，存在肿瘤导向的转录重塑，提示肠癌转录组研究对照选择及癌旁组织生物学意义需重新审视。
grade_rationale: 基于25例配对样本的转录组+单细胞分析，方法学扎实但样本量小、无临床干预，尚不足以改变实践。

title: Adjuvant treatment intensity in circulating tumour DNA-negative colorectal cancer: a systematic review and reconstructed individual patient data meta-analysis.
authors: Yajima S, Yoshida S, Hirose K, Chen W, Sato H, Hirakawa A, et al.
journal: Clinical & Translational Oncology : Official Publication of the Federation of Spanish Oncology Societies and of the National Cancer Institute of Mexico
abstract: Postoperative circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) is strongly prognostic after curative-intent surgery, but whether a negative result identifies patients with colorectal cancer (CRC) who can safely receive less-intensive adjuvant management remains uncertain. We synthesised prospective comparative evidence using reconstructed individual patient data (r-IPD), distinguishing the types of treatment contrast that have been studied. PubMed/MEDLINE, Google Scholar, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched through August 2025, and the structured databases and trial registry were updated to 1 October 2026. Time-to-event data for postoperative ctDNA-negative patients were reconstructed from published Kaplan-Meier curves. CRC analyses were organised by type of contrast: omission of chemotherapy, treatment duration, or addition of an investigational agent to standard chemotherapy. A pooled estimate across contrasts was reported as an exploratory summary. Thirteen studies involving 9552 patients were included; r-IPD were reconstructed for 5323 ctDNA-negative patients, including 4236 with CRC from five studies. Hazard ratios (HRs) favoured more-intensive management for chemotherapy versus observation in the non-randomised GALAXY registry (HR 0.72, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.52-0.99) and for 6 versus 3 months of chemotherapy in IDEA-France (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.58-0.97), whereas adding an investigational agent to standard chemotherapy in three randomised trials did not show a clear benefit (HR 0.95, 95% CI 0.75-1.20). The exploratory pooled estimate was HR 0.84 (95% CI 0.73-0.96; I Current evidence does not support omission or broad de-escalation of adjuvant therapy solely because postoperative ctDNA is negative. The association with treatment intensity depended on the type of contrast, complete omission has been examined only in non-randomised data, and absolute differences were small. Research registration PROSPERO registration number: CRD420251153449.
cn_title: ctDNA阴性结直肠癌辅助治疗强度的系统综述与重建个体数据Meta分析
insight: 术后ctDNA阴性不足以安全降阶辅助治疗，治疗强度获益因对比类型而异，提示需结合其他风险因素个体化决策。
grade_rationale: 基于13项研究、9552例的重建个体数据Meta分析，证据等级较高，但结论为阴性且未提供新的随机证据，暂不改变实践。

title: Outcome after vacuum-assisted closure in patients with anorectal malformations-a multi-center comparative study.
authors: Borsch LM, Bouzidi M, Ludwikowski B, Bottländer M, Wennemann L, Dingemann J, et al.
abstract: In patients with anorectal malformations (ARM), perineal wound complications following posterior sagittal anorectoplasty (PSARP) remain a challenge with an occurrence of 22%-43%. In adults, vacuum-assisted closure (VAC) aims to support wound healing after colorectal procedures. In children evidence is limited, suggesting a potential benefit of VAC therapy after PSARP. We aimed to evaluate the impact of VAC therapy on outcomes after PSARP in a multicenter comparative study. All consecutive patients who underwent PSARP from 01/2018-12/2025 in two participating pediatric surgical departments were included. Complications including postoperative perineal wound dehiscence were analyzed. The study was approved by the local ethics committee (approval number: 12354-BO-K-2026). 48 patients were included: 26 with and 22 without VAC therapy. Baseline characteristics, follow-up duration and the interval until first follow-up were comparable between cohorts respectively. Postoperative outcomes did not differ significantly between groups. Stool smearing occurred in none of the patients in the VAC cohort and in one patient in the non-VAC cohort (p > 0.99). No incontinence was observed in either cohort (p > 0.99). Perineal wound dehiscence occurred in two patients (8%) in the VAC and in one (5%) in the non-VAC cohort (p > 0.99). In our study, VAC therapy was associated with comparable rates of postoperative wound dehiscence after PSARP compared to the non-VAC cohort and to previous reports. Larger, prospective studies are required to confirm our findings.
cn_title: 真空辅助闭合技术在后矢状入路肛门直肠成形术后结局的多中心对比研究
insight: 该研究显示VAC对儿童ARM术后会阴伤口裂开率无显著改善，提示需更大样本前瞻性验证，对肠癌术后伤口管理无直接启示。
grade_rationale: 多中心回顾性小样本（n=48），无显著差异，证据等级低，不足以改变实践。

title: Photon-counting computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging in rectal cancer: reassessment of normalized iodine concentration and apparent diffusion coefficient in an expanded cohort.
authors: Saeed S, Shahzadi I, Niehoff JH, Schreck J, Katz MS, Miller M, et al.
abstract: To reassess pretreatment photon-counting computed tomography (PCCT)-derived normalized iodine concentration (NIC) in an expanded rectal-cancer cohort, using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-derived apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) as a within-cohort reference marker for histopathologic treatment response. This single-center retrospective study included 63 patients with rectal adenocarcinoma who underwent pretreatment pelvic MRI and contrast-enhanced PCCT, followed by neoadjuvant treatment and surgical resection. Dworak tumor regression grades 0-1 were classified as poor response (n = 22) and grades 2-4 as moderate/good response (n = 41). MRI and PCCT were performed a median of 3 days apart (IQR, 1-4.5). The previously reported NIC threshold of ≥ 0.36 was reassessed without re-optimization. Twenty-one of 63 patients overlapped with the preceding pilot cohort; therefore, the present study is an expanded reassessment rather than an independent external validation. Twenty-two patients showed poor response and 41 moderate/good response. ADC interobserver agreement was excellent (ICC, 0.959; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.90-0.98). In the 61 patients with paired numeric NIC measurements from both observers, NIC interobserver agreement was also excellent (ICC, 0.905; bootstrap 95% CI, 0.858-0.936). Mean ADC was lower in poor responders than in moderate/good responders (0.876 ± 0.186 vs. 1.035 ± 0.208 × 10⁻³ mm²/s; p = 0.003; AUC, 0.738; 95% CI, 0.608-0.867). NIC did not differ between groups (median, 0.313 vs. 0.370; p = 0.91; AUC, 0.509; 95% CI, 0.362-0.656). Applying the previously published NIC threshold ≥ 0.36 yielded sensitivity 53.7%, specificity 63.6%, and accuracy 57.1% for Dworak grades 2-4. Adding NIC to ADC did not improve model fit (likelihood-ratio p = 0.601). In this exploratory expanded cohort, lower pretreatment ADC was associated with Dworak grades 0-1. Single-phase portal-venous NIC measured with the described two-dimensional ROI approach did not reproduce the high performance reported in the pilot study and showed no evidence of improved model fit beyond ADC in this cohort. These findings require independent prospective validation.
cn_title: 光子计数CT与MRI在直肠癌中的再评估：扩展队列中标准化碘浓度与表观扩散系数的价值
insight: 扩大队列未能复现PCCT碘浓度的预测效能，ADC仍与病理反应相关，提示影像组学生物标志物需独立前瞻验证，肝转移转化研究应谨慎外推。

title: Non-Invasive and Cost-Effective Fecal Occult Blood Detection for Colon Cancer Prognosis in Murine Models.
authors: Iden JA, Liron T, Gabet Y
abstract: Fecal occult blood testing is a widely used diagnostic method for the early detection of colorectal cancer and the assessment of gastrointestinal pathologies in humans. For preclinical research purposes, we developed a cost-effective, non-invasive luminol-based chemiluminescent assay to detect fecal occult blood in murine feces that can function as a predictive tool, with sufficient sensitivity to correlate with disease severity. Fecal samples were collected and weighed, solubilized in a sodium hydroxide solution, then combined with luminol and hydrogen peroxide and immediately analyzed using a luminometer. Luminol reacts with the iron in hemoglobin to produce a measurable chemiluminescent signal; therefore, known hemoglobin concentrations from mouse blood, quantified using a hemoglobinometer, were used to generate a standard curve along with feces from naïve mice. The method was validated against standard Guaiac paper slide tests for accuracy. We demonstrated a strong correlation with disease severity metrics, including colonoscopy findings and tumor burden in multiple models of colon cancer, offering an accessible, non-invasive, and inexpensive alternative for routine monitoring of disease progression. The application of this technique can be broadened to other murine models of gastrointestinal pathologies, such as peptic ulcers, inflammatory bowel disease, Crohn's disease, and gastritis.
cn_title: 基于鲁米诺化学发光的小鼠粪便隐血检测用于结肠癌预后评估
insight: 开发了一种低成本、非侵入性的小鼠粪便隐血化学发光检测法，与结肠镜和肿瘤负荷强相关，为临床前肠癌研究提供了便捷的疾病进展监测工具。
grade_rationale: 方法学开发研究，仅在动物模型验证，样本量有限，未涉及临床转化，但为临床前研究提供实用工具。

title: Impact of Phosphatidylinositol 3-Kinase and B-Raf Mutations in Rat Sarcoma Wild-Type Metastatic Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Wang W, Wang T, Qian L, Nie Y
abstract: Activating mutations in phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha (PIK3CA) and B-Raf proto-oncogene (BRAF) are hypothesized to confer primary resistance to anti-epidermal growth factor receptor (anti-EGFR) monoclonal antibodies in metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). However, the clinical impact of these mutations in patients with rat sarcoma (RAS) wild-type tumors remains incompletely characterized. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the association of PIK3CA and BRAF mutations with clinical outcomes in RAS wild-type mCRC patients receiving first-line EGFR inhibitor therapy. A systematic literature search was conducted across PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Google Scholar, and OVID from inception through June 2019, following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines. From 600 screened records, 10 studies comprising 1,478 patients with RAS wild-type mCRC were included. Pooled hazard ratios (HRs) for progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS), and risk differences (RDs) for objective response rate (ORR), were calculated using fixed- or random-effects models with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). PIK3CA mutations were associated with significantly worse PFS (HR, 1.38; 95% CI, 1.11-1.71; p = 0.004) and OS (HR, 1.58; 95% CI, 1.22-2.05; p < 0.001). BRAF mutations were similarly associated with worse PFS (HR, 1.68; 95% CI, 1.46-1.94; p < 0.001) and OS (HR, 1.27; 95% CI, 1.09-1.49; p = 0.003). No significant difference in ORR was observed for either PIK3CA mutations (RD, -0.12; 95% CI, -0.38 to 0.15; p = 0.38) or BRAF mutations (RD, -0.12; 95% CI, -0.28 to 0.04; p = 0.15) compared with wild-type. These findings confirm that PIK3CA and BRAF mutations are negative prognostic biomarkers in RAS wild-type mCRC, associated with inferior PFS and OS but not ORR. Incorporating BRAF and PIK3CA mutation testing into pretreatment evaluation is supported, and alternative therapeutic strategies for mutation carriers are needed. Prospective validation in larger studies is warranted.
cn_title: PIK3CA与BRAF突变在RAS野生型转移性结直肠癌中的影响：系统综述与Meta分析
insight: 该Meta分析证实PIK3CA/BRAF突变是RAS野生型mCRC抗EGFR治疗的不良预后标志，支持治疗前检测并探索替代策略。
grade_rationale: 基于10项研究1478例患者的系统综述/Meta分析，证据等级较高但为回顾性汇总，尚不足以直接改变实践。

title: The Role of Intraoperative Indocyanine Green Fluorescence Angiography in Reducing Anastomotic Leak After Colorectal Resection: A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trials.
authors: Abu-Khalaf L, Khalil Y, Abu-Khalaf R, Abu-Khalaf S, AlKaabi H
abstract: Anastomotic leak (AL) has a reported incidence of 3%-19% after colorectal resection. The aim of this Preferred Reporting Items of Systematic Reviews and Meta-analyses (PRISMA) 2020 compliant systematic review is to determine whether intraoperative indocyanine green fluorescence angiography (ICG-FA) reduces clinically significant anastomotic leak and improves peri-operative outcomes compared with standard white-light assessment in adults undergoing colorectal resection with primary anastomosis. We searched MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), and Web of Science from inception to March 2026. Eligible study designs included randomised controlled trials (RCTs) enrolling adults undergoing elective colorectal resection with primary anastomosis and comparing intra-operative ICG-FA with standard white-light assessment. The primary outcome was "clinically relevant anastomotic leak" as defined by the International Study Group of Rectal Cancer. Six RCTs enrolling 4,366 randomised patients, of whom 4,221 were evaluable: FLAG (n=377), De Nardi et al. (n=240), EssentiAL (n=839), AVOID (n=931), ICG-COLORAL (n=1,136), and IntAct (n=698). EssentiAL was the only trial to demonstrate a statistically significant reduction in all-grade AL (7.6% (32/422) vs 11.8% (49/417); relative risk (RR) 0.645; p=0.041) and grade B/C AL (4.7% (20/422) vs 8.2% (34/417); p=0.044). AVOID, ICG-COLORAL, and IntAct did not meet their primary endpoints but consistently favoured left-sided resections in subgroup analyses. IntAct showed an absolute five percentage-point reduction in grade B/C AL (10% (36/343) vs 15% (54/355); adjusted odds ratio (OR) 0.667; 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.419-1.060; p=0.087). No serious ICG-related adverse events were reported. Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) certainty of evidence for the primary outcome was moderate. Current RCT evidence does not support routine ICG-FA across all colorectal anastomoses. Leak rates are most consistently reduced for left-sided and low rectal resections where inferior mesenteric artery (IMA) ligation may compromise anastomotic perfusion.
cn_title: 术中吲哚菁绿荧光血管造影降低结直肠切除吻合口漏：随机对照试验系统综述

authors: Ivancev VD, Iskander J, Hanna J, Ghotra K, Iorio C, Ivancev DV
abstract: Zileuton is a selective, orally active inhibitor of the enzyme 5-lipoxygenase (5-LOX), originally developed and clinically approved for the prophylaxis and chronic management of asthma. Discovered in the 1980s, its unique pharmacological mechanism distinguishes it from other widely used leukotriene receptor antagonists. Rather than blocking downstream receptors, zileuton acts upstream to suppress the overall synthesis of all 5-LOX-derived eicosanoids. title: RAS Mutations as Prognostic Biomarkers in Digestive Cancers: From Binary Classification to Variant-Specific and Context-Dependent Risk Stratification.
authors: Grados L, Rhaiem R, Amroun K, Zimmermann P, Deguelte S, Gigante E, et al.
abstract: In digestive cancers, activating RAS mutations - primarily KRAS, less frequently NRAS - are among the most prevalent oncogenic drivers. Their clinical significance depends strongly on the tumor type, disease stage, treatment context, and specific RAS variant. In colorectal cancer (CRC), RAS alterations are well-established predictors of resistance to anti-EGFR therapy. However, KRAS G12C-mutant tumors represent a distinct subgroup with demonstrated sensitivity to KRAS G12C inhibitors. However, growing evidence supports the negative prognostic impact of RAS mutations on both primary CRC and colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM) in both post-resection and adjuvant therapies. In pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), where KRAS alterations are nearly universal, prognostic evaluation has evolved from a binary mutant versus wild-type classification to a more refined approach based on mutation subtype (e.g., G12D/V vs. G12R) and KRAS mutant dosage, both of which influence clinical outcomes. In biliary tract cancers, KRAS mutations occur in a relevant subset and are consistently associated with poor survival. Liquid biopsy approaches increasingly enable noninvasive detection and longitudinal monitoring. In gastric cancer, RAS alterations are less frequent overall but may identify biologically aggressive subsets and may also be associated with inferior outcomes under HER2-targeted therapy in selected populations. This review synthesizes contemporary data supporting RAS alterations as prognostic biomarkers across digestive cancers, highlights practical considerations for integrating variant-level RAS information into risk stratification and trial designs, and discusses how emerging RAS-directed therapies may reshape the prognostic significance of specific molecular subsets.
cn_title: RAS突变作为消化道肿瘤预后生物标志物：从二元分类到变异特异性及情境依赖的风险分层

grade_rationale: 系统综述整合多癌种证据，提出变异特异性预后分层框架，但非前瞻干预性研究，暂不直接改变实践。

title: A lectin-directed antibody-recruiting molecule against Tn antigen for cancer immunotherapy.
authors: Yan B, Hong H, Li H, Peng J, Cao W, Wu Z
abstract: The Tn antigen, an abnormally glycosylated structure on the cell surface, is a key target for cancer immunotherapy. However, the intrinsically weak immunogenicity of glycans and the resulting complex immune tolerance constitute the primary challenges in the clinical translation of Tn-targeted immunotherapies. Native human macrophage galactose lectin (MGL) exhibits a strong binding preference for Tn antigen. Here, we report a Tn-targeting, bifunctional antibody-like molecule ZZ-MGL comprised of an antibody-recruiting domain and a lectin domain. title: IPO5 contributes to cetuximab resistance in colorectal cancer by modulating Ras signaling.
authors: Yuan Q, Lu S, He X, Zheng L, Liu L, Chen Y, et al.
abstract: Resistance to cetuximab is a major challenge in colorectal cancer (CRC). Here, we show that IPO5, an importin mediating RASAL2 nuclear import, contributes to cetuximab resistance. Screening six CRC cell lines revealed an inverse correlation between IPO5 expression and cetuximab sensitivity, with higher IPO5 levels in resistant (RKO and SW620) than sensitive (LoVo and Caco2) cells. IPO5 knockdown in resistant cells restored cetuximab sensitivity, induced apoptosis (upregulated active caspase-3/BAX and downregulated BCL-2), and suppressed proliferation and xenograft growth, whereas IPO5 overexpression in sensitive cells reduced sensitivity. Mechanistically, IPO5 facilitates RASAL2 nuclear translocation via its nuclear localization signal, depleting cytoplasmic RASAL2 and increasing GTP-bound RAS to sustain AKT and MAPK activation. Consistently, IPO5 and downstream Ras effectors were elevated in resistant LoVo-CR cells. Collectively, our findings identify the IPO5/RASAL2 axis as a key contributor to cetuximab resistance in CRC by disrupting the cytoplasmic localization of RASAL2 and activating the RAS/MAPK and PI3K/AKT pathways.

title: Structure-based development of a peptide inhibitor targeting fibroblast activation protein for the treatment of rectal cancer.
authors: Zhou Z, Chen B, Zhao J, Wang T
abstract: Rectal cancer progression and resistance are linked to the tumor microenvironment, making FAP a stromal target for peptide inhibitor development. This study integrated transcriptomic data from 1236 rectal cancer and normal rectal tissue samples with random forest- and LASSO-based target prioritization and structure-based peptide screening. FAP ranked first in the six-dimensional scoring system, with a comprehensive score of 0.89. Its expression was consistently increased in TCGA-READ, GSE38718, and GSE87211 cohorts by 4.32-fold, 3.87-fold, and 4.15-fold, respectively, and showed diagnostic performance with an AUC of 0.82. High FAP expression was associated with advanced stage, lymph node metastasis, lower 5-year overall survival, stromal enrichment, and immunosuppressive cell infiltration. Structure-based screening of 10,000 peptides identified 32 candidates. Among them, Pep17 showed relatively stable binding during the 100 ns molecular dynamics simulation, with a Top 1 cluster population of 42.3% and the most favorable MM/PBSA binding free energy among the three tested peptides (-4.82 ± 0.36 kJ/mol). Pep17 was therefore prioritized as a promising FAP-targeted peptide candidate for experimental validation. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05061-x.

insight: 该研究通过多组学与结构筛选鉴定FAP为直肠癌基质靶点并开发肽抑制剂Pep17，为肠癌微环境靶向治疗提供新候选分子。

Logistic regression evaluated predictors of advanced neoplasia (high-grade dysplasia [HGD] or adenocarcinoma); adenocarcinoma-only and age × With advancing age, body mass index, Colorectal lesion severity and high-risk endoscopic features showed an age-related gradient. The red-flag composite is an exploratory descriptive construct, not a validated predictive score.

He was referred to palliative radiotherapy because of painful and pruritic skin lesions. His history included two synchronous colorectal adenocarcinomas. Comprehensive next-generation sequencing identified the rectosigmoid tumor as the metastatic source and revealed a pathogenic germline BRCA1 mutation, supporting a precision systemic strategy (olaparib plus pembrolizumab).
