title: Temporal Trends in Six Major Cancers: Implications for Lifestyle-Based Cancer Prevention and Early Detection Across the Life Course.
authors: Sokale I, Rosales O, El-Serag H, Khalaf N, Thrift AP, Adekanmbi V, et al.
abstract: Cancer remains a serious public health challenge in the United States. Six major cancers (female breast, colorectal, liver, lung/bronchus, pancreas, and prostate) account for a substantial proportion of the national cancer burden. Understanding the changes in the incidence of these cancers over time can provide insights for prevention and control. This study examined temporal trends in the cancer incidence according to age at onset and stage at diagnosis. This population-based study analyzed data from the United States Cancer Statistics database for 2001-2023, including all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Joinpoint regression was used to estimate annual percent changes (APCs) and average annual percent changes (AAPCs), with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs), based on age-adjusted incidence rates per 100,000 people. Of note, incidence rates from 2020 data were excluded from the Joinpoint models because COVID-19 pandemic disruptions affected cancer screening, diagnosis, and reporting. From 2001 to 2023, the incidence of lung and colorectal cancers declined, particularly among older adults (aged ≥50 years) (lung cancer: AAPC -2.09; 95% CI: -2.27, -1.90; colorectal cancer AAPC -2.70; 95% CI: -2.83, -2.56). In contrast, the incidence of colorectal, pancreatic, and breast cancers increased among younger adults (aged <50 years), whereas the incidence of liver and lung cancer declined. Moreover, prostate cancer incidence declined over time despite modest rebound in recent years (AAPC 1.83; 95% CI: 0.53, 3.14). Stage-specific analyses revealed increasing rates of early-stage diagnoses for several cancers, while late-stage cancer incidence increased for pancreatic and colorectal cancers (especially among younger adults). Cancer incidence varied substantially by cancer type, age, and stage at diagnosis. The rising incidence of colorectal, pancreatic, and breast cancers among younger adults underscores the need for continued research into risk factors, early detection, and prevention strategies.

title: A Pilot Head-to-Head Comparison of Two Bisulfite Conversion Kits for NGS-Based DNA Methylation Analysis of Liquid Biopsy Samples from Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Mazouji O, Ouhajjou A, Incitti R, Nejjari C, David M, Karlyle MV, et al.
abstract: Given the important role of early detection in improving cancer outcomes, epigenetic alterations, particularly DNA methylation, have emerged as powerful biomarkers for cancer screening and diagnosis. However, methylation profiling of cfDNA (circulating free DNA) presents particular technical challenges because cfDNA is typically present at very low concentrations and is highly fragmented. Bisulfite conversion, although essential for distinguishing methylated from unmethylated cytosines, can further compromise DNA integrity through chemical-induced loss of DNA during purification steps. Inadequate conversion or excessive DNA loss may consequently reduce library complexity, increase DNA duplication rates, and negatively affect mapping efficiency and downstream sequencing quality. Therefore, optimizing bisulfite conversion is particularly important for reliable methylation profiling of low-input cfDNA. The effectiveness of these diagnostic approaches relies on the accurate detection of DNA methylation patterns, which is fundamentally dependent on the efficiency of bisulfite conversion of genomic DNA. This pilot study aims to compare the performance of two widely used bisulfite conversion kits, namely the EpiTect Bisulfite (EpiTect) Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) and the EZ DNA Methylation (Zymo) Kit (Zymo Research, Irvine, CA, USA), in the context of plasma-derived cfDNA methylation profiling using five samples, including two plasma samples from metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) patients collected at the Department of Gastrointestinal Oncology at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, in Houston, TX, USA, and two plasma samples from healthy donors (controls) purchased from Innovative Research (Novi, MI, USA), along with one control DNA sample (Corriel NA12878-N88). Our objective was to evaluate and compare their conversion efficiency, mapping efficiency (percentage of mapped and unmapped reads), duplication rate, and distribution of methylated cytosines in CpG, CHG, and CHH contexts. Our results indicate that samples processed using the Zymo kit consistently outperformed those treated with the EpiTect kit across multiple performance metrics. The Zymo-treated samples yielded a higher concentration of cfDNA following bisulfite conversion (125.34 nM vs. 45.60 nM in samples processed with the Epitect kit). Additionally, the Zymo kit achieved a higher average bisulfite conversion efficiency (99.3% vs. 95.7%), as well as a significantly higher average mapping rate (94.86% vs. 72.4%), with fewer unmapped reads and lower duplication rates. Head-to-head comparison of Bismark methylation calls across the same reference regions showed high concordance between the two protocols. The SEPT9 region was strongly hypermethylated with both protocols (100% with EpiTect and approximately 94% with Zymo), whereas the BMP3 region was predominantly unmethylated (approximately 4% with EpiTect and 7% with Zymo). These findings suggest that the Zymo kit demonstrated improved performance under the conditions evaluated for cfDNA methylation analysis compared to the EpiTect protocol. Further investigation using a larger number of samples is needed to validate our findings.

Angiotensin II (AT-II) may improve TNR by inducing vasoconstriction primarily in arteries supplying healthy liver parenchyma. title: Cross-Dataset Genomic Proximity and Functional Association of FOXA1 and TET2 at Hypomethylated Regulatory Regions in Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Lyu D, Lyu B, Qin Q, Gao C, Hu J, Cao F, et al.
abstract: Aberrant DNA methylation plays a critical role in the development and progression of colorectal cancer (CRC). However, how pioneer transcription factors are associated with DNA demethylases at cis-regulatory elements and influence tumor-associated transcriptional programs remains poorly understood. This study investigated the functional relationship between FOXA1 and TET2, an enzyme that converts 5-methylcytosine (5mC) to 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC), and its association with epigenetic features and malignant phenotypes in CRC. Public DNA methylation, ChIP-seq, and transcriptomic datasets were integrated with genome-wide genomic-proximity analyses. The association between FOXA1 and TET2 was evaluated by co-immunoprecipitation. FOXA1 and TET2 were individually or simultaneously depleted in HCT116 and SW480 cells, followed by proliferation and invasion assays. In addition, RNA-seq profiles were generated from control, FOXA1-KD, TET2-KD, and Double-KD HCT116 cells to characterize the resulting transcriptional changes. CRC-associated hypomethylated regions showed preferential enrichment of FOXA1- and TET2-associated ChIP-seq signals. title: Post-Translational Modification Crosstalk in Gastric Cancer: Molecular Switches, Signaling Networks, and Therapeutic Opportunities, with Comparative Insights from Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Wang J, Chen X, Wang Y, Han Y
abstract: Gastric cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related death, and its malignant behavior is driven in large part by dysregulated post-translational modifications (PTMs). Yet the prevailing tendency to study individual modifications in isolation has obscured a defining feature of PTM biology: modifications frequently interact, competing for the same residue or cooperating across residues to form regulatory switches that dictate protein fate. This review synthesizes the PTM crosstalk framework in gastric cancer around three principal axes-phosphorylation-ubiquitination relays, SUMOylation-ubiquitination interplay, and metabolic coupling through lactylation-and traces how these axes translate into the hallmarks of proliferation, metastasis, therapeutic resistance, and immune evasion. The framework is further extended to colorectal cancer to separate shared regulatory principles from cancer-specific switches. Central to this account is the proposition that oncogenic output is governed not by any single modification but by the balance among competing and cooperating marks, and that the switch enzymes maintaining this balance constitute the most informative therapeutic targets. Translating this view into therapy will require selective degraders and inhibitors, crosstalk-aware biomarkers, and systematic multi-omics maps of the modification network.
cn_title: 胃癌翻译后修饰串扰：分子开关、信号网络与治疗机会及结直肠癌比较启示

title: Treatment Allocation and Survival Outcomes in Potentially Resectable Colorectal Liver Metastases: A Real-World Cohort Study from Thailand.
authors: Jaseanchiun W, Kato H, Phettool C, Suwannakij C, Athigakunagron J, Pantanakul S, et al.
abstract: Liver resection is a potentially curative treatment for colorectal liver metastases (CRLM), but some potentially resectable patients may not reach specialist hepatobiliary assessment. This study evaluated treatment allocation, survival outcomes, and the potential gap between resectability and actual liver resection in a real-world Thai cohort. We retrospectively reviewed 265 patients with CRLM treated at a tertiary-care hospital in Thailand between 2012 and 2022. Patients were classified into liver resection (LR; Median OS was 59 months in the LR group and 23 months in the NLR group. In the NLR group, age < 65 years (adjusted HR 0.663, 95% CI 0.458-0.960; A clinically relevant subgroup of non-resected patients met predefined criteria for potential resectability on retrospective specialist reassessment. These findings should be interpreted as real-world treatment-allocation observations rather than evidence of a causal survival benefit of LR and support early hepatobiliary referral and repeated multidisciplinary assessment of resectability.
cn_title: 泰国真实世界队列：潜在可切除结直肠癌肝转移的治疗分配与生存结局

title: Minimally Invasive Surgical Approaches to Colorectal Cancer: Learning Curve and Cost Considerations.
authors: Maini A, Gallant BP, Hu A, Peponis T
abstract: Minimally invasive surgical (MIS) techniques have fundamentally transformed the management of colorectal cancer. Since the early 1990s, the field has rapidly evolved, shifting from initial concerns about oncologic safety to the widespread adoption of both laparoscopic and robotic surgeries. Specifically, laparoscopic approaches to colorectal cancer resection are now widely adopted and supported by robust randomized controlled trial evidence demonstrating favorable perioperative outcomes with equivalent oncologic results compared to open surgery. Robotic-assisted platforms have gained increasing adoption; however, their incremental clinical and oncologic benefit over laparoscopy remains under active investigation. As these technologies have been implemented, significant challenges related to surgical proficiency and economic sustainability have emerged. MIS approaches, particularly laparoscopic colectomies and proctectomies, involve steep, multidimensional learning curves that require substantial case volumes to achieve technical mastery and consistent clinical outcomes. Simultaneously, the rising costs of robotic platforms raise important considerations regarding the financial sustainability of healthcare systems. While robotic surgery may reduce certain downstream costs through shorter hospital stays and fewer complications, its substantially higher upfront operative costs and uncertain cost-effectiveness relative to laparoscopy require careful consideration, and access remains a barrier, particularly for patients without private insurance. This narrative review describes the evolution of MIS in colorectal cancer treatment and examines the dual considerations of the surgical learning curve and hospital cost implications.
cn_title: 结直肠癌微创手术入路：学习曲线与成本考量

grade_rationale: 叙述性综述，无原始数据或定量合并，仅归纳现有RCT与成本证据，不足以直接改变实践。

title: Integrating Tumour Biology into Surgical Decision-Making for Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: A Real-World Cohort Analysis Adapted for Clinical Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Gonçalves MPC, Trocoli-Couto PHFS, Marchiodi AH, de Carvalho LTB, Yamashita YPH, Lima HA, et al.
abstract: Metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) is biologically heterogeneous, resulting in variable outcomes despite similar disease burden and treatment. Although metastasectomy offers the only potentially curative option for selected patients, surgical selection remains largely anatomy based. Whether biological factors continue to influence outcomes after resection remains unclear. We retrospectively analysed 290 consecutive patients with stage IV colorectal adenocarcinoma treated at a Brazilian tertiary oncology centre (2003-2019). Tumour sidedness, RAS mutational status, and metastasectomy were evaluated for overall survival (OS) using Kaplan-Meier analysis and multivariable Cox regression in the overall cohort and the metastasectomy subgroup. Median OS was 40.2 months. Patients undergoing metastasectomy had significantly longer survival than those managed non-operatively (median 116.0 vs. 30.1 months; 5-year OS 63% vs. 14%; Tumour biology remains a dominant determinant of survival in mCRC even after metastasectomy. These data challenge purely anatomy-based surgical paradigms and support integrating molecular and clinicopathological risk into post-resection management and treatment planning.
cn_title: 整合肿瘤生物学特征指导转移性结直肠癌手术决策：真实世界队列分析

grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列样本量中等（290例），但直接挑战纯解剖学手术范式，具较强实践启示潜力。

title: Disease- and Region-Specific Molecular Patterns Involving miRNAs and Associated Signalling Pathways and Epithelial Cell-Fate Responses in PSC-Associated Ulcerative Colitis.
authors: Łaba A, Abramczyk J, Lubkowski M, Rogoza-Mateja W, Milkiewicz M, Knap O, et al.
abstract: Patients with primary sclerosing cholangitis-associated ulcerative colitis (PSC-UC) have an elevated risk of colorectal cancer compared with ulcerative colitis (UC), but the molecular mechanisms linking chronic inflammation to epithelial cell fate remain unclear. The present study investigated disease- and region-specific molecular patterns involving miRNAs and associated PI3K/AKT, STAT3, and NF-κB signalling pathways. miR-21, miR-181a, miR-181b, and key pathway components were analysed in paired ascending and sigmoid colon biopsies from patients with PSC, PSC-UC, UC, and controls. Functional effects were examined in HT-29 and NCM460D cells, and circulating miRNAs, including miR-155, were assessed. UC was characterised by marked miR-181a upregulation and PI3K/AKT activation, whereas PSC-UC showed reduced PDCD4, divergent p65 regulation, and altered miR-181a/miR-181b coordination. In NCM460D cells, miR-181a and miR-181b reduced viability, promoted apoptosis, impaired cell-cycle progression, and decreased PDCD4, p-AKT, and p-STAT3; miR-181b additionally reduced CYLD. Serum miR-155 was elevated in PSC-UC compared with UC and showed the strongest individual discriminatory capacity. Random forest analysis and an exploratory multivariable serum miRNA profile showed discriminatory potential. These findings support disease- and region-specific molecular patterns involving miRNAs and associated signalling pathways linked to epithelial cell-fate responses in PSC-UC and highlight molecular differences between PSC-UC and conventional UC.
cn_title: PSC相关溃疡性结肠炎中miRNA及信号通路与上皮细胞命运的区域特异性分子模式
insight: 揭示PSC-UC与普通UC的miRNA/信号通路差异及血清miR-155的鉴别价值，提示PSC-UC癌变风险机制独特，为肠癌监测提供分子线索。

abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) arises within a complex microbial ecosystem that may influence carcinogenesis, tumor immunity, and therapeutic response. This is particularly relevant in metastatic disease, where most tumors are microsatellite-stable/mismatch repair-proficient (MSS/pMMR) and derive little meaningful benefit from immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) monotherapy. title: Acquired Chemoresistance in Colorectal Cancer: Therapy-Induced Signalling Adaptation, Cellular Plasticity and Mechanism-Guided Therapeutic Strategies.
authors: Bartusik-Aebisher D, Wilk I, George BP, Aebisher D
abstract: The effectiveness of chemotherapy in colorectal cancer (CRC) is significantly reduced by acquired chemoresistance to 5-fluorouracil (5-FU), oxaliplatin and irinotecan. This structured narrative review synthesises mechanistic, preclinical, translational and clinical evidence underlying resistance to these agents. Distinct drug-specific molecular mechanisms can underlie acquired chemoresistance, whereas shared adaptive survival processes support treatment persistence and may, in some settings, contribute to the emergence of stable acquired resistance. 5-FU resistance is associated with factors such as altered thymidylate synthase activity, drug catabolism, nucleotide metabolism and apoptosis avoidance, whereas resistance to oxaliplatin involves enhanced deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) repair, detoxification, reduced platinum accumulation and metabolic adaptation. insight: 系统梳理5-FU/奥沙利铂/伊立替康获得性耐药的药物特异性与共享适应机制，为克服耐药、优化肠癌（含肝转移）化疗及联合策略提供机制导向路线图。

title: Sacral Neural Crest-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Promote Pelvic Ganglion Repair Through Anti-Pyroptotic Effects Involving ANXA1-FPR2 Signaling.
authors: Yang T, Liu W, Wang H, Wu Y, Ma Y, Wang X, et al.
abstract: Pelvic autonomic nerve injury is a major cause of postoperative bowel dysfunction, yet effective strategies for restoring damaged pelvic ganglia remain lacking. Here, we demonstrate that extracellular vesicles derived from human pluripotent stem cell-derived sacral neural crest cells (Sacral NC-EVs) promote pelvic neuroregeneration by suppressing oxidative stress-induced pyroptosis. In a rat model of major pelvic ganglion (MPG) injury, local administration of Sacral NC-EVs improved gastrointestinal motility and partially restored rectal neural innervation and epithelial barrier integrity. Mechanistic analyses showed that MPG injury increased oxidative stress and activated the NLRP3-caspase-1-GSDMD pyroptosis pathway, whereas Sacral NC-EVs attenuated both responses. Comparisons across EV sources showed that Sacral NC-EVs more effectively suppressed oxidative stress and pyroptosis and increased PGP9.5-positive and ChAT-positive neuronal areas than mesenchymal stem cell-derived EVs and vagal neural crest-derived EVs. Proteomic and functional analyses implicated EV-associated annexin A1 (ANXA1) as one contributor to the antioxidant and anti-pyroptotic effects of Sacral NC-EVs through FPR2 signaling. Collectively, our findings support Sacral NC-EVs as a promising cell-free strategy for pelvic neural repair by targeting the oxidative stress-pyroptosis axis.
cn_title: 骶神经嵴来源细胞外囊泡通过ANXA1-FPR2信号抑制焦亡促进盆腔神经节修复

title: Prior abdominal surgery characteristics predict adhesion phenotype and adhesiolysis in robotic colorectal cancer resection while preserving short-term outcomes.
authors: Sueda T, Kagawa Y, Nishimura J, Hata T, Kitakaze M, Kobayashi Y, et al.
abstract: Prior abdominal surgery (PAS) is common in patients undergoing robotic colorectal cancer (CRC) resection. Most studies have evaluated PAS as a binary exposure, leaving unclear which specific PAS characteristics are associated with technically relevant adhesions, adhesiolysis, and operative efficiency in robotic surgery. This retrospective cohort study included 746 consecutive patients who underwent robotic CRC resection at a single institution between January 2018 and December 2025; 200 patients (26.8%) had a history of PAS. Among patients with PAS, associations between detailed PAS characteristics and intraoperative adhesion phenotype or adhesiolysis were assessed using multivariable regression analyses. Short-term outcomes between PAS and non-PAS patients were compared after 1:1 propensity score matching using age, sex, body mass index, American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status, preoperative treatment, primary tumor site, and clinical T stage. In the PAS cohort, adhesions were observed in 46.0 and 36.0% required adhesiolysis. Cancer-related PAS (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 3.78, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.36-11.4; p = 0.01) and prior open surgery (aOR 6.06, 95% CI 2.47-16.9; p < 0.01) independently predicted abdominal wall adhesions. Among adhesion-positive PAS patients, middle (aOR 15.2, 95% CI 1.34-172.9; p = 0.02) and lower abdominal PAS (aOR 12.2, 95% CI 3.05-48.9; p < 0.01) independently predicted adhesiolysis. After matching, operative time, console time, blood loss, conversion, and severe complications were comparable between groups. Mean differences were small for operative time (16.2 min, 95% CI -8.5 to 40.9), console time (10.6 min, 95% CI -7.6 to 28.8), and blood loss (12.9 mL, 95% CI -7.4 to 33.2). Specific PAS characteristics, rather than PAS presence alone, were associated with technically relevant adhesions and adhesiolysis in robotic CRC resection. Despite increased technical burden, short-term outcomes remained comparable, supporting a more individualized interpretation of prior surgical history in robotic colorectal surgery.
cn_title: 既往腹部手术特征预测机器人结直肠癌切除术中粘连表型及粘连松解并保持短期结局
insight: 该研究揭示既往腹部手术的具体特征（而非仅有无）可预测机器人结直肠癌术中粘连及粘连松解需求，但短期结局仍相当，提示应个体化评估手术史以优化术前规划。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列研究，样本量较大但缺乏外部验证，对临床实践有参考价值但不足以直接改变指南。

title: Incidence of parastomal hernia after open versus minimally invasive surgery: a comparative systematic review.
authors: Bellato V, Moojen TB, Gooszen JAH, Buskens CJ, Bemelman WA
abstract: Peristomal bulging and external stoma prolapse are the most common long-term complications following stoma formation. This systematic review aims to describe available evidence on the incidence of parastomal hernia, subcutaneous prolapse and external stomal prolapse following open versus minimally invasive intestinal resections with definitive stoma formation. In this systematic review and meta-analysis, a literature search was performed to include studies published in the last 15 years on intestinal resections with a definitive ileostomy or colostomy formation and a follow-up of more than 12 months, reporting on PSH and/or subcutaneous prolapse and/or external stoma prolapse after laparoscopic or robotic, and open surgery. The incidence of PSH after open versus minimally invasive surgery was the primary outcome, and secondary outcomes included other stoma-related complications such as subcutaneous stoma prolapse and external stoma prolapse, and outcomes. In total six studies (one randomised controlled trial and five observational studies) on 1480 patients with a definitive stoma were included (731 open, 749 laparoscopic). All studies reported PSH as an outcome, no study reported the incidence of subcutaneous prolapse and one study reported on external stoma prolapse. There was consistent trend toward higher PSH rates following laparoscopic resections, both in clinically (RR 1.89 (95% CI 1.39-2.58)) and radiologically (RR 1.70 (95% CI 0.89-3.28)) assessed hernias. Minimally invasive intestinal resection may be associated with a higher incidence of PSH than open surgery, but the certainty of the evidence is very low. Subcutaneous prolapse is seldom recognised as a distinct form of stoma herniation. Clear differentiation is essential, as these conditions differ in their underlying mechanisms and management. PROSPERO CRD420251026395.
cn_title: 开放与微创手术造口旁疝发生率比较的系统综述
insight: 微创肠切除造口旁疝发生率可能高于开放手术，但证据质量极低；提示需重新评估微创造口策略并规范皮下脱垂定义。

title: Association between technical difficulty and patient prognosis after transanal total mesorectal excision for middle and low rectal cancer: a multicenter cohort study.
authors: Chen W, Zhu J, Weng H, You J, Lin C, Xu Y, et al.
abstract: Whether technical difficulty influences outcomes after transanal total mesorectal excision (TaTME) for middle and low rectal cancer remains unclear. This study evaluated the association between technical difficulty and patient outcomes. This multicenter retrospective cohort study included 210 consecutive patients with middle and low rectal cancer who underwent TaTME at three centers in China. A five-item technical difficulty score was constructed using male sex, body mass index ≥ 25 kg/m Overall, 130 patients were classified into the low technical difficulty group and 80 into the high technical difficulty group. The high technical difficulty group had a longer operative time (249.0 ± 60.0 vs. 220.3 ± 50.1 min, P < 0.001), but major short-term outcomes did not differ significantly. The 3-year DFS and OS rates were 80.2% and 89.0%, respectively. Forty postoperative recurrences were recorded, mainly distant metastases, with most occurring within 2 years. Overall recurrence (17.7% vs. 21.2%, P = 0.588) and local recurrence (3.8% vs. 2.5%, P = 0.711) were comparable between groups. High technical difficulty was not independently associated with DFS (HR 1.06, 95% CI 0.57-2.00, P = 0.849) or OS (HR 1.21, 95% CI 0.52-2.81, P = 0.664). Technical difficulty in TaTME was mainly reflected by prolonged operative time and was not significantly associated with increased local recurrence or reduced 3-year DFS/OS. Early surveillance for systemic recurrence remains important.
cn_title: 经肛全直肠系膜切除术技术难度与中低位直肠癌患者预后的多中心队列研究
insight: TaTME技术难度主要延长手术时间，但不增加局部复发或降低3年DFS/OS，提示高难度病例仍可安全实施，术后应重点监测远处转移。
grade_rationale: 多中心回顾性队列样本量适中（210例），但非随机设计且缺乏外部验证，对临床实践影响有限。

title: Early functional reactivity to a CEACAM5 x CD3 T cell bispecific antibody in solid tumors associates with baseline immune contexture rather than target antigen density alone.
authors: Wilson S, Silva A, Serrano-Serrano ML, Karanikas V, Waldhauer I, Schoenle A, et al.
abstract: Clinical translation of T cell bispecific (TCB) therapies in solid tumors is hindered by the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and intratumoral heterogeneity, features poorly captured by standard preclinical models. We applied an integrated translational framework, combining humanized mouse models, a patient-derived ex vivo organ culture (EVOC) platform, and Phase 1 clinical trial data (ClinTrials.gov identifier NCT03539484), to define the biologic determinants of functional reactivity to a CEACAM5 x CD3 TCB. In humanized mice bearing CEA-positive tumors, the TCB inhibited tumor growth and increased intratumoral T cell infiltration. EVOC, which preserves native 3D tumor architecture and endogenous tumor immune contexture, revealed rapid TCB-induced secretion of IFNγ, IL-2, TNFα, and IL-10 across colorectal, pancreatic, and non-small cell lung cancer patient tumors, with substantial inter-patient heterogeneity. Higher baseline CD3+ T cell infiltration trended with a greater magnitude of cytokine release in patient tumors treated with the TCB ex vivo versus tumors with lower CD3+ T cell infiltration. Baseline tumor CEA expression did not associate with functional response in EVOC. In the Phase 1 trial, on-treatment peripheral cytokine induction was greater in patients with immune-inflamed or -excluded tumors as compared to those with immune-desert tumors. EVOC recapitulated the high inter-patient functional heterogeneity observed clinically, with a coefficient of variation for IFNγ of 135% in EVOC versus 190% in patients, compared with 52% in humanized mice. These findings suggest that early pharmacodynamic responses to CEACAM5 x CD3 TCB associate with a pre-existing tumor immune state rather than target antigen expression alone and support integration of patient-derived ex vivo models for modeling clinically-relevant pharmacodynamics.
cn_title: CEACAM5×CD3双特异性抗体早期功能反应与基线免疫状态而非靶抗原密度相关
insight: 该研究揭示实体瘤对CEACAM5×CD3 TCB的早期药效取决于基线免疫浸润而非CEA表达，提示肠癌肝转移治疗需结合免疫分型，并支持EVOC平台用于临床前药效评估。
grade_rationale: 研究整合人源化小鼠、患者来源离体器官培养和I期临床试验数据，但样本量有限且为早期转化研究，暂不足以改变临床实践。

title: Liver Transplantation for Unresectable Colorectal Liver Metastases: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Survival Outcomes.
authors: Valagni G, Pereira RA, Lenz G, Barcellos G, de Castria TB
abstract: Palliative chemotherapy for unresectable colorectal liver metastases (uCRLM) yields poor long-term survival. Liver transplantation (LT) is an emerging curative option for highly selected patients with liver-only disease. We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA guidelines. Electronic databases were searched for studies evaluating LT for uCRLM. Overall survival (OS) from comparative studies was pooled using random-effects models. Risk of bias was assessed using Cochrane RoB 2 and ROBINS-I V2. Potential patient overlap between cohorts from the same transplant programs was assessed and, where present, only 1 report per cohort contributed to pooling. Seventeen studies were included, with 3 comparative studies providing data for meta-analysis. Pooled analysis favored LT over best alternative therapies (HR 0.45, 95% CI 0.28-0.72; P = .0009; I² = 3%). This estimate was not robust: the TransMet randomized trial contributed 63% of the pooled weight, and its exclusion rendered the effect nonsignificant (HR 0.64, 95% CI 0.30-1.35). Comparators were clinically heterogeneous, spanning chemotherapy alone, mixed best alternative therapy, and ALPPS, so the pooled hazard ratio should not be read as a single transferable estimate of transplant benefit. Narrative synthesis indicated 5-year OS rates reached 83% following strict biological selection. Post-transplant recurrence was frequent (72%-81.5%) but often amenable to curative-intent management. Referral data, available only from a conference abstract, suggest that approximately 10% of evaluated patients ultimately undergo LT. In highly selected patients with permanently unresectable, liver-confined CRLM, LT is associated with a survival advantage, although the pooled estimate rests principally on a single randomized trial and should not be generalized across the clinically distinct comparators from which it was derived. The benefit appears to be driven by identifying a ``biological elite'' through stringent selection and aggressive multidisciplinary management of recurrences. PROSPERO registration: CRD42025124542.
cn_title: 肝移植治疗不可切除结直肠癌肝转移：系统综述与荟萃分析
insight: 肝移植为严格筛选的不可切除肝局限结直肠癌肝转移患者带来生存获益，但证据主要依赖单一RCT，需强调生物学筛选与多学科复发管理。
grade_rationale: 系统综述/Meta分析，纳入17项研究但仅3项比较性研究，合并效应主要由单一RCT驱动，证据稳健性不足，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Japanese-style dietary patterns, mortality, and selected cancer outcomes in Japanese populations: a systematic review integrating meta-analysis, food-group loading visualization, and qualitative synthesis.
authors: Yu T, Yamagishi M, Okoshi K, Nomura S, Yamamoto N, Tsugane S
abstract: Japanese-style dietary patterns (DPs) are often regarded as healthy, but the food-group combinations needed to develop health-oriented Japanese-style DPs remain unclear. This systematic review synthesized associations between predefined (a priori) Japanese-style DPs and health outcomes in Japanese populations and used data-derived (a posteriori) DPs to examine outcome-specific heterogeneity in food-group composition and loadings. PubMed/MEDLINE and Web of Science Core Collection were searched for observational studies. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted for comparable a priori Japanese-style DPs using adjusted hazard ratios (HRs) comparing the highest and lowest score categories. A posteriori DPs derived by principal component analysis or factor analysis were visualized using reported estimates, investigator-assigned pattern names, relative similarity to the Japanese Diet Index-9 (JDI-9) reference profile, and food-group loadings. Of 37 reports retained in the review, 12 longitudinal reports contributed to meta-analyses or food-group loading visualizations, and 25 were synthesized qualitatively. Across 3 independent studies contributing 5 analytic estimates per outcome, pooled HRs comparing the highest and lowest score categories suggested lower all-cause mortality (HR: 0.88; 95% CI: 0.83, 0.93; I
cn_title: 日本式饮食模式与日本人群死亡率及部分癌症结局：系统综述与Meta分析
insight: 日本式饮食模式与全因死亡率降低相关，但癌症结局证据有限；提示饮食因素在肠癌预防研究中需结合食物组构成精细刻画。
grade_rationale: 系统综述/Meta分析证据等级较高，但聚焦日本人群饮食与总死亡率，癌症结局证据不足且非肠癌特异，难以直接改变临床实践。

title: Gemella morbillorum promotes colorectal tumorigenesis through barrier disruption and invasion-dependent DNA damage.
authors: Meyers M, Medina Evora G, Molina Tijeras JA, Brauer M, Benzarti M, Jans M, et al.
abstract: Bacteria are increasingly recognized as contributors to cancer, yet the underlying mechanisms remain unclear for most species. Here, we find that Gemella morbillorum (Gm) is enriched in feces and tumor tissues from patients with colorectal cancer (CRC) and reveal a multi-step host-pathogen mechanism that promotes colorectal tumorigenesis. In mouse models of CRC, Gm suppresses IL-22 production by type 3 innate lymphoid cells (ILC3s), impairing intestinal barrier function and facilitating bacterial translocation to early neoplastic lesions. At the tumor site, Gm utilizes an ANXA2-dependent, clathrin-mediated pathway to invade CRC cells. Gm induces profound lipid remodeling, characterized by the accumulation of oxidation-prone fatty acids and enhanced lipid peroxidation, which contributes to invasion-dependent DNA damage. Inhibition of lipid peroxidation attenuates Gm-induced DNA damage, functionally linking lipid oxidative stress to genotoxicity. Together, these findings identify Gm as a candidate onco-pathogen in CRC that uses multiple mechanisms to disarm the intestinal barrier and trigger genotoxicity.
cn_title: 微小孪生球菌通过屏障破坏和侵袭依赖性DNA损伤促进结直肠癌发生
insight: 揭示Gm作为促癌共生菌通过抑制ILC3-IL-22轴破坏屏障、经ANXA2入侵并诱导脂质过氧化DNA损伤，为肠癌机制研究和靶向干预提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 机制研究虽设计严谨但尚处临床前阶段，未提供临床干预证据，暂不改变实践。

title: Zuojin Wan reverses cetuximab resistance in KRAS-mutant colorectal cancer via the NRF2-GCH1/CoQ and DHODH/CoQ axes.
authors: Liu X, Chen Y, Jiang Y, Sui H, Liang T, Meng J, et al.
journal: Phytomedicine : International Journal of Phytotherapy and Phytopharmacology
abstract: Cetuximab (CET), a monoclonal antibody targeting the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), serves as a cornerstone therapeutic option for advanced colorectal cancer (CRC). However, patients with KRAS-mutant CRC present inherent resistance to CET, which directly compromises its clinical efficacy and therapeutic benefits. Zuojin Wan (ZJW), a classic traditional Chinese medicine formula consisting of Coptis chinensis Franch. and Evodia rutaecarpa (Juss.) Benth., has been documented to exert potent antitumor activity; nevertheless, its potential role in reversing CET resistance in KRAS-mutated CRC and the underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly defined. This study aimed to investigate the efficacy of ZJW in overcoming CET resistance in KRAS-mutated CRC and further characterize its key molecular targets and regulatory mechanisms. In vitro experiments were conducted using two KRAS-mutated CRC cell lines, HCT116 and SW620. The synergistic antiproliferative effect of ZJW combined with CET was assessed via CCK-8 assay and colony formation assay. Ferroptosis induction mediated by the combination treatment was verified by measuring lipid peroxidation, glutathione (GSH) depletion, ferrous ion (Fe2+) accumulation, and observing characteristic mitochondrial morphological alterations using transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels were detected to evaluate intracellular oxidative stress. Transcriptome sequencing, Western blot analysis and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) were performed to explore the underlying molecular mechanisms, while plasmid transfection and quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) were carried out for functional validation. A nude mouse subcutaneous xenograft model was established to evaluate the antitumor efficacy of the combined treatment in vivo, and immunohistochemical (IHC) staining was performed to detect the expression of relevant proteins. The primary bioactive components of ZJW were identified by mass spectrometry, and network pharmacology analysis was performed to predict the potential interactions between these active components and CRC-related signaling pathways. ZJW synergistically augmented the CET-mediated suppression of KRAS-mutated CRC cell proliferation and triggered significant ferroptosis, as evidenced by elevated lipid peroxidation, reduced GSH levels, increased Fe2+ accumulation, shrunken mitochondria with condensed cristae, and markedly enhanced intracellular oxidative stress. Combination treatment with ZJW and CET significantly downregulated the expression of core proteins involved in the parallel NRF2-GCH1/CoQ and DHODH/CoQ antioxidant axes, thereby disrupting intracellular redox homeostasis. Silencing of NRF2 or DHODH facilitated ferroptosis and sensitized CRC cells to CET, whereas overexpression of these two molecules abolished the synergistic antitumor effect of ZJW plus CET. In the nude mouse xenograft model, the combined regimen notably suppressed tumor growth and decreased tumor weight, and modulated the expression of ferroptosis-associated markers (NRF2, DHODH) and the lipid peroxidation indicator 4-HNE in tumor tissues. Mass spectrometry identified the major bioactive constituents of ZJW, and network pharmacology analysis predicted their potential involvement in multiple CRC-related pathways, including antioxidant defense and ferroptosis regulation. ZJW reverses CET resistance in KRAS-mutated CRC by inhibiting the parallel NRF2-GCH1/CoQ and DHODH/CoQ antioxidant axes to induce ferroptosis. This study provides a solid scientific basis for the clinical translation of ZJW as an adjuvant therapeutic strategy to boost the efficacy of CET in CRC treatment.
cn_title: 左金丸经NRF2-GCH1/CoQ与DHODH/CoQ轴逆转KRAS突变结直肠癌西妥昔单抗耐药
insight: 揭示左金丸通过抑制两条CoQ抗氧化轴诱导铁死亡、逆转KRAS突变肠癌西妥昔单抗耐药，为天然药物增敏抗EGFR治疗提供新靶点。
grade_rationale: 细胞与裸鼠移植瘤层面的机制研究，尚无临床数据，但靶点新颖、具转化潜力。

title: Lactobacillus reuteri attenuates chronic diarrhea by modulating microbiota homeostasis and macrophage polarization through the cGAS/STING pathway dependent on D-lactate-mediated mitochondrial function.
authors: Cheng X, Zhang Y, Li C, Jiang M, Song J, Fang F, et al.
abstract: Chronic diarrhea (CD) severely affects patients' quality of life and is linked to ulcerative colitis, inflammatory bowel disease, and colorectal cancer. Gut microbiota dysbiosis plays a crucial role in intestinal health, with Lactobacillus reuteri emerging as a key regulator. However, its role in chronic diarrhea remains unclear. In this study, we observed macaques with spontaneous diarrhea and investigated microbial and metabolic changes. We also developed a chronic diarrhea mouse model using dextran sulfate sodium. CD group of both models revealed a significant reduction of L. reuteri. L. reuteri transplantation alleviates intestinal injury in CD by secreting D-lactate and modulates macrophage polarization. L. reuteri-derived D-lactate binds to IARS2 in intestinal epithelial macrophages, reducing mitochondrial IARS2 activation and suppressing cGAS-STING pathway activation. This preserves mitochondrial function while decreasing M1 macrophage polarization. Our research revealed the significance of microbiota dysbiosis in CD with both non-human primate and murine model, and highlighted the critical role of L. reuteri, which is conducted with D-lactate-mediated modulation of macrophage function and offered new insights into probiotic therapy for CD.
cn_title: 罗伊氏乳杆菌通过D-乳酸介导的cGAS/STING通路调控巨噬细胞极化缓解慢性腹泻
insight: 揭示罗伊氏乳杆菌经D-乳酸-IARS2-cGAS/STING轴调控巨噬细胞极化缓解慢性腹泻，为肠道炎症相关肠癌发生机制及益生菌干预提供新线索。
grade_rationale: 研究基于猕猴和小鼠模型，机制深入但属临床前基础研究，尚无人体证据，暂不具备改变临床实践潜力。

title: Multiscale transformer model based on Raman spectroscopy detection in diagnosis of colorectal cancer.
authors: Xu J, Zheng X, Hu Y, Li C, Chen X, Dai S, et al.
journal: Spectrochimica Acta. Part A, Molecular and Biomolecular Spectroscopy
abstract: There is currently a lack of low-cost, nonintrusive methods for colorectal adenocarcinoma (CRA) detection. Moreover, the application of Raman spectroscopy (RS)-based CRA detection is limited due to its high noise levels and low characterization abilities. Propose a method for the early screening of CRA based on RS and deep learning techniques. An MS-Former (multiscale transformer) method was constructed by combining multiscale convolution and self-attention mechanisms to adapt spectral scenarios based on RS and surface-enhanced Raman spectra (SERS) at the cellular and patient serum levels, respectively. Furthermore, Raman spectral critical frequency test (classifying the spectrum extracted from each threshold by linear discriminant analysis (LDA) using the classical machine learning method) was performed and the concerning Raman shifts were screened in the identification process of different samples. At the cellular level, the proposed model can identify normal cells and cancer cells at an accuracy of 99.12%. At the serum level, for the first time, this model achieved AUC values of 98.45% and 99.40% in identification of adenoma and adenocarcinoma, respectively. When classifying patients into groups of healthy, adenoma, and adenocarcinoma, the single Raman detection and individual level accuracy were 94.78%, 100%, respectively. Matching metabolites were obtained through matching the screened Raman shifts, which greatly improved the interpretability and biological significance of the results. The proposed model can conveniently and rapidly screens patients with colorectal adenomas and adenocarcinomas, requiring no pretreatment and exhibiting extremely high accuracy and low cost.
cn_title: 基于拉曼光谱的多尺度Transformer模型用于结直肠癌诊断
insight: 该研究首次将多尺度Transformer与拉曼光谱结合，实现结直肠腺瘤和腺癌的高精度无创筛查，为肠癌早期诊断提供了低成本、可解释的新工具。
grade_rationale: 研究为单中心方法学开发，样本量有限且缺乏外部验证，但技术新颖且诊断性能优异，暂不足以改变临床实践。

title: CXCL8⁺HIF-1α⁺ macrophages define a disease-associated myeloid state during colorectal tumorigenesis.
authors: Song B, Huo X, Li H, Bahetinuer J, Cao R, Zhong Y, et al.
abstract: Tumor-associated myeloid alterations extend beyond the local microenvironment and involve systemic changes in myeloid development and circulating monocytes. However, how these systemic changes are coordinated with macrophage reprogramming during colorectal tumorigenesis remains unclear. Here, we identified coordinated HIF-1α-associated changes across the monocyte-macrophage compartment in advanced adenoma and early colorectal cancer. Circulating HIF-1α⁺ monocytes were prominently altered in advanced adenoma, whereas colorectal tissues accumulated CXCL8⁺HIF-1α⁺ macrophages with enhanced glycolytic programs. In tumor-bearing mice, common monocyte progenitors and mature monocytes expanded together with HIF-1α⁺ myeloid cells, and macrophages acquired heightened HIF-1α responsiveness to tumor-derived signals. Functional perturbation further demonstrated that macrophage HIF-1α promoted tumor-cell survival, proliferation, and invasion. These findings define the systemic monocytic remodeling and HIF-1α-associated protumor macrophage activity as coordinated features of the myeloid response during colorectal tumorigenesis.
cn_title: CXCL8⁺HIF-1α⁺巨噬细胞定义结直肠肿瘤发生中的疾病相关髓系状态
insight: 揭示结直肠癌发生早期循环单核细胞与组织巨噬细胞的HIF-1α相关协同重塑，为靶向髓系免疫抑制及早期干预提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 机制研究深入但尚处临床前阶段，未提供临床干预数据，暂不具备改变实践的直接证据。

title: Transcriptomic profiling of psychological stress-related genes uncovers prognostic subtypes in colorectal cancer.
authors: Tao R, Tu Y, Shen D
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) represents a major malignancy of the gastrointestinal tract with substantial global morbidity and mortality. Mounting evidence underscores the pivotal role of chronic psychological stress in the pathogenesis of gastrointestinal cancers. Psychological stress-related genes have been implicated in modulating tumor progression and represent promising prognostic biomarkers. Nevertheless, their precise prognostic significance in CRC remains incompletely characterized. We initially identified prognostic genes through univariate Cox regression analysis of The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) dataset. An optimal prognostic signature was subsequently constructed using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression and multivariate Cox analysis. Predictive accuracy was assessed via Kaplan-Meier survival analysis, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis, and calibration curves. Furthermore, immune microenvironment characterization and chemotherapeutic response profiling were performed across risk-stratified subgroups to elucidate underlying biological mechanisms. Of 374 psychological stress-related genes examined, 62 demonstrated significant associations with overall survival (OS). The resulting 11-gene signature achieved area under the curve (AUC) values of 0.711, 0.768, and 0.800 for 1-, 3-, and 5-year OS prediction in the TCGA training cohort, respectively. External validation in three GEO cohorts showed attenuated but reproducible prognostic stratification, with AUCs ranging from approximately 0.56 to 0.63. High-risk patients exhibited significantly reduced survival probability. Computational analyses suggested a higher estimated M2 macrophage fraction and reduced predicted sensitivity to oxaliplatin. We developed and externally evaluated an 11-gene transcriptomic signature related to stress-associated tumor biology in CRC. The signature stratified survival in retrospective cohorts, although external discrimination was moderate. This signature should be regarded as an exploratory research tool rather than a clinically validated assay. Computational analyses generated hypotheses regarding immune contexture and oxaliplatin sensitivity, and UBP1 emerged as a candidate tumor-suppressive regulator. Prospective multicenter validation and mechanistic studies are required before clinical application.
cn_title: 心理应激相关基因转录组分析揭示结直肠癌预后亚型
insight: 基于心理应激基因构建的11基因预后特征可分层结直肠癌生存，但外部验证区分度中等，提示应激相关肿瘤生物学值得探索但尚不能临床转化。
grade_rationale: 回顾性生信分析，外部验证AUC仅0.56-0.63，区分度中等，仅为探索性工具，不足以改变临床实践。

title: Assessment of Prognostic Value of CEACAM5 Expression Using Archival Tissue and Real-World Evidence of Metastatic Patients with NSCLC in United States.
authors: Krishna A, Reich A, Lebovic G, Lubwama R, McCracken A, Ahluwalia MS, et al.
abstract: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is the most common form of lung cancer and is often diagnosed at an advanced stage, leading to poor prognosis. Carcinoembryonic antigen-related cell adhesion molecule 5 (CEACAM5) has emerged as a potential biomarker in colorectal and other gastrointestinal cancer; however, its role in NSCLC remains unexplored. This study evaluated the prognostic role of the CEACAM5 biomarker in metastatic non-squamous (mNSQ) NSCLC using real-world data. CEACAM5 expression was assessed via immunohistochemistry of archival tissue from 336 eligible patients. Real-world overall survival (rwOS) was the primary outcome analyzed across six treatment cohorts. Secondary outcomes included prevalence of CEACAM5 expression (high, moderate, negative) by cohort and tumor site (primary vs. metastatic) and other outcomes including real-world progression-free survival (rwPFS), time to next treatment (rwTTNT), and time to treatment discontinuation (rwTTD). High CEACAM5 expression was observed in approximately 18% of the overall population, with consistent levels observed across both primary and metastatic tumor samples. No significant associations were found between different CEACAM5 expression levels and rwOS, rwPFS, rwTTNT, and rwTTD, across all cohorts. CEACAM5 did not demonstrate prognostic value in this retrospective cohort study of patients with metastatic NSCLC. Further research to confirm our findings is needed.
cn_title: CEACAM5表达在转移性非鳞非小细胞肺癌中的预后价值评估：基于存档组织与真实世界证据
insight: CEACAM5在转移性NSCLC中无预后价值，提示其作为肠癌生物标志物的器官特异性，肠癌肝转移研究需谨慎外推肺癌数据。
grade_rationale: 回顾性真实世界队列，样本量中等（336例），阴性结果且非肠癌研究，实践改变潜力低。

title: Discovery of novel CDK9 inhibitors containing 1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine moiety for treatment of colorectal cancer.
authors: Zhong Y, Xu J, Zhang L, Cheng M, Li N, Liu Y
abstract: In this work, YK-2168 was selected as the lead compound for the development of a series of highly selective CDK9 inhibitors due to its unique 1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine scaffold, which acts as an optimal backbone for targeting the kinase hinge region. The optimized compound B3 exhibited potent inhibitory activities at both enzymatic and cellular levels with satisfactory selectivity. Mechanistic studies revealed that compound B3 induces apoptosis in the HCT116 cells by suppressing the phosphorylation of RNA polymerase II at Ser2 site, which further results in the downregulates the expression of apoptosis-related gene and protein (Mcl-1) and triggers the cleavage of caspase 3 and PARP. Pharmacokinetic studies and in vivo experiments demonstrated that intravenous injection of compound B3 could achieve prominent therapeutic efficacy with a high safety profile. In general, these findings indicate that compound B3 is a promising candidate for CRC treatment.
cn_title: 新型CDK9抑制剂1H-吡咯并[2,3-b]吡啶衍生物治疗结直肠癌的发现
insight: 发现高选择性CDK9抑制剂B3通过抑制RNA聚合酶II磷酸化诱导结直肠癌细胞凋亡，为CRC靶向治疗提供新候选化合物，但需进一步临床前及临床验证。
grade_rationale: 临床前药物开发研究，尚未进入临床试验，但为CDK9靶向治疗提供新思路，暂不改变临床实践。

title: Network pharmacology and single-cell sequencing analysis of gastrodin in anticancer effects against colorectal cancer by regulating key target genes and the tumor immune microenvironment.
authors: Minjun Z, Dong X, Yuting Z, Zhishang L
abstract: Gastrodin is a natural compound with anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antitumor activities; however, its therapeutic role and molecular mechanisms in colorectal cancer (CRC) remain unclear. In this study, we explored the anti-CRC mechanisms of gastrodin through integrated bioinformatics and experimental validation. The potential targets of gastrodin were obtained from public databases. Transcriptomic data of CRC were retrieved from TCGA and GEO datasets, and the differentially expressed genes were screened. The CRC-related genes were subjected to gene-set variation analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis, and the core genes were identified by the LASSO regression, support vector machine, and random forest algorithms, followed by SHAP analysis. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), immune infiltration analysis, consensus clustering, molecular docking, and in vitro experiments were further performed. A total of 628 potential gastrodin targets and 15 overlapping CRC-related genes were identified. Five core hub genes, including NFE2L3, UBE2S, CA9, CCNB1, and CFD, were screened, among which NFE2L3 showed the highest SHAP importance score. The scRNA-seq data indicated cell-type-specific expression patterns of these genes in CRC tissues. Immune infiltration analysis further suggested that gastrodin may regulate the CRC immune microenvironment by regulating the activated B cells, activated CD4⁺ T cells, and other immune cells. Molecular docking revealed favorable binding affinity between gastrodin and the five core proteins. Moreover, NFE2L3 was highly expressed in CRC tissues and cell lines, and its knockdown significantly inhibited the proliferation, migration, and invasion of the tumor cells. Gastrodin may suppress CRC progression by targeting key genes, particularly NFE2L3, and modulating the tumor immune microenvironment. Furthermore, our study has identified the potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets for CRC.
cn_title: 天麻素抗结直肠癌的网络药理学与单细胞测序分析：调控关键靶基因及肿瘤免疫微环境
insight: 该研究通过多组学与实验验证揭示天麻素靶向NFE2L3等核心基因调控免疫微环境抑制结直肠癌，为天然化合物治疗及生物标志物开发提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 研究基于公共数据库与体外实验，缺乏临床验证与体内模型，证据等级有限，但多组学整合与实验验证提供一定转化潜力。

title: AMCOD: Acute Malignant Colorectal Obstruction Dataset.
authors: Huang Y, Chen S, Zhang J, Chen S, Huang L, Chen X
journal: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine
abstract: Automated colorectal segmentation provides a quantitative basis for the preoperative assessment of acute malignant colorectal obstruction. However, existing public datasets predominantly focus on conventional anatomical structures, lacking representation of colorectal cancer-related anatomical phenotypes. This study aims to establish a dedicated dataset for colorectal segmentation in acute malignant colorectal obstruction and provide a benchmark for evaluating segmentation models. A total of 86 eligible cases were retrospectively included to construct AMCOD, with the colorectum annotated into proximal, obstructed, and distal segments. Experiments were conducted to establish a segmentation benchmark on AMCOD, assess the contribution of the three-region supervision strategy through ablation analysis, and evaluate cross-dataset transferability with two public colorectal datasets. Benchmark experiments revealed differences across the three annotated colorectal regions, with the obstructed segment consistently showing the lowest segmentation performance across the evaluated models. Ablation analysis showed that three-region supervision improved obstructed-segment segmentation compared with obstruction-only supervision. Cross-dataset evaluation further showed that the AMCOD-trained model retained colorectal segmentation capability on both evaluated external datasets. This work provides a dataset resource for acute malignant colorectal obstruction segmentation and establishes a benchmark for evaluating segmentation methods under obstruction-related anatomical conditions. To facilitate further research and community development, the proposed dataset is made publicly available at https://github.com/FZU312lab/AMCOD.
cn_title: 急性恶性结直肠梗阻数据集（AMCOD）的构建与分割基准
insight: 发布首个急性恶性结直肠梗阻专用分割数据集，为梗阻性肠癌术前评估提供AI基准，推动梗阻解剖表型量化研究。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性数据集构建研究，样本量86例，无外部验证，但公开数据集有方法学价值，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Surgeon-Derived Design Insights Regarding Real-Time Artificial Intelligence Decision Support for Endoscopic Cancer Surgery.
authors: McCarrick CA, Erzen S, Forgione A, Marescaux J, Cahill RA
abstract: IntroductionReal-time artificial intelligence (AI) decision-support systems are increasingly proposed for use in endoscopic and minimally invasive surgery although how best to present such information intraoperatively is unclear. This study explored surgeon perspectives regarding the user-interface, interpretation and workflow integration of a prototype AI system (CLASSICA-OR) for real-time endoscopic cancer characterization during surgery.MethodsSurgeons specialising in minimally invasive gastrointestinal surgery were asked for their first impressions in their evaluation of the CLASSICA-OR system within a high-fidelity surgical simulation environment. For this, participants viewed prerecorded colonoscopic imagery of significant rectal neoplasia while the AI analysis was applied in real-time to the video. Commentary and responses to semi-structured interview were recorded audiovisually for transcription and analysis using qualitative thematic analysis supported by NVivo (Lumivero).ResultsEighteen surgeons participated, generating rich qualitative data. Four major themes emerged: (1) AI was viewed as a valuable but evolving decision-support tool; (2) institutional culture, governance and commercial realities were recognised as important determinants of adoption; (3) real-time perfusion-based lesion characterisation (foundational to CLASSICA-OR) was considered promising but with specific challenges; and (4) clarity, usability, transparency and workflow compatibility are surgeon priorities in decision-support displays. Participants emphasised minimised cognitive load, preserved surgeon autonomy, clear communication of uncertainty and seamless workflow integration. Preferences differed between simplified binary outputs and more detailed numerical displays supporting the need for adaptable interfaces.ConclusionsSurgeons perceive real-time intraoperative AI decision support as promising but requiring thoughtful user-centred design. They articulate practical development and implementation insights for intraoperative AI systems.
cn_title: 外科医生对术中实时AI决策支持系统的设计见解：CLASSICA-OR原型评估
insight: 外科医生认为实时AI决策支持有前景，但需以用户为中心设计，强调降低认知负荷、保留自主权和透明沟通不确定性，为肠癌术中AI工具开发提供实践指导。
grade_rationale: 基于高保真模拟的定性研究，样本量小（18名外科医生），无临床结局数据，但为AI系统设计提供重要用户视角，暂不足以改变临床实践。

title: Set binding factor 1 (SBF1/MTMR5) as a potential novel target in colorectal cancer: an exploratory immunohistochemical and bioinformatics study.
authors: Alatawi A, Alhabib I, Fagere M, Al-Jindan FA, Alsamman K, Alzahrani FM, et al.
journal: Brazilian Journal of Medical and Biological Research = Revista Brasileira de Pesquisas Medicas E Biologicas
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a major cause of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide, and dysregulation of phosphoinositides signaling pathways plays a critical role in its pathogenesis. The involvement of Set Binding Factor 1 (SBF1; MTMR5), a pseudophosphatase of the myotubularin family in CRC, remains unexplored. This study compiled experimental and bioinformatics approaches to investigate the expression and potential relevance of SBF1 in CRC. Immunohistochemical analysis was performed on CRC tissue specimens and corresponding normal adjacent tissues (NAT), with estimation of SBF1 staining followed by statistical comparison. In parallel, bioinformatics assessed gene ontology and protein-protein interactions, and open CRC datasets were analyzed to assess SBF1 alterations, expression profiles, and survival associations. The results demonstrated a significant overexpression of SBF1 in CRC tissues compared with NAT. Bioinformatics revealed SBF1 as a partner within a functional network enriched in phosphoinositide metabolism. Bioinformatics identified SBF1 genetic alterations in approximately 5% of cases, and survival analysis indicated that wild-type SBF1 could be an unfavorable prognostic marker, as reflected by hazard assessment. Collectively, these findings provided the first experimental evidence that SBF1 is overexpressed in CRC and suggest that it may represent an unrecognized component of phosphoinositide related pathways involved in colorectal tumorigenesis.
cn_title: SBF1/MTMR5在结直肠癌中的表达及预后价值的探索性研究
insight: 首次发现SBF1在结直肠癌中过表达且与不良预后相关，提示其作为磷酸肌醇通路新靶点的潜力，为肠癌机制研究和靶向治疗提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 探索性免疫组化结合生信分析，样本量有限且无外部验证，但首次报道SBF1在CRC中的作用，IF较低，不足以改变临床实践。

title: A simple method for analyzing competitive growth of multiple cell types in xenograft tumors.
authors: Melhuish TA, Adair SJ, Pemberton OS, Bauer TW, Wotton D
abstract: Low take rates and inter-tumor variability in growth rates can limit the effectiveness of mouse xenograft models when comparing between groups. To address this problem we developed a simple method to compare multiple cell types within a single mixed xenograft. Individual cell lines or clones were transduced with a lentiviral vector that includes a unique PCR tag, allowing the use of qPCR to determine the proportion of each tagged cell type within a mixed xenograft tumor. We generated vectors with six distinct PCR tags, and two different selectable markers, and have optimized the approach for determining their relative proportions within a mix. An initial pre-amplification step is used to increase the amount of material for subsequent qPCR reactions. This also removes the bulk of the genomic DNA, increasing the specificity of the qPCR step. Samples are then used for qPCR with specific pairs of primers that distinguish between each of the individual PCR tags, and the relative proportion of each tag is determined relative to that in the starting mix. We have tested this approach for in vitro growth of mixed cell cultures and in an orthotopic cecal xenograft model using a human colon cancer cell line. Since each individual tumor is initiated with a mix of cells, multiple tumors within a single animal can be analyzed separately, and overall tumor size is not important. Similarly, multiple metastatic lesions from the same animal can be analyzed individually. Thus, each tumor provides a direct comparison between individually tagged cell lines or clones. This low throughput "bar-coding" approach is simple and cost effective and has the potential to reduce the number of animals needed for xenograft experiments.
cn_title: 一种分析异种移植瘤中多种细胞类型竞争性生长的简单方法
insight: 建立PCR标签条形码法，可在同一混合移植瘤内直接比较多种细胞亚群的竞争生长，为肠癌肝转移克隆演化研究提供低成本体内定量工具。
grade_rationale: 方法学论文，技术简单低成本但非临床研究，不直接改变临床实践。

title: Associations of food processing and dietary risk factors with colorectal cancer incidence in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study: A cohort study.
authors: Abar L, O'Connell CP, Hong HG, Herrick KA, Kahle L, Lerman JL, et al.
abstract: Ultra-processed foods (UPF) account for >50% of energy intake by US adults. UPF intake can include dietary components linked to lower colorectal cancer (CRC) risk, such as whole grain and dairy products, and others linked to higher CRC risk, such as processed meats, potentially explaining the heterogeneity of evidence for an association between UPF and CRC risk. Our goal was to estimate the associations of UPF and established CRC-related dietary factors, by UPF and non-UPF source, with CRC incidence in a large cohort study. US adults, aged 50-71, who enrolled in the NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study in 1995-96, self-reported dietary intake using a food frequency questionnaire (FFQ). Median UPF intake was 293 g/1000 kcal/day or 43% of daily energy intake. We assigned disaggregated FFQ items to Nova classification and categorized UPF intake (g/1000 kcal/day) into sex-specific quintiles. Participants who were cancer-free at baseline (N = 461,682) were followed for cancer incidence through 2018, and 10,075 colorectal adenocarcinoma cases were diagnosed. We used multivariable-adjusted Cox proportional hazards regression models, adjusted for demographic, lifestyle, and health-related factors, including age, sex, race/ethnicity, education, physical activity, smoking, and alcohol drinking, to estimate associations for UPF and related dietary components with CRC incidence. UPF intake was not associated with CRC incidence (hazard ratio 5th versus 1st quintile 0.97; 95% confidence interval [0.91-1.03]; ptrend = 0.55). Whole grain, fiber, dairy, and calcium intakes from UPF sources were inversely but meat intake from UPF sources was positively associated with CRC incidence. The main limitations of the study relate to its observational design and include potential residual confounding and exposure misclassification owing to systematic or random error in self-reported dietary data. Total UPF intake was not associated with incident CRC in this cohort of older, US adults. This may be explained, in part, by opposing associations of some UPF with CRC risk. Our findings support current dietary guidance to consume whole grains, fiber, dairy, and calcium and avoid processed meat for CRC prevention.
cn_title: 食品加工与饮食风险因素与结直肠癌发病的关联：NIH-AARP队列研究
insight: 总超加工食品摄入与结直肠癌发病无关，但按来源拆分后全谷物/纤维/乳制品/钙呈负相关、加工肉呈正相关，提示饮食研究应细化食品来源而非笼统评估UPF。
grade_rationale: 大样本前瞻队列（46万人、1万余例）证据强度较高，但为观察性设计且饮食自报存在错分，仅支持而非改变现有膳食指南。

title: Organ Preservation and Quality of Life After Total Neoadjuvant Treatment in Rectal Cancer.
authors: Diefenhardt M, Fokas E, Kosmala R, Polat B, Germer CT, Schlenska-Lange A, et al.
abstract: Data on quality of life (QOL) after total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) are important for counseling patients on the benefits of watch-and-wait (WW) vs total mesorectal excision (TME) for rectal cancer. A thorough understanding of both options and their long-term impact on bowel, urinary, sexual function, and other QOL domains remains limited. To examine the association of organ preservation with QOL and functional outcomes among patients with rectal cancer treated in 2 phase 2 clinical trials. This unplanned, post hoc, cohort study used data from the CAO/ARO/AIO-12 and CAO/ARO/AIO-16 trials, recruiting participants from June 15, 2015, through October 7, 2020, from 19 centers in Germany. Included patients had cT3 to cT4 or node-positive rectal adenocarcinoma. Total neoadjuvant treatment included chemoradiation therapy combined with induction or consolidation chemotherapy. The statistical analysis was performed from March 6 to December 23, 2025. The association of WW with functional outcomes and QOL was assessed using prospectively recorded EORTC QLQ-C30, EORTC QLQ-CR29, and Wexner score questionnaires. Differences in QOL scores were estimated using adjusted longitudinal and cross-sectional analyses with a predefined clinically meaningful difference of at least 5 points. Baseline questionnaires were available from 346 of 385 eligible patients (89.9%; median [range] age, 60 [19-80] years; 257 male [67%]), while available QOL questionnaires decreased over time to 185 (48.1%) at 5 years. Using the longitudinal analytic approach, statistically significant and clinically meaningful differences in favor of WW were noted for fecal incontinence (-21.2 [95% CI, -30.0 to -12.3]; P < .001); stool frequency (-19.8 [95% CI, -27.6 to -11.9]; P < .001); embarrassment (-17.0 [95% CI, -27.4 to -6.6]; P = .002); flatulence (-15.2 [95% CI, -24.4 to -6.0]; P < .001), buttock pain (-11.9 [95% CI, -20.8 to -3.0]; P = .01); social (9.7 [95% CI, 1.1-18.3]; P = .03), physical (10.2 [95% CI, 4.1-16.3]; P = .002), and role (13.9 [95% CI, 4.9-22.9]; P = .003) functioning; and global health status (9.2 [95% CI, 3.2-15.2]; P = .004). These clinically meaningful differences were detectable in both the intended organ preservation and disease-free groups. Patients with sustained clinical complete response at 3 years (n = 29) vs those with pathologic complete response or matched baseline characteristics favored WW for fecal incontinence (-24.0 and -11.6, respectively), stool frequency (-34.6 and -19.1), sore skin (-18.0 and -18.1), buttock pain (-14.7 and -17.6), embarrassment (-41.1 and -20.5), role functioning (19.1 and 10.9), and social functioning (20.0 and 8.4). In the absence of prospective randomized trials, this study provides evidence suggesting long-term clinically meaningful benefits for organ preservation regarding QOL, especially for most gastrointestinal subscales, social functioning, and global health status, over a 5-year period among patients with rectal cancer. As treatment options for patients with rectal cancer now routinely include WW in cases of clinical complete response after TNT, patient-reported QOL measures have become paramount for informed shared decision-making. ClinicalTrials.gov Identifiers: NCT02363374 and NCT03561142.
cn_title: 直肠癌全程新辅助治疗后器官保留与生活质量：两项II期试验的事后队列分析
insight: TNT后等待观察较TME在肠道功能、社交功能及整体健康上具持续5年临床意义获益，为肝转移风险分层下器官保留决策提供QOL证据。
grade_rationale: 基于两项前瞻性II期试验的事后汇总分析，样本较大且随访5年，QOL差异达临床意义阈值，可影响WW与TME的医患共同决策。

title: MACC1 in colorectal cancer: a claim-level evidence audit from metastasis driver to proposed microenvironmental regulator.
authors: Yang R, Deng R, Lin H, Huang D, Su T, Song X, et al.
journal: Clinical & Translational Oncology : Official Publication of the Federation of Spanish Oncology Societies and of the National Cancer Institute of Mexico
abstract: Metastasis-associated in colon cancer 1 (MACC1) is an established regulator of colorectal cancer (CRC) progression and metastatic competence, but its proposed role in the tumour microenvironment is less certain. We performed a critical claim-level audit of original studies, classifying evidence by cancer-type match, manipulated cellular compartment, direct MACC1 perturbation, functional recipient cell endpoint, and immune context. The audit identifies convergent CRC evidence for tumour cell-intrinsic functions and inflammatory regulation of tumour cell MACC1. It also supports MACC1-dependent extracellular vesicle communication between CRC cells. By contrast, direct immune or stromal causality in CRC is not yet demonstrated: the available macrophage result is pharmacologically conditioned, functional immune and fibroblast mechanisms come from other cancers, and CRC immune associations are mainly computational. We define the conclusions permitted by each evidence class, specify clinical guardrails for prognostic and treatment-predictive claims, and propose two experiments that could establish or falsify cell-specific microenvironmental functions.
cn_title: MACC1在结直肠癌中的证据分级审计：从转移驱动因子到微环境调控假说
insight: 该文以声明级证据审计厘清MACC1在肠癌中的证据边界：肿瘤细胞内在功能证据充分，而免疫/基质直接因果尚缺，为肝转移微环境研究设定验证标准。
grade_rationale: 属方法学严谨的证据审计而非系统Meta，未产生新临床数据，但为MACC1预后与治疗预测声明划定边界，具规范研究设计价值。

title: BHLHE40 as a transcriptional rheostat: decoding microenvironmental signals in context-dependent tumor plasticity.
authors: Wang J, Shao F, Zhang R, Wu R, Wusiman D, Yoo KH, et al.
abstract: The basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor BHLHE40 (also known as BHLHB2, DEC1, STRA13) functions as a critical molecular rheostat in cancer biology, exhibiting context-dependent roles that contribute to tumor plasticity. This review synthesizes current knowledge of BHLHE40, with emphasis on its structural features, including DNA binding, dimerization, and regulatory domains, as well as its integration of key physiological signals, such as circadian rhythm regulation, hypoxic adaptation, cellular senescence, and immune modulation. Pancancer analyses indicate that BHLHE40 expression is dysregulated across multiple tumor types. Elevated expression is associated with poor prognosis in cancers such as glioblastoma, acute myeloid leukemia, and ovarian cancer, whereas it correlates with favorable outcomes in breast and kidney cancers. Notably, the functional role of BHLHE40 is highly tissue-dependent. It promotes tumor progression in hepatocellular carcinoma, gastric cancer, colorectal cancer, and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma by enhancing proliferation, invasion, migration, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), and therapeutic resistance. In contrast, BHLHE40 exhibits tumor-suppressive effects in prostate cancer by inducing cellular senescence, and in endometrial cancer by inhibiting EMT. The tumor microenvironment plays a pivotal role in modulating BHLHE40 activity, with factors such as hypoxia, cytokine signaling, and immune cell interactions shaping its oncogenic or tumor-suppressive functions.
