cn_title: 自组装疏水聚合物纳米平台用于膜蛋白降解与免疫调节药物递送
insight: 该纳米平台实现EGFR降解与PD-L1下调协同，为肠癌提供蛋白降解联合免疫治疗新策略，但尚处临床前阶段。
grade_rationale: 临床前纳米药物机制研究，概念新颖但无临床数据，暂不具备改变实践的证据强度。

title: Microbiota modulation in colorectal cancer: A scoping review of its potential role in toxicity mitigation and treatment response.
authors: Rizky D, Pramono A, Setiawan B, Pangarsa EA, Santosa D, Suharti C
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) treatment remains limited by gastrointestinal toxicity, heterogeneous therapeutic responses, and treatment resistance. The gut microbiota has emerged as a modifiable factor implicated in these outcomes, particularly chemotherapy-induced toxicity. Probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics have been investigated as adjunctive strategies to mitigate chemotherapy-related harm. However, whether the field is ready to extend its focus toward oncologic endpoints, including treatment response, recurrence, and survival, remains unclear. We conducted a scoping review following the Arksey and O'Malley framework and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidance. PubMed, EBSCOhost, Scopus, and CENTRAL were searched through 18 February 2026 for studies evaluating probiotic, prebiotic, or synbiotic interventions in adults with CRC receiving systemic therapy. Primary clinical studies and systematic reviews were eligible. Outcomes included treatment-related toxicity, microbial composition, inflammatory and immune markers, and oncologic endpoints. Of 114 records screened, 16 studies were included, comprising 9 primary studies and 7 systematic reviews. Most studies evaluated probiotic-only regimens in patients receiving fluoropyrimidine- or oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy. The most consistent benefit was a reduction in chemotherapy-induced gastrointestinal toxicity, particularly diarrhea, mucositis, and nausea, along with improved treatment tolerance. Effects on microbial diversity, systemic inflammation, and immune parameters were inconsistent. Only 2 trials directly addressed oncologic outcomes: one reported significantly higher 6-, 12-, and 24-month survival in the probiotic arm, whereas another identified a microbiota-based classifier that predicted treatment response, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.95. However, neither trial comprehensively reported conventional oncologic endpoints such as objective response rate or progression-free survival. In addition, strain, dose, and timing varied widely across studies. Microbiota modulation is a plausible and well-tolerated adjunctive strategy in CRC. However, current evidence remains largely anchored to toxicity mitigation, while oncologic endpoints remain underexamined. The field appears ready to move beyond a supportive-care framework and prospectively test whether microbiota-targeted adjuncts influence treatment response, recurrence, and survival. Probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics should not be treated as interchangeable interventions. Advancing this research agenda will require adequately powered, strain-specific trials with prespecified oncologic endpoints, embedded microbiome and biomarker readouts, and harmonized reporting.
cn_title: 肠道菌群调节在结直肠癌治疗中的范围综述：毒性缓解与治疗反应
insight: 该综述指出菌群调节（益生菌/益生元/合生元）主要证据集中于减轻化疗胃肠道毒性，对肿瘤学终点（反应率、生存）探索不足，提示未来需开展以肿瘤学终点为目标的前瞻性菌株特异性试验。
grade_rationale: 范围综述证据等级较低，且现有研究异质性大、肿瘤学终点数据有限，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Living donor liver transplantation in transplant oncology: A disease-specific framework for access, timing, and donor risk.
authors: Moris D, Gupta P, Nguyen B, Ziogas IA, Theocharopoulos C, Walls D, et al.
abstract: Living donor liver transplantation (LDLT) should not only be evaluated as an alternative graft source in transplant oncology; it should also be evaluated as a disease-specific intervention on access and oncologic time. By removing dependence on deceased-donor availability, LDLT can convert an uncertain wait into a planned operation-but that temporal advantage is not biologically neutral, and its consequences differ sharply by tumor type. In hepatocellular carcinoma, an abbreviated wait can reduce waitlist dropout but may also shorten the interval during which aggressive biology would otherwise declare itself; contemporary biology-based selection has reduced this concern in selected cohorts. In perihilar cholangiocarcinoma, LDLT solves organ scarcity, but the neoadjuvant and staging protocol-not the graft-must remain the actual selection mechanism, and irradiated recipient anatomy adds a distinct technical burden. In intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, LDLT remains investigational, justified only by durable response to systemic therapy in small, prospectively protocolized cohorts. In neuroendocrine liver metastases, direct living-donor evidence is too sparse to support a confident recommendation in either direction. In colorectal liver metastases, LDLT can be framed as a timing technology: transplantation is scheduled once sustained chemotherapy response suggests a temporarily favorable biological state, on the premise that an unpredictable wait might otherwise close that window. This narrative review deliberately isolates the living-donor evidence within each of these five diseases rather than treating LDLT as one intervention, and proposes a common framework-the oncologic clock, the strength of pre-transplant biological selection, and the donor risk that expected recipient benefit can justify-for interpreting it. We further argue that transplant benefit over the best nontransplant alternative, rather than post-transplant survival, should anchor these judgments; that left-lobe and two-stage (RAPID-type) grafting strategies offer a means to reduce donor risk; and that the appropriate metrics depend on whether LDLT operates within a deceased-donor-predominant or a living-donor-predominant health-care system. Across all five diseases, graft source itself appears to matter less than who is selected and when; the central task for the next generation of studies is to report outcomes from evaluation and donor exposure forward, not from transplantation alone.
cn_title: 活体肝移植在移植肿瘤学中的疾病特异性框架：可及性、时机与供体风险
insight: 该综述提出活体肝移植可作为结直肠癌肝转移的“时机技术”，在化疗持续应答的生物学窗口期计划性移植，为不可切除肝转移提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 叙述性综述，非系统评价，无原始数据，但提出新框架，对临床实践有潜在启发但未达改变实践证据级别。

title: Long-term survival after HIPEC with mitomycin C versus oxaliplatin in patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases.
authors: van der Snee L, Aalbers AGJ, Snaebjornsson P, Grotenhuis BA, Bottenberg PD, Lopez-Yurda M, et al.
journal: European Journal of Surgical Oncology : the Journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology
abstract: Cytoreductive surgery (CRS) and oxaliplatin-based hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is controversial in patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases, particularly in those who have received prior systemic oxaliplatin. In the Netherlands, upfront CRS-HIPEC remains the preferred treatment. The aim was to compare the survival of patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases treated with CRS and mitomycin C versus oxaliplatin-based HIPEC. This was a retrospective, single-center cohort study of consecutive patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases who underwent macroscopic complete CRS-HIPEC between 2010 and 2023. Main outcomes were differences in disease-free, peritoneal disease-free, distant disease-free, and overall survival. Of 366 patients included, 153 and 213 underwent mitomycin C-based and oxaliplatin-based HIPEC, respectively. Most patients (68.6%) underwent upfront CRS-HIPEC. Median follow-up was 58.7 months (range, 24.8 - 175.1) and median overall survival was 43.3 months (95% CI, 36.5 - 49.9). In multivariable analyses, oxaliplatin-based HIPEC was associated with worse peritoneal disease-free survival compared to mitomycin C-based HIPEC (median 11.3 vs. 14.9 months; HR 1.44, 95% CI, 1.09 - 1.90; P = .010). No difference was observed in disease-free, distant disease-free, and overall survival. Among patients treated with oxaliplatin-based HIPEC, prior systemic oxaliplatin exposure was associated with worse peritoneal disease-free survival (median 8.7 vs. 13.1 months; HR 1.59, 95% CI, 1.10 - 2.31; P = .014) and overall survival (median 35.7 vs. 50.6 months; HR 1.55, 95% CI, 1.07 - 2.23; P = .020) compared to no prior oxaliplatin exposure. Oxaliplatin-based HIPEC was associated with a higher risk of peritoneal recurrence, particularly in patients previously treated with systemic oxaliplatin. Mitomycin C-based HIPEC is a better choice in this subgroup.
cn_title: 结直肠癌腹膜转移患者接受丝裂霉素C与奥沙利铂HIPEC的长期生存比较
insight: 该回顾性研究提示奥沙利铂HIPEC腹膜复发风险更高，尤其既往系统奥沙利铂暴露者，支持丝裂霉素C作为优选，对肝转移综合治疗中HIPEC方案选择有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列但样本量较大（366例）且直接比较HIPEC药物方案，可能影响临床实践选择。

title: Optimizing neoadjuvant immunotherapy in rectal cancer.
authors: Pennoni G, Rebecchi G, Gou M, Rossano G, Patti F, Scardino A, et al.
journal: European Journal of Surgical Oncology : the Journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology
abstract: The integration of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) into neoadjuvant strategies is increasingly being studied in locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC), to improve complete response (CR), organ preservation, and potentially overall survival (OS). However, the clinical impact of conventional PD-1 blockade still remains limited in proficient mismatch repair/microsatellite-stable (pMMR/MSS) disease, suggesting that its simple addition to standard neoadjuvant therapy may be insufficient. By contrast, deficient mismatch repair/microsatellite instability-high (dMMR/MSI-H) rectal cancer displays marked sensitivity to PD-1 blockade, enabling non-operative management in a substantial proportion of patients, although primary resistance and incomplete responses are increasingly recognized. In this review, we critically discuss the available randomized evidence and the biological determinants of response to neoadjuvant immunotherapy, with particular focus on pMMR/MSS disease. We examine the role of pre-existing antitumor immunity and potential biomarkers such as PD-L1 and Immunoscore, as well as how radiotherapy integration, novel ICIs, and immune-sensitizing strategies may enhance ICI efficacy. Finally, we also address emerging challenges in dMMR/MSI-H rectal cancer and potential strategies to overcome resistance. Moving from empiric ICI addition toward biologically informed and rationally designed immune-based strategies may represent the next step to maximize complete response and organ preservation in rectal cancer.
cn_title: 优化直肠癌新辅助免疫治疗策略
insight: 系统梳理新辅助免疫治疗在直肠癌中的证据与生物学决定因素，强调从经验性联合转向基于生物标志物的理性设计，对提升pMMR/MSS患者完全缓解率和器官保留率具有指导意义。
grade_rationale: 综述性文章，非原始研究，但整合随机证据与生物学机制，对临床决策有参考价值，尚不足以直接改变实践。

title: Phormidolide D, a novel cytotoxic cyanobacterial macrolide: Assessing its effects on the extracellular matrix, apoptosis, and angiogenesis.
authors: Ferreira L, Ribeiro T, Peravali R, Vasconcelos V, Urbatzka R, Reis M
abstract: Marine cyanobacteria are a rich source of structurally diverse secondary metabolites and have inspired at least four anticancer drugs currently on the market, highlighting their potential for the discovery of new therapeutic candidates. This study aimed to discover and elucidate the structure of a novel halogenated polyketide from marine cyanobacteria and to characterize its cytotoxic and mechanistic profile. Phormidolide D (1) was discovered through bioactivity-guided isolation, and its structure was elucidated using NMR and HR-MS/MS analyses. Cytotoxicity was evaluated in SH-SY5Y, HepG2, HCT 116, and hCMEC/D3 cell lines. Its biological activity was further characterized in 2D and 3D HCT 116 models by assessing spheroid morphology, extracellular matrix-related mRNA expression, combination effects with staurosporine, cell cycle distribution and apoptosis. In vivo anti-angiogenic activity was evaluated in transgenic zebrafish (Tg(fli1a:EGFP) embryos. Phormidolide D (1) exhibited potent cytotoxicity against the human colon carcinoma cell line HCT 116 in both monolayer and spheroid cultures (IC
cn_title: Phormidolide D：新型蓝藻大环内酯对结肠癌细胞的细胞毒性及ECM、凋亡与血管生成作用
insight: 发现新型海洋蓝藻大环内酯Phormidolide D，在结肠癌细胞及斑马鱼中显示细胞毒与抗血管生成活性，为肠癌新药研发提供先导化合物，但尚属早期体外研究。
grade_rationale: 纯体外细胞与斑马鱼模型的化合物发现研究，无临床数据，距实践改变甚远。

title: DeepLNM: A Multimodal Model for Predicting Lymph Node Metastasis in Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Zhang Z, Lu C, Wang Z, Cen Z, Zhou Y, Li D, et al.
abstract: Accurate assessment of lymph node metastasis (LNM) is critical for prognostic stratification and treatment selection in colorectal cancer (CRC), yet imaging and routine pathology can yield false-negative/false-positive results. We propose DeepLNM, a multi-center foundation model for LNM prediction in CRC, evaluated with retrospective, external, prospective, and user study evidence. A multimodal dataset was assembled from three hospitals, with matched hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained whole-slide images (WSI), CT scans, and text. DeepLNM achieved a mean AUC of 0.922 in the internal cohort and AUCs of 0.872 and 0.848 in two external cohorts. In a prospective cohort from a registered clinical trial (NCT07239063), DeepLNM remained robust (AUC = 0.845). In a user study, DeepLNM improved diagnostic accuracy, especially for junior pathologists (95.0%-97.3%), while reducing diagnostic time and increasing confidence. To explore the model's generalizability, it was further validated in a gastric cancer cohort, achieving an AUC of 0.793. Finally, DeepLNM identified histopathological features associated with LNM, addressing the "black-box" concern of deep learning. Together, these results position DeepLNM as a clinically preliminarily validated multimodal model for predicting LNM status in CRC, potentially facilitating the clinical translation of AI pathology.
cn_title: DeepLNM：预测结直肠癌淋巴结转移的多模态模型
insight: 多模态AI模型整合病理、影像与文本，在多中心及前瞻性队列中稳健预测淋巴结转移，为肠癌精准分期提供新工具。
grade_rationale: 多中心回顾性+前瞻性验证设计严谨，但尚需更大规模干预性研究证实临床效用。

title: Longitudinal plasma phosphorylated neurofilament-heavy chain levels in oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy: a prospective multi-institutional exploratory study.
authors: Motoo Y, Shinozaki K, Miura M, Takagi T, Ito S, Yoshida N, et al.
abstract: Reliable circulating biomarkers for chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) remain lacking. Phosphorylated neurofilament-heavy chain (pNF-H) is an axon-oriented biomarker of neuroaxonal injury, but its clinical relevance in oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy has not been established. We evaluated the feasibility and longitudinal behavior of plasma pNF-H in patients receiving oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy. This prospective multi-institutional exploratory study included patients with unresectable or recurrent colorectal cancer receiving CapeOX plus bevacizumab as part of the NYX study, a randomised trial of ninjin'yoeito (NYT; TJ-108, Tsumura & Co., Tokyo, Japan), a twelve-ingredient Kampo herbal extract, at 9.0 g/day for 24 weeks in the NYT arm. Plasma samples were collected at baseline, at clinically assessed CIPN onset (follow-up 1), and at the time of neuropathy resolution, at cycle 9, or at discontinuation, whichever came first (follow-up 2). Plasma pNF-H concentrations were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. CIPN was assessed using CTCAE version 5.0. Thirty patients with evaluable plasma samples were included. Plasma pNF-H levels showed substantial inter-individual variability without a consistent temporal pattern. Compared with baseline and CIPN onset, plasma pNF-H levels at follow-up 2 were modestly but significantly increased. However, plasma pNF-H levels were not associated with the onset, severity, or persistence of clinically assessed CIPN. Although longitudinal plasma pNF-H measurement was technically feasible, pNF-H did not function as a clinically meaningful biomarker for oxaliplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy. These findings may reflect a pathophysiological mismatch between dorsal root ganglion neuronal cell body injury and the axon-oriented biological specificity of pNF-H.
cn_title: 奥沙利铂诱导周围神经病变中血浆pNF-H水平的纵向变化：前瞻性多中心探索研究
insight: 血浆pNF-H虽可纵向检测，但与奥沙利铂所致CIPN的发生、严重程度及持续性无关，提示其不能作为临床生物标志物，需探索其他机制标志物。
grade_rationale: 前瞻性多中心探索研究，样本量小（30例），阴性结果，不足以改变临床实践。

title: Gut microbiota-considered pharmacotherapeutic management of hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Pizzi A, Creta E, Pallozzi M, Stella L, Gasbarrini A, Ponziani FR, et al.
abstract: Treatment efficacy for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains limited. Increasing evidence indicates that gut microbiota may influence treatment response, toxicity and clinical outcomes. Our review synthesizes recent literature from PubMed and Wiley Online Library regarding gut microbiota, microbial metabolites, HCC and immunotherapy by critically analyzing the main research frameworks and identifying current research gaps. Clinical studies suggest that microbial diversity and specific taxa, including Despite the encouraging results about the modulation of ICIs response by FMT in other solid tumors (melanoma, colorectal cancer, renal cell carcinoma and mixed solid-tumor), whether this strategy is effective and safe in HCC remains to be established in prospective HCC-specific trials. The availability of a preliminary detailed characterization of gut microbial before undertaking HCC treatment would be tempting, especially if it could lead to a more precision-tailored approach with the possibility to foresee, within certain limits, the therapeutic outcome. Moreover, the eventual discovery of specific bacterial patterns in responders and non-responders to ICIs could open the possibility to administer FMT as a standard of care at least in selected patients with the target of re-stablishing HCC response to ICIs.
cn_title: 肠道微生物指导的肝细胞癌药物治疗管理
insight: 综述指出肠道菌群可影响肝细胞癌免疫治疗应答与毒性，但FMT在HCC中的疗效与安全性尚待前瞻性试验验证，提示肠癌肝转移患者免疫治疗亦需关注菌群干预策略。
grade_rationale: 叙述性综述，非系统Meta分析，未提供新临床数据，但提出FMT在HCC中的研究空白，实践改变潜力有限。

title: MLH1 p.His112Arg Variant Is Associated With Increased Cancer Susceptibility.
authors: Elfatih A, Tout I, Doha NA, Arja TA, Mohammed I, Abdelrhaman D, et al.
abstract: Lynch syndrome, a prevalent hereditary cancer predisposition, is frequently caused by pathogenic variants in the MutL homolog 1 (MLH1) mismatch repair gene. However, a significant proportion of MLH1 missense variants remain classified as variants of uncertain significance (VUS), creating clinical ambiguity. Functional validation assays in vertebrate models are crucial to assess the pathogenicity of these VUS. We previously reported the rare MLH1 NM_000249.4:c.335A>G (p.His112Arg) variant in individuals with cancer histories within the Qatar Genome Program. To assess its functional impact, we established the MLH1 p.His112Arg variant in the human colorectal cancer cell line, COLO205, using CRISPR-Cas9 technology. Isogenic wild-type (WT) and variant-carrying cells were xenotransplanted into the zebrafish. Tumor growth was quantified via fluorescence microscopy at 24 and 72 h post-injection. Zebrafish xenografted with MLH1 p.His112Arg cells exhibited a significant increase in tumor area compared to WT. This accelerated growth was associated with a significant upregulation of the proliferation marker MKI67 in variant-carrying tumors, while cyclin D1 (CCND1) and proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) (key regulators of cell cycle progression and DNA replication, respectively) expression remained unchanged, despite a tendency for increased expression. Furthermore, our functional characterization of the MLH1 p.His112Arg variant in COLO205 cells showed an enhanced proliferation capacity compared to the WT cell line, as well as increased cell viability and decreased apoptotic susceptibility when subjected to methylation-induced DNA damage. The MLH1 p.His112Arg variant confers a tumor-promoting phenotype in an in vivo zebrafish model, providing functional evidence that supports its reclassification from VUS to likely pathogenic.
cn_title: MLH1 p.His112Arg变异增加癌症易感性：斑马鱼模型功能验证
insight: 该研究通过斑马鱼异种移植模型证实MLH1 p.His112Arg变异具有促肿瘤表型，支持其从VUS重分类为可能致病性，为Lynch综合征相关结直肠癌的遗传咨询和筛查提供功能证据。
grade_rationale: 研究基于CRISPR-Cas9细胞模型和斑马鱼异种移植的功能验证，虽为临床变异解读提供证据，但样本量小且缺乏临床队列验证，尚不足以直接改变实践。

title: The New Face of an Old Disease: A Survey of Young People regarding Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Langenfeld SJ, Zigouras S, Smith JJ, Garoufalia Z, Dahlen H, Raasch C, et al.
journal: Diseases of the Colon and Rectum
abstract: Colorectal cancer is now the leading cause of cancer-related deaths for people under the age of 50. As an initial step of the Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Awareness Campaign, the purpose of this study was to survey a large sample of members of the public age 20 to 44 to determine their baseline levels of early-onset colorectal cancer understanding as well as their comfort discussing early-onset colorectal cancer and the associated symptoms. This was an online survey conducted in December 2025, before the launch of the Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Awareness Campaign, to establish baseline measures. Baseline demographics were collected, including age, gender, race/ethnicity, region, and survey language. Survey measures were developed based on the Health Belief Model, focus group findings, and subject matter expert review. Participants aged 20 to 44 were recruited from a respondent panel maintained by a market-research vendor, and recruitment was stopped after meeting a quota of 1,000 respondents. Healthcare providers were excluded. A total of 1,000 respondents were included with even distribution of age and sex. The survey was taken in Spanish by 27%. Overall awareness of colorectal cancer (CRC) and early-onset colorectal cancer was low (41 and 24%, respectively). Knowledge of family history was low for colorectal cancer (22%) as well as colorectal polyps (17%). Twenty-nine percent of respondents had not heard of any symptoms of colorectal cancer while 36% identified rectal bleeding and 29% identified changes in stool habits as symptoms of colorectal cancer. Only 22% of respondents had looked for information on colorectal cancer within the last year. Female respondents felt less comfortable than their male counterparts discussing early-onset colorectal cancer with a healthcare provider (55 vs 67%, p = 0.017) or with their friends and family (56% vs 67%, p = 0.025). When asked about potential reasons to avoid or postpone a colonoscopy, respondents reported concerns about cost (69%), risk of complications (68%), fear of a cancer diagnosis (68%), and mistrust of the health care system (57%). The limitations of the study include the use of an opt-in survey, as this requires a self-selected group of respondents with potential differences in health literacy, digital engagement, and survey-taking behavior from the public. Currently, people under the age of 45 have a low overall understanding of early-onset colorectal cancer, and most are unaware of their own family history of colorectal cancer and colon polyps. Several important roadblocks to gaining information and/or seeking care for early-onset colorectal cancer were also identified. These findings will be used to inform future efforts of the Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Awareness Campaign. See Video Abstract.
cn_title: 早发性结直肠癌认知调查：公众意识与障碍分析
insight: 揭示年轻人群对早发性结直肠癌认知严重不足及就医障碍，提示需加强针对性健康教育以促进早期筛查和肝转移预防。
grade_rationale: 基于在线调查的描述性研究，样本量大但非干预性，对临床实践直接影响有限，但为公共卫生教育提供依据。

title: Belgian protocol for indication and selection of patients with unresectable colorectal cancer liver metastases eligible for liver transplantation.
authors: Rasschaert G, Vandermeulen M, Van den Eynde M, Eker H, Vandamme T, Bracke B, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is common in Western countries, about 50% of patients develop liver metastases (CLM). While local CLM therapies can achieve 5-year survival up to 60%, most patients eventually become unresectable (uCLM) and have poor outcomes with systemic treatment alone. Prospective studies, including SECA I and II and the TransMet trial, showed that in carefully selected patients, liver transplantation (LTx) can achieve survival outcomes comparable to standard LTx indications. The aim of this work was to develop a harmonized national consensus protocol for the indication and selection of uCLM patients eligible for LTx. Under the coordination of the Belgian Liver & Intestine Advisory Committee (Be-LIAC), all six Belgian transplant centers delegated a transplant surgeon, an oncologist and an hepatologist to a working group that performed a literature review and drafted preliminary criteria. Three successive national meetings and a structured voting refined these criteria in the current protocol. Consensus was reached on inclusion and exclusion criteria for LTx in uCLM. Two key conditions are liver-only disease and technically uCLM. Strict requirements include a six months disease stability or response on systemic therapy and an obligatory eight-week treatment holiday. Absolute CEA levels and specific somatic mutations are not excluded. A national Be-LIAC governance model was established, combining local prospective decision-making with central auditing and registry-based evaluation. A harmonized national protocol for LTx inuCLM has been established, ensuring consistent patient selection across all Belgian centers. Stricter criteria and a national governance model aim to optimize outcomes while maintaining ethical allocation of donor organs.
cn_title: 比利时不可切除结直肠癌肝转移肝移植指征与患者选择的国家共识方案
insight: 该共识为不可切除结直肠癌肝转移肝移植建立了统一的国家筛选标准与治理框架，推动肝移植成为严格选择患者的治疗选项，并强调前瞻性登记与中央审计。
grade_rationale: 基于文献综述与全国多中心专家共识投票，形成首个国家级肝移植治疗uCLM方案，具有改变临床实践的潜力。

title: Integrated Multi-Time-Point
authors: He M, Yang H, Shi Y, Zhang R, Wan T, Pang X, et al.

In this prospective exploratory study (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06608537), 49 patients received short-course radiotherapy followed by sintilimab plus CAPOX and subsequently underwent radical surgery. title: Design, synthesis, and structure-activity relationships of novel flavone derivatives as tankyrase inhibitors against colorectal cancer.
authors: Yao H, Wang Z, Huang N, Wang N, Gan G
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a lethal malignancy driven by Wnt/β-catenin pathway hyperactivation. Tankyrase (TNKS) is a promising therapeutic target for CRC; however, existing inhibitors suffer from poor subtype selectivity and severe intestinal toxicity. Guided by structure-based drug design (SBDD), we developed a novel series of flavone-based TNKS inhibitors using 4'-hydroxyflavone, a plant-derived hit, as the structural scaffold. By systematically introducing diverse aliphatic amines and fluorine atoms onto the flavone B-ring, we designed and synthesized 37 derivatives. Structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis revealed that bulky

insight: 基于SBDD开发黄酮类TNKS抑制剂并解析构效关系，为Wnt通路激活型肠癌提供低肠毒性的候选化合物，提示靶向TNKS的成药性优化方向。

title: Gut Microbial Metabolism Inactivates Trifluridine and Drives Loss of Anticancer Efficacy.
authors: Ahmad S, Igbalaye JO, Perez V, Wenning E, Gauthier S, Ridlon J, et al.
abstract: Human-associated gut bacteria harbor diverse genetic and metabolic potential. Orally administered therapeutic drugs can interact with these bacteria in the gastrointestinal tract. Recent evidence shows modifications of multiple drugs via gut bacteria, influencing therapeutic outcomes. Trifluridine, a fluoropyrimidine drug used in colorectal cancer treatment, is susceptible to microbial metabolism and premature inactivation, yet the breadth and functional consequences of this metabolism remain incompletely defined. In this work, we further explore the potential of additional gut bacterial strains that can metabolize trifluridine and characterize how this microbial metabolism impacts cancer cell responses. Sequence-based similarity search revealed trifluridine metabolizing homologues in multiple
cn_title: 肠道菌群代谢灭活曲氟尿苷导致抗癌疗效丧失
insight: 揭示肠道菌群可代谢灭活曲氟尿苷，提示菌群-药物互作是肠癌口服化疗耐药新机制，为联合抗菌或个体化用药提供依据。

title: Exploring tumor-derived exosomes as promising antigenic platforms: novel vaccine and immunotherapy strategies for "cold" colorectal cancer.
authors: Liu X, Wang X
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a formidable clinical challenge, largely due to the prevalence of microsatellite-stable tumors characterized by an immunologically "cold" tumor microenvironment (TME) that is resistant to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Tumor-derived exosomes (TEXs) play a paradoxical dual role in this landscape. Native TEXs actively orchestrate immune evasion by delivering immunosuppressive molecules, such as programmed cell death 1 ligand 1 (PD-L1) and transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-β), which impair cytotoxic T-cell function and promote the expansion of regulatory T cells and M2 macrophages. Conversely, TEXs possess inherent biocompatibility and naturally harbor a broad repertoire of tumor-associated antigens (TAAs) and major histocompatibility complex (MHC) molecules, positioning them as potential cell-free platforms for cancer vaccination. Current evidence demonstrates that native TEXs establish their immunosuppressive niche primarily through the systemic PD-1/PD-L1 axis and microRNA-driven macrophage polarization. However, preclinical studies indicate that exosome engineering strategies-such as masking surface PD-L1 or loading vesicles with immune adjuvants, siRNAs, or CRISPR components-can effectively neutralize these suppressive traits and amplify antigen presentation. While clinical data in CRC remain limited, engineered TEXs exhibit strong preclinical promise for synergizing with ICIs to reprogram cold CRC into immune-responsive "hot" tumors. Advancing these early-stage therapies from the bench to the clinic will require overcoming significant translational hurdles, particularly regarding standardized isolation protocols and scalable manufacturing.
cn_title: 肿瘤源性外泌体作为抗原平台：冷结直肠癌疫苗与免疫治疗新策略
insight: 系统阐述工程化肿瘤外泌体逆转冷结直肠癌免疫抑制微环境、增强抗原呈递的潜力，为免疫联合治疗提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 该文为临床前证据为主的叙述性综述，无临床数据，但提出外泌体工程化策略，转化潜力大，尚不足以改变实践。

title: Isolated splenic metastases from colorectal carcinoma and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor: a report of two rare cases.
authors: Cho E, Chang AL, Chang CK
abstract: Splenic metastases usually historically signal pre-terminal malignancy, arising amid widespread tumor dissemination and most often discovered at autopsy. Isolated splenic metastases without disseminated disease are exceedingly rare, with only a limited number of cases reported in the literature. Recognizing these presentations is important as isolated splenic involvement may be amenable to definitive management in contrast to the poor prognosis associated with splenic spread. In this report, we present two patients with isolated splenic metastases. The first is an 83-year-old patient with splenic metastasis secondary to colorectal cancer. The second is a 29-year-old patient with splenic metastasis secondary to a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor (PNET), which, to our knowledge, may represent a novel incidence. Neither patient had evidence of disseminated disease at presentation. In this case report, we review the clinical presentation, diagnostic workup, and management of both cases, each of which demonstrate a favorable short-term outcome. These cases taken together show that isolated splenic disease, when identified in the absence of widespread metastasis, can be operatively and chemically managed with favorable short-term results. The PNET patient in particular broadens the recognized spectrum of primary tumor locations that can metastasize to the spleen in isolation. Further reports and longer follow-ups, however, are needed to identify the optimal management and longer-term prognoses.
cn_title: 结直肠癌与胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤孤立性脾转移：两例罕见病例报告
insight: 报道结直肠癌孤立性脾转移可行手术联合化疗并获得良好短期结局，提示对无广泛播散的孤立性脾转移应积极局部处理，为肠癌寡转移管理提供罕见部位参考。
grade_rationale: 仅为两例罕见病例报告，无对照与长期随访，证据等级低，不足以改变临床实践。

title: Efficacy and Safety of Fruquintinib Plus TAS-102 in Patients With Previously Treated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: Results From a Single-Arm, Multi-Center, Phase II Study.
authors: Peng J, Li Y, Huang L, Liu J, Xiao J, Xie D, et al.
abstract: The clinical efficacy of currently available third- and later-line treatment regimens for patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) remains suboptimal. This study was designed to investigate fruquintinib plus TAS-102 regimen in this patient population. This study was a prospective, multi-center, single-arm phase II trial. A total of 50 patients with mCRC who had experienced treatment failure to at least two standard therapies were enrolled. The primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS) and secondary endpoints included overall survival (OS), objective response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), and safety. Survival outcomes were estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. With a median follow-up duration of 25.1 months, the median PFS was 6.07 months (95% CI: 4.07-7.87) and the median OS was 14.10 months (95% CI: 9.84-23.28). The ORR was 10.0% (95% CI: 3.3-21.8), with a DCR of 66.0% (95% CI: 51.2-78.8). All the patients experienced treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs), with 68.0% reporting grade ≥ 3 TRAEs. No serious adverse events (AEs), deaths, or new safety concerns were reported. In conclusion, fruquintinib combined with TAS-102 showed preliminary anti-tumor activity with a manageable safety profile in patients with refractory mCRC, which highlights its potential as a viable later-line therapeutic option.
cn_title: 呋喹替尼联合TAS-102治疗经治转移性结直肠癌的单臂多中心II期研究
insight: 该研究提示呋喹替尼联合TAS-102在后线mCRC中具有初步疗效且安全性可控，为后线治疗提供了潜在新选择，但需随机对照验证。
grade_rationale: 单臂II期研究样本量小（50例），缺乏随机对照，证据等级有限，暂不足以改变临床实践。

Notably, TLR7 and TLR8 agonists have gained significant attention as promising therapeutic candidates because of their ability to activate immune responses and modulate immune signaling pathways for treating viral infections, autoimmune disorders, and cancer. Despite the growing interest in the area of immunotherapy, there remains a substantial gap in the development of new immunomodulators with improved efficacy and safety profiles. cn_title: 新型TLR7/8激动剂的整合筛选与免疫评价

title: Pulmonary dirofilariasis mimicking malignant pulmonary lesions: Two cases presenting as solitary and multiple pulmonary nodules.

title: Endoscopic submucosal dissection for colitis cystica profunda in a 49-year-old woman: a case report with 52-month follow-up and sustained remission.
authors: Guan L, Ouyang R, Li Z, Tang W, Chen Z
abstract: Colitis cystica profunda (CCP) is a rare benign colorectal lesion characterized by mucus-filled cysts within the submucosa. However, the durability of endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) for CCP beyond 48 months has not been documented. This case aims to fill that gap. ESD has emerged as a minimally invasive approach enabling both definitive diagnosis and treatment, but data on long-term efficacy remain limited, with no reported follow-up exceeding 48 months. A 49-year-old woman presented with a 6-month history of unformed stools. Colonoscopy revealed a submucosal mound-like lesion in the rectum, 5 cm from the anal verge. Endoscopic ultrasonography (EUS) showed hypoechoic areas (0.4 cm × 0.2 cm) confined to the muscularis mucosa and submucosa, suspicious for a neuroendocrine tumor. Routine laboratory tests (complete blood count, C‑reactive protein, carcinoembryonic antigen) were within normal limits. ESD was performed for en bloc resection. Histopathological examination demonstrated cystica dilated glands in the submucosa lined by benign colonic epithelium with surrounding fibrotic stroma and chronic inflammatory infiltration, confirming the diagnosis of CCP. No cytologic atypia was observed. The patient was followed with serial colonoscopy at 12, 40, and 52 months post-ESD, and with contrast‑enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) at 12 months. Functional outcomes were assessed using the Wexner Constipation Score (0/30) and 36-Item Short Form Health Survey (SF-36) questionnaire (scores comparable to population norms). All follow‑up examinations showed stable scar‑like changes without evidence of recurrence, and the patient maintained normal bowel habits (formed stools 1-2 times daily). This case provides preliminary evidence that ESD can achieve durable remission and excellent functional outcomes in a single patient with CCP over 52 months. However, these findings are from one case and require confirmation in larger, prospective studies.
cn_title: 内镜黏膜下剥离术治疗结肠囊肿性深在性囊性结肠炎：52个月随访持续缓解病例报告
insight: 该病例首次报道ESD治疗CCP随访超48个月无复发，提示ESD可作为CCP的微创根治手段，但需大样本验证。
grade_rationale: 单例个案报告，证据等级低，但为ESD治疗罕见良性病变提供长期随访数据，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Primary adrenal small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma in a patient with sarcoidosis and synchronous colon adenocarcinoma.
authors: Sano A, Takeichi T, Miyamaoto A, Nishii Y, Yamamoto T, Kusama Y
abstract: Primary adrenal neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC), particularly the small cell subtype, is exceptionally rare. In patients with sarcoidosis, inflammatory lymphadenopathy may mimic a metastatic disease, making disease detection difficult. A 76-year-old man with sarcoidosis was referred for an enlarging left adrenal incidentaloma that had increased in size from 7 mm to 19 × 14 mm over 3 years. Hormonal evaluation revealed unremarkable findings; laparoscopic adrenalectomy was performed because malignancy could not be excluded. Histopathological examination revealed small cell NEC with positive synaptophysin and chromogranin A staining, and a Ki-67 labeling index of 80%. One month after surgery, para-aortic lymphadenopathy was detected. Fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (CT) showed uptake in the para-aortic lymph nodes and ascending colon, where colonoscopy identified synchronous adenocarcinoma. The cause of the lymphadenopathy was uncertain because of coexisting sarcoidosis and colon cancer. Cisplatin plus irinotecan induced a partial response; however, disease progression was observed. CT-guided lymph node biopsy confirmed metastatic NEC. Second-line amrubicin therapy reduced tumor size; comprehensive genomic profiling revealed a tumor mutation-burden-high phenotype. This case highlights diagnostic challenges in the evaluation of lymphadenopathy in patients with sarcoidosis and synchronous malignancy, emphasizing the importance of pathological confirmation for guiding appropriate management.
cn_title: 结节病合并结肠腺癌患者中原发性肾上腺小细胞神经内分泌癌一例
insight: 罕见病例提示结节病背景下的淋巴结肿大鉴别诊断困难，强调病理确认对指导治疗的重要性，对肠癌肝转移鉴别有借鉴意义。
grade_rationale: 单一个案报道，无普遍实践改变潜力，但提示诊断陷阱。

title: The Resection Ability of Low-power Pure-cut Hot Snare Polypectomy for Nonpedunculated Colorectal Polyps Smaller Than 10 mm: A Single-center Prospective Study.
authors: Mizuno R, Kimura H, Kushima R, Notsu A, Nishida A, Inatomi O, et al.
abstract: Small colorectal polyps sometimes include high-grade adenomas or carcinomas that require endoscopic resection with electrocautery. Recent studies have reported the usefulness of low-power pure-cut hot snare polypectomy (LPPC-HSP) as a less invasive technique. However, the actual resection depth of LPPC-HSP has not been fully investigated. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate the resection ability of LPPC-HSP for small colorectal polyps. In this single-arm prospective observational study, patients scheduled to undergo LPPC-HSP for nonpedunculated colorectal polyps smaller than 10 mm were enrolled. The primary outcome was the rate of sufficient vertical R0 resection (SVR0), defined as an R0 resection with a sufficient submucosal layer beneath the whole lesion. A total of 95 patients with 150 lesions were included. The en bloc and R0 resection rates were 100% and 83%, respectively. The SVR0 rate was 76.7% (90% confidence interval: 70.3%-82.2%). All specimens contained the muscularis mucosa, and 132 lesions (88%) contained submucosal tissue. The median maximum submucosal thickness was 1331 µm (interquartile range, 736-2044 µm). No bleeding, perforation, or other serious adverse events were observed. LPPC-HSP demonstrated acceptable vertical resection capability. LPPC-HSP may be applicable for colorectal polyps smaller than 10 mm with potential malignancy, providing resection depth comparable to that of conventional electrocautery-based methods.
cn_title: 低功率纯切热圈套息肉切除术对小于10mm无蒂结直肠息肉的切除能力：单中心前瞻性研究
insight: LPPC-HSP对<10mm无蒂结直肠息肉垂直R0切除率达76.7%，提示其可用于潜在恶性小息肉，为内镜切除深度提供新选择。
grade_rationale: 单中心单臂前瞻性研究，样本量有限（150个病灶），无对照，证据等级中等，暂不足以改变临床实践。

title: Effect of Anterior Quadratus Lumborum Block at the Lateral Supra-Arcuate Ligament Combined with Esketamine on the Quality of Postoperative Recovery After Laparoscopic Radical Surgery for Elderly Patients with Colorectal Cancer: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
authors: Dai Z, Yang M, Liu H, Gao X, Zhao X, Wang Y, et al.
abstract: Postoperative pain, opioid exposure and slow recovery remain common concerns in elderly patients undergoing laparoscopic radical resection of colorectal cancer. We assessed whether anterior quadratus lumborum block at the lateral supra-arcuate ligament (QLB-LSAL) combined with low-dose esketamine improves recovery quality. In this single-centre, randomized, placebo-controlled trial with blinded outcome assessment, 90 patients aged ≥60 years were assigned to QLB-LSAL with a saline infusion (Group Q), esketamine alone (Group E), or QLB-LSAL with esketamine (Group QE). The prespecified primary endpoint was the QoR-40 total score on postoperative day 3. Esketamine 0.2 mg/kg was given intravenously before induction, followed by 0.2 mg/kg/h until 30 min before the end of surgery in Groups E and QE; Group Q received an equal volume of saline. Longitudinal data were analysed with linear mixed-effects models, with Tukey post-hoc testing and Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Eighty-eight patients were analysed (Q=29, E=30, QE=29). On day 3 the QoR-40 total score was higher in Group QE than in Group E (adjusted difference 8.30, 95% CI 4.37-12.23, Tukey P<0.001); the corresponding day-1 difference was 12.07 (95% CI 7.66-16.47, P<0.001). Group QE also showed better comfort and pain scores, lower remifentanil consumption and fewer day-1 pump activations than Group E, and a higher day-1 QoR-40 score than Group Q (P=0.006). Between-group differences in HADS anxiety scores were not significant after adjustment for multiplicity (QE vs Q on day 1, P=0.068). The incidence of adverse events did not differ between groups. In elderly patients undergoing laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery, QLB-LSAL combined with low-dose esketamine improved the prespecified day-3 recovery endpoint and reduced early postoperative pain and opioid use compared with esketamine alone; any anxiolytic effect was not confirmed after multiplicity adjustment. Trial registration: ChiCTR2400082301.
cn_title: 前路腰方肌阻滞联合艾司氯胺酮改善老年结直肠癌腹腔镜术后恢复质量：随机对照试验
insight: 该RCT证实QLB-LSAL联合低剂量艾司氯胺酮可改善老年结直肠癌腹腔镜术后恢复质量并减少阿片用量，为围术期多模式镇痛优化提供新证据，对加速康复外科实践有启示。
grade_rationale: 单中心随机对照试验，样本量较小（88例），主要终点为恢复质量评分，证据级别中等，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Preoperative risk stratification for postoperative inflammatory-nutritional deterioration after colorectal cancer surgery: an interpretable machine learning study.
authors: Zhang Y, Hu Y, Cao X, Zan X, Tian Z, Shen W
abstract: Postoperative inflammatory-nutritional deterioration may adversely affect recovery after colorectal cancer surgery. This study aimed to develop and internally validate an interpretable machine learning model for preoperative prediction of postoperative modified Glasgow Prognostic Score (mGPS) = 2. This single-centre retrospective study included consecutive patients who underwent elective radical resection for colorectal cancer between 2020 and 2025. The cohort was divided into training and internal validation sets using stratified sampling. Recursive feature elimination identified eight predictors: age, prealbumin, albumin, cholinesterase, lymphocyte percentage, platelet count, fibrinogen and serum calcium. Eight conventional machine learning algorithms, TabICLv2 and SuperLearner ensembles were evaluated using discrimination, calibration and decision curve analyses. SHapley Additive exPlanations were used for model interpretation. Among 1196 patients, 507 (42.4%) developed postoperative mGPS=2. In the internal validation cohort, TabICLv2 achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.753 (95% confidence interval, 0.701-0.804) and a Brier score of 0.197. SuperLearner-W and SuperLearner-SR showed comparable discrimination, with areas under the curve of 0.752 and 0.751, respectively. Lymphocyte percentage, platelet count and fibrinogen were the leading contributors to model predictions. Learning-curve analysis revealed suboptimal convergence behaviour, with relatively flat cross-validation trajectories and persistent separation from training performance across increasing training fractions. A web-based research prototype was developed to provide individualised risk estimates, patient-level feature attribution and an applicability-domain assessment indicating the level of support from the model-development data. An interpretable model based on routinely available preoperative variables provided moderate discrimination for postoperative inflammatory-nutritional deterioration after colorectal cancer surgery. The suboptimal learning-curve convergence indicates that the model is not suitable for clinical deployment without further development and independent external validation.
cn_title: 结直肠癌术后炎症-营养恶化术前风险分层的可解释机器学习研究
insight: 基于常规术前指标的可解释模型可中等程度预测术后mGPS=2，但学习曲线未收敛且缺乏外部验证，提示需完善后方可临床部署。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性研究，内部验证AUC仅0.753且学习曲线未收敛，作者自述不宜临床部署，实践改变潜力低。

title: A large iliopsoas abscess due to migration of ureteral stent: a case report.
authors: Sun H, Cao X, Su Y, Liu S
abstract: Iliopsoas abscess (IPA) is a rare but potentially life-threatening condition. Due to its nonspecific clinical presentation and low incidence, IPA often leads to diagnostic delays and suboptimal initial management. Secondary IPA originating from urinary tract complications is extremely rare, and IPA induced by ureteral stent migration appears to be exceptionally uncommon. Fungal IPA caused by We report a 63-year-old woman with a history of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and prior colon cancer surgery that involved partial ureteral resection and ureteral stent implantation 6 months ago. The patient later developed IPA, which was successfully managed with dual ultrasound-guided percutaneous drainage, ureteral stent exchange, and systemic antimicrobial therapy. Cultures of the drained abscess and urine both yielded Ultrasound-guided percutaneous drainage is a safe and effective treatment modality for IPA. This case highlights that ureteral stent migration, though typically managed uneventfully, may precipitate severe septic sequelae including IPA, particularly in immunocompromised patients.
cn_title: 输尿管支架移位致巨大腰大肌脓肿一例并文献复习
insight: 报道输尿管支架移位继发腰大肌脓肿的罕见病例，提示肠癌术后输尿管支架患者需警惕此致命并发症，早期影像与引流至关重要。
grade_rationale: 单一个案报道，无对照或系统评价，证据等级低，但提示临床需警惕罕见并发症。

title: Circulating arginine-nitric oxide pathway metabolites and nitrated fatty acids in relation to pathological features of colorectal cancer.
authors: Klekowski J, Fortuna P, Lewandowski Ł, Maciejewska G, Szewczak W, Mosna K, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is associated with metabolic and inflammatory disturbances, including alterations in the arginine-nitric oxide (NO) pathway. This study assessed serum metabolites related to the arginine-NO-nitrated fatty acid (NO₂-FA) axis in patients with CRC and examined their associations with tumor stage and pathological features. A total of 122 patients undergoing colorectal resection for CRC were prospectively enrolled, of whom 117 had complete measurements for the candidate-metabolite panel and were included in the analyses. Preoperative serum samples were analyzed using targeted LC-MS/MS. Associations between metabolite concentrations and tumor stage were evaluated using complementary exploratory modelling approaches, including ordinal regression for TNM stage, tumor extent (T), and nodal involvement (N), as well as binary logistic regression for advanced disease (TNM III-IV), angioinvasion, and neuroinvasion. Among the analyzed metabolites, SDMA showed the most recurrent inverse association with pathological disease stage in the initial models. However, these associations attenuated after adjustment for age and sex and were further weakened after additional adjustment for serum creatinine, with all fully adjusted 95% confidence intervals (CIs) including unity. Thus, the observed SDMA pattern was not independent of renal function and should be regarded as hypothesis-generating rather than as a convincing stage-associated metabolic signal. In a complementary binary analysis of TNM stages III-IV versus I-II, an inverse association with SDMA persisted after adjustment only under the stepwise selection strategy. Lower agmatine concentrations were associated with higher T category under the elastic-net strategy. Under the stepwise strategy, higher ADMA concentrations were associated with lower odds of angioinvasion and neuroinvasion, whereas higher citrulline concentrations were associated with higher odds of neuroinvasion. These invasive-feature associations were not reproduced under the elastic-net strategy and should therefore be considered procedure-dependent exploratory findings. No clear association was detected between circulating nitrooleates and the analyzed pathological outcomes. These exploratory findings identify preliminary stage-associated metabolic patterns within patients with CRC and require validation in independent cohorts.
cn_title: 循环精氨酸-一氧化氮通路代谢物及硝化脂肪酸与结直肠癌病理特征的关系
insight: 该研究提示精氨酸-NO通路代谢物与结直肠癌分期/侵袭特征的关联多受肾功能与统计策略影响，尚属假设生成，需独立队列验证后方可用于预后分层。
grade_rationale: 前瞻性单中心探索性代谢组研究，样本量小（117例）且关联经校正后多消失，无外部验证，不足以改变实践。

title: Telmisartan enhances anti-PD-1 efficacy in MSS colorectal cancer via modulation of PD-L1 and STAT3 signaling.
authors: Lin X, Li J, Lin W
abstract: Microsatellite stable (MSS) colorectal cancer (CRC), accounting for over 85% of advanced cases, shows intrinsic resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors due to an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. The renin-angiotensin system (RAS), particularly angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R), has been implicated in tumor progression and immune evasion. This study investigated whether telmisartan, a selective AT1R antagonist, modulates programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression and enhances anti-tumor immunity in MSS CRC. Mismatch repair (MMR) protein expression was characterized in human (SW480, HT29, HCT116) and murine (CT26) CRC cell lines. The effects of telmisartan on cell viability, PD-L1 expression, STAT3 signaling, and migration were evaluated using Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8), Western blotting, and Transwell assays. A CT26 tumor model in BALB/c mice was used to assess therapeutic efficacy alone or combined with pembrolizumab, with immunohistochemical analysis of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. Public transcriptomic analysis of The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) CRC data and immune infiltration analysis using the CIBERSORT (Cell-type Identification By Estimating Relative Subsets Of RNA Transcripts) algorithm were further performed. Telmisartan (10-20 μM) reduced PD-L1 expression in both MSS and MSI-H CRC cell lines without significant cytotoxicity. It was associated with increased signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) phosphorylation and reduced cell migration. Telmisartan may remodel the tumor immune microenvironment, potentially through modulation of PD-L1 expression associated with STAT3 signaling, thereby enhancing the response of MSS CRC to immune checkpoint blockade. These findings suggest that telmisartan could serve as a potential immunotherapy adjuvant for MSS CRC.
cn_title: 替米沙坦通过调控PD-L1和STAT3信号增强MSS结直肠癌抗PD-1疗效
insight: 揭示AT1R拮抗剂替米沙坦可下调PD-L1、调节STAT3并增敏MSS结直肠癌免疫治疗，为MSS肠癌免疫联合策略提供老药新用思路。
grade_rationale: 研究为细胞与小鼠模型的基础机制探索，尚无临床数据，但为MSS肠癌免疫增敏提供新靶点，暂不足以改变实践。

title: The m6A/METTL3 modifies USP11 to promote Warburg effect progression of colon cancer undifferentiated by HIF-1α/YAP signaling pathway.
authors: Wang Y, Zhu F, Chen X, Feng L, Pu Z
abstract: In China, colorectal cancer (CLC) is the third most common malignancy, following lung cancer and thyroid cancer. This study attempts to reveal the protective mechanism of ubiquitin-specific peptidase 11 (USP11) on Warburg effect of CLC. The study used single-cell analysis and the Chinese Glioma Genome Atlas (CGGA) dataset. HCT-116 cells were transfected with the USP11 or small interfering (si)-USP11 plasmid, respectively. The USP11 messengerRNA(mRNA) expression in patients with CLC was elevated compared to the normal group. Patients with high USP11 expression exhibited poorer survival than those with low USP11 expression in CLC. USP11 was expressed in the epithelial cells of CLC patients. USP11 promoted Warburg effect to induce cell growth progression of CLC. USP11 upregulates the expression of HIF-1α and YAP in CLC. Mechanistically, HIF-1α mediates the effect of USP11 in CLC by driving the progression of the Warburg effect. USP11 physically interacts with the HIF-1α complex and stabilizes HIF-1α protein in CLC cells via suppressing HIF-1α ubiquitination. Additionally, the N6-methyladenosine (m6A) methyltransferase METTL3 enhances USP11 stability in a YTHDF1-dependent manner. This study demonstrates that the METTL3-mediated m6A modification facilitates USP11 stabilization by YTHDF1 in CLC models, providing novel mechanistic insights and potential therapeutic targets for the clinical management of CLC and other malignant tumors.
cn_title: METTL3介导m6A修饰稳定USP11通过HIF-1α/YAP通路促进结肠癌Warburg效应
insight: 揭示METTL3-m6A-YTHDF1-USP11-HIF-1α轴驱动结肠癌糖代谢重编程的新机制，为靶向Warburg效应的治疗提供潜在靶点。
grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，虽揭示新通路但尚无临床转化验证，暂不改变实践。

title: A clinicopathological and hematological biomarker-based nomogram for overall survival in early-onset colorectal cancer: development, external validation, and translational implications.
authors: Su M, Xia C, Li Z, Gao B, Zhang J, Wang G, et al.
abstract: Early-onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) is increasing globally, yet prognostic tools specifically tailored to younger patients remain limited. Molecular markers such as mismatch repair (MMR) status, although biologically important, are not routinely available in many clinical settings, creating a translational gap between laboratory advances and bedside practice. This study aimed to develop and externally validate a practical nomogram for predicting overall survival (OS) in EOCRC using widely accessible clinicopathological variables and routine hematological biomarkers, thereby bridging routine laboratory data to individualized risk stratification. This retrospective study included 410 EOCRC patients who underwent radical surgery (training cohort n=246, internal validation n=164). An independent external cohort (n=91) from a second tertiary center was used for validation. Candidate predictors included T/N stage, presenting symptoms, tumor markers [carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA), carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9)], and the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII)-a composite biomarker reflecting the balance between tumor-promoting inflammation and antitumor immunity. A nomogram was constructed using the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and multivariable Cox regression. Model performance was assessed by discrimination [time-dependent area under the curve (AUC)], calibration, decision curve analysis (DCA), risk stratification, and head-to-head comparison with an anatomical-stage model and a clinicopathological model without inflammatory biomarkers. Six predictors were retained in the final nomogram: T stage, N stage, changes in bowel habits, CEA, CA19-9, and SII. For 3-year OS, the AUC was 0.897 (training), 0.837 (internal validation), and 0.861 (external validation); for 5-year OS, the corresponding AUCs were 0.904, 0.873, and 0.868. The nomogram significantly outperformed the anatomical-stage model in all cohorts (all P<0.001) and provided incremental value over the clinicopathological model in both validation cohorts. Calibration curves showed good agreement between predicted and observed survival probabilities. DCA confirmed clinical net benefit across a range of threshold probabilities. The nomogram successfully stratified patients into high- and low-risk groups (log-rank P<0.001 in all three cohorts). This externally validated nomogram translates routinely available clinicopathological and hematological data into individualized OS predictions for EOCRC. By integrating inflammatory biomarkers such as SII, the model provides a translatable tool that may support risk-stratified surveillance and management, particularly in clinical settings where routine hematological and clinicopathological assessments are available but comprehensive molecular profiling is not.
cn_title: 基于临床病理与血液学标志物的早发性结直肠癌总生存列线图：开发、外部验证及转化意义
insight: 该模型用常规临床病理与血液学指标（含SII）预测早发性结直肠癌总生存，并经外部验证，为分子检测不可及场景提供可推广的风险分层工具。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性建模加外部验证，样本量中等（410+91），方法学规范但非前瞻干预，暂不足以直接改变实践。

title: Association between primary-site surgery and overall survival in non-metastatic and metastatic colorectal cancer: a population-based study using the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results database.
authors: Fan X, Luo T, Li Z, Wang X, Xu E
abstract: Surgery is central to the management of localized colorectal cancer (CRC), whereas surgical decision-making in metastatic disease is more complex and highly individualized. This study aimed to investigate patterns of primary-site surgery recorded in the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database, reasons for no surgery, patient and tumor characteristics, and observed overall survival (OS) in non-metastatic CRC, with a separate exploratory analysis of surgical patterns in metastatic disease. CRC tumor records diagnosed between 2006 and 2015 were identified according to prespecified eligibility criteria. Non-metastatic (M0) disease was the primary cohort. Descriptive analyses characterized recorded surgery, reasons for no surgery, baseline features, and survival; multivariable Cox regression, propensity-score matching (PSM), and sensitivity analyses estimated adjusted associations. Metastatic (M1) disease was analyzed separately as an exploratory cohort. Among 14,130 M0 tumor records, five with unknown surgery status were excluded, leaving 13,807 with and 318 without recorded primary-site surgery. Surgery was not recommended in 213 of 318 no-surgery records (67.0%), and the method used to determine regional nodal status differed markedly by surgery status [absolute standardized mean difference (SMD), 2.158]. Median OS was 164 months with recorded surgery and 59 months without recorded surgery (log-rank P<0.001). In the primary Cox model, recorded surgery was associated with a lower average hazard of death over follow-up [hazard ratio (HR), 0.457; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.397-0.527; P<0.001], but the proportional hazards assumption was not met. PSM yielded 317 pairs; the pair-stratified HR was 0.453 (95% CI: 0.344-0.598; P<0.001), and 60-month OS was 74.1% versus 50.2%. The M1 cohort comprised 694 tumor records. In the 2010-2015 subset (n=467), records without primary-site surgery more often had lung metastasis, bone metastasis, and at least two documented organ sites; four recorded surgical patterns were observed. In M0 disease, no recorded primary-site surgery was uncommon, usually reflected that surgery was not recommended, and was associated with substantially shorter observed survival. This association does not quantify the causal effect of surgery. Heterogeneous metastatic distributions and procedure patterns in M1 disease underscore the need for individualized clinical decision-making rather than routine primary-site surgery based on registry survival comparisons.
cn_title: 原发灶手术与非转移性及转移性结直肠癌总生存的关联：基于SEER数据库的人群研究
insight: 该研究证实非转移性肠癌中原发灶手术与显著生存获益相关，但转移性肠癌手术模式异质，提示肝转移等M1患者需个体化决策而非常规原发灶切除。
grade_rationale: 基于SEER的大样本回顾性队列，采用PSM和敏感性分析，但为观察性设计且转移性队列仅探索性分析，证据等级不足以直接改变实践。

title: FBXO17 regulates the malignant progression of colorectal cancer via the Wnt/β-catenin pathway.
authors: Tang E, Xiao Y, Qian X, Li S, Chen B
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most common malignant tumors worldwide, often presenting without apparent early symptoms, and most patients are diagnosed at an advanced stage with a poor prognosis. F-box protein 17 (FBXO17) is up-regulated in various tumors and may represent a potential prognostic marker in CRC. This study sought to elucidate FBXO17's specific role in CRC and the underlying mechanism. Real-time fluorescence quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), together with Western blot, was applied to determine FBXO17 expression in CRC cell lines. FBXO17-silenced and FBXO17-overexpressing CRC cells were established using a lentiviral system and liposome transfection technology, respectively. Cell counting kit-8, Transwell, and wound healing assays, as well as Western blot, were used to assess CRC cell proliferation, invasion, and migration, and to examine Wnt/β-catenin pathway activation. Intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS), Fe Compared with human normal colon cells, human CRC cells exhibited generally high FBXO17 expression. Silencing FBXO17 led to decreased CRC cell proliferation, invasion, and migration, attenuated Wnt/β-catenin pathway activation, and enhanced ferroptosis, whereas overexpression of FBXO17 reversed these effects by enhancing CRC cell proliferation, invasion, and migration, activating the Wnt/β-catenin pathway, and suppressing ferroptosis. Furthermore, treatment with ferrostatin-1 (ferroptosis inhibitor) or CHIR-99021 (Wnt/β-catenin pathway agonist) enhanced the proliferation, invasion, and migration of FBXO17-silenced CRC cells while attenuating ferroptosis. Silencing FBXO17 can promote CRC cell ferroptosis but inhibit proliferation, invasion, and migration through suppression of Wnt/β-catenin pathway activation.

title: Kinase-based molecular subtyping and a prognostic risk model in colorectal cancer with functional validation of PLK4.
authors: Shen C, Ding C, Han X, Wang Y
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) exhibits marked molecular heterogeneity, yet prognostic tools centered specifically on protein kinases remain scarce. This study aimed to identify kinase-related molecular subtypes of CRC and to develop and validate a kinase-based prognostic risk model integrating clinical and immune features. Transcriptomic data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) were integrated to identify prognosis-related kinase genes. Unsupervised consensus clustering was used to define molecular subtypes, and differences in survival, immune infiltration, and immune checkpoint expression between subtypes were assessed. A nine-gene prognostic model was constructed using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and multivariate Cox regression and validated in an independent external cohort. Associations with the consensus molecular subtypes (CMS), tumor mutational burden (TMB), drug sensitivity, and immunotherapy response were analyzed. The expression of core genes was verified by quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) in CRC cell lines, and the function of Consensus clustering revealed two distinct kinase-based subtypes with significantly different survival; the poorer-prognosis subtype overlapped predominantly with CMS4 and showed altered immune infiltration. The nine-gene risk model provided reproducible prognostic stratification, remained an independent predictor of survival after adjustment for tumor-node-metastasis (TNM) stage, and was validated in the external validation cohort. Compared with high-risk patients, low-risk patients showed higher TMB and greater predicted responsiveness to immunotherapy and selected chemotherapeutic agents. qRT-PCR confirmed that nine core genes exhibited expression trends consistent with the bioinformatics predictions, and This kinase-based subtyping and prognostic model offers a complementary tool for risk stratification and individualized treatment decisions in CRC. title: Phytochemicals in colorectal cancer therapy: emerging mechanisms, translational opportunities, and global research evolution.
authors: Adil M, Dawe GS, Subramaniyan V
abstract: Colorectal cancer is still a leading cause of cancer morbidity and mortality in the world. This is a reflection of the limitations of current chemotherapy and the need for additional therapeutic strategies. Phytochemicals from plants have been of great interest recently because they can affect several pathways involved in cancer. In this review, we combine bibliometric mapping with a narrative synthesis to discuss the changing nature of phytochemical research in colorectal cancer. A total of 1029 records from Web of Science, covering January 2000 to December 2025, were analyzed using VOSviewer, Bibliometrix, and CiteSpace. The trend of publications is steadily increasing, particularly since 2020. Keyword mapping revealed some common themes, particularly apoptosis, flavonoids, curcumin, quercetin, network pharmacology, nanoparticles, and ferroptosis. The literature shows a transition from early screening studies to more in-depth mechanistic and translational studies. From the bibliometric findings, five areas are identified that might influence the future development of the field. These areas include modulation of multiple signaling pathways, regulated cell death, interactions between the gut microbiome and immune system, overcoming chemoresistance, and innovative delivery systems to enhance bioavailability. Taken together, these findings suggest that phytochemicals act as multi-target compounds rather than single cytotoxic agents with promising potential in combination therapies for colorectal cancer. Materials and delivery research accounts for a rising share of this corpus, increasing from 0.0% of records published between 2000 and 2011 to 16.0% of those published between 2020 and 2025, and nanoparticles emerge as a major keyword cluster although no materials term appears in the search string. The review therefore treats biomaterial design as a component of the field rather than as an adjunct to it, covering polymeric, lipid, inorganic, biomimetic and stimuli-responsive platforms against a common set of performance criteria.
cn_title: 植物化学物在结直肠癌治疗中的新兴机制、转化机遇与全球研究演进
insight: 该文献通过文献计量与叙述性综述揭示植物化学物在结直肠癌治疗中的多靶点机制及转化趋势，提示纳米递送与联合治疗是未来方向，为肠癌肝转移的辅助治疗提供新思路。

title: Elucidating the Molecular Mechanisms of N-Nitrosodimethylamine-Induced Colorectal Cancer: A Network Toxicology and Molecular Docking Analysis.
authors: Zhou J, He D, Lin J, Yao H, Zhao Z
journal: Journal of Environmental Pathology, Toxicology and Oncology : Official Organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer
abstract: N-nitrosodimethylamine (NDMA), a prevalent environmental contaminant found in food, water, and pharmaceuticals, is a recognized carcinogen strongly associated with colorectal cancer (CRC). However, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying NDMA-induced colorectal carcinogenesis remain incompletely understood. This study aimed to systematically investigate the molecular interactions between NDMA and CRC-related proteins to uncover potential mechanisms and therapeutic targets. We employed an integrated computational approach combining network toxicology and molecular docking. NDMA targets were identified using ChEMBL, STITCH, SwissTargetPrediction, and PharmMapper databases. CRC-associated genes were retrieved from GeneCards, OMIM, and TTD databases. Protein-protein interaction networks were constructed using STRING and analyzed with Cytoscape. Hub genes were identified through centrality analysis, validated using TCGA expression data, and subjected to molecular docking with AutoDock Vina. We identified 370 NDMA targets and 1,575 CRC-related genes, with 91 overlapping genes representing potential mediators of NDMA-induced carcinogenesis. Enrichment analysis revealed significant involvement of xenobiotic response, MAPK signaling, and extracellular matrix remodeling pathways. Network analysis identified TP53, HSP90AB1, and HSP90AA1 as critical hub genes, all showing significant differential expression in CRC tissues (p < 0.05). Molecular docking revealed direct binding of NDMA to TP53 (-4.2 kcal/mol), HSP90AB1 (-4.6 kcal/mol), and HSP90AA1 (-3.8 kcal/mol), suggesting potential functional interference beyond genotoxic effects. This study elucidates multi-faceted mechanisms of NDMA-induced colorectal carcinogenesis, identifying TP53, HSP90AB1, and HSP90AA1 as key molecular targets. The convergence of network analysis, expression validation, and structural predictions provides a comprehensive framework for understanding NDMA toxicity and offers potential targets for preventing CRC in exposed populations.
cn_title: 网络毒理学与分子对接解析NDMA诱导结直肠癌的分子机制
insight: 揭示NDMA通过TP53/HSP90等靶点诱导肠癌的潜在机制，为环境致癌物相关肠癌预防提供线索，但肝转移相关性弱。
grade_rationale: 纯计算毒理学研究，无实验验证或临床数据，证据等级低，但方法整合有一定参考价值。

title: Gene Expression Patterns in Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation: A Prognostic and Predictive Tool for Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Liao Z, Zou W, Guo J, Teng X
journal: Journal of Environmental Pathology, Toxicology and Oncology : Official Organ of the International Society for Environmental Toxicology and Cancer
abstract: To illuminate the role of liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) in colorectal cancer (CRC) and its potential as a therapeutic target, we conducted an in-depth analysis focusing on LLPS-related genes (LLPSRGs). Our approach involved a predictive model with LLPSRGs levels a s basis, with intent to prognosticate patient survival and assist in immunotherapy decision-making. Employing univariate Cox regression equipped with LASSO for initial screening, we identified LLPSRGs linked to CRC survival. A subsequent multivariate Cox regression analysis led to the establishment of a prognostic model that included seven pivotal genes. Survival analysis and ROC curve assessment confirmed the accuracy of this model in predicting CRC patient survival, validated in a GEO dataset. PPI network showed that there were complex correlations between differentially expressed genes in risk groups. qRT-PCR findings showed that the top 10 hub genes in the network were all upregulated in CRC cells. Immune profiling unveiled differences in immune cell infiltration and potential immunotherapy responses between high-risk and low-risk groups, with the latter being more suitable for immunotherapeutic interventions. Drug sensitivity analysis supported personalized treatment approaches. Overall, we developed a robust LLPSRG-based prognostic model for CRC, offering insights for CRC clinical prognosis and therapy.
cn_title: 基于液-液相分离相关基因的结直肠癌预后与免疫治疗预测模型
insight: 该研究构建了基于液-液相分离相关基因的结直肠癌预后模型，可预测生存并指导免疫治疗决策，为肠癌精准分层提供新思路。
grade_rationale: 研究基于公共数据库构建预后模型，缺乏前瞻性验证，但生信分析较为全面，对临床实践影响有限。

title: Peritumoral Malignant Cellular Foci Performs Better Than Tumor Budding and Poorly Differentiated Cluster in Risk Stratification of Lymph Node Metastasis in pT1 Colorectal Cancer.
authors: Yuan C, Wang C, Lai J, Huang J, Chen J, Wu W, et al.
journal: The American Journal of Surgical Pathology
abstract: As biomarkers separated by the arbitrary 5-tumor-cell cutoff at the tumor invasive front, tumor budding (TB) and poorly differentiated clusters (PDC) are recognized as high-risk factors for lymph node metastasis (LNM) in pT1 colorectal cancer (CRC). Nonetheless, relevant findings remain inconsistent. Furthermore, the association between the tumor invasive front biomarker and D3 LNM in pT1 CRC remains unknown. To identify a biomarker that captures the full morphologic spectrum and eliminates the need for such cutoffs at the tumor invasive front for predicting LNM, particularly D3 LNM, in pT1 CRC, we defined peritumoral malignant cellular foci (PMCF) as nonglandular foci composed of ≥1 tumor cell at the tumor invasive front. After enrolling 2611 endoscopically or surgically resected pT1 CRC patients from 6 high-volume Chinese institutions, we found that neither TB nor PDC exhibited a consistent independent association with LNM across the training and validation cohorts. In contrast, PMCF emerged as an independent risk factor with superior risk stratification of LNM in both cohorts (P<0.05). The association between PMCF and LNM remained significant in subgroup analyses stratified by age, sex, tumor location, and BMI (P<0.05). Moreover, PMCF correlated with a greater number of metastatic lymph nodes and exhibited a stronger association with D3 LNM than with D1 and D2 LNM (P<0.05). In conclusion, PMCF not only suggests additional radical surgery after endoscopic resection in pT1 CRC, but may also indicate D3 lymph node dissection. PMCF provides an evidence-based rationale to optimize surgical decision-making in pT1 CRC.
cn_title: 瘤周恶性细胞灶在pT1结直肠癌淋巴结转移风险分层中优于肿瘤出芽和低分化簇
insight: 提出PMCF新指标，能更优预测pT1结直肠癌淋巴结转移及D3转移，辅助内镜切除后手术决策和淋巴结清扫范围。

title: Platelet P2Y12 inhibitor use and risk of colorectal cancer incidence and colorectal cancer-related mortality: a Swedish registry-based cohort study.
authors: Fuchs M, Ha J, Yan J, Bottai M, Song M, Simon TG, et al.
abstract: Low-dose aspirin use is associated with reduced CRC incidence and CRC-related mortality. A similar association with P2Y12 inhibitor use remains uncertain. We investigated whether the use of P2Y12 inhibitors was associated with CRC incidence and CRC-related mortality among individuals diagnosed with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). From the ESPRESSO cohort, we identified 334,882 patients diagnosed with ASCVD between 2006 and 2021. We identified patients who initiated P2Y12 inhibitors ≥ 84 consecutive Defined Daily Doses (cDDDs). We estimated the risk of incident CRC and CRC mortality according to P2Y12 inhibitor use using Cox proportional-hazards regression models adjusting for potential confounders including comorbidities and regular aspirin use. We documented 4,015 incident CRC cases and 2,610 CRC-related deaths during a median follow-up of 5.1 years (IRQ, 2.1-9.0 years). We did not observe an association between P2Y12 inhibitor use and CRC incidence. In contrast, a longer duration of P2Y12 inhibitor use was associated with lower CRC-related mortality. Compared to non-users, multivariable-adjusted hazard ratio (HR) for CRC mortality were 0.73 (95% CI, 0.60-0.89) in patients with 336-671 cDDDs of P2Y12 inhibitor and 0.81 (95% CI, 0.68-0.97) in those with ≥672 cDDDs. Among patients with incident CRC diagnosis, subsequent initiation of P2Y12 inhibitor after CRC diagnosis was associated with significantly lower CRC mortality (HR 0.42; 95% CI, 0.29-0.60). P2Y12 inhibitor use was not associated with risk of incident CRC but was significantly inversely associated with CRC mortality, which appeared to be due to improved survival among individuals who initiate P2Y12 inhibitors after CRC diagnosis. These findings merit further study given the observational nature of the analysis and potential for residual confounding.
