title: Are we being prudent or profligate? Overblocking in colorectal adenocarcinoma resections.
authors: Tsang SPW, Bhula NH, Fielder T, Kench JG, Shin JS, McKenzie C
abstract: There are two main margins in histopathological assessment of colorectal resections for primary adenocarcinoma: non-peritonealised and longitudinal margins (proximal and distal). The Royal College of Pathologists of Australasia (RCPA) recommends microscopic examination of longitudinal margins only if tumour extends within 30 mm macroscopically, unless aggressive features are present. We evaluated the utility of microscopic longitudinal margin assessment by auditing colorectal resections presented at the Royal Prince Alfred Hospital (RPAH) multidisciplinary meetings (between July 2023 and June 2025) and surveying Australasian Gastrointestinal Pathology Society (AGPS) members on sampling practices. A total of 308 specimens were identified, of which all underwent routine longitudinal margin sampling. Findings were present in 2.27% (n=7) of margin sections, including five neoplastic and two non-neoplastic abnormalities. Neoplastic findings included adenocarcinoma (n=2), sessile serrated lesion (n=1), low-grade dysplasia (n=1), and Paget disease (n=1). Both adenocarcinomas were macroscopically identified and margin status was not altered by microscopy. Regarding the survey, there were 82 participants; 89% reported routine universal longitudinal margin sampling and 91% donut sampling. Most participants believed routine microscopic examination of margins rarely yields diagnostic information (91% for longitudinal margins; 68% for donuts). A targeted approach to selective sampling could reduce costs, workload, and environmental impact without compromising patient care.
cn_title: 结直肠腺癌切除标本纵向切缘过度取材：审慎还是浪费？
insight: 常规纵向切缘显微镜检查阳性率仅2.27%且未改变分期，支持按RCPA标准选择性取材，可减少病理工作量与医疗成本。
grade_rationale: 基于308例标本审计联合82人调查，样本量中等且为单中心回顾性设计，但直接挑战常规取材规范，具较强实践改变潜力。

title: Cohort profile: KaroLiver, a population-based cohort of patients receiving curative liver-directed treatment for colorectal liver metastases at a Swedish tertiary centre.
authors: Gerling M, Fernández Moro C, Limbecker C, Viljamaa A, Harrizi S, Hamidi Y, et al.
abstract: The Karolinska Liver Metastases (KaroLiver) cohort was established to investigate associations between clinical characteristics and histopathological features in patients treated with curative intent for colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM). The cohort combines whole-slide digital histopathology images with detailed oncological, surgical, radiological and survival data, enabling comprehensive analyses of treatment trajectories, clinical outcomes and metastatic tumour biology. KaroLiver is a retrospective observational cohort comprising all consecutive patients who received curative-intent, liver-directed treatment for CRLM at Karolinska University Hospital in Stockholm, Sweden. The hospital is the regional referral centre for hepatopancreatobiliary (HPB) surgery, serving the population of approximately 2.5 million people in the Stockholm-Gotland healthcare region. Patient enrolment is continuously updated in accordance with amended ethical approvals and evolving scientific questions. The cohort currently comprises 811 patients who underwent 1204 liver interventions between February 2012 and January 2022. Detailed clinical, oncological, surgical, pathological, molecular, recurrence and survival data are collected. Median overall survival (OS) in the current cohort is 51.0 months (95% CI 46.2 to 57.1 months), and median recurrence-free survival (RFS) is 10.4 months (95% CI 9.2 to 11.9 months). The 5-year OS rate is 44.9% (95% CI 41.2% to 48.8%). Studies using the cohort have so far identified a liver injury-derived stromal capsule in a subset of metastases associated with improved survival. The cohort has also enabled the identification of histopathological markers of tumour biology, sex-based differences in treatment and survival, and associations between post-hepatectomy liver failure and oncological outcomes. Current research priorities include advanced histology-based prognostic scoring, sex differences in recurrence and retreatment, tumour biology and outcomes in early-onset versus average-onset CRLM, as well as CT-based and MRI-based radiomics, all integrated within KaroLiver’s histopathological framework. Data sharing is supported, given that regulatory requirements are met. Retrospective accrual and outcome updates will continue for current and future studies, subject to the required approvals.
cn_title: KaroLiver队列：瑞典三级中心结直肠癌肝转移根治性局部治疗的 population-based 队列
insight: 该队列整合数字病理与临床多维度数据，为CRLM根治性治疗后肿瘤生物学与预后研究提供独特资源，启示肝转移研究应重视病理-影像-分子整合。
grade_rationale: 基于大样本回顾性队列，提供预后数据但非干预性研究，暂不改变临床实践。

title: Postoperative length of stay comparison associated with a switch from alvimopan to naloxegol in patients undergoing major small and large bowel procedures.
authors: Schultz HM, Raiff D
journal: American Journal of Health-system Pharmacy : AJHP : Official Journal of the American Society of Health-system Pharmacists
abstract: This retrospective analysis compares postoperative length of stay in patients undergoing colorectal surgery who received naloxegol or alvimopan as part of an Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocol. This is a systemwide retrospective cohort. The community health system switched from alvimopan to naloxegol as the peripherally acting mu-opioid receptor antagonist (PAMORA) agent used in the colorectal ERAS protocol in December 2024. Adult patients who underwent colorectal surgery and received one PAMORA dose for surgical discharge dates between May 2024 and August 2025 were included. There was no difference in median length of stay (alvimopan 3.2 days [2.2-6.2] versus naloxegol 3.3 days [2.2-5.9], p = 0.881). Median bowel function return was achieved sooner in patients receiving alvimopan (1.4 days [1.1-2.1] versus 1.7 [1.2-2.4], p = 0.015), however all-cause 30-day readmission rates were higher in the alvimopan group (15.2% versus 8.2%, p = 0.021). Patients in the alvimopan group were more likely to receive a dose prior to the procedure than naloxegol (89.1% versus 76.4%, p < 0.001). A subgroup analysis of those patients revealed there was no difference in median length of stay, median bowel function return, or incidence of postoperative ileus, with higher readmission rates in the alvimopan group (p = 0.005). The average PAMORA cost per admission who received alvimopan was approximately 16 times more expensive than naloxegol. Switching from alvimopan to naloxegol in colorectal ERAS protocols is a potential cost-saving initiative for formulary management that was associated with similar observed length of stay and postoperative ileus rates.
cn_title: 结直肠手术ERAS方案中阿维莫泮换用纳洛昔醇的术后住院时间比较
insight: 在结直肠ERAS方案中以纳洛昔醇替代阿维莫泮，住院时间与肠梗阻发生率相当且费用大幅降低，为围手术期用药管理提供成本效益依据。
grade_rationale: 系统级回顾性队列，样本量尚可但非随机、单系统数据，成本节约有参考价值但不足以直接改变指南。

title: ShenqiYichang decoction enhances colorectal cancer immune efficacy via IDO1 mediated reduction of Treg infiltration.
authors: Yang Y, Li L, Fang Y, Yang Z, Xue R, Gao M, et al.
abstract: ShenqiYichang decoction (SQYCD) is a traditional Chinese formula indicated for colorectal cancer (CRC). Studies have shown that SQYCD potentiates antitumor immunity and enhances the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). This study aimed to investigate the mechanism of SQYCD in enhancing ICIs efficacy against microsatellite stability (MSS) CRC. An in vivo CT26 tumor-bearing mouse model was established. The antitumor efficacy of SQYCD alone and in combination with ICIs was evaluated, and Treg infiltration was detected by immunofluorescence. Network pharmacology and bioinformatics were used to screen potential targets of SQYCD for MSS CRC. In vitro, MSS CRC cell lines were used for CCK-8 to assess cell proliferation. A CT26-Treg co-culture system was used to analyze Treg proportion by flow cytometry. Western blot, qRT-PCR, ELISA, and Co-IP assays were used to assess the IDO1/Kyn/p-AKT axis and IDO1-PI3K interactions. UPLC-Q-TOF/MS and molecular docking were subsequently employed to identify the key absorbed components involved in the IDO1-PI3K pathway regulated by SQYCD. In vivo, SQYCD alone did not affect the proliferation of MSS CRC cells but inhibited Treg infiltration. When combined with ICIs, SQYCD enhanced the efficacy of ICIs, significantly inhibiting tumor cell proliferation and further reducing Treg infiltration. Network pharmacology and bioinformatics analysis suggested IDO1 as a potential target of SQYCD in MSS CRC. In vitro, SQYCD-containing serum did not reduce MSS CRC cell proliferation but decreased Treg proportion in the CT26-Treg co-culture system. SQYCD also promoted IL-2 levels while downregulating IL-10 and TGF-β levels. Mechanistically, SQYCD suppressed the IDO1/Kyn pathway and p-AKT expression. Additionally, components of SQYCD significantly reduced the IDO1-PI3K interaction. LC-MS and molecular docking results suggested that esculetin, glycitin, and hydroxygenkwanin may be the active components of SQYCD that reduce the IDO1-PI3K interaction. SQYCD reduces Treg infiltration by inhibiting both the IDO1/Kyn/p-AKT and the IDO1-PI3K interaction, consequently enhancing the efficacy of ICIs.
cn_title: 参芪益肠汤通过IDO1介导减少Treg浸润增强结直肠癌免疫疗效
insight: 该研究揭示中药复方通过IDO1/Kyn/p-AKT及IDO1-PI3K轴减少Treg浸润，为MSS型肠癌免疫增敏提供新策略，对肝转移免疫微环境调控有借鉴意义。
grade_rationale: 研究为临床前基础机制探索，虽具转化潜力但尚未经临床验证，不足以改变实践。

title: Piperlongumine alleviates colitis by promoting β-catenin proteasomal degradation to inhibit NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis.
authors: Li Y, Jiang J, Zhou Y, Chen J, Tang J, Hu Q, et al.
abstract: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory disorder characterized by diffuse mucosal inflammation confined to the colon and rectum. Long pepper is a widely used condiment for stews and barbecues and is known for its potential nutritional and medicinal value. Piperlongumine (PPL), the major active component of long pepper, represents a promising anti-inflammatory agent. However, the precise mechanism by which PPL regulates colitis remains unclear and requires further elucidation. In this study, we found that PPL interfered with NLRP3 inflammasome assembly in mouse and human macrophages and inhibited inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis. Mechanistic exploration revealed that PPL impaired NLRP3-ASC complex assembly and subsequent inflammasome activation largely by promoting β-catenin proteasomal degradation and reducing β-catenin abundance, with a minor contribution from a β-catenin-independent pathway. Most importantly, PPL alleviated pathological features of dextran sulfate sodium-induced colitis, including colorectal shortening, body weight loss, occult blood, and decreased neutrophil infiltration. In summary, PPL is a food-derived ingredient with anti-inflammatory properties that ameliorates colitis by suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis.
cn_title: 荜茇酰胺通过促进β-catenin蛋白酶体降解抑制NLRP3炎症小体活化与细胞焦亡缓解结肠炎
insight: 揭示PPL通过β-catenin-NLRP3轴缓解结肠炎的新机制，为肠癌炎-癌转化及肝转移微环境干预提供潜在靶点。
grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，未涉及临床转化或实践改变，但机制新颖且具潜在转化价值。

title: SPP1
authors: Song L, Yan T, Lu SY, Tong T, Wang Z, Zhou CB, et al.
abstract: Rising incidence of colorectal cancer (CRC) and limited therapeutic options highlight the urgent need to define the drivers of its progression. The SPP1
cn_title: SPP1在结直肠癌进展中的驱动作用研究
insight: 揭示SPP1作为结直肠癌进展驱动因子的潜力，为靶向SPP1的治疗策略及肝转移机制研究提供新方向。
grade_rationale: 摘要信息有限，属基础机制探索性研究，尚无临床验证，暂不具备改变实践的证据强度。

title: Acute MCL1 Loss via Homoharringtonine-Mediated Translational Inhibition Enables Potent Apoptotic Synergy with BCLXL Blockade.
authors: Ohtsu A, Sawada T, Poluben L, Onose M, Oyama H, Katayama A, et al.
abstract: Antiapoptotic buffering in solid tumors is generally mediated by both BCLXL and MCL1, so that BH3 mimetic drugs targeting only one have limited efficacy. To identify agents that may sensitize tumors to BH3 mimetics targeting BCLXL, we screened prostate cancer cells against a panel of mitochondria-targeted drugs in combination with navitoclax, a BH3 mimetic targeting BCL2 and BCLXL. Homoharringtonine (HHT) in combination with navitoclax and as a single agent emerged as a potent inducer of apoptosis. HHT has been identified as an inhibitor of protein translation, and proteomic analysis showed broad suppression of translation-related pathways, while immunoblotting demonstrated rapid decreases in short-lived proteins, including MCL1. HHT dose response and time course studies showed marked declines in MCL1 within 2 hours that were associated with apoptosis in response to BCLXL inhibition with navitoclax or A1331852. Further cell viability assays showed synergy between HHT and BCLXL inhibitors in multiple prostate, lung, and colorectal cancer cell lines. HHT monotherapy in vivo caused tumor regression in two prostate cancer xenograft models. Analysis of tumor tissue taken at 4 hours after dosing showed decreases in MCL1 and MYC, indicating that HHT levels obtainable in vivo are adequate to deplete short-lived proteins and potentially sensitize to BH3 mimetics targeting BCLXL. These findings support further exploration of HHT as a single agent in solid tumors and establish a rationale for investigating safer, tumor-selective approaches to combine HHT-mediated translational inhibition with BCLXL targeting.
cn_title: 高三尖杉酯碱通过抑制翻译快速降低MCL1，与BCLXL阻断协同诱导结直肠癌细胞凋亡
insight: 该研究揭示HHT可快速降解MCL1，与BCLXL抑制剂在结直肠癌中协同促凋亡，为靶向抗凋亡蛋白的联合治疗提供新策略。
grade_rationale: 研究为临床前体外及小鼠模型，尚未进入临床试验，但协同机制明确，具有转化潜力。

title: Single-gRNA CRISPR/eCas9-mediated simultaneous targeting of cIAP1 and cIAP2 in colorectal cancer cells: RNA-seq reveals distinct transcriptomic and apoptotic responses.
authors: Batır MB
abstract: Cellular inhibitor of apoptosis proteins 1 and 2 (cIAP1 and cIAP2), encoded by BIRC2 and BIRC3, respectively, are important regulators of cellular survival and apoptosis. These proteins contribute to cancer cell survival by suppressing apoptotic signaling. While individual knockouts of BIRC2 or BIRC3 in cancer cells have been investigated, the consequences of simultaneously targeting both paralogs remain poorly understood. Thus, a single-gRNA CRISPR/eCas9 strategy was developed in which one gRNA targeting a shared sequence in BIRC2 and BIRC3 was used to simultaneously disrupt both genes in human colorectal cancer HCT-116 cells, and the resulting cellular and transcriptomic effects were compared with those of the individual knockouts. Individual and dual-targeting CRISPR/eCas9 constructs were experimentally validated by immunofluorescence analysis, RT-PCR, and RT-qPCR, while fluorescence microscopy and T7EI analysis were used to evaluate single-cell-derived clones. Apoptosis was evaluated using flow cytometry, and RNA sequencing was performed for differentially expressed gene (DEG) analysis. The single-gRNA dual-targeting strategy resulted in concurrent loss of cIAP1 and cIAP2 expression and produced a stronger reduction in cell survival and induction of apoptosis than targeting either gene individually. In addition, the expression levels of TNFRSF25, TRAF2, TNFSF15, and MIR663AHG were significantly upregulated following simultaneous BIRC2/BIRC3 targeting. RNA-seq analysis provided detailed insight into the molecular alterations associated with concurrent cIAP1 and cIAP2 depletion. Overall, these findings demonstrate the technical feasibility of targeting two highly homologous genes with a single gRNA and reveal that simultaneous disruption of cIAP1 and cIAP2 produces biological effects that are more pronounced than those observed following individual targeting.
cn_title: 单gRNA CRISPR/eCas9同时靶向结直肠癌细胞cIAP1和cIAP2的转录组与凋亡响应
insight: 证实单gRNA可同时敲除高度同源的BIRC2/BIRC3并产生协同促凋亡效应，为结直肠癌IAP双靶点治疗提供转录组学依据。
grade_rationale: 仅为HCT-116细胞系体外机制研究，无动物或临床验证，距实践改变尚远。

title: Transposable element splicing reveals a tumor-enriched class of gene-independent transcripts.
authors: Li Z, Bao Y, Yu H, Li Q, Zhang H, Wen Y, et al.
abstract: Transposable elements (TEs) are broadly reactivated in tumors, but their repetitive nature has limited transcript-level characterization. Here, we systematically investigate the TE-derived splicing landscape across pan-cancer samples and define a splice-resolved subset of TE-derived transcripts, termed TEtrans, with tumor enrichment and gene independence. TEtrans initiate within TEs, spliced within or between TE loci, and are composed predominantly of TE sequences. Their expression was associated with stemness and inflammation regulators in a context-dependent manner. Functional analyses identify an endogenous retrovirus-derived TEtrans that promotes colorectal cancer growth by enhancing topoisomerase I-mediated DNA relaxation. A subset of TEtrans encodes shared tumor antigens that elicit antigen-specific cytotoxic T cell responses, while a murine TEtrans-like transcript mediates antigen-dependent tumor control in vivo. Collectively, TEtrans represent a splice-resolved source of TE-derived oncogenic drivers and actionable tumor antigens, broadening the scope of TE reactivation in cancer.
cn_title: 转座元件剪接揭示肿瘤富集的基因非依赖性转录本类别
insight: 该研究系统解析泛癌中转座元件剪接景观，定义肿瘤富集且基因非依赖的TEtrans，并发现其可编码致癌驱动因子和共享肿瘤抗原，为肠癌提供新靶点与免疫治疗启示。
grade_rationale: 研究基于多组学数据整合与功能验证，发现新型转录本类别并揭示其功能，但尚未进入临床转化阶段，暂不改变实践。

title: Peritoneal disseminations from appendiceal vs. colorectal mucinous adenocarcinoma. An Italian multicentric comparative study.
authors: Baratti D, Valle M, Tonello M, Di Giorgio A, Lippolis PV, Robella M, et al.
journal: European Journal of Surgical Oncology : the Journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology
abstract: We compared baseline characteristics, outcomes and patterns of failure between patients undergoing cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (CRS/HIPEC) for peritoneal disseminations from appendiceal (MACA) or colorectal mucinous adenocarcinoma (MCRC), in order to assess clinical and prognostical differences. Prospectively collected data for 402 patients treated for MACA (n = 218) or MCRC (n = 184) in 17 Italian centers were retrospectively analyzed. Colorectal origin was associated with lower peritoneal cancer index (PCI) (P < 0.001), lower rates of signet-ring cells histology (P = 0.016), T4a/b primaries (P < 0.001), negative nodes (P < 0.001), synchronous metastases (P < 0.001), microsatellite stability (P = 0.009), wild-type KRAS (P < 0.001) and BRAF (P < 0.001), but not wild-type NRAS (P = 0.999), incomplete cytoreduction (P = 0.014), and perioperative systemic anticancer treatments (s-ACT) (P < 0.001). Median follow-up was 70.5 months (95% confidence interval [CI] = 45.8-92.3) for MACA, and 40.2 months (95%CI = 35.4-55.2) for MCRC. Five-year overall survival was 58.9% (95%CI = 51.3-67.5) for MACA, and 35.4% (95%CI = 27.1-46.2) for MCRC (P < 0.001). Appendiceal origin correlated with better prognosis at multivariate analysis (hazard-ratio 2.52; 95%CI = 1.50-4.25; P < 0.001). Five-year cumulative incidence of distant relapses was higher for MCRC: 42.6% (95%CI = 30.8-52.4) vs. 28.1% (95%CI = 19.7-35.7) (P = 0.032). Incidence of peritoneal relapse was not different (P = 0.706). PCI correlated with survival in MCRC (P < 0.001), but not in MACA. Perioperative s-ACT correlated with worse prognosis in MACA (P = 0.024), but not in MCRC (P = 0.920). Peritoneal disseminations from MACA are associated with distinct clinical-biological features, better prognosis and lower incidence of systemic relapses, suggesting that MCRC and MACA are different entities. MACA should not be excluded from CRS/HIPEC based only on higher PCI. The role of s-ACT remain unclear.
cn_title: 阑尾与结直肠黏液腺癌腹膜播散的多中心比较研究
insight: 阑尾与结直肠黏液腺癌腹膜播散在生物学行为、预后及复发模式上存在本质差异，提示两者应作为独立疾病实体管理，支持对阑尾来源者更积极行CRS/HIPEC。
grade_rationale: 17中心402例前瞻采集数据回顾分析，样本量较大且直接比较两种疾病实体，对CRS/HIPEC适应证选择有实践指导意义。

title: Mechanism matters with traumatic rectal injuries: Multicenter analysis of blunt versus penetrating traumatic rectal injury management and associated outcomes.
authors: Bent CI, Vojvodic V, Nekooei N, Wong MD, Siletz AE, Matsushima K, et al.
abstract: Examine the impact of injury mechanism and management strategies on outcomes after traumatic rectal injury (TRI). TRI are uncommon, with most data derived from penetrating injuries. Whether management and outcomes differ between blunt (BR) and penetrating (PR) injuries remains unclear. A multicenter study across 22 trauma centers compared management patterns, use of the "4 Ds" adjuncts (drain, diversion, distal washout, direct repair), and outcomes between BR and PR. Among 725 patients (511 PR, 214 BR), BR had higher injury severity, more abdominal complications, and required more interventions despite similar TRI grade. Mortality was lowest in PR managed with adjuncts and highest in BR without adjuncts. In BR, diversion-only management resulted in the highest complication and reintervention rates. Drain and distal washout were also associated with increased abdominal complications. Multivariable analysis showed diversion-only management independently increased complications versus primary repair. BR carry greater morbidity than PR and may favor repair strategies.
cn_title: 创伤性直肠损伤机制对治疗策略及结局的影响：钝性与穿透性损伤的多中心分析
insight: 钝性直肠损伤较穿透性损伤并发症更多、干预需求更高，且仅行转流术式结局最差，提示应优先考虑直接修补策略。
grade_rationale: 基于22个创伤中心725例的多中心回顾性分析，样本量较大但非随机设计，对直肠创伤术式选择有参考价值但非肠癌核心实践。

title: Cancer incidence trends among young adults in Portugal, 2001-2022: A population-based study.
authors: Garcia TM, Calisto R, Silva P, Godinho O, Rodrigues C, Lopes-Conceição L, et al.
abstract: Cancer incidence is rising among young adults in several high-income countries, yet comprehensive data from Southern Europe, particularly Portugal, remain limited. We characterized temporal trends in cancer incidence among young adults (20-49 years) in Portugal between 2001 and 2022, comparing them with older adults (≥50 years). This nationwide population-based cohort study included 1,102,774 incident cancer cases recorded by the Portuguese National Cancer Registry. Age-standardized incidence rates (ASIR) per 100,000 inhabitants were calculated using the European Standard Population. Temporal trends were analysed using joinpoint regression, estimating annual percentage changes (APC) and average annual percentage changes (AAPC) by sex, age group, and cancer type. Cancer cases increased from 36,604 in 2001 to 60,926 in 2022. Young adults accounted for 13.0% of all cases. Among young women, ASIR increased by 31.6% (from 156.2 to 205.6; AAPC: +1.48%), driven largely by breast cancer (+50.0%), thyroid (+94.1%), melanoma (+84.1%), and lung cancer (+78.7%). In contrast, young men showed stable overall ASIR (AAPC: -0.05%), with a biphasic pattern of increase (2001-2010) followed by decline (2010-2022). However, young men experienced substantial rises in colorectal (+56.6%), thyroid (+185.1%), and melanoma (+70.1%) incidence, alongside declines in stomach (-67.0%), oesophageal (-56.8%), and lung (-45.8%) cancers. Older adults demonstrated significant ASIR increases driven by trends before 2011, with subsequent stabilization or decline. Cancer incidence among young Portuguese adults is increasing, particularly among women, with sex-specific and site-specific patterns. While declines in tobacco-related cancers reflect successful prevention efforts, rising rates of breast, colorectal, thyroid, and melanoma in young adults signal the need for enhanced targeted prevention strategies and continued etiological research.
cn_title: 2001-2022年葡萄牙年轻成人癌症发病趋势：基于人群研究
insight: 葡萄牙年轻成人癌症发病率上升，其中男性结直肠癌上升56.6%，提示早发性肠癌需加强针对性预防与病因研究。
grade_rationale: 基于全国登记的大样本回顾性趋势分析，揭示早发性肠癌上升，但非干预性研究，实践改变潜力有限。

title: Antitumor potential of medicinal plants from the Brazilian Cerrado: a systematic review of experimental studies.
authors: Franco PIR, Neto JRDC, Braga YLL, de Menezes LB, Miguel MP
journal: Phytomedicine : International Journal of Phytotherapy and Phytopharmacology
abstract: The Brazilian Cerrado harbors 12,180 cataloged angiosperm species; 7395 (60.7%) are endemic to Brazil, and its flora has been used in traditional medicine for generations. Regardless, the antitumor potential of these species has been investigated in a fragmented manner. To compile and analyze experimental evidence on the antitumor effects of preparations derived from Cerrado plant species in vitro and in vivo models. Searches were conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and Scopus, without date restrictions and limited to publications in English. The methodological quality of included studies was assessed using an adapted risk-of-bias assessment tool. Sixty-two studies were included; 55 employed in vitro models and 12 employed in vivo models, five of which combined both approaches. The studies encompassed a broad range of malignancies, including melanoma, leukemias, glioblastoma, and breast, prostate, and colorectal cancers, and evaluated crude extracts, fractions, and isolated compounds from >40 species. The most frequently documented antitumor effects were cell viability reduction, apoptosis induction via the intrinsic mitochondrial pathway, cell cycle arrest, and matrix metalloproteinase inhibition. Annona crassiflora, Campomanesia adamantium, Stryphnodendron adstringens, and Tapirira guianensis were each reported in three or more independent studies (most frequently investigated species). Relevant methodological limitations, including a widespread absence of tumor selectivity data, pharmacokinetic profiles, and experimental blinding, were revealed. No clinical trials evaluating Cerrado plant species as oncological interventions were identified. The Cerrado flora represents a relevant source of compounds with preclinical antitumor activity, but essential translational data remain absent. PROSPERO database (CRD420261372222). Available from https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261372222.
cn_title: 巴西塞拉多药用植物的抗肿瘤潜力：实验研究系统综述
insight: 塞拉多植物提取物在结直肠癌等模型中显示凋亡诱导等临床前活性，但缺乏选择性、药代及临床试验数据，提示天然产物转化研究需补足关键证据链。
grade_rationale: 系统综述整合62项临床前研究，方法学较规范但证据层级低、无临床试验，难以改变临床实践。

title: Multifunctional nanoflower-assisted catalytic hairpin assembly enables extracellular vesicles derived-microRNAs profiling for colorectal cancer diagnosis.
authors: Zhang X, Pan J, Lin Y, Lin Z, Zhu Y, Yang C, et al.
abstract: The clinical translation of small extracellular vesicle-derived microRNAs (sEV-miRNAs) for early colorectal cancer (CRC) diagnosis is often limited by their low abundance and complexity of biological fluids. Herein, we developed an ultrasensitive electrochemical platform based on multifunctional DNA nanoflower-assisted catalytic hairpin assembly (NF-CHA) for sEV-miRNAs detection. The NF acts as a localized scaffold to accelerate CHA kinetics and load abundant signal reporter. As a result, the NF-CHA strategy enables the platform achieving a limit of detection of 23.65 aM. To improve diagnostic performance, we employed different sEV-miRNAs combination and machine learning (ML) algorithms, achieving an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.996 for distinguishing early-stage CRC from healthy donors in clinical samples. Therefore, the electrochemical platform holds a great promise as a robust tool for CRC early diagnosis.
cn_title: 多功能纳米花辅助催化发夹组装实现细胞外囊泡miRNA谱分析用于结直肠癌诊断
insight: 该研究开发了超灵敏电化学平台检测sEV-miRNA，结合机器学习实现早期CRC高精度诊断，为肠癌无创早筛提供了新工具，但肝转移应用尚待探索。
grade_rationale: 方法学创新且诊断性能优异（AUC 0.996），但样本量有限且缺乏外部验证，暂不足以改变临床实践。

title: Artemether induces JNK1/FOXO1/GPX4-mediated ferroptosis to suppress colorectal cancer.
authors: Ge L, Lu H, Zeng B, Xiao Z, Lin Q, Xie C, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, necessitating novel therapeutic strategies. Ferroptosis, an iron‑dependent, lipid-peroxidation-driven form of cell death, has emerged as a potential tumor‑suppressive mechanism. Artemether, a derivative of Artemisia annua L., exhibits antitumor activity in various cancers, but its role in CRC and its link to ferroptosis remain unclear. Using an HCT116 xenograft model and CRC cell cultures, we evaluated artemether's effects on viability, migration, invasion, and histopathology. Inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, IL-18, IL-1, caspase-1) were measured. Ferroptosis was assessed by flow cytometry, electron microscopy, and biochemical markers (GSH, MDA, ROS). Mechanistic studies included network pharmacology, molecular docking, SP600125 treatment, JNK1 siRNA knockdown, ferrostatin-1 rescue, western blotting, and qRT-PCR. Network pharmacology identified JNK1 as a core target of artemether in CRC. In vivo, artemether dose-dependently suppressed tumor growth, with efficacy comparable to that of oxaliplatin. In vitro, artemether inhibited CRC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Concurrently, artemether reduced multiple pro-inflammatory cytokines in serum and cell supernatants, indicating suppression of systemic and local inflammation. Mechanistically, artemether activated the JNK1/FOXO1/GPX4 pathway, leading to Fe²⁺ accumulation, a ROS burst, and lipid peroxidation, thereby inducing ferroptosis. These effects were reversed by the JNK inhibitor SP600125 and JNK1 knockdown. Furthermore, the ferroptosis inhibitor ferrostatin-1 significantly rescued artemether-induced cell death and lipid peroxidation, confirming ferroptosis as the primary mode of cell death. Artemether inhibits CRC and alleviates tumor-associated inflammation by inducing JNK1/FOXO1/GPX4-mediated ferroptosis, validated pharmacologically and genetically, highlighting its potential as an immunomodulatory anticancer agent.
cn_title: 青蒿琥酯诱导JNK1/FOXO1/GPX4介导的铁死亡抑制结直肠癌
insight: 揭示青蒿琥酯经JNK1/FOXO1/GPX4轴诱导铁死亡并抑制肠癌炎症，为肠癌（含肝转移）提供老药新用的候选治疗策略。
grade_rationale: 临床前细胞与裸鼠移植瘤研究，机制链条完整但缺乏人体数据，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Machine learning and multi-omics analyses reveal CLDN1 as a candidate marker associated with colorectal cancer invasion and nutlin-3a (-) response.
authors: Shan W, Li Q, Yuan W, Feng R, Hu P, Song Z, et al.
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is molecularly, cellularly and spatially heterogeneous, and current staging systems and biomarkers incompletely explain prognosis and treatment response. This study integrated transcriptomics, machine learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics and in vitro experiments to prioritize candidate CRC-associated markers and characterize their potential biological and clinical relevance. GSE44861 and GSE44076 from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) and The Cancer Genome Atlas Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA-COAD) were used for differential expression, consensus differentially expressed gene (DEG) identification and functional enrichment analyses. Four machine-learning algorithms were applied for feature selection. Candidate genes were prioritized by differential expression, model importance and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) performance. GSE231559 single-cell data and spatial transcriptomics characterized the cellular source, pseudotime dynamics and spatial distribution of the core gene. TCGA-COAD assessed prognosis, pathways and computationally predicted drug sensitivity. Western blotting, Transwell and MTT assays were used for experimental validation, and public immunohistochemistry images from the Human Protein Atlas were used as supplementary protein-expression evidence. We identified 544 consensus DEGs enriched in leukocyte migration, chemotaxis, extracellular matrix organization, cytokine activity and metabolic pathways. Six genes were jointly selected: CLDN1, CDH3, KRT24, MMP7, NEBL and SCGN. CLDN1 was markedly upregulated and showed the highest tumour-versus-normal discrimination among the six candidates in the TCGA-COAD cohort. Single-cell and spatial analyses showed that CLDN1 was mainly expressed in CRC epithelial cells, displayed increasing expression across the inferred pseudotime ordering, and was enriched in malignant and mixed regions. In the TCGA-COAD cohort, high CLDN1 expression was associated with poorer overall survival and pathways involving the cell cycle, proteasome, autophagy, Hippo, ErbB and CRC. CLDN1 manipulation altered CRC-cell invasion and in vitro response to Nutlin-3a (-). These findings support CLDN1 as a candidate CRC-associated marker linked to malignant epithelial-cell states, tumour-associated spatial heterogeneity, invasive phenotype and Nutlin-3a (-) response. Further independent and prospective validation is required to determine its clinical diagnostic, prognostic and treatment-response relevance.
cn_title: 机器学习与多组学揭示CLDN1作为结直肠癌侵袭及Nutlin-3a(-)反应候选标志物
insight: 整合多组学与机器学习筛选出CLDN1，关联上皮恶性状态、空间异质性、侵袭及Nutlin-3a(-)反应，为肠癌预后与治疗反应标志物提供候选。
grade_rationale: 基于公共数据库的生信分析结合体外验证，无前瞻性临床验证，证据等级有限，尚不足以改变临床实践。

title: Transcriptomics Analysis Provides Insights into the Cytotoxicity Effect by Inonotus rickii Mushroom (Agaricomycetes) Culture Exudate in Breast and Colon Cancer Cells.
authors: Kawashte G, Bose G, Sadawarte S, Kulkarni A, Barvkar VT, Mittal SPK, et al.
abstract: Medicinal mushrooms have higher metabolite content and thus receive considerable attention as medicines. Inonotus rickii (Pat.) Reid is one of the mushrooms found in India. The anticancer effects of I. rickii mushrooms were investigated in this study using breast cancer and colon cancer cell lines. I. rickii mushrooms are known to secrete exudate, and its cytotoxic effect on breast cancer cells (MDA-MB-231) and colon cancer cells (HCT116) was determined. Transcriptomic analysis was determined to investigate the differentially regulated genes responsible for the growth and migration of cancer cells. The cancer cells namely HCT116 and MDA-MB-231 cells were treated with 20% and 10% exudate of I. rickii for cell viability and wound healing assay was done. RNA from the treated and non-treated cells were isolated and analyzed for RNA sequencing. The RNA sequence data was analyzed for functional pathway enrichment analysis, data visualization and gene set enrichment analysis. Quantitative analysis of gene expression of some gene responsible for cancer inhibition by using real-time polymerase chain reaction. The culture exudate of I. rickii showed 25% decrease in cell viability of breast cancer cell line (MDA-MB-231) and colon cancer cell line (HCT116) at 10% (v/v) and 20% (v/v) of exudate respectively compared to HEK normal cell line. At low concentrations, comparative transcriptomics was performed after treatment of exudate to MDA-MB-231 and HCT116 cancer cells. Few differentially regulated genes included genes responsible for the growth and migration of cancer cells. The exudate treatment also showed inhibition in cell migration and also in genes involved in both the cancers. Thus, I. rickii exudate possess anti-cancer property based on cell viability, cell migration and gene expression analysis. Out of ten reported metabolites by LCMS analysis from exudate, four anticancerous metabolites viz., Kysimplexini, Pterulamide, Etzionin and Communesin H. Mushrooms are known to have many nutrients and thus can be used as a part of diet. Thus, these can be used as therapeutics for breast and colon cancer without any side effects.
cn_title: 皱盖纤孔菌培养渗出物体外抑制乳腺癌与结肠癌细胞并调控迁移相关基因的转录组研究
insight: 该研究提示皱盖纤孔菌渗出物含潜在抗肿瘤代谢物，可抑制结肠癌细胞增殖与迁移，为肠癌辅助/化学预防提供天然产物线索，但仅为细胞水平证据。
grade_rationale: 仅两种细胞系的体外转录组与表型实验，无动物或临床验证，证据等级低，难以改变临床实践。

title: Flexible 3D-printed colon with embedded polyps for colorectal cancer public engagement.
authors: Roberts A, Roughley M, Rankin M, O'Toole P, Baker S
journal: Journal of Visual Communication in Medicine
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) modelling has demonstrated value in endoscopic training by creating models that improve recognition of colorectal polyp morphology. Building on our previously published research, we aimed to explore how a research-derived 3D printed colon model could function as an alternative visual communication tool to raise public awareness of colorectal cancer (CRC), screening, and interdisciplinary medical careers. A 3D colon model was modelled in ZBrush, and previously validated 3D digital polyp models were embedded within the colon lumen. The colon was segmented so that the model could be 3D printed in parts and connected with embedded magnets, allowing for the model to be broken down into parts to increase educational interactions. The model was 3D printed in thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) to permit flexibility. It was exhibited at the Museum of Liverpool during the British Science Festival 2025 as an interactive engagement artefact, and facilitated conversations around colorectal anatomy and polyp development, and cancer prevention and screening pathways. Its tactile and visual realism encouraged hands-on exploration and cross-generational engagement. We propose that the use of physical 3D printed colon and polyp models for clinical training can be used as powerful public health communication artefacts.
cn_title: 柔性3D打印结肠模型嵌入息肉用于结直肠癌公众科普
insight: 该研究将已验证的3D打印结肠息肉模型转化为公众科普工具，提示3D打印模型可同时服务于内镜培训与肠癌筛查宣教，为肝转移等晚期肠癌的早筛早诊提供低成本传播载体。
grade_rationale: 仅为科普展示类方法学研究，无临床结局数据，不改变诊疗实践。

title: Oncological outcomes of direct versus delayed surgery after neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy for rectal cancer: national cohort study.
authors: Azhar N, Lydrup ML, Buchwald P
abstract: After the Stockholm III trial, a trend towards delayed surgery after neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy (5 × 5 Gy) for rectal cancer has emerged in Sweden, driven by the lower short-term complication rates and similar oncological outcomes. This study aimed to examine long-term oncological outcomes after neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy, comparing direct versus delayed surgery for rectal cancer in a real-world setting. A registry-based retrospective national cohort study was conducted using prospectively collected data from the Swedish Colorectal Cancer Registry. Patients with rectal cancer receiving neoadjuvant neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy with surgery between 2016 and 2020 were analysed for oncological outcomes (local recurrence, distant metastasis) and overall survival at 3 years, comparing direct surgery, defined as surgery within 7 days after neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy, and delayed surgery, defined as surgery after 28-90 days. The rate of patients who underwent surgery within the delayed time frame of the Stockholm III trial was also recorded. A total of 2080 patients were identified, of whom 1208 (58.1%) underwent direct surgery and 872 had delayed surgery. Of note, only 288 patients underwent resection 28-56 days after neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy (within the time frame of the Stockholm III trial). Although the pathological complete response rate was higher in the delayed-surgery group compared with the direct-surgery group (6.5% versus 0.4%), 3-year local recurrence and distant metastasis rates were, respectively, 1.0% (12 patients) and 6.8% (82) in the direct-surgery group, and 3.4% (30) and 11.9% (104) in the delayed-surgery group. The adjusted hazard ratios for local recurrence and distant metastasis comparing delayed surgery with direct surgery were 3.60 (95 per cent confidence interval 1.75 to 7.39) and 2.17 (1.58 to 2.96), respectively, whereas the adjusted hazard ratio for overall survival was 1.37 (1.06 to 1.77), favouring the direct-surgery group. In a real-world setting, the results indicate that few patients in the delayed-surgery group had surgery within the stipulated time frame. Considering this, delayed surgery was associated with a higher risk of local recurrence, distant metastasis, and reduced overall survival.
cn_title: 直肠癌新辅助短程放疗后直接手术与延迟手术的肿瘤学结局：全国队列研究
insight: 真实世界中延迟手术多超出Stockholm III规定时间窗，且局部复发、远处转移及生存均劣于直接手术，提示短程放疗后应审慎推迟手术。
grade_rationale: 基于全国前瞻性登记数据的大样本真实世界队列，直接挑战当前延迟手术趋势，具较强实践改变潜力。

title: Use of circulating microRNAs to identify high-risk adenomas among FIT+ patients undergoing screening colonoscopy.
authors: Sutherland RL, Ruan Y, Warkentin MT, O'Sullivan DE, Hutchinson JM, McIntyre JB, et al.
journal: Cancer Epidemiology, Biomarkers & Prevention : a Publication of the American Association for Cancer Research, Cosponsored By the American Society of Preventive Oncology
abstract: Colonoscopy prevents colorectal cancer (CRC) but is invasive and resource intensive. Circulating microRNAs (miRNAs) may improve risk stratification of fecal immunochemical test (FIT)-positive individuals by identifying high-risk adenomas (HRAs). We evaluated the association of circulating miRNAs with HRAs and their contribution to risk prediction models (RPMs). We analyzed 398 FIT-positive participants from a Canadian screening cohort (160 HRAs; 238 controls). Plasma miRNAs were quantified using NanoString nCounter. Differential expression was assessed using two-tailed t-tests with Bonferroni correction, and LASSO regression identified predictive miRNAs. Five RPMs were developed (Baseline, Bonferroni, Bonferroni+Baseline, LASSO, LASSO+Baseline) and evaluated using AUCs, DeLong's test, calibration, bootstrap validation, and decision curve analysis. Eleven miRNAs were Bonferroni-significant, and LASSO retained 8 predictors. The Baseline model had an optimism-corrected AUC of 0.61, increasing to 0.80 with these miRNAs and 0.82 with baseline variables added; the LASSO+Baseline model achieved an AUC of 0.82 with good calibration. All miRNA-enhanced models outperformed Baseline (P<0.001) and showed greater net benefit on decision curve analysis. At a 20% threshold, the LASSO+Baseline model achieved 95.0% sensitivity and 56.7% PPV. Conclusions Circulating miRNAs substantially improved identification of HRAs among FIT-positive individuals with clinical utility. These data support further evaluation of miRNA-informed RPMs to refine CRC screening.
cn_title: 循环microRNA用于FIT阳性筛查人群高危腺瘤风险分层
insight: 循环miRNA可显著提升FIT阳性者高危腺瘤识别（AUC 0.82），为肠癌筛查风险分层提供无创工具，但需外部验证。
grade_rationale: 单中心回顾性队列、样本量中等（398例），有bootstrap内部验证但缺乏外部验证，尚不足以改变实践。

title: Expanding Resectability in Bilobar Colorectal Liver Metastases: Hepatic Venous Deprivation as Part of Contemporary Staged Hepatectomy.
authors: Younos M, Christodoulou M, Sucandy I
abstract: Bilobar colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) remain one of the most challenging scenarios in hepatobiliary surgery because complete oncologic resection often requires removal of extensive hepatic parenchyma while preserving an adequate future liver remnant (FLR). Over the past two decades, advances in systemic chemotherapy, minimally invasive liver surgery, liver-directed interventions, and multidisciplinary treatment planning have substantially expanded resectability, allowing an increasing number of patients previously considered unresectable to undergo curative-intent surgery. Contemporary management now focuses on selecting among complementary strategies that safely maximize resectability while preserving functional liver reserve. Within this evolving treatment algorithm, hepatic venous deprivation (HVD) hasemerged as an important strategy for FLR augmentation in appropriately selected patients requiring major hepatectomy.As functional assessment of the FLR continues to evolve beyond volumetric measurements alone, appropriate patient selection and individualized operative planning have become increasingly important. This case-based review describes the successful management of a 66-year-old woman with bilobar CRLM treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy, robotic first-stage parenchymal-sparing liver resection combined with synchronous sigmoid colectomy, HVD, and completion open extended right hepatectomy after adequate FLR hypertrophy. Using this case as a framework, we review the contemporary management of bilobar CRLM, current approaches to FLR augmentation, the rationale for selecting HVD over alternative strategies, evolving methods of functional liver assessment, and the role of minimally invasive staged hepatectomy within multidisciplinary oncological care.
cn_title: 肝静脉剥夺在分期肝切除中扩大双叶结直肠癌肝转移可切除性
insight: 该文通过病例综述展示了肝静脉剥夺作为FLR增量策略在双叶CRLM分期肝切除中的应用，启示需个体化选择FLR增量方式并重视功能评估。
grade_rationale: 基于单病例的叙述性综述，无原始数据或对照，证据等级低，但为FLR增量策略选择提供了实践框架。

title: Establishment of In Vivo Mouse Models to Study Salmonella-Induced Chronic Infection and Gastrointestinal Cancer.
authors: Zhang Y, Sun J
abstract: Salmonella infection increases the risk of chronic diseases, e.g., inflammatory bowel diseases, colon cancer, and gallbladder cancer. However, the mechanisms leading to the development of these conditions are still not completely understood. Here, we describe the methods to establish in vivo mouse models to study Salmonella-induced chronic infection and colon cancer. These models will allow us to investigate the initiation and progression of diseases.
cn_title: 沙门氏菌诱导慢性感染与胃肠道肿瘤小鼠模型的建立
insight: 建立沙门氏菌诱导慢性感染及结肠癌的体内小鼠模型，为感染相关肠癌机制研究提供可操作平台，但与肝转移直接关联有限。
grade_rationale: 方法学描述性论文，无临床数据与外部验证，仅提供模型构建方案，实践改变潜力低。

title: Postoperative complications and hospital costs following elective and emergency colon cancer surgery: a Clavien-Dindo grade-specific cost analysis.
authors: Bech-Larsen S, Vedin T, Engdahl J, Öberg A, Öberg S
abstract: Postoperative complications are drivers of healthcare costs following colon cancer surgery. We compared hospital costs between elective and emergency colon cancer resections according to complication severity. This retrospective cohort study included 520 patients undergoing colon cancer resection, of whom 431 underwent elective and 89 emergency surgery. Postoperative complications were graded according to the Clavien-Dindo classification. Hospital costs were analysed using a micro-costing approach. Adjusted costs were estimated using generalized linear models with gamma distribution and log link, adjusting for tumour stage, ASA classification, age and sex, with surgical technique in elective surgery. CD II-V occurred in 35% of elective and 56% of emergency patients. Emergency patients had higher ASA class, more advanced tumour stage and lower BMI (p < 0.05). Among patients with no or minor complications (CD 0-I), median costs were €9809 following elective surgery and €12,079 following emergency surgery. Among patients with complications, costs were higher in emergency versus elective surgery (€19,655 vs. €14,820; p = 0.004). Adjusted excess costs increased from CD 0-I to CD IV, whereas CD V did not follow this pattern. In adjusted analyses, complication severity remained associated with increased costs, with cost ratios of 3.21 in elective and 4.86 in emergency surgery for grade IV vs no or minor complications; however, the emergency estimate was based on six patients with CD IV complications and should be interpreted cautiously. Complication severity was independently associated with substantial cost increases after colon resection. Observed costs were generally higher and more variable following emergency surgery.
cn_title: 择期与急诊结肠癌术后并发症分级与住院费用的Clavien-Dindo分级成本分析
insight: 该研究揭示并发症严重程度独立驱动结肠癌术后费用增长，急诊手术费用更高且变异更大，提示优化围手术期管理可降低经济负担，对肠癌肝转移患者的手术决策亦有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 回顾性单中心队列，样本量中等，虽采用微成本法和调整模型，但证据等级有限，不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: A case report of pediatric Gardner syndrome and literature review.
authors: Liu M, He S
abstract: This case report discusses the diagnosis and treatment of a 14-year-8-month-old male patient genetically diagnosed with Gardner syndrome (GS), systematically reviewing the disease's epidemiology, clinical manifestations, imaging advances, and management strategies. The patient presented with a post-influenza A chest wall mass and had prior resections of abdominal/scalp masses. Colonoscopy revealed > 20 adenomatous polyps. Imaging demonstrated multiple craniofacial osteomas and epidermoid cysts. Genetic testing identified a pathogenic APC gene mutation (NM_000038.6:c.4669_4670del (p.Ile1557*) heterozygous variant). GS, a familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) subtype, has an estimated pediatric incidence of 1/8000-1/14,000. Its classic triad comprises colorectal polyps, osteomas, and soft tissue tumors. Recent studies indicate earlier malignant transformation of duodenal polyps in children versus adults, with desmoid tumor incidence reaching 10-20%. In imaging, low-dose CT, panoramic radiography, and contrast-enhanced MRI can improve early detection of bone lesions and soft tissue tumors. Genetic testing (APC/MUTYH) is the pediatric screening gold standard. Optimized chemoprevention (sulindac/celecoxib) and endoscopic monitoring have significantly improved prognoses. This case highlights the urgency of multidisciplinary management and genetic counseling for pediatric GS.
cn_title: 儿童Gardner综合征一例报告及文献综述
insight: 儿童Gardner综合征病例提示APC突变携带者需早期基因筛查与多学科管理，对肠癌遗传易感人群的早期干预具有参考价值。
grade_rationale: 单例个案报告结合文献综述，证据等级低，但强化了儿童FAP基因筛查与多学科管理的认识。

title: Recurrence After Resection of Colorectal Liver Metastases and Its Impact on Survival: A Multistate Model-Based, Multi-institutional Observational Cohort Study.
authors: Baldo A, Akabane M, Charalampous CM, Elemosho A, Kawashima J, Spolverato G, et al.
abstract: Conventional survival analyses cannot fully account for recurrence as an intermediate event that dynamically influences subsequent mortality. Multistate models (MSMs) enable explicit modeling of transitions between clinically relevant disease states; however, their application among patients undergoing resection for colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) remains limited. An international multi-institutional database was queried to identify patients undergoing curative-intent hepatectomy for CRLM between 1998 and 2023. A four-state MSM was constructed comprising alive and recurrence-free, alive with recurrence, colorectal cancer (CRC)-related death, and non-CRC-related death. Transition probabilities and transition-specific prognostic factors were evaluated RESULTS: Among 3002 patients, 1624 (54.1%) developed recurrence and 911 (56.1%) died, predominantly from CRC-related causes (92.8%). The probability of recurrence decreased substantially the longer patients remained recurrence-free after surgery, whereas recurrence markedly worsened subsequent prognosis. High tumor burden score was independently associated with transition to recurrence (hazard ratio [HR] 1.06 per unit; 95% confidence interval 1.03-1.08; p < 0.001) but not post-recurrence mortality, suggesting that the adverse prognostic impact of tumor burden was mediated primarily through recurrence. Adjuvant chemotherapy reduced recurrence (HR 0.76; p = 0.005) and CRC-related death from the recurrence-free state (HR 0.39; p = 0.002). MSMs provide a dynamic framework to characterize disease evolution after CRLM resection and represent recurrence as a clinically meaningful time-dependent intermediate state rather than a simple binary endpoint. Recurrence was the dominant determinant of long-term prognosis, supporting the role of MSMs for individualized prognostication and surveillance after hepatectomy for CRLM.
cn_title: 结直肠癌肝转移切除术后复发及其对生存影响的多状态模型多中心队列研究
insight: 多状态模型动态刻画CRLM术后复发-死亡轨迹，证实复发是长期预后主导因素，为个体化监测和辅助治疗决策提供新框架。
grade_rationale: 基于多中心大样本（3002例）的回顾性队列，方法学创新（多状态模型）但非干预性研究，尚不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: Adverse event reporting of golimumab: A disproportionality analysis of the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) database.
authors: Ma W, Jia N, Liao H, Li Z, Li X
abstract: This study conducted a retrospective disproportionality analysis of 50,031 adverse drug event (ADE) reports from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) database spanning Q2 2009 to Q3 2025, in which golimumab was identified as the primary suspect drug. Four disproportionality algorithms were simultaneously applied: the reporting odds ratio (ROR), proportional reporting ratio (PRR), Bayesian confidence propagation neural network (BCPNN), and multi-item gamma Poisson shrinker (MGPS). A total of 397 positive signals were identified across 25 system organ classes (SOCs). The SOCs with concordant positive signals across all four algorithms were identified for infections and infestations and surgical and medical procedures. High-frequency signals included pneumonia, lower respiratory tract infection, influenza, nasopharyngitis, sinusitis and cellulitis. Comparison with the current prescribing information revealed several previously undocumented ADEs, including urinary tract infection, ear infection, flavivirus infection, Zika virus infection and Dengue fever. Twenty-nine positive malignancy signals absent from the prescribing information were identified, including basal cell carcinoma, colorectal cancer, cervical cancer and breast cancer. Time-to-onset analysis revealed that the risk of ADEs was the highest within the first few months of treatment initiation. Clinicians should rigorously monitor for infectious complications and malignancies when prescribing golimumab to ensure patient safety.
cn_title: 戈利木单抗不良事件报告：基于FAERS数据库的不比例分析
insight: 该研究通过FAERS数据库发现戈利木单抗可能增加结直肠癌等恶性肿瘤风险，提示肠癌患者使用该药需警惕，并为药物相关肠癌监测提供信号。
grade_rationale: 基于FAERS的回顾性不比例分析，样本量大但为自发报告数据，存在固有偏倚，证据等级有限，不足以直接改变临床实践。

title: [Lexusus: when the law uses the healthcare professional].
authors: Santos Suárez J
journal: Cuadernos de Bioetica : Revista Oficial de la Asociacion Espanola de Bioetica Y Etica Medica
abstract: The methodological and ethical analysis of clinical studies is a responsibility of the Research Ethics Committees. There are scenarios in which this assessment can be very difficult. This is the case with the TRASMETIR trial that studies liver transplantation in patients with unresectable metastases of colorectal carcinoma. It was conducted in several Spanish hospitals as a clinical trial because liver transplantation was not previously considered a treatment indication for these patients. To justify and supervise the trial, it was stated that it would not represent an additional financial burden for the hospitals and that it was a study based on routine clinical practice. Thus, the infrastructure and professionals dedicated to performing liver transplantation for approved indications could participate in this prospective clinical trial as if it were part of their ordinary work. Upon a detailed analysis of this new and interesting experience, we observed that there are ethical issues that require closer attention. These include the distinction between clinical practice and clinical studies, the impact of possible public sponsorship in clinical trials, the information received in order to participate in a trial by the different professional profiles that collaborate in the systematics of each transplant, the priority and availability of biological resources such as organs for transplantation for their integration into clinical trials, or the way in which information is given and the content of this information to the donor or relatives.
cn_title: TRASMETIR试验的伦理与方法学分析：肝移植治疗不可切除结直肠癌肝转移
insight: 该文剖析TRASMETIR试验的伦理与方法学争议，提示肝移植用于不可切除结直肠癌肝转移的临床研究需严格区分临床实践与研究，并规范知情同意与器官分配。
grade_rationale: 基于对特定临床试验的伦理与方法学分析，非原始研究，但涉及肝移植治疗肠癌肝转移的前沿探索，对研究设计有参考价值。

title: Cohort methods: the CANadian RADiation workers (CANRAD) cohort.
authors: Lane RSD, Prendergast T, Rodriguez-Villamizar LA, Prince P, Zablotska LB
abstract: The long-term follow-up of workers with protracted exposure to low dose occupational ionizing radiation is important to understand the health effects and risks of radiation. This paper describes the creation and record linkage of the CANadian RADiation workers (CANRAD) cohort, including the work to resolve data issues and linkage challenges to outcome databases. The CANRAD cohort includes all workers with occupational exposure to ionizing radiation (1951-2018) in Canada's National Dose Registry (NDR) and three facility-based sub-cohorts: Eldorado uranium workers (1932-1980), Ontario uranium miners (1954-1996), and Atomic Energy of Canada Limited nuclear workers (1956-1985). The sub-cohorts were added to the NDR to update workers' employment histories and radiation exposures to 2018. Deterministic and probabilistic record linkage methods linked the CANRAD cohort to national population-based mortality (1950-2020), cancer incidence (1969-2019), and tax (1981-2020) data. Of 957,580 CANRAD workers, 883,150 (92.2%) successfully linked to Statistics Canada vital statistics databases. The analytical cohort includes 860,650 (89.9%) workers, including 427,920 (49.7%) females. At the end of follow-up, 751,520 (87.3%) of the cohort were alive and 94,410 (11.0%) were dead. Neoplasms and circulatory disease represented 63.8% (57,030) of all known causes of death (89,330). Prostate, breast, lung & bronchus, and colorectal cancer represented 49.9% (40,780) of first primary cancers (81,670). The mean cumulative effective dose was 17.1 mSv; but most cumulative doses were <10 mSv (∼85.0% of males and 98.1% of females). Females (350,510, 82.4%) dominated the medical sector. The CANRAD cohort is a large and valuable cohort of Canadian occupationally exposed radiation workers with employment histories, radiation exposures and long-term follow-up of tax, mortality, and cancer incidence. Analysis of this cohort will support the radiation protection framework.
cn_title: 加拿大辐射工作者队列（CANRAD）：低剂量职业辐射暴露与癌症长期风险研究平台
insight: CANRAD大型职业辐射队列的建立为低剂量辐射与结直肠癌等癌症风险关联提供长期随访证据，对肠癌环境暴露病因研究有参考价值，但与肝转移无直接关联。
grade_rationale: 方法学队列描述性论文，样本量极大（约86万）但无干预与临床结局分析，不改变临床实践。

title: Humor-Based Interventions for Colorectal Cancer Screening: Reappraisal Pathways and the Moderating Roles of Health Anxiety and Cancer Information Overload.
authors: Peng W, Occa A
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) screening remains underused, in part because screening-related stressors can elicit fear, embarrassment, and other emotional barriers. Guided by the process model of emotion regulation, this study examined whether humor-based interventions engage cognitive reappraisal of CRC screening stressors and whether these reappraisal processes support screening intention. In a randomized experiment with 180 U.S. adults aged 45-75, participants received pre-crafted humor messages (PHM), completed self-generated humor tasks (SHT), or viewed an emotionally neutral control. Humorous and serious reappraisal were tested as parallel mediators, with health anxiety (HA) and cancer information overload (CIO) examined as moderators. Both PHM and SHT increased humorous reappraisal relative to control, and humorous reappraisal linked each intervention to stronger screening intention. Serious reappraisal did not mediate either intervention overall. Moderated mediation analyses showed that HA strengthened SHT's indirect effect through humorous reappraisal, whereas CIO strengthened SHT's indirect effect through serious reappraisal. The corresponding moderated pathways were not significant for PHM. These findings identify reappraisal as a pathway linking humor interventions with screening intention and suggest that self-generated humor may engage different reappraisal processes under heightened health-focused attention and information overload.
cn_title: 幽默干预促进结直肠癌筛查意愿的重评路径及健康焦虑与信息过载的调节作用
insight: 幽默干预通过认知重评提升肠癌筛查意愿，且受健康焦虑与信息过载调节，为筛查依从性干预提供心理机制依据，但与肝转移诊疗关联有限。
grade_rationale: 随机实验设计但样本仅180人、为心理学沟通干预且非临床结局，实践改变潜力有限。

authors: Kabadayı Ensarioğlu H, Becer E, Çalış İ, Kıyak N, Vatansever HS
abstract: LPS-induced inflammation plays a key role in colorectal cancer progression. This study investigates how 6,3'-disinapoyl-sucrose (DSS) from
cn_title: 6,3'-双芥子酰蔗糖抑制LPS诱导炎症抗结直肠癌
insight: 揭示天然蔗糖酯DSS经抗炎通路抑制肠癌进展，为炎症相关肠癌及肝转移提供潜在先导化合物，但尚需体内与临床验证。

title: Risk of second primary malignancies in older long-term survivors of breast, prostate, colon, and rectal cancer.
authors: Kwaramba T, Westvold S, Long JB, Hyslop T, Silber A, Yasin F, et al.
journal: Journal of the National Cancer Institute
abstract: Cancer survivors face an increased risk of second primary malignancies (SPMs). Understanding SPM incidence and risk factors is crucial for long-term survivorship care. This was a SEER-Medicare retrospective cohort study of breast, prostate, colon, or rectal cancer survivors diagnosed between 2003-2011 at age 66+ years who survived ≥5 years post-diagnosis. The primary outcome was a 'late' SPM, defined as invasive cancer occurring ≥5 years after initial diagnosis. Restricted mean survival time (RMST) regression was used to assess demographic, clinical, and treatment related factors associated with late SPMs. SPMs were categorized as hematologic, screen-detectable (breast, prostate, lung, colon, or rectal), or non-screen detectable solid tumors. Of 90,261 long-term survivors, 11.2% (10,116) developed at least one late SPM. The cumulative incidence of late SPMs over 8 years was highest in prostate cancer survivors. Non-screen detectable cancers composed the largest proportion (47.8%) of 10,220 total late SPMs. The most common late SPM site was lung in colon (14.9%), and rectal (16.1%) cancer survivors, urinary bladder in prostate (17.0%), and new-primary breast cancers in breast cancer survivors (36.5%). In RMST regression, significant associations with demographic, index cancer, treatment, and clinical characteristics and late SPMs ranged from 3.6 months shorter to 4.4 months longer time without late SPM during the 8 years assessed. Between 10-14% of older long-term cancer survivors developed a late SPM during 5-13 years after index cancer diagnosis. Over 40% of late SPMs were screen-detectable, highlighting the need for surveillance strategies beyond 5 years from index cancer diagnosis.
cn_title: 老年乳腺癌、前列腺癌、结肠癌和直肠癌长期幸存者第二原发恶性肿瘤风险
insight: 老年肠癌长期幸存者中第二原发恶性肿瘤（SPM）发生率约11%，且肺癌为最常见部位，提示需加强5年后的肺癌筛查与监测。
grade_rationale: 基于SEER-Medicare大样本回顾性队列，证据等级中等，可为监测策略提供依据但非直接改变实践。

title: Healthcare providers' perspectives on implementing a primary care-based initiative to increase equitable bowel cancer screening participation in Australia.
authors: Jiang J, Zou E, Huang L, McIntosh J, Jenkins M, Wilson C
abstract: Bowel cancer is the fifth most common cancer in Australia and the second leading cause of cancer-related death. Although the National Bowel Cancer Screening Program mails test kits to eligible Australians, uptake remains suboptimal, particularly among underserved populations. The Alternative Access Model (AAM) is a primary care-based strategy through which healthcare providers (HCPs) distribute kits directly to eligible patients, enabling practitioner endorsement and patient navigation. This study explored HCPs' perceptions of the acceptability, feasibility, barriers, and enablers of implementing the AAM in general practices serving ethnically and socioeconomically diverse populations. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with primary HCPs in Melbourne, Australia. Nine general practice clinics participated in a two-phase study. Thirty-seven interviews were conducted with general practitioners (n = 13), practice nurses (n = 15), and practice managers (n = 9). Data were analysed using NVivo 15. Most participants (89%) were unfamiliar with the AAM. Once explained, the model was perceived as acceptable because it aligns with primary care's preventive role; however, implementation would be feasible only if barriers such as lack of financial incentives, system integration, and maintenance are addressed and provided. Improving equitable access requires more than making screening kits available. Tailored, culturally responsive, multi-faceted resources that could address perceived low bowel health literacy and cultural beliefs about screening, along with practitioners' endorsement and encouragement, and enhanced patient navigation within primary care are perceived having potential benefits in supporting more equitable bowel cancer screening participation among underserved populations.

title: Integrated bioinformatics analysis of prognostic significance and molecular regulation of mitochondrial metabolism-related genes in colorectal cancer.
authors: Li X, Zhang K, Liu T, Liu L, He H, Xu Z, et al.
abstract: The development and progression of colorectal cancer (CRC) are closely associated with metabolic reprogramming, in which mitochondrial metabolism is critically associated with tumor cell survival and proliferation. This study aims to provide novel insights for mitochondrial metabolism-related genes (MMRGs)-based prognosis prediction, biomarker discovery, and the development of targeted therapeutic strategies in CRC. Based on multi-omics data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) (including single-cell RNA-seq), we systematically analyzed MMRGs through differential expression screening, functional enrichment, least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression modeling, and independent validation, supplemented by cell-cell communication, immune infiltration, drug sensitivity, and regulatory network analyses. We identified 7 major cell types and uncovered the immune microenvironment characteristics in CRC patients. We constructed a novel MMRGs-centric prognostic signature (CD36/ACOX1) validated in TCGA and GEO cohorts, effectively stratifying patients into distinct risk groups with significant survival differences. The risk model demonstrated independent prognostic value, correlated with distinct immune landscapes and genomic features. Regulatory network analysis revealed miRNA/TF interactions targeting CD36/ACOX1, while drug sensitivity screening identified 81 therapeutic agents with enhanced efficacy in high-risk patients. Pseudotime trajectory analysis further uncovered novel B-cell differentiation dynamics associated with prognostic gene expression. The mitochondrial metabolic signature CD36/ACOX1 enables robust survival stratification in CRC. This clinically applicable model informs tumor microenvironment dynamics and precision oncology frameworks for CRC.

title: Targeting neuronal pentraxin 1 microRNA-492 exerts pro-tumorigenic effects in colorectal cancer through stimulation of proliferation, migration, and invasion.
authors: Zhang JY, Yu QZ, Wei W, Qiu JM, Gu YL, Wan C
abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most common cancer types affecting both men and women. MicroRNA-492 (miR-492) plays an important role in the development of various malignant tumors; however, its specific role and related mechanisms in CRC remain unclear. Therefore, we aimed to explore the relationship between miR-492 and the prognosis of patients with CRC, as well as the specific mechanisms involved in CRC development. The Gene Expression Omnibus and The Cancer Genome Atlas datasets were downloaded to analyze the relationship between the miR-492 expression level and the overall survival of patients with CRC. Forty-four pairs of primary CRC tissues and paired normal tissues were collected. The relationship between the miR-492 expression level and clinicopathological parameters of patients with CRC was analyzed using statistical methods. MiRNA quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) was used to detect miR-492 expression levels in CRC tissues and cell lines. 3-(4,5-Dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyl tetrazolium bromide and colony-formation assays were performed to assess cell growth and proliferation, respectively. Transwell assays were performed to analyze the migration and invasion potential of CRC cells. The interaction between miR-492 and 3' untranslated regions (3'-UTRs) of neuronal pentraxin 1 (NPTX1) was evaluated using a luciferase reporter assay. The expression of NPTX1 in CRC tissues and cells was detected by qRT-PCR. Low expression of miRNA-492 in CRC tissues is closely associated with patients' survival prognosis. miR-492 can recognize the 3'-UTR of NPTX1 mRNA and directly target and regulate NPTX1 expression, thereby promoting the growth, migration, and invasion of CRC cells. The ability of miR-492 to mediate the biological behavior of CRC by targeting NPTX1 is associated with poor prognosis and suggests that miR-492 is a potential therapeutic candidate for CRC.
cn_title: miR-492靶向NPTX1促进结直肠癌增殖、迁移和侵袭

grade_rationale: 基础机制研究，仅44对组织及公共数据库分析，无外部验证或临床干预，实践改变潜力低。

title: Mesenteric vascular variations and Henle's trunk anatomy in right colon cancer surgery: implications for complete mesocolic excision and D2 lymphadenectomy.
authors: Deflaoui T, Derkaoui A, Amara R, Ziani H, Nasri S, Skiker I, et al.
abstract: Complete mesocolic excision (CME) with central lymphadenectomy represents the oncologic standard for right colon cancer surgery. However, vascular anatomical variability particularly involving the superior mesenteric vessels and Henle's gastrocolic trunk may substantially increase operative complexity and hemorrhagic risk. This study aimed to evaluate mesenteric vascular variations systematically and to analyze their implications for the quality and safety of CME/D2 right hemicolectomy. A retrospective descriptive single-center study was conducted at a tertiary referral university hospital. A total of 250 consecutive patients who underwent oncologic right hemicolectomy for histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the right colon between January 2020 and January 2025 were included. Clinical, radiological, operative, pathological, and postoperative data were analyzed. Mesenteric vascular anatomy was evaluated using CT angiography (available in 51.2% of cases) and correlated with intraoperative observations. The study was reported according to the STROBE criteria. The mean patient age was 64.5 ± 11.2 years (range 28-89) with slight female predominance (55.2%). Complicated presentations (obstruction, perforation, hemorrhage) occurred in 31.2% of cases. CT angiography was available for 128/250 patients (51.2%); its incomplete use was primarily attributable to emergency/complicated presentations (41.0% of the 122 non-angiography cases), resource/protocol constraints (34.4%), and adequate standard CT for planning (24.6%). The ileocolic and middle colic arteries were invariably present. The right colic artery was absent in 35.2% of patients, with variable origins when present. Henle's trunk was identified in 59.2% of patients, with three distinct venous configurations characterized. Open surgery was performed in 67.2% of cases. No major intraoperative vascular injury was recorded. Adequate lymph node harvest (≥12 nodes) was achieved in all patients (mean 24.6 ± 6.8 nodes). Anastomotic leakage occurred in 2.4% and 30-day mortality in 0.8%. Mesenteric vascular variations are the rule rather than the exception during right colon cancer surgery. Preoperative CT angiography with vascular reconstruction appears to facilitate operative planning and anatomical orientation during CME/D2 lymphadenectomy. Standardized vascular-oriented dissection may improve oncologic quality while minimizing vascular complications.

title: Gut microbiota profile and response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in patients with rectal cancer: a systematic review.
authors: de Aguiar LS, Echeverria LS, Genaro LM, Rodrigues BAG, de Paula Pessoa Bezerra M, Costa FO, et al.
abstract: Rectal cancer (RC) accounts for approximately 30% of all colorectal cancers, with pathological complete response (pCR) rates following neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) ranging from 10-15% and reaching up to 38% with total neoadjuvant therapy. The intestinal microbiota has emerged as a potential modulator of treatment efficacy, offering opportunities for patient stratification and personalized therapy. This review aimed to the best of our knowledge, no robust systematic review has focused on the microbiota profile as a biomarker of response to nCRT in RC. Most studies focus on the effect of the microbiota on the adjuvant response to chemotherapy. To synthesize the available evidence and fill the gap in knowledge on the role of the intestinal microbiota in modulating treatment response and prognosis in patients with RC undergoing nCRT. This systematic review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251174787). A comprehensive search was conducted across PubMed, PubMed Central (PMC), Virtual Health Library (BVS), Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, and Cochrane Library. Studies evaluating the association between the intestinal microbiota and treatment response or prognosis in adult patients with RC were included. Two independent reviewers selected studies, and data were extracted from eligible studies. Seventeen studies were included, all published after 2020, with 11 published between 2023 and 2025. Most studies originated from China (11/17). Sequencing methodologies included 16S rRNA sequencing (9 studies), shotgun metagenomics (6 studies), RNA-sequencing (2 studies), and whole-exome sequencing with Path-seq (1 study). A total of 868 patients were evaluated. Alpha-diversity did not differ significantly between responders and non-responders in most studies. Beta-diversity results were heterogeneous. Responders were associated with genera such as The intestinal microbiota may play a relevant role in modulating response to nCRT in RC, particularly through functional metabolic pathways rather than taxonomic composition alone. Predictive models based on microbial signatures show promising accuracy, although standardization of methodologies and validation in diverse populations are needed before clinical implementation.

title: Artificial intelligence in colonoscopy for colorectal cancer prevention: a comprehensive narrative review of technology, evidence and clinical implementation.
authors: Sharma A, Kumar H, Sisodia R, Bharadwaj HR, Mohamed I, Alsakarneh S, et al.
abstract: Adenoma miss rates (AMRs) reduce the effectiveness of colonoscopy in preventing colorectal cancer (CRC). Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are being developed to address this limitation. This article reviews current evidence on their performance, prevention potential, real-world implementation, and cost-effectiveness, while offering practical guidance for gastroenterologists. A comprehensive literature search was conducted across PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase and Cochrane Library databases from January 2015 to February 2026. All studies focusing on AI on colonoscopy and major society position statements were all included. Evidence was synthesized thematically with critical appraisal and clinical contextualization. Pooled data from meta-analyses confirms an approximately 20% relative increase in adenoma detection rate (ADR) and an approximately 50% relative reduction in AMR with computer-aided detection (CADe). ENDOANGEL demonstrated the highest efficacy in one network meta-analysis [odds ratio (OR) 1.84], followed by EndoAID (OR 1.64), though system rankings vary across analyses and should be interpreted with caution. Benefits are most prominent with diminutive early lesions, with limited impact on advanced adenomas or serrated lesions. A significant efficacy-effectiveness gap can however be seen between trial and real-world settings, driven by alert fatigue, Hawthorne effects, and endoscopist variability. Cost-effectiveness has been demonstrated in modeling studies conducted in European and American settings, with incremental cost-effectiveness ratios (ICERs) ranging from EUR 23,000 to USD 122,539 per quality-adjusted life-year (QALY) depending on the healthcare context. Implementation barriers remain substantial, consisting of organizational, technical, educational, and equity factors. AI systems have demonstrated measurable improvements in adenoma detection metrics in controlled trial settings; however, current evidence is insufficient to support a definitive conclusion about enhanced colonoscopy quality, and guidelines reflect ongoing uncertainty given uncertainty about long-term outcomes, real-world effectiveness and the balance of benefits with harms. Prospective trials with cancer incidence endpoints are essential to guide wider adoption.

title: Myeloid control of dendritic cell priming after mechanical HIFU in colorectal cancer: implications for PD-1/PD-L1 blockade.
authors: Liao Y, Yang X, Du X
abstract: Mechanical high-intensity focused ultrasound releases tumor antigens and danger signals. It provides a potential substrate for immune checkpoint blockade. However, antigen release does not necessarily generate productive dendritic cell priming. In colorectal cancer, this transition occurs within a mucosal microenvironment shaped by epithelial barrier integrity, microbial exposure and myeloid clearance. Neutrophils can support epithelial repair or reinforce tumor-associated suppression. Macrophages remove apoptotic granulocytes and regulate inflammatory resolution. They can also restrain dendritic cell cytokine production. These context-dependent functions may determine whether mechanically released antigens initiate cytotoxic immunity or enter a nonproductive clearance response. This mini review integrates intestinal myeloid homeostasis with experimental evidence for mechanical ultrasound ablation and PD-1/PD-L1 blockade. It distinguishes antigen uptake from cross-presentation, protective resolution from tumor-permissive suppression, and colorectal evidence from observations in other tumor models. Functional dendritic cell readouts, lineage-resolved checkpoint measurements and concurrent barrier assessment provide a framework for evaluating combination therapy. The therapeutic objective is to preserve mucosal protection while sustaining antigen-specific immunity.

title: Macrophage states and immunometabolic adaptation in peritoneal metastases from colorectal cancer.
authors: Chen W, Wei J, Wang Y, Sun L, Ye Y, Sun K
abstract: Immunotherapy responses in colorectal cancer peritoneal metastases (CRCPM) are not determined by mismatch repair (MMR) status alone. Most MMR-proficient/microsatellite-stable (pMMR/MSS) tumors have low baseline sensitivity, while MMR-deficient/microsatellite instability-high (dMMR/MSI-H) tumors do not respond uniformly, particularly in patients with ascites. This Mini Review compares evidence across compartments and disease stages: human associations, macrophage-resolved functional studies and interventions altering immunotherapy efficacy in mice. title: Mechanisms of immune resistance in microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer.
authors: Niu D, Liu P, Chen X, Li J, Sun Z, Kuang Z, et al.
abstract: Microsatellite-stable (MSS) colorectal cancer (CRC) accounts for approximately 85% of all CRC cases and exhibits limited responsiveness to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), representing a major challenge in current cancer immunotherapy. At the tumor-cell intrinsic level, low tumor mutational burden (TMB), impaired neoantigen generation, aberrant activation of oncogenic pathways such as WNT/β-catenin signaling, and defects in interferon-γ signaling contribute to impaired immune recognition and immune escape. Within the TME, the accumulation of immunosuppressive populations, including regulatory T cells (Tregs), myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), and tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), together with extracellular matrix remodeling and chemokine dysregulation, establishes an immune-excluded microenvironment that restricts effective antitumor immune responses. Furthermore, metabolic alterations, including enhanced glycolysis, lactate accumulation, and amino acid metabolic reprogramming, impair immune cell function and promote immunosuppression. Epigenetic modifications, including DNA methylation, histone remodeling, and non-coding RNA regulation, further contribute to the silencing of immune-related genes and reinforcement of immune evasion. In addition, recent advances in single-cell sequencing and spatial transcriptomics have provided unprecedented insights into the cellular heterogeneity and spatial organization of MSS CRC immune ecosystems. This review summarizes current knowledge regarding the molecular and cellular mechanisms driving immune resistance in MSS CRC and discusses future therapeutic opportunities for transforming immunologically "cold" MSS tumors into responsive immune microenvironments.

grade_rationale: 综述性文章，无原始数据或临床试验，但系统整合机制研究，对免疫治疗策略开发有参考价值，暂不改变临床实践。
